text.body:
atha dīkṣāprayogaḥ prakāśyate |
tatrādau bhaktiyuktaḥ śiṣyaḥ prathamadine kṣaurādikaṃ vidhāya śarīraśuddhyarthaṃ tīrthādau snātvā gāyatrīsahasraṃ prajapya haviṣyaṃ sakṛdbhuktvā dvitīyadine kṛtopavāsastṛtīyadivase kṛtanityakriyo vastrālaṅkārādibhirdehamalaṅkṛtya vighnanivāraṇārthaṃ svagṛhe gaṇeśamabhyarcya puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā nāndīśrāddhaṃ ca vidhāya yathoktavaraṇasambhārānādāya pañcavādyapuraḥsaraṃ gurugṛhaṃ gacchet | tatra ca hastau pādau prakṣālya kṛtāñjalirbhaktinamraḥ(-)
bhagavan paramātmarūpin paramakāruṇika śrīguro sakalapuruṣārthasādhanamahāmantrapradānena māmanugṛhṇīṣva(-)
ityuktvā guruṃ sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇamya tadājñayā praṅmukha udaṅmukho vā'sane upaviśya kuśatrayatilajalānyādāgra svastivācanapūrvakaṃ saṃkalpaṃ kuryāt |
tadyathā(-)
oṃ viṣṇurviṣṇuḥ | oṃ adyetyādi (-) amukagotrotpanno'mukadevaśarmā dharmārthakāmamokṣaprāptikāmaḥ śrīmadamukadevatāthā amukamantradīkṣāmahaṃ kariṣye (-) iti saṃkalpya guruṃ vṛṇuyāt |
tadyathā(-)
oṃ sādhu bhavānāstāt (-) iti śiṣyo vadet | oṃ sādhvahamāse (-) iti guruḥ | oṃ arcayiṣyāmo bhavantam (-) iti śiṣyaḥ | oṃ arcaya (-) iti guruḥ |
tataḥ śiṣyaḥ(-)
śrīgurave namaḥ (-) iti mantreṇa gurave āsanaṃ datvā tenaiva mantreṇa pādyādibhirgandhapuṣpadhūpadīpavastrālaṅkaraṇādibhiśca gurumabhyarcya dakṣiṇajānuṃ bhūmau dhṛtvā paṭhet(-)
oṃ adyetyādi (-) amukagotrotpanno'mukadevaśarmā dharmārtha (****************)(?) devatāyā amukamantra(-)
grahaṇāyāmukagotramamukapravaramamukavedādhyāyinamamukadevaśar(-)māṇamebhiḥ pādyādibhirarcitaṃ bhavantaṃ gurutvenāhaṃ vṛṇe |
oṃ vṛto'smi (-) iti prativacanam |
punarbaddhāñjalinā(-)
oṃ adyetyādi (-) amukamantradīkṣākarmaṇi tvamācāryā bhava | oṃ bhavāmi (-) iti prativacanam | bhagavan śrīguro yathāvihitaṃ karma kuru (-) iti śiṣyo vadet | yathājñānataḥ karavāṇi (-) iti prativacanam |
tataḥ śiṣyo gurave namaskāraṃ kuryāt | tathā tato'vaśiṣṭāṃ varaṇasāmagrīṃ gurave nivedya taccaraṇau praṇamya tadājñayā ṛtvijo vṛṇuyāt | tadyathoktopacārairuktaprakāreṇa ca tān pratyekamabhyarcya paṭhet(-)
oṃ adyetyādi (-) amukagotrotpanno'mukadevaśarmā caturvargaphala(-)prāptikāmaḥ śrīmadamukadevatāyā matkarttṛkāmukamantradīkṣā(-)karmaṇyamukagotramamukapravaramamukavedādhyāyinasamukaśarmāṇamebhiḥ pādyādibhirarcitaṃ bhavantamṛtviktevanāhaṃ vṛṇe |
oṃ vṛto'smi (-) iti prativacanam | yathāvihitaṃ karma kuru (-) iti śiṣyaḥ | yathājñānataḥ karavāṇi (-) iti prativacanam |
evamaṣṭau ṛtvijaḥ pratyekaṃ vṛṇuyāt | tataḥ karmopayuktasāmagrīṃ tebhyo datvā tān praṇamet | tato guruḥ śiṣyeṇa ṛtvigbhiśca sahito yāgamaṇḍapaṃ gatvā taddvāri upaviśya dantakāṣṭhaparīkṣāṃ kuryāt | pāyasabhojanānantarameva dantakāṣṭhaparīkṣā kartavyā | (*) karttavyā (-) iti eṣāṃ mataistu tasminneva kāle karttavyā |
sā yathā(-)
aśvatthodumbaravaṭaplakṣādikṣīravṛkṣasambhavaṃ dvādaśāṅgulapramāṇaṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ deyamūlamantreṇābhimantrya guruḥ śiṣyāya dadyāt |
śiṣyo'pi hastau pādau prakṣālyācamya guruṃ natvā taddantakāṣṭhamādāya dantān viśodhya vālukādinirmite hastamātre caturasrasthaṇḍile dantakāṣṭhaṃ tyaktvā śuddhajalena gaṇḍūṣapūrvakamācamanaṃ kuryāt | tato guruḥ pūrvādidikpatitadantakāṣṭhāgramālokya śubhāśubhaphalāni vicārayet |
yathā(-)
dantakāṣṭhāgre pūrvadikpatite aiśvaryalābhaḥ | āgneyadikpatite hṛdayasantāpaḥ dakṣiṇadikpatite bandhunāśaḥ | rakṣodikpatite maraṇam | paścimadikpatite śokaḥ | vāyavīyadikpatite vyagratā uttaradikpatite saukhyam | īśānadikpatite ca jñānalābha iti phalaṃ vicārya aśubhadikpatite tu tajjanyadoṣanivāraṇārtham(-) phaṭ amukadoṣaṃ jahi 2 phaṭ svāhā (-) iti mantreṇāṣṭottarasahasrasaṃkhyākamaṣṭottaraśatasaṃkhyākaṃ vā homamājyane kuryāt | tato gururmaṇḍapadvāradeśe āsane upaviśya ācamanaprāṇāyāmau vidhāya sāmānyārghasthāpanaṃ kuryāt |
tadyathā(-)
astrajalena bhūmiṃ saṃprokṣya trikoṇavṛttacaturasramaṇḍalaṃ vilikhya(-)
oṃ ādhāraśaktaye namaḥ (-) iti maṇḍalaṃ saṃpūjya tadupari ādhāraṃ
saṃsthāpya(-)
ra(/) vahnimaṇḍalāya daśakalātmane namaḥ (-) ityādhāraṃ saṃpūjya(-) phaṭ (-) iti mantreṇārghapātraṃ prakṣālyādhāropari saṃsthāpya(-) a(/) sūryamaṇḍalāya dvādaśakalātmane namaḥ (-) ityarghapātraṃ saṃpūjya(-) namaḥ (-) iti jalenāpūrya(-) sa(/) somamaṇḍalāya ṣoḍaśakalātmane namaḥ (-) iti jalaṃ saṃpūjya tasmin jale(-)
oṃ gaṅge ca yamune caiva godāvari sarasvati | narmade sindhukāveri jale'smin sannidhiṃ kuru || 5-1 ||
ityaṅkuśamudrayā sūryamaṇḍalāt tīrthamāvāhya praṇavena gandhapuṣpaṃ nidhāya tenaiva saṃpūjya tenaivāṣṭadhā daśadhā vā'bhimantrya dhenumudrāṃ pradarśayet |
tatastajjalena(-)
phaṭ (-) iti dvāramabhyukṣya dvārapūjāṃ kuryāt |
tadyathā(-)
oṃ (*****)(?) namaḥ (-) iti dāramyo(?)rdhvodumbare |
ma(/) mahālakṣmyai namaḥ (-) iti taddakṣiṇe | sa(/) sarasvatyai namaḥ (-) iti tadvāme | dvāraśriyai namaḥ (-) iti madhye |
dvārasya dakṣiṇaśākhāyāṃ vāmaśākhāyāṃ cordhvabhāgādārabhya talaparyantametā dvāradevatāḥ pūjayet |
tadyathā(-)
ga(/) gaṇapataye namaḥ (-) iti dakṣiṇe | kṣa(/) kṣetrapālāya namaḥ (-) iti vāme | śa(/) vasundharāyuktāya śaṅkhanidhaye namaḥ (-) iti punardakṣiṇe | pa(/) vasumatiyuktāya padmanidhaye namaḥ (-) iti vāme | ma(/) māyāśaktaye namaḥ (-) iti dakṣiṇe | ca(/) cicchaktaye namaḥ (-) iti vāme | ga(/) gaṅgāyai namaḥ (-) iti dakṣiṇe | ya(/) yamunāyai namaḥ (-) iti vāme | dha(/) dhātre namaḥ (-) iti dakṣiṇe | va(/) vidhātre namaḥ (-) iti vāme | da(/) dehalyai namaḥ a(/) astrāya namaḥ (-) iti vā dehalyām |
evaṃ paścimadvāramārabhya pratidvāraṃ saṃpūjya dvārapālān pūjayet | tatra viśeṣaśivapūjāyām(-)
nandimahākālagaṇeśavṛṣabhṛṅgiskandabhavānīcaṇḍeśvarān(-)
paścimadvāramārabhya pratidvāraṃ krameṇa dvau dvau pūjayet | eṣāṃ pūjane mantrastu(-)
na(/) nandine namaḥ (-) ityādi | viṣṇupūjāyām(-)
nandasunandacaṇḍapracaṇḍabalaprabalabhadrasubhadrākhyān(-)
gaṇeśapūjāyām(-)
vakratuṇḍaikadaṃṣṭramahodaragajānanalambodaravikaṭavighnarājadhū(-)mravarṇān (-) pūjayet |
sūryapūjāyāṃ devīpūjāyāṃ ca(-)
brāhmīmāheśvarīkaumārīvaiṣṇavīvārāhīndrāṇīcāmuṇḍāmahā(-)lakṣmīḥ (-) pūjayet |
tripurādipūjāyāṃ tu(-)
gaṇeśakṣetrapālavaṭukayoginīgaṅgāyamunālakṣmīsarasvatīḥ(-) pūjayediti | tato deyamantreṇa divyadṛṣṭyā'valokanān divyān vighnānutsārya(-)
astrāya phaṭ (-) iti jalakṣepeṇāntarikṣagān vighnānutsārya tenaiva mantreṇa tribhirvāmapārṣṇighātairbhaumān vighnānutsārayet |
tato dakṣiṇāṅgaṃ kiñcat saṃkocya dvārasya vāmaśāstrāṃ spṛśatrutsāritabhūtānāṃ nirgamanārthaṃ dakṣiṇamārgaṃ dadaddakṣiṇapādapuraḥsaraṃ maṇḍapāntaḥ praviśet | vāmamārge tu śaktivāmapādapuraḥsaraṃ maṇḍapāntaḥpraveśaḥ | tathaiva strīkartṛkadīkṣāyāmapi |
tato nair(-)ṛtyāṃ diśi(-)
oṃ vāstupuruṣāya vāstvadhīśāya brahmaṇe namaḥ(-)
iti puṣpākṣataiḥ saṃpūjya praṇamya pañcagavyasāmānyārghatoyābhyāṃ maṇḍapābhyantaraṃ saṃprokṣya saṃskāracatuṣṭayaṃ kuryāt |
tadyathā(-)
mūlamantraṃ (-) samuccaran maṇḍapābhyantaraṃ paśyet | phaṭ (-) iti sāmānyārghajalena tatprokṣaṇaṃ kuryāt | tenaiva mantreṇa darbhaistāḍayet | hu(/) (-) iti mantreṇa ciñcet |
tataḥ śrīkhaṇḍāgurukarpūrādidhūpena maṇḍapābhyantaraṃ pradhūpya lājācandanasiddhārthabhasmadūrvākuśākṣatāniti sapta vikirānekīkṛtya(-)
phaṭ (-) ityastramantreṇa saptadhā'bhimantrya(-)
oṃ apasarpantu te bhūtā ye bhūtā bhuvi saṃsthitāḥ | ye (**)(?) vighnakarttāraste(?) naśyanta śivājñayā || 5-2 ||
iti tridhā vikiret | tatastān vikirānastramantramuccaran darbhamuṣṭinā saṃmārjya vardhanyāsanadhya(?)mīśānakoṇe puñjīkṛtya sthāpayet | tataḥ puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā viprān santoṣya(-)
oṃ dīpanāthabhairavāya namaḥ (-) iti tannāmakaṃ bhairavaṃ saṃpūjya baddhāñjaliḥ prārthayet |
tasmin kṣetre dīpanātha nirvighnasiddhihetave | dīkṣāyāgasamṛddhyarthamanujñāṃ dātumarhasi || 5-3 ||
atitīkṣṇa mahākāya kalpāntadahanopam | bhairavāya namastubhyamanujñāṃ dātumarhasi (-) || 5-4 ||
ityanuśāmādāya(-)
phaṭ (-) iti mantramuccaran vedikopari gatvā vedikāyāṃ mṛdā caturasraṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ nirmāya tadupari sarvatobhadramaṇḍalaṃ vilikhya pūjopakaraṇāni yathāsthānaṃ niveśyāsanamāstīrya vāmabhāgasthajalapātramādāya jalaśodhanaṃ kuryāt |
tadyathā(-)
ya(/) (-) iti vāyubījena saṃśodhya(-) ra(/) (-) ityagnibījena saṃdahya(-) va(/) (-) iti varuṇabījenāplāvya(-)
prāyatryā saṃprokṣya dhenumudrayā'mṛtīkṛtya tena jalena(-)
oṃ ātmatattvāya svāhā(,) oṃ vidyātattvāya svāhā(,) oṃ śivatattvāya svāhā (-) iti trirācamya(-) astrāya phaṭ (-) ityāsanaṃ saṃprokṣya tadupari aṣṭadalakamalaṃ vilikhya(-) pṛthivyā merupṛṣṭha ṝṣiḥ sutalaṃ chandaḥ kūrmo devatā āsanaparigrahe viniyogaḥ |
āsanaṃ dhṛtvā(-)
oṃ pṛthvi tvayā dhṛtā lokā devi tvaṃ viṣṇunā dhṛtā |
hrī(/) ādhāraśaktikamalāsanāya namaḥ (-) ityāsanaṃ saṃpūjya tadupari ātmamantramuccaran svastikapadmāsanādikrameṇopaviśya saṃkalpaṃ kuryāt |
yathā(-)
oṃ adyetyādi (-) amukadevaśarmā'mukagotro'mukaśarmakartṛkā(-)mukadevatāyā amukamantradīkṣākarmaṇi yathāsambhavopacārairamukadevatāyāḥ pūjāmahaṃ kariṣye (-) iti saṃkalpaḥ | oṃ hrā(/) hrī(/) saḥ sagraharāśinakṣatrayogakaraṇaparivṛtāsanasthita(-)śrīsūryāya eṣa te'rghaḥ svāhā (-) iti sūryārghaṃ datvā pūjādravyāṇi saṃskuryāt |
tadyathā (-) nārācamudrāṃ baddhvā(-)
hrā(/) hu(/) phaṭ (-) iti mantramuccaran gandhapuṣpanaivedyādīni samadṛṣṭyā vilokayet | ra(/) (-) iti mantreṇa dīpaśikhāṃ spṛśet |
tataḥ(-)
au(/) bījamuccaran devatīrthena jalaṃ saṃspṛśya jalapātraṃ vāmahastena dhṛtvā(-) ja(/) jalādhārapātrāya namaḥ (-) iti mantraṃ paṭhet |
tataḥ śirasyañjalimādhāya vāme(-)
oṃ gurubhyo namaḥ oṃ paramagurubhyo namaḥ oṃ parāparagurubhyo namaḥ (-) iti gurutrayaṃ natvā dakṣiṇe(-) ga(/) gaṇapataye namaḥ (-) madhye (-) amukadevatāyai namaḥ (-) iti praṇamya (-)
akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākāraṃ vyāptaṃ yena carācaram || 5-5 ||
tatpadaṃ darśitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ |
iti guruṃ punarnatvā karaśuddhiṃ kuryāt |
yathā(-)
hsau(/)ḥ (-) iti mantreṇa candanāktaṃ puṣpamādāya(-)
phaṭ (-) iti mantreṇa karābhyāṃ saṃmardya tat puṣpaṃ vāmahastenādāya śirasi paribhrāmya praṇavaṃ japannāghrāya(-)
hau(/) oṃ te sarve vilayaṃ yāntu ye māṃ hisanti hiṃsakāḥ || 5-6 ||
mṛtyurogabhayakleśāḥ patantu ripumastake (-) iti paṭhitvā (-) phaṭ (-) iti mantreṇa nārācamudrayā īśāne tyajet |
tato'stramantreṇa ūrdhvordhvakrameṇa tālatrayapuraḥsaraṃ choṭikābhirdaśadigbandhanaṃ vidhāya tajjanitatejo vahniprākāramudrayā saṃrakṣya mūlena tadbījena praṇavena vā prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā bhūtaśuddhiṃ kuryāt |
yathā (-) svāṅke uttānau karau kṛtvā(-)
so'ham (-) iti jīvātmānaṃ pradīpakalikākāraṃ hṛtpadmāsanamūlādhārasthitakuṇḍalinyā saha suṣumṇāvartmanā mūlādhārasvādhiṣṭhānamaṇipūrakānāhataviśuddhājñākhyaṃṣaṭ-cakrāṇi bhittvā śiro'vasthitādhomukhasahasradalakamalakarṇikāntargata(-)paramātmani saṃyojya tatra pṛthivyaptejovāyvākāśagandharasarūpa(-)sparśaśabdanāsikājihvācakṣustvakśrotravākpāṇipādapāyūpastha(-)prakṛtimanobuddhyahaṅkārākhyāni caturviṃśatitattvāni uktakrameṇa līnāni vibhāvya(-)
ya(/) (-) iti vāyubījaṃ dhūmravarṇaṃ vāmanāsāpuṭe vicintya tasya ṣoḍaśavārajapena vāyunā dehamāpūrya nāsāpuṭau dhṛtvā pañcāśadvārajapena catuḥṣaṣṭivārajapena vā kumbhakaṃ kṛtvā vāmakukṣisthakṛṣṇavarṇapāpapuruṣeṇa saha dehaṃ saṃśodhya pañcāśadvārajapena dvātriṃśadvārajapena vā dakṣanāsayā vāyuṃ recayet | evamagre'pi saṃkhyāvikalpo bodhyaḥ |
tato dakṣanāsāpuṭe(-)
ra(/) (-) iti vahnibījaṃ raktavarṇaṃ dhyātvā tasya ṣoḍaśavārajapena dehamāpūrya nāsāpuṭau dhṛtvā catuḥṣaṣṭivārajapena kumbhakaṃ kṛtvā pāpena saha dagdhvā tasya dvātriṃśadvārajapena vāmanāsayā bhasmanā saha vāyuṃ recayet | ṭha(/) (-) iti candrabījaṃ śuklavarṇaṃ vāmanāsikāyāṃ dhṛtvā tasya ṣoḍaśavārajapena lalāṭe candraṃ nītvā sahasraṃdalakamalakarṇikāntaṃ paramātmānaṃ candrarūpaṃ vibhāvya(-) va(/) (-) iti varuṇabījasya catuḥṣaṣṭivārajapena tasmāllalāṭacandrādgalitasudhayā mātṛkāvarṇātmikayā samastadehamāplāvya(-) la(/) (-) iti pṛthvībījasya dvātriṃśadvārajapena dehaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ vicintya dakṣiṇena
tataḥ paramātmani līnāni pañcabhūtānyuktakrameṇa yathāsthānaṃ niveśya devatārādhanayogyaṃ tejorūpaṃ dehamutpannaṃ vibhāvya(-)
haṃsaḥ (-) iti jīvātmānaṃ paramātmanaḥ samākṛṣya hṛtpadme sthāpayitvā devatārūpamātmānaṃ vicintayet | iti bhūtaśuddhiṃ vidhāya(-)
ā(/) so'haṃ mama prāṇā iha prāṇā iha sthitāḥ ā(/) so'haṃ mama jīva iha jīva iha sthitaḥ ā(/) so'haṃ mama sarvendriyāṇi vāṅmanaścakṣuḥśrotrajihvāghrāṇāni ihāgatya sukhaṃ ciraṃ tiṣṭhantu svāhā | iti svahṛdi prāṇasthāpanaṃ kṛtvā mātṛkānyāsaṃ kuryāt | yathā(-) asya śrīmātṛkāsarasvatīmantrasya brahmā ṛṣirgāyatrī chando mātṛkāsarasvatī devatā halo bījāni svarāḥ śaktayo vyaktayaḥ kīlakāni śarīraṃśuddhipuraḥsaramabhīṣṭasiddhyarthe lipinyāse viniyogaḥ | śirasi (-) brahmaṇe ṛṣaye namaḥ | mukhe (-) gāyatryai chandase namaḥ | hṛdi (-) mātṛkāsarasvatyai devatāyai namaḥ | guhye (-) halbhyo bījebhyo namaḥ | pādayoḥ (-) svarebhyaḥ śaktibhyo namaḥ | sarvāṅgeṣu (-) vyaktibhyaḥ kīlakebhyo namaḥ | lipinyāse viniyogaḥ (-) iti baddhāñjaliḥ |
tataḥ karāṅganyāsau (-)

amṛtātmakanaivedyaṃ namaḥ (-) ityuccārya dhenumudrāṃ pradarśya bhuñjānāṃ devatāṃ smṛtvā'ṣṭottaraśataṃ daśadhā vā mūlamantraṃ prajapya(-) oṃ amṛtāpidhānamasi svāhā (-) iti jalaṃ dadyāt |
tato dakṣiṇe sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇāgniṃ saṃsthāpya tasminnagnau devatāmāvāhya pādyādibhirgandhapuṣpādibhiśca saṃpūjya ghṛtayuktena pāyasena vaiśvadevākhyaṃ homaṃ kuryāt | tatra prathamaṃ sapraṇavābhirvyāhṛtibhirhutvā mūlamantreṇa pañcaviṃśatyāhutīrdadyāt | punarvyāhṛtibhirhutvā pañcopacārairdevatāṃ saṃpūjya pīṭhamūrtau tāṃ saṃyojya vahniṃ visṛjet | tataḥ śiṣṭena pāyasena(-)
oṃ amukadevatāyāḥ pārṣadebhya eṣa valirnamaḥ (-) iti pārṣadebhyo gandhapuṣpākṣatasahitaṃ valiṃ visṛjet | tato yavanikāmudghāṭya devena yatheṣṭaṃ bhuktaṃ naivedyaṃ sambhāvya naivedyapātraṃ nair(-)ṛteyadiśi saṃsthāpya naivedyasthānamastramantreṇa gomayādbhiḥ saṃśodhya devocchiṣṭaṃ kiṃcit samādāya(-)
oṃ nirmālyabhojine namaḥ (-) ityaiśānyāṃ diśi kṣipet |
tato hastau prakṣālya tāmbūlamādāya purataḥ saṃsthāpya(-)
elālavaṅgakhadiracūrṇapūgādisaṃyutam || 5-30 ||
tāmbalaṃ devadeveśa gṛhāṇa tvaṃ prasīda me (-) iti paṭhitvā(-) mūlānte(-)
amukadevatāyai idaṃ tāmbūlaṃ nivedayāmi svāhā (-) iti nivedya mūlena gandhapuṣpādibhistrivāraṃ pūjayet | tato darpaṇaṃ pradarśya chatracāmarādikaṃ nivedya śaktiviṣaye tu svakalpoktamantreṇa devatāyai māṣabhaktādibaliṃ datvā āgneyādiṣu pūrvadakṣiṇottarapaścimabhāgeṣu vā yathākramaṃ gaṇeśavaṭukakṣetrapālayoginībhyo baliṃ dadyāt |
tatra kramastu(-) maṇḍalāni kṛtvā balipātrāṇi saṃsthāpya(-)
ga(/) gaṇeśāya balimūrtaye namaḥ (-) ityādimantreṇa valiṃ saṃpūjya(-)
gā(/) gaṇeśāya namaḥ | vā(/) vaṭukāya namaḥ | kṣā(/) kṣetrapālāya namaḥ | yā(/) yoginībhyo namaḥ |
iti mantrairgandhapuṣpādibhistānabhyarcya(-)
gā(/) gī(/) gū(/) gaṇapataye vara varada sarvajanaṃ me vaśamānaya valiṃ gṛhṇa (2) svāhā (-) eṣa valirgaṇapataye namaḥ(-)
iti gaṇeśāya valiṃ datvā(-)
ehyehi devīputra vaṭukanātha kapilajaṭābhāra bhāsura trinetra jvālāmukha sarvavighnān nāśaya sarvopacārasahitaṃ valiṃ gṛhṇa (2) svāhā (-) eṣa valiṃ vaṭukāya namaḥ (-) iti vaṭukāya valiṃ datvā(-)
kṣāṃ kṣī(/) kṣū(/) kṣai(/) kṣau(/) kṣaḥ kṣetrapālāya dhūpadīpādisahitaṃ valiṃ gṛṇa (2) svāhā (-) eṣa valiḥ kṣetrapālāya namaḥ (-) iti kṣetrapālāya valiṃ datvā (-) yā(/) yoginibhyāḥ(?) namaḥ(?)
ūrdhvaṃ brahmāṇḍato vā divi gaganatale bhūtale niṣkale vā pātāle vā'nale vā salilapavanayoryatra tatra sthitā vā | kṣetre pīṭhopapīṭhādiṣu ca kṛtapadāḥ puṣpadhūpādikena prītā devyaḥ sadānaḥ śubhavidhi valinā pāntu vīrendravandyāḥ || 5-31 ||
eṣa valiryoginibhyo namaḥ (-) iti yoginībhyo valiṃ dadyāt | vaiṣṇavādau tu bhūtavalimātram | tato bhūtavaliṃ dadyāt | tadyathā(-) īśāne maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā annavyañjanapuṣpākṣatajalādiyuktaṃ sādhāraṃ valipātraṃ saṃsthāpya tatra(-)
oṃ sarvebhyo bhūtebhyo namaḥ (-) iti gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ saṃpūjya(-)
ye raudrā raudrakarmāṇo raudrasthānanivāsinaḥ | yoginyo'pyugrarūpāśca gaṇānāmadhipāśca ye || 5-32 ||
bhūcarāḥ khecarāścaiva ye tiṣṭhantyantarikṣagāḥ | sarve te prītamanaso bhūtvā gṛhṇantvimaṃ valim || 5-33 ||
iti paṭhitvā vāmahastena tatpātre jaladhārāṃ samarpya(-)
oṃ sarvebhyo bhūtebhya eṣo'nnavalirnamaḥ (-) iti dakṣahastenotsṛjet |
tataḥ puṣpāñjalimādāya prārthayet |
bhūtāni yanīha vasanti bhūtale valiṃ gṛhītvā vidhivat prayuktām | santoṣamāsādya vrajantu sarve kṣamantu tānyatra namo'stu tebhyaḥ || 5-34 ||
iti saṃprārthya puṣpāñjaliṃ datvā natvā ca(-)
bhūtāni yathāsukhaṃ viharantu (-) iti nārācamudrayā visṛjet |
tato mūlamaṣṭottarasahasraṃ prajapya(-)
guhyātiguhyagoptā tvaṃ gṛhāṇāsmatkṛtaṃ japam |
siddhirbhavatu me deva tvatprasādājjagatpate(-)
iti japaṃ nivedya yathāśakti stutvā praṇamya āsanādutthāya triḥ parikramya sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇamet | tata īśānasthe pūrvasañcitavikirapuñjeṣu suvarṇagarbhāṃ vastraveṣṭitāṃ jalapūritāṃ varddhanīṃ saṃsthāpya(-)
siṃhasthāṃ khaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇīṃ ghorarūpāṃ paścimāsyām (-) astradevatāṃ dhyātvā tasyāmāvāhya(-)
phaṭ astradevatāyai namaḥ (-) iti mantreṇa pañcopacāraiścalāsanenaiva saṃpūjya tāṃ karkarīmādāya(-)
amukadevatājñayā indrāmukadevayajanaṃ rakṣa (-) ityādisakalalokapālān bhāvayan nālādvāridhārāṃ vimocya maṇḍapābhyantaraṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya(-)
phaṭ (-) ityastramantramuccārya yathāsthānaṃ niveśayet |
tataḥ sthirāsano bhūtvā gandhādyairupacāraiḥ pūrvavat saṃpūjya praṇamet | tata ācāryaḥ svīyakuṇḍe pūrveśānamadhyasthe vidhivadagnisaṃskāraṃ kuryāt | tatrādau kuṇḍasthānamāgatyāsane upaviśya tattvatrayeṇācamya kuśatrayatilajalānyādāya saṃkalpaṃ kuryāt |
tadyathaḥ(-)
oṃ adya (-) ityādideśakālau saṃkīrtya(-) amukagotro'mukadevaśarmā'mukagotrāmukaśarmakarttṛkāmuka(-)devatāmukamantradīkṣākarmāṅgabhūtahomakarmāhaṃ kariṣye (-) iti saṃkalpya pūrvoktamantreṇa sūryārghaṃ datvā sāmānyārghaṃ saṃsthāpya kuṇḍasya vīkṣaṇādyaṣṭādaśasaṃskārān kuryāt |
tadyathā(-)
mūlamantramuccaran kuṇḍaṃ paśyediti vīkṣaṇam | phaṭ (-) ityastramantreṇa prokṣaṇam | tenaiva mantreṇa darbhaistridhā tāḍanam | hu(/) (-) iti kavacamantreṇā bhyukṣaṇam | phaṭ (-) ityastramantreṇāṅgulamānena khananam |
tenaiva mantreṇāṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ mṛttikoddharaṇam |
namaḥ (-) iti hṛnmantreṇa punarmṛttikābhiḥ pūraṇam | astramantreṇa samīkaraṇam | hu(/) (-) iti jalena secanam | phaṭ (-) iti kuṭṭanam |
taccakāṣṭhādinā hastenaiva vā dṛḍhīkaraṇam |
tataḥ(-)
hu(/) (-) iti mantreṇa kuśamuṣṭinā kuṇḍe mṛdaṃ mārjayediti mārjanam |
tenaiva mantreṇa gomayenopalayediti lepanam | tatrastenaiva mantreṇa kuṇḍamadhye somasūryāgnikalāścintayediti kalārūpakalpanam |
hu(/) (-) iti kavacamantramuccaran sūtratrayeṇa kuṇḍamekhalāstrivāraṃ veṣṭayediti trisūtrīkaraṇam |
oṃ amukakuṇḍāya namaḥ (-) iti mantreṇa kuṇḍaṃ pūjayedityarcanam |
kuṇḍārcanānantaram(-)
oṃ amukakuṇḍanābhaye namaḥ (-) oṃ amukakuṇḍamekhalābhyo namaḥ(-)
iti pūjayet |
astramantreṇa kuṇḍaṃ vajravaddṛḍhaṃ cintayediti vajrīkaraṇam | kuṇḍamadhye pūrvāgraṃ kuśaṃ nidhāya taduparyuttarāgraṃ kuśaṃ nidhāyopari viṣṭaraṃ nyasya tadupari puṣpaṃ datvā(-)
namaḥ (-) iti hṛnmantreṇa pūjayediti catuṣpathīkaraṇam |
astramantrābhimantritānacchinnāgrān kuśān mekhalāsu kavacamantramuccarannāstrareditya kṣapāṭanam | ityaṣṭādaśasaṃskārān kuryāt | aṣṭādaśasaṃskārakaraṇāśaktastu pūrvoktavīkṣaṇādisaṃskāracatuṣṭayameva kuryāt | vāmamārge tu saṃskāracatuṣṭayameva kuryāt | tataḥ kuṇḍamadhye darbhamūlena sruvamūlena vā(-)
namaḥ (-) ityuccaran prāgagrāstisro rekhā udagagrāstisro rekhā likhet |
tatra prāgagrā rekhā dakṣiṇopakramā udagapavargā udagagrāśca paścimopakramāḥ prāgapavargā iti likhanakramaḥ | atha vā trikoṇagarbhaṃ vṛttaveṣṭitaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ likhediti (śāradāyām) uktam | uktarekhāṣaṭkaṃ tādṛśaṣaṭkoṇaṃ ca likhediti (merutantre) proktam |
trikoṇamadhye lajjābījaṃ praṇavaṃ ca likhedityapi kvaciduktam |

prāgagrarekhāsu(-) udagrarekhāsu(-)
oṃ mukundāya namaḥ | oṃ brahmaṇe namaḥ | oṃ īśānāya namaḥ | oṃ vaivastāya namaḥ | oṃ purandarāya namaḥ | oṃ indave namaḥ |

hiraṇyā kanakā raktā kṛṣṇā dakṣānane sthitā | suprabhā cātiraktā ca bahuraktā ca jihvikā || 5-45 ||
imā rasajñāstadvāmavadane nityamāsthitāḥ | etābhiḥ saptajihvābhirupetaṃ pāṭitānanam || 5-46 ||

oṃ svāhā | oṃ śrī(/) svāhā | oṃ śrī(/) hrī(/) svāhā | oṃ śrī(/) hrī(/) klī(/) svāhā | oṃ śrī(/) hrī(/) klī(/) glau(/) svāhā | oṃ śrī(/) hrī(/) klī(/) glau(/) ga(/) svāhā | oṃ śrī(/) hrī(/) klī(/) glau(/) ga(/) gaṇapataye svāhā | oṃ śrī(/) hrī(/) klī(/) glau(/) ga(/) gaṇapataye vara varada svāhā | oṃ śrī(/) hrī(/) klī(/) glau(/) ga(/) gaṇapataye vara varada sarvajanaṃ me svāhā | oṃ śrī(/) hrī(/) klī(/) glau(/) ga(/) gaṇapataye vara varada sarvajanaṃ me

iti sarvasādhāraṇo'gnimukhavidhiḥ |
tataścarupākaṃ kuryāt | yathā (-) ācāryaḥ prāṅmukho bhūtvā tavyaṃ tāmrādipātramā(-)dāyāstramantritajalena prakṣālya tasmin pātre taṇḍulānusāreṇa gokṣīraṃ nidhāya sādhāraṃ tat pātraṃ vahnau saṃsthāpya pañcadaśaprabhṛtiparimitān śālitaṇḍulān mūlamantreṇābhimantrya tasmin pātre kṣiptvā pidhānapātramādāyāstramantritajalena prakṣālya(-) hu(/) (-) iti kavacamantramuccara(/)stena pātreṇa pākapātramukhaṃ pidhāya mūlamantramuścara(/)śca(/)ruṃ pacet | tataḥ sruveṇājyamādāya svinnaṃ caruṃ mūlamantramuccarannabhidhārayet |
tataḥ(-)
hu(/) (-) iti kavacamantreṇa tatpātramavatārya astramantrābhimantritakuśāstīrṇamaṇḍalaṃ sthāpayet | tataścaruṃtridhā vibhajya bhāgamekaṃ pātrāntare nidhāya devatāyai samarpayet | dvitīyaṃ bhāgaṃ vakṣyamāṇahomārthaṃ tṛtīyaṃ bhāgaṃ bhojanārthaṃ sthāpayet | tato vahnau devatāyā ādhāraśaktyādipīṭhamantrāntaṃ saṃpūjya tatreṣṭadevatāmāvāhyopacāraiḥ saṃpūjyāvaraṇadevatā api pūjayet | tato deyamūlamantreṇa svāhāntena pañcaviṃśatyājyāhutīrvahnimukhe juhuyāt | idameva vahnīṣṭadevatayorvaktraikīkaraṇaṃ mityucyate | tata ātmāgnidevatānāmaikyaṃ vicintya ekādaśājyāhutīrmūlenaiva dadyāt | idaṃ ca nāḍīsandhānamityucyate | tata āvaraṇadevatābhya ekaikāmāhutiṃ datvā ritvigbhiruktaprakāreṇa saṃskṛteṣu pūrvādikuṇḍeṣu krameṇācāryo vahniṃ viharet | tataḥ sarve ṛtvijaḥ svasvakuṇḍāgnau sāvaraṇāmiṣṭadevatāmupacāraiḥ saṃpūjya mūlamantreṇājyena pañcaviṃśatyāhutirhutvā'varaṇadevatābhya ekaikāmāhutiṃ dadyuḥ | tato guruḥ pūrvoktacarordvitīyabhāgaṃ navadhā vibhajya bhāgamekaṃ svayaṃ gṛhītvā ekaikaṃ bhāgaṃ sarvebhya ṛtvigbhyo dadyāt | tatastasmi(/)ścarau ghṛtaṃ nidhāya saghṛtena caruṇā'cārya ṛtvijaśca sve sve kuṇḍe mūlamantreṇa pratyekaṃ pañcaviṃśatyāhutīrjuhuyuḥ | tata āvaraṇadevatābhya ekaikāmāhutiṃ datvā mūlamantreṇājyena daśa daśāhutīrhutvā vahnirūpāmiṣṭadevatāṃ praṇameyuḥ | tata ācāryaścarostṛtīyabhāgaṃ dvidhā vibhajya palāśapatre pippalapatre vā nidhāya bhāgamekaṃ svayaṃ gṛhītvā paraṃ bhāgaṃ śiṣyāya dadyāt |
tato guruḥ śiṣyaśca(-)
namaḥ (-) iti hṛnmantramuccaran grāsatrayaṃ grāsāṣṭakaṃ vā dantasparśaṃ vinā bhuktvā mantrapūtena jalenācamanaṃ kuryāt | tato guruḥ kṛtācamanaṃ śiṣyaṃ mūlamantreṇa sakalīkṛtya tasmai pūrvoktalakṣaṇaṃ hṛnmantritaṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ dadyāt | tataḥ śiṣyastena dantakāṣṭhena dantān viśodhya jalena prakṣālya dantakāṣṭhaṃ visṛjyācamanaṃ kuryāt | asminneva samaye pūrvoktadantakāṣṭhaparīkṣāṃ kecit kurvanti | tataḥ sāyaṃ sandhyopāsanaṃ kṛtvā gururmūlamantreṇa svakalpoktamantrāntareṇa vā
śiṣyasya śikhāṃ badhvā maṇḍapādbahirdevatāyā dakṣiṇabhāge vedikāntaropari kuśaśayyāyāṃ pūrvaśiraskaḥ śiṣyeṇa sārdhaṃ śayanaṃ kuryāt | śiṣyaśca śayanasamaye svapnamānavamantreṇa śubhasvapnaṃ prārthayet |
svapnamānavamantro yathā(-)
bhagavan devadeveśa śūlabhṛdvṛṣavāhana || 5-47 ||
iṣṭāniṣṭe samācakṣva mama suptasya śāśvatam |
yadvā(-)
oṃ hili (2) śūlapāṇaye svāhā || 5-48 ||
namo jaya trinetrāya piṅgalāya mahātmane | vāmāya viśvarūpāya svapnādhipataye namaḥ || 5-49 ||
svapne kathaya me tathyaṃ sarvakāryeṣvaśeṣataḥ | kriyāsiddhiṃ vidhāsyāmi tvatprasādānmaheśvara || 5-50 ||
vaiṣṇave tu(-)
oṃ namaḥ sakalalokāya viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave | viśvāya viśvarūpāya svapnādhipataye namaḥ || 5-51 ||
yadvā(-)
parabrahmasvarūpastvamantaścarasi viśvadhṛk |
śubhāśubhagatiṃ deva svapne me vinivedaya (-) ityuccārya jānubhyāmavanīṃ spṛṣṭvā viṣṇuṃ praṇamya prasanno vāgyato nijeṣṭaṃ vicintya śayanaṃ kuryāt | tataḥ svapnaṃ dṛṣṭvā samutthāyācamya puṣpaṃ dhṛtvā guruṃ praṇamya gurave svapnaṃ nivedayet | tato guruḥ śubhamaśubhaṃ vā svapnaṃ nirṇīya svapno yadi śubhastadā devatāṃ prasannāṃ jānīyāt | svapno yadyaśubhastadā śāntiṃ kuryāt |

phaṭ duḥsvapnadoṣān jahi (2) phaṭ svāhā (-) iti mantreṇa | oṃ vajranakhadaṃṣṭrāyudhāya mahāsiṃhāya hu(/) phaṭ namaḥ svāhā(-) iti siṃhamantreṇa vā taddevatāgāyatryā vā palāśasamicchatamājyāhutiśataṃ vā
tatra saṃkalpastu(-)
oṃ adyetyādi (-) amukagotro'mukadevaśarmā duḥsvapnaśāntikāmo gurudvārā sak.īraghṛtāktapālāśasamidāhutiśatamahaṃ hoṣyāmi |
ityadhivāsanavidhiḥ |
tato dīkṣādine gurvādayaḥ sarve prātarutthāya prātaḥkṛtyasnānasandhyādinityakarma samāpya yāgamaṇḍapaṃ praviśya devatāṃ natvā sve sve kuṇḍe saghṛtaistilaistaddevatākalpoktadravyāntarairvā svāhāntena mūlamantreṇa pratyekamaṣṭottarasahasrāhutīraṣṭottaraśatāhutīrvā juhuyuḥ | tato homasamāptau guruḥ samutthāya maṇḍapādbahirgatvā kṛtasnānaṃ śiṣyaṃ pañcagavyaṃ pāyayitvā dakṣiṇadvāreṇa maṇḍapaṃ praveśya svīyaṃ kuṇḍāntikamānayet | tato divyadṛṣṭyā śiṣyaṃ vilokya tadvṛdayādvahannāḍyā'ṅkuśamudrayā taccaitanyamākṛṣya svavahannāḍīmārgeṇa svahṛdaye saṃyojyādhvaśodhanaṃ kuryāt | tadyathā (-) śiṣyasya pādayoḥ(-)
nivṛtipratiṣṭhāvidyāśāntiśāntyatītākhyāḥ (-) pañcakalā vicintya kūrcena tatpādau saṃspṛśya(-)
oṃ kalādhvānaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā (-) iti saghṛtaistilairaṣṭāhutīrjuhuyāt | tataḥ kalādhvānaṃ tattvādhvani vilīnaṃ vibhāvya śiṣyasyopasthapradeśe(-)
śivaśaktisadāśiveśvaravidyāmāyāvidyākalārāgakālaniyatipu(-)ruṣaprakṛtibuddhyahaṅkāramanaścakṣuḥśrotraghrāṇajihvātvagvākpā(-)ṇipādapāyūpasthaśabdasparśarūparasagandhākāṃśavāyutejojalapṛthi(-)vyākhyāni (-) ṣaṭtriṃśadgaṇeśaśaivatattvāni | jīvaprāṇamanobuddhiśabdasparśarūparasagandhākāśavāyutejo(-)jalapṛthvīcakṣuḥśrotrajihvāghrāṇatvagvākpāṇipādapāyūpasthasūrya(-)somāgnivāsudevasaṃkarṣaṇapradyumnāniruddhākhyāni (-) dvātriṃśadvaiṣṇavatattvāni |
ākāśavāyutejojalapṛthivīśabdasparśarūparasagandhamano'haṅ-kāracakṣuḥśrotrajihvāghrāṇatvagvākpāṇipādapāyūpasthaprakṛti(-)mahattattvākhyāni (-) caturviṃśatiḥ sauratattvāni | nivṛttipratiṣṭhāvidyāśāntiśāntyatītākhyakalāpañcakavinduka(-)lānādaśaktisadāśivākhyāni (-) daśaprakṛtitattvāni | ātmavidyāśivaśivavidyātmātmavidyāśivasarvākhyāni (-) daśaśāktatattvāni | ātmavidyāśivaśivavidyātmasarvākhyāni (-) traipuratattvāni ca vicintya śiṣyasyopasthapradeśaṃ kūrcena saṃspṛśya(-) oṃ tattvādhvānaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā (-) ityaṣṭāhutīrjuyāt | tatastattvādhvānaṃ bhuvanādhvani vilīnaṃ vibhāvya śiṣyasya nābhau krameṇa(-) pātālarasātalamahātalatalātalasutalavitalatalātalabhūrbhuvaḥsvar(-)maharjanastapaḥsatyākhyāni (-) caturdaśa bhuvanāni vicintya nābhiṃ spṛṣṭvā(-) oṃ bhuvanādhvānaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā (-) ityaṣṭāhutīrjuhuyāt | tato bhuvanādhvānaṃ varṇādhvani vilīnaṃ vibhāvya śiṣyasya hṛdaye'kārādikṣakārāntān vicintya hṛdayaṃ spṛṣṭvā(-) oṃ varṇādhvānaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā (-) ityaṣṭāhutīrjuhuyāt | tato varṇādhvānaṃ padādhvani vilīnaṃ vibhāvya śiṣyasya lalāṭe mantrapadāni vicintya lalāṭaṃ saṃspṛśya(-) oṃ padādhvānaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā (-) ityaṣṭāhutīrjuhuyāt |
tataḥ padādhvānaṃ mantrādhvani vilīnaṃ vibhāvya śiṣyasya mūrdhni saṃpūrṇamantraṃ vicintya mūrdhānaṃ spṛṣṭvā(-) oṃ mantrādhvānaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā (-) iti pūrvavadaṣṭāhutīrhutvā brahmarandhrasthite paramaśive mantrādhvā vilīna iti cintayet | evaṃ saṃhārakrameṇa śiṣyadehe ṣaḍvidhimadamadhvaśodhanaṃ vidhāya punaḥ sṛṣṭikrameṇa paramaśivān mantrādhvanaḥ padādhvā padādhvano varṇādhvā varṇādhvano bhuvanādhvā bhuvanādhvanastattvādhvā tattvādhvanaḥ kalādhvā utpanna iti cintayet | atra kecit(-)
oṃ paramaśivānmantrādhvānamutpādayāmi svāhā (-) ityāhutibhi krameṇādhvano janayediti vadanti | tataḥ śiṣyaṃ divyadṛṣṭyā vilokayannātmasthitaṃ taccaitanyaṃ svavahannāḍyā tadvahannāḍīmārgeṇa taddhṛdaye yojayet | tato mūlamantreṇa daśāhutīrhutvā'varaṇadevatābhya ekaikāmāhutiṃ datvā pūrṇāhutiṃ kuryāt | tatkramastu (-) homāvaśiṣṭena ghṛtena srucamāpūrya puṣpatilayavaphalādikaṃ nidhāyādhomukhena sruveṇa srucaṃ pidhāya tadagre puṣpaṃ datvā mūlāccaturaṅgalaṃ parityajya śaṅkhamudrayā sruksruvau dhṛtvā tanmūlenābhisaṃlagne kṛtvotthitaḥ san dakṣiṇapādapuraḥsaraṃ vauṣaḍantena mūlamantreṇa pūrṇāhutitrayaṃ dadyāt | śākte vāmamārgādau ca vāmapādapuraḥsaraṃ pūrṇāhutiṃ dadyāt | vāmamārge svāhāntena mūlamantreṇa | vaidikakramastu(-)
mūrddhānaṃ diva (-) iti mantreṇa | pūrṇādarvī (-) ityādimantreṇa vā pūrṇāhutiṃ dadyāditi viśeṣaḥ |
tato brahmārpaṇamantraiḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ dadyāt | mantro yathā |
itaḥ pūrvaṃ prāṇabuddhidehadharmādhikārato jāgratsvapnasuṣuptyavasthāsu manasā vācā karmaṇā hastābhyāṃ padmyāmudareṇa śiśnā yat smṛtaṃ yaduktaṃ yat kṛtaṃ tat sarvaṃ brahmārpaṇaṃ bhavatu svāhā |
evaṃ brāhmārpaṇamantreṇa pūrṇāhutiṃ datvā vahnisthāmiṣṭadevatāṃ pañcopacāraiḥ saṃpūjya praṇamya ṣaḍaṅgamantreṇa sakalīkṛtya saṃhāramudrayā kuṇḍādudvāsya kalaśe saṃyojya pūrvādidikṣu sthāpitān dhrūvādīnindrādilokapālān bahiḥsthitā aṅkurārpaṇadevatāśca tattatsthānādudvāsya pradhānakalaśe samānīya tāsāṃ devatānāmiṣṭadaivataikyaṃ vicintya vahnervisarjanārthaṃ mahāvyāhṛtibhirhomaṃ kuryāt |
tadyathā(-)
oṃ bhūragnaye pṛthivyai ca mahate svāhā | oṃ bhuvo vāyave antarīkṣāya ca dive ca mahate svāhā | oṃ svarādityāya candramase digbhyaśca nakṣatrebhyaśca svāhā | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥsvaścandramase nakṣatrebhyo digbhyaśca mahate svāhā |
iti hutvā pūrvoktaprakāreṇa vahnerjihvāṅgamūrtimantrairlokapālān tadāyudhamantraiścaikaikāmāhutiṃ hutvā payasā jalena vā mekhalāsu vahniṃ pariṣiñcya tanmantreṇa pañcopacāraiḥ saṃpūjya
svasti śraddhāṃ yaśaḥ prajñāṃ vidyāṃ buddhiṃ śriyaṃ balam ||
āyuṣyaṃ teja(-)ārogyaṃ dehi me havyavāhana || 5-52 ||
bho bho vahne mahāśakte sarvakarmaprasādhaka | karmāntare'pi saṃprāpte sānnidhyaṃ kuru sādaram || 5-53 ||
iti saṃprārthya(-)
bhagavannagne pūjito'si kṣamasva (-) ityuktvā vahniṃ praṇamya saṃhāra mudrayā visṛjet | tato brahmāṇamudvāsya dvātriṃśatpalapramāṇena nirmitaṃ tāmrapātraṃ taṇḍulairāpūrya tadupari suvarṇadakṣiṇāṃ nidhāya brahmapratinidhibrāhmaṇāya dadyāt | dānavākyaṃ yathā(-)
oṃ adyetyādi (-) kṛtaitaddīkṣākarmāṅgabhūtahomakarmapratiṣṭhār(-)thamidaṃ pūrṇapātraṃ prajāpatidaivataṃ hiraṇyamagnidaivatamamukagotrāyāmukaśarmaṇe viprāya tubhyamahaṃ saṃpradade (-) iti pūrṇapātraṃ dadyāt | tata ācāryaḥ paristaraṇakuśān paridhī(/)śca tūṣṇīmagnau prakṣipet | nityahome tu tān na dahediti viśeṣaḥ |
tataḥ(-)
vauṣaṭ (-) iti netramantramuccaran navyena śuklavastreṇa śiṣyasya netre badhvā puṣpaistadañjaliṃ pūrayitvā tatkaraṃ dhṛtvā tiraskaraṇīṃ vimocya śiṣyaṃ devatāntikamānīya svayaṃ mūlamantramuccaran devatāyai pīṭhopari puṣpāñjaliṃ kṣepayet |
tato guruṇā nirākṛtanetrabandhaḥ śiṣyaḥ(-)
ajñānatimirāndhasya jñānāñjanaśalākayā |
cakṣurunmīlitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ (-) iti paṭhitvā gurucaraṇau praṇamya devatāṃ sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇamet | tato guruḥ śiṣyaṃ darbhāstare niveśya bhūtaśuddhikrameṇa pañcabhūtātmakaṃ taddehaṃ saṃhṛtya punaḥ sṛṣṭimārgeṇotpādya taddehe svakalpoktanyāsān vidhāyābhiṣekārthamīśānadiśi viracite maṇḍapāntare hastadvayāyāmāyāmaṣṭāṅgulocchritāyāṃ caturasravedikāyāṃ śrīparṇyādikāṣṭhanirmitapīṭhopari śiṣyaṃ niveśya svayaṃ devatāsthānamāgatya pādyādibhirupacārairdevatāṃ saṃpūjya mūlena puṣpāñjalitrayaṃ datvā'rādhanārpaṇaṃ kuryāt | tadyathā (-) mūlamantramuccārya(-)
sādhu vā'sādhu vā karma yadyadācaritaṃ mayā || 5-54 ||
tatsarvaṃ devadeveśa gṛhāṇārādhanaṃ param (-) ityuktvā devasya dakṣiṇakare śaktiviṣaye vāmakare'rghodakamutsṛjet | tato devatāṃ praṇamya puṣpāñjalimādāya kṣamāpayet | yathā(-)
yaddattaṃ bhaktimātreṇa patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ jalam |
niveditaṃ ca naivedyaṃ tadgṛhāṇānukampayā || 5-55 ||
āvāhanaṃ na jānāmi na jānāmi visarjanam | pūjāṃ caiva na jānāmi tvaṃ gatiḥ parameśvara || 5-56 ||
karmaṇā manasā vācā tvatto nānyā gatirmama |
antaścāreṇa bhūtānāṃ draṣṭā tvaṃ parameśvara (-) ityuktā puṣpāñjaliṃ kṣiptvā praṇamet | tataḥ śiṣyārthaṃ varaṃ prārthayet | tadyathā(-)
kāruṇyanilaye devi sarvasannidhisaṃśraye || 5-57 ||
śaraṇye vatsale mātaḥ kṛpāmasmin śiśau kuru |
āṇavapramukhaiḥ pāśaiḥ pāśitasya sureśvari || 5-58 ||
dīnasyāsya dayādhāre kuru kāruṇyamīśvari | aihikāmuṣmikairbhogairapi saṃbadhyatāmasau || 5-59 ||
svabhaktiḥ sakalā cāsmai dīyatāṃ niṣkalāśraye (-) iti |
pundaivate tu |

iti saṃprārthya sarvā āvaraṇadevatāḥ pradhānadevatāṅge līnā iti vicintya tejorūpāṃ devatāṃ dhyātvā(-)
bhagavatyamukadevate pūjitā'si kṣamasva (-) ityuktvā saṃhāramudrayā visṛjya vahannāḍīmārgeṇa svahṛdaye tāṃ sthāpayet | tata aiśānyāṃ diśi maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā taddevatākalpoktaṃ nirmālyavāsinaṃ saṃpūjya(-)
lehyacoṣyānnapānādi nirmālyaṃ sragvilepanam |
nirmālyabhojine tubhyaṃ dadāmi devatājñayā (-) iti nirmālyaṃ datvā saṃhāramudrayā nirmālyavāsinaṃ visṛjet | tato mūlamantreṇa svaśirasi kiṃcinnirmālyaṃ dhṛtvā kumbhamutthāpya śiṣyanikaṭaṃ gatvā kumbhamukhasthān pallavān śiṣyasya śirasi vinyasya mātṛkāvarṇān mūlamantraṃ coccaran pañcavādyādinādairviprāśīrbhiśca sārdhaṃ kumbhatoyena śiṣyamabhiṣiñcet | tato vardhanīmutthāpya tajjalenābhiṣiñcet | tato'vaśiṣṭajalena śiṣyamācamya ṣaḍaṅgaiḥ sakalīkṛtya taṃ devatātmānaṃ cintayet | tataḥ śiṣyaḥ samutthāya dhautavāsasī paridhāyācamya guroḥ sannidhau tadājñayā pūrvābhimukha uttarābhimukho vā āsane upaviśet | tato gururātmanaḥ sakāśāt taddehe saṃkrāntāṃ devatāṃ vicintya tayoraikyaṃ vibhāvya gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ saṃpūjya mantraṃ dadyāt | tadyathā(-) amukadevatāmantramahaṃ dadāmi (-) iti pratijñāṃ śrāvayan guruḥ śiṣyahaste jalaṃ dadyāt | dadasvānugrahapūrvakam (-) iti śiṣyo vadet | tato guruḥ śiṣyasya śirasi hastaṃ datvā deyamantramaṣṭottaraśataṃ prajapya dakṣiṇa karṇe trivāraṃ mantraṃ śrāvayet |
strīśūdrayostu vāmakarṇe mantraṃ kathayet | jaladānapūrvakamantradānaṃ brāhmaṇamātraviṣayam | taditarebhyastu tadvinaiva mantraṃ dadyāt | tato gururjyotirmayīṃ vidyāṃ svataḥ śiṣyatanuṃ praviśantīṃ vicintya(-)
mantro'yamāvayostulyaphalado'stu (-) iti brūyāt |
śiṣyo'pi tādṛśīṃ vidyāṃ gurumukhāt svahṛdayaṃ praviśantīṃ vicintya(-)
namaste nātha bhagavan śivāya gururūpiṇe || 5-60 ||
sarvadevasvarūpāya sarvamantramayāya ca |
ghorānmṛtyumahāpāśānmocitaḥ kṛpayā tvayā || 5-61 ||
tvatprasādādahaṃ nātha kṛtakṛtyo'smi sarvataḥ (-) iti stutvā gurucaraṇayordaṇḍavat patita eva tiṣṭhet | tato guruḥ(-)
uttiṣṭha vatsa mukto'si samyagācāravān bhava |
kīrttiśrīkāntimedhāyurbalārogyaṃ sadā'stu te (-) ityuktvā śiṣyamutthāpayet | tataḥ śiṣyo gurudevamantrāṇāmaikyaṃ saṃbhāvya gurorājñayā tatsannidhau mantramaṣṭottaraśataṃ japet | gururapi mantradānānantaramaṣṭottarasahasramaṣṭottaraśataṃ vā mantraṃ japet | tataḥ śiṣyo vittaśāṭyaṃ vihāya sarvasvaṃ tadardhaṃ tadardhaṃ vā gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt | kuśatrayatilajalānyādāya(-)
oṃ adyetyādi (-) amukagotro'mukaśarmā kṛtaitadamukadevatāmukamantragrahaṇapratiṣṭhārthamimāṃ dakṣiṇāmamukagotrāyāmukaśarmaṇe śrīgurave tubhyamahaṃ saṃpradade | evaṃ brahmapratinidhiviprāya ṛtvigbhyaśca gobhūhiraṇyavāso'laṅkārādīn dadyāt | tataḥ pūjopakaraṇasahitaṃ maṇḍapaṃ gurave dadyāt | tato brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ datvā tadāśiṣaḥ samādāya devaniveditaṃ naivedyaṃ tadbhaktebhyo datvā guruśiṣyau bhuñjīyātām | dīkṣādine guruśiṣyayorupavāso niṣiddhaḥ |
tataḥ śiṣyo dinatrayaṃ gurukule nivāsaṃ kṛtvā caturthadine devatārcanaṃ kārayitvā guruṃ praṇamya tadājñāmādāya svagṛhaṃ gacchet | iti kriyāvatīdīkṣāprayogaḥ paripūrṇaḥ |
etadaśaktau saṃkṣepadīkṣā vidheyā | sā ca proktā (nibandhe) |
muhūrte sarvatobhadre navakumbhaṃ nidhāya ca || 5-62 ||
sodakaṃ gandhapuṣpābhyāmarcitaṃ vastrasaṃyutam |
sarvauṣadhīnavaratnapañcapallavasaṃyutam || 5-63 ||
tato devārcanaṃ kṛtvā hunedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam |
sarvauṣadhīti tantrāntare |
jaṭāmāṃsī vacā kuṣṭaṃ śaileyaṃ rajanīdvayam || 5-64 ||
śaṭīcampakamustaṃ ca sarvoṣadhigaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ |
rajanīdvayaṃ haridrā dāruharidrā | pṛśniparṇī pippalī sahadevī ghṛtakumārī | navaratnāni pūrvamuktāni | pañcapallavamiti (vaśiṣṭhe)
panasāmraṃ tathā'śvatthaṃ vaṭaṃ vakulameva ca || 5-65 ||
pañcapallavamityuktaṃ munibhistantravedibhiḥ |
tantrāntare(-)
aśvatthodumbaravaṭaplakṣāmrāḥ pañcapallavāḥ (-) ityuktam |
(nibandhe)
śiṣyaṃ svalaṅkṛtaṃ vedyāmupāgnyamupaveśayet || 5-66 ||
mantritaiḥ prokṣaṇītoyaiḥ śāntiṃ kumbhajalaistathā |
mūlamantreṇāṣṭaśataṃ mantritairabhiṣecayet || 5-67 ||
aṣṭaśatamaṣṭottaraśatam |
atha saṃpādayan mantraṃ hastaṃ śirasi dhārayan | śamastvityakṣatān dadyāt tataḥ śiṣyo'rcayedgurum || 5-68 ||
iti saṃkṣepadīkṣāvidhiḥ |
atha varṇamayī dīkṣā (merutantre)
atha varṇamayīṃ dīkṣāṃ śṛṇvantu jñānadāyinīm | puṃprakṛtyā'tmakatvaṃ ca varṇānāṃ samudīritam || 5-69 ||
tādṛktvaṃ ca śarīrasya proktamevāsti deśikaiḥ | tatastanau śiśornyasyedarṇān deśikasattamaḥ || 5-70 ||
saṃharedvaiparītyena varṇā(/)statsthānasaṃsthitān | deśikendraḥ svasāmarthyādājñayā devatātmanaḥ || 5-71 ||
devatātmā bhavecchiṣyastadāsaṃlīnatattvakaḥ | tatastu śiṣyacaitanyaṃ paramātmāni yojayet || 5-72 ||
tānarṇā(/)stata utpādya nyasecchiṣyaśarīrake | tasmi(/)śca dṛṣṭikramatastaccaitanyaṃ punarnyaset || 5-73 ||
bhavecchiṣyo devatātmā nityānandātmakaḥ śivaḥ | jñānadā'rṇamayī dīkṣā kathitā sarvasiddhidā || 5-74 ||
iti varṇamayī dīkṣāvidhiḥ |
atha kalāvatī dīkṣā tatraiva |
atha vakṣye kalādīkṣāmaṇimādyaṣṭasiddhidām | vede pañcakalā dīkṣā dakṣe'ṣṭatrikalā matā || 5-75 ||
kupañcāśatkalā vāme siddhamantragurostu sā | grāhyā drutaṃ siddhikartrī viparīte viparyayaḥ || 5-76 ||
kalā nivṛttipramukhā bhūtānāṃ pañca ceritāḥ | śiṣyakāye bhūtamaye vedhayet tāḥ kramāt sudhīḥ || 5-77 ||
pādādijānuparyantaṃ nivṛttiḥ saṃsthitā kalā | jānvoḥ sakāśādānābhi pratiṣṭhākhyā kalā sthitā || 5-79 ||
nābhitaḥ kaṇṭhaparyantaṃ vidyākhyā saṃsthitā kalā | kaṇṭhato hyālalāṭaṃ tu śāntyākhyā saṃsthitā kalā || 5-80 ||
bhālācchiro'vadhi proktā śāntyatītā kalā tathā | saṃhṛtikramato vidvān vedhayet sthānato'nyataḥ || 5-81 ||
sthāne svīyājñayā caivaṃ dīkṣā pañcakalā smṛtā | aṣṭatriṃśatkalādīkṣāyuktiṃ śṛṇvantu devatāḥ || 5-82 ||
krameṇa kādikā varṇā yatra dvādaśa saṃsthitāḥ | vilomā bhādikā yatra tatra sthānadvaye kalāḥ || 5-83 ||
bhāvanīyāstu sūryasya ṣoḍaśāsu vidhostathā | yakārādisthale vahnerbhāvanīyāḥ kalā daśa || 5-84 ||
tato varṇakalānāṃ tu varṇasthānācca saṃhṛtiḥ | punaśca janayecchiṣyaṃ kalādīkṣāvidhiḥ svayam || 5-85 ||
iti kalāvatī dīkṣā |
atha vedhamayī dīkṣā tatraiva |
dīkṣāṃ vedhamayīṃ vakṣye yā labdhvā tyajate janaḥ | tatkālameva saṃsāraṃ jīvanmukto'bhijāyate || 5-86 ||
mūlādhāre'pi śiṣyasya dhyāyet kañjaṃ caturdalam | tasya madhye trikoṇaṃ ca tanmadhye cāpi kaṇḍalīm || 5-87 ||
trirāvarttamayīṃ devīṃ vidyutpuñjasvarūpiṇīm | mahādevamayīṃ sākṣājjñānamātraśarīriṇīm || 5-88 ||
aṇoraṇīyasīṃ devīṃ cakraṣaṭkaprabhedinīm | suṣumṇāvartmanā divyāṃ yāntīṃ śivagṛhaṃ prati || 5-89 ||
sāntavāditalasthārṇān padmasthāne samāharet | ṣaḍdale kamale tāṃ tu lāntavādyarṇayugdale || 5-90 ||
svādhiṣṭhāne guruṃ samyagyojayitvā tu vedhayet | tadarṇānānayedviṣṇau viṣṇuṃ taṃ nābhipaṅkaje || 5-91 ||
phāntaḍādyarṇasaṃyukte digdale vedhayet svayam | varṇā(/)stān yojayedrudre rudraṃ taṃ hṛtsaroruhe || 5-92 ||
kāntathādyarṇapatrābje vedhayedīśvare svayam | varṇā(/)stānāharedasmin kaṇṭhapadme ca taṃ tathā || 5-93 ||
kalādalamaye padme svarān saṃyojya yatnataḥ | sadāśive'tha saṃyojya tā(/)stadbhrūmadhyapadmake || 5-94 ||
dvidale hakṣasaṃyukte vedhayitvā tu deśikaḥ | śaktyā sahaivamātmānaṃ nayet paraśivāvadhi || 5-95 ||
deśikājñāvaśācchiṣyo dagdhvā'jñānaṃ tadā kṣitau | patedavāptavijñānaḥ sarvajño jāyate tataḥ || 5-96 ||
sadāśivaḥ svayaṃ bhūyāt satyameva na saṃśayaḥ | iyaṃ jñānapradā proktā dīkṣā vedhātmikā śubhā || 5-97 ||
iti vedhamayī dīkṣā |
atha pañcāyatanī dīkṣā | tatra mukhyakalaśaṃ madhye saṃsthāpya caturṣu koṇeṣu caturaḥ kalaśān saṃsthāpya pañcadevatā āvāhya pūjayet | atha vā ekameva kalaśaṃ saṃsthāpya vakṣyamāṇakrameṇa devatāḥ pūjayet | proktaṃnaivaṃ kalaśavidhinaikena vā naikakumbhairiti (prapañcasāra-) vacanāt | tatra devatāsthāpanakrama ukto (jñānamālāyām) |
yadā tu śaṅkaraṃ madhye aiśānyāṃ śrīpatiṃ yajet | āgnejyāṃ ca tathā haṃsaṃ nair(-)ṛtyāṃ pārvatīsutam || 5-98 ||
vāyavyāṃ ca sadā pūjyā bhavānī bhaktavatsalā | yadā tu madhye govindamaiśānyāṃ śaṅkaraṃ yajet || 5-99 ||
āgneyyāṃ gaṇanāthaṃ ca nair(-)ṛtyāṃ tapanaṃ tathā | vāyavyāmambikāṃ caiva yajenmantrī samāhitaḥ || 5-100 ||
sahasrāṃśuṃ yadā madhye aiśānyāṃ pārvatīpatim | āgneyyāmekadantaṃ ca nair(-)ṛtyāmacyutaṃ yajet || 5-101 ||
vāyavyāṃ pūjayeddivīṃ bhogamokṣaikadāyinīm | bhavānīṃ tu yadā madhye aiśānyāṃ mādhavaṃ yajet || 5-102 ||
āgneyyāṃ pārvatīnāthaṃ nair(-)ṛtyāṃ gaṇanāyakam | pradyotanaṃ ca vāyavyāmācāryastu prapūjayet || 5-103 ||
herambaṃ tu yadā madhye aiśānyāmacyutaṃ yajet | āgneyyāṃ pañcavaktraṃ tu nair(-)ṛtyāṃ jagadambikām || 5-104 ||
vāyavyāṃ dyumaṇiṃ caiva yajenmantrī hyatandritaḥ | svasthānavarjitā devāḥ śokaduḥkhabhayapradāḥ || 5-105 ||
tanmaṇḍalasthito rājā sādhakaśca vinaśyati || 5-105ef ||
tantrāntare(-)
śambhau madhyagate harīnaharabhūdevyo harau śaṅkare(-) bhāsyenāgasutā ravau haragaṇeśājāmbikāḥ sthāpitāḥ | devyāṃ viṣṇuharaikadantaravayo lambodare'jeśvarā(-) ryenāḥ śaṅkarabhāgato nigaditā vyastāstu te hānidāḥ || 5-106 ||
(merutantre)
iśe'jeneśajaśivā harāvīśeśajenasāḥ | svāvīśeśajājomā devyāṃ viśigabhāskarāḥ || 5-107 ||
gaṇeśe'jeśabhādevyo'bhyarcyā īśādikoṇataḥ |
pūjākramastu tantrāntare |
mukhye puṣpāñjaliṃ datvā gaṇeśādyarcanaṃ bhavet || 5-108 ||
gaṇeśa eva mukhyaścet tatra sūryakramādbhavet (-) iti ||
idaṃ ca |
ekapīṭhe pṛthakpūjāṃ vinā yantraṃ karoti yaḥ | aṅgāṅgaṃ tu parityajya devatāśāpamāpnuyāt || 5-109 ||
iti kalāvatīvacanena yantrātiriktādhāre pṛthakpūjāyā niṣedhāt pratiṣṭhitayantrādiviṣayaṃ pīṭhasyārcanamaṅgadevajayanamityādi (sanatkumārīya-) vacanāt | aṅgadevatāpūjākālastu pīṭhārcanāntaramiti (tantrasārakṛtaḥ) | (mahākālasaṃhitāyāṃ-) tu pīṭhārcanāt prāgeva gaṇeśādipūjanamuktam |
pañcāyatanavānasminnevāvasara utsukaḥ |
gaṇeśaviṣṇusūryeśān pūjayedupacārakaiḥ (-) iti |
vastutastu pīṭhāsyārcanamaṅgadevayajanamityādivacanamekakalaśa(-)pakṣe | pañcakalaśapakṣe tu pañcasu sarvatobhadramaṇḍaleṣu pañcakalaśānuktakrameṇa saṃsthāpya pañcadevatāḥ pṛthak pūjayediti na kaścidvirodhaḥ | (śyāmādau) tu pañcāyatanadīkṣābhāva uktaḥ (cāmuṇḍātantre) |
śyāmāyāṃ bhairavītārācchinnamastāstu bhairave || 5-110 ||
mañjughoṣe tathā raudre pañcāṅgo neṣyate budhaiḥ |
iti pañcāyatanadīkṣāvidhiḥ |
(ṣaḍanvayamahāratne)
āṇavī bahudhā dīkṣā śākteyī śāmbhavī punaḥ || 5-111 ||
ekadhaiveti vidvadbhiḥ paṭhyate śāstrakovidaiḥ | āṇavī bahudhetyuktvā tadbhedaṃ tvadhunocyate || 5-112 ||
smārtī mānasikī yaugī cākṣuṣī spārśanī tathā | vācikī mantrikī hotrī śāstrī cetyabhiṣecikī || 5-113 ||
atha smārtī dīkṣā tatraiva |
videśasthaṃ guruṃ smṛtvā śiṣyaṃ pāśatrayaṃ kramāt | viśliṣya layabhogasya vidhānena pare śive || 5-114 ||
samyagyojanarūpaiṣā smārttī dīkṣeti kīrtitā |
iti smārtī dīkṣā |
atha mānasī dīkṣā tatraiva |
svasannidhau samāsīnamālokya manasā śucim || 5-115 ||
malatrayādupāyairyā mocakī sā tu mānasī |
iti mānasī dīkṣā |
atha yogadīkṣā tatraiva |
yogoktakramato yogī śiṣyadehaṃ praviśya tu || 5-116 ||
gṛhītvā tasya cātmānaṃ svātmanā yojanātmikā | yogadīkṣeti sā proktā malatrayavināśinī || 5-117 ||
iti yogadīkṣā |
atha dṛgdīkṣā (merutantre)
nimīlya nayane dhyātvā paramātmani devatām | taddarśanānandapūrṇanetrābhyāṃ vīkṣayedguruḥ || 5-118 ||
śiṣyaṃ prasannacittaḥ san paścādupadiśediti | mantraḥ śiṣyasya siddhyai syāddṛgdīkṣeyaṃ phalapradā || 5-119 ||
(ṣaḍanvayamahāratne)
śivo'hamiti niścitya vīkṣaṇaṃ karuṇārdrayā | dṛśā sā cākṣuṣī dīkṣā sarvapāpapraṇāśinī || 5-120 ||
iti dṛgdīkṣā |
atha sparśadīkṣā tatraiva |
svayaṃ paraśivo bhūtvā niḥsaṃdigdhamanā guruḥ | śivahastena śiṣyasya samantraṃ mūrdhni saṃspṛśet || 5-121 ||
sparśadīkṣeti sā proktā śivābhivyaktakāriṇī |
śivahasteneti |
gandhairmaṇḍalakaṃ svīye vidadhyāddakṣiṇe kare || 5-122 ||
vidhinā cārcayeddevamitthaṃ syācchivahastakaḥ (-) iti (somaśambhu-) proktarūpeṇetyarthaḥ ||
(merutantre)
guruḥ svasya guruṃ dhyāyet svahaste śivarūpiṇam | mūlavidyāṃ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ ca mātṛkādimanūn japan || 5-123 ||
śiṣyasya mastake datvā kṛpayā dakṣiṇaṃ karam | paścādupadiśet proktā sparśadīkṣā'tisiddhidā || 5-124 ||
iti sparśadīkṣā |
atha vācikī dīkṣā (ṣaḍanvayamahāratnai)
guruvaktraṃ nijaṃ vaktraṃ vibhāvya gururādarāt | guruvaktraprayogeṇa divyamantrādikaṃ śiśau || 5-125 ||
mudrānyāsādibhiḥ sārdhaṃ dadyāt seyaṃ hi vācikī |
(merutantre)
sadāśive tu cidrūpe guruścittaṃ nidhāpayet | mantrān samastā(/)stajjātān dhyāyet svayaṃ tadātmakaḥ || 5-126 ||
jāto gurośca kṛpayā kevalo'haṃ sadāśivaḥ | iti dhyāyannupaviśedvāgdīkṣā tviyamīritā || 5-127 ||
iti vācikī dīkṣā |
atha mantrī dīkṣā (ṣaḍanvayamahāratne)
dīkṣā parā tathā mantranyāsasaṃyuktavigrahaḥ | svayaṃ mantratanurbhūtvā sakramaṃ mantramādarāt || 5-128 ||
dadyācchiṣyāya sā dīkṣā māntrī malavighātanī |
iti māntrī dīkṣā |
atha hotrī dīkṣā tatraiva |
kuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile vā'pi niḥkṣipyāgniṃ vidhānataḥ || 5-129 ||
layabhogakrameṇaiva pratyadhvānaṃ yathākramam | mantravarṇakalātattvapadaviṣṭapameva ca || 5-130 ||
śuddhyarthaṃ homayedeṣā hotrī dīkṣā samīritā |
layabhogakrameṇeti | vedhadīkṣākrameṇa mūlādhārādhiṣṭhita(-)varṇadevatāsaṃhārarūpeṇetyartha iti hotrī dīkṣā |
iti śāstrī dīkṣā |
atha śāstrī dīkṣā tatraiva |
yogaśiṣyāya bhaktāya śuśrūṣārcāparāya ca || 5-131 ||
sārdhaṃ śāstrapradā trayyā śāstrī dīkṣeti cocyate |
iti śāstrī dīkṣā |
athābhiṣecikī dīkṣā tatraiva |
śivaṃ ca śivapatnīṃ ca kumbhe saṃpūjya sādaram || 5-132 ||
śivakumbhābhiṣekāt sā dīkṣā syādabhiṣecikī |
ityabhiṣecikī dīkṣā |
atha śāmbhavī dīkṣā (merutantre)
gororālokamātreṇa bhāṣaṇāt sparśanādapi || 5-133 ||
sadyaḥ saṃjāyate jñānaṃ sā dīkṣā śāmbhavī smṛtā |
iti śāmbhavī dīkṣā |
athopadeśa dīkṣā (viśvasāre)
tatrāpyaśaktaḥ kaściccedabjamabhyarcya sākṣatam || 5-134 ||
tadambunā'bhiṣiñcyāṣṭavāraṃ mūlena ke karam | nidhāyāṣṭau japet karṇe upadeśe tvayaṃ vidhiḥ || 5-135 ||
tatreti | pūrvoktasaṃkṣepadīkṣāyāmityarthaḥ | abjamiti śaṅkham | ke karaṃ nidhāyeti | śirasi hastaṃ nyasyedityarthaḥ | athopadeśadīkṣāntaraṃ tatraiva |
mahādīkṣā tathā dīkṣā upadeśastataḥ param | yuge yuge ca karttavyā upadeśaḥ kalau yuge || 5-136 ||
candra sūryagrahe tīrthe siddhikṣetre śivālaye | mantramātraprakathanamupadeśaḥ sa ucyate || 5-137 ||
(merutantre)
bhuktimuktiprasiddhyarthaṃ parīkṣya vidhivadaguruḥ | paścādupadiśenmantramanyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavet || 5-138 ||
anyāyena ca yo dadyāt gṛhṇātyanyāyataśca yaḥ | dadato gṛhṇato vā'pi kula śāpo bhaviṣyati || 5-139 ||

ityupadeśadīkṣāvidhiḥ |
atha kramadīkṣā vidhiḥ | (tantracintamaṇi-) dhṛta(-)(śaktiśaṅgamakulārṇavā-) divacanāni |

candrāgnipakṣaṣoḍhākhyaparānirvāṇatatparā | ṣaṭśāmbhavaṃ tato devi cakrasaṃbhedameva ca || 5-147 ||
svacakradehavijñānaṃ parakāyapraveśanam | etajjñānādbhavenmedhā dīkṣā proktā mayā tava || 5-148 ||

kevalā tu bhavenmedhā ṛddhisiddhikriyā dvidhā | tritayā divyasāmrājye medhā dīkṣā prakīrtitā || 5-154 ||
devarūpā divyarūpā mantrarūpā mahāparā | sarvarūpā sarvapūrvā mahāsāmrājyamedhayā || 5-155 ||
ṛddhisiddhikrameṇaiva bhedabāhulyamīritam | vidyā rājyābhidhā dīkṣā chinnamastāvidhau smṛtā || 5-156 ||
candravahnirasāraktaśyāmā ca ṣoḍaśī tathā | parā ṣoḍhā saptadaśī tadā jātā parā bhavet || 5-157 ||
dīpinī mālinī kullā kramādvidyādirājyadā | vagalā yā maheśāni sāmrājyaparame sthitā || 5-158 ||
candravedasūkṣmamerumantrahīnaṃ śivāntaram | hṛdayaṃ ca śatārṇaṃ ca pañcāstraṃ kullukā tathā || 5-159 ||
gāyatrī kramayogena sāmrājyaparameṣṭhyadhṛk | etatpañcakasaṃyuktaḥ sarvasāmrājyabuddhidhṛk || 5-160 ||
śrīdivyasarvasāmrājyadīkṣāsarvottarā bhavet | tato'pi dīkṣā deveśi nāsti brahmāṇḍagolake || 5-161 ||
daśa vidyāprabhedāśca mahāvidyāprabhedajāḥ | siddhividyāprabhedāśca mahāmantrāstathaiva ca || 5-162 ||
tadaṅgamantrā deveśi śāvaraṃ deśaśāvaram | kālaśāvarakaṃ devi tathaiva siddhiśāvaram || 5-163 ||
tridhā darśanamantrāśca tathā'mnāyakramodbhavāḥ | kādihādikramatvena ūrddhāmnāye kalau śive || 5-164 ||

etaddīkṣāsamāyuktaḥ sākṣācchrīkālikā svayam | praharāṣṭakrameṇaiva daśavidyāsvarūpadhṛk || 5-166 ||
kāmakalābhidhā vidyā sabhedā vṛttidevatā | aṅgamantrāstathā'nye'pi tasya cāstragatāḥ sadā || 5-167 ||
kramadīkṣā maheśāni pañcavidyāsu bhedataḥ | tadaṅgamantrā gāyatrīkullukāpañcakaṃ śive || 5-168 ||
anyavidyāvidhau proktaṃ rahasyātirahasyakam | śrīvidyāyāṃ kālikāyāṃ tārāyāṃ parameśvari || 5-169 ||
kramadīkṣāṃ vinā devi yo japet sādhakādhamaḥ | sa daridrī mahāghorī lakṣmīhīnastu ninditaḥ || 5-170 ||
atha vā vātulo bhūyānmantrakṣobhamavāpnuyāt | kramadīkṣāsamāyukto rājā bhavati niścitam || 5-171 ||
mahāvibhavasaṃyuktaḥ sarvasiddhisamanvitaḥ | vijayī vinayī sādhuḥ siddhaśca siddhidaḥ śubhaḥ || 5-172 ||
prahṛṣṭātmā sarvavettā trikālajñaḥ kaviḥ sukhī | koṭisiddhīśvaraḥ śūraḥ sundaraḥ kāmamohanaḥ || 5-173 ||
ānandātmā parātmā ca parājitaguṇottaraḥ | rājarājeśvaraḥ sākṣānmahākālasamaḥ kalau || 5-174 ||
naitadvidyopāsakasya dāridryaṃ dīnatā kvacit | guruhīnāt kramatyāgāt saṃpradāyaviyogataḥ || 5-175 ||
dāridryaṃ prathamaṃ bhūyānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā | cintāmaṇigṛhaṃ yatra yatra ratnasya mandiram || 5-176 ||
navaratnātmasopānaṃ sarvaiśvaryāspadaṃ gṛham | kalpavṛkṣavanaṃ yatra parijātavanaṃ tathā || 5-177 ||
sparśamaṇestu prākāro dāridryaṃ tatra kutra vai | tasmāt kramavihīnasya dāridryaṃ tu pade pade || 5-178 ||
kramayuktaṃ guruṃ prāpya kramaṃ saṃprārthayet sudhīḥ | anyathā gurumauḍhyena daridratvamavāpnuyāt || 5-179 ||

etāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu mantrapūtena vāriṇā | ugradaṃṣṭrā mahādaṃṣṭrā śubhadaṃṣṭrā kapālinī || 5-250 ||

maṅgalā nandinī bhadrā lakṣmīḥ kīrtiryaśasvinī | puṣṭirmedhā śivā sādhvī yaśaḥśobhā jayā dhṛtiḥ || 5-252 ||
śrīnandā ca sunandā ca nandinyānandapūjitā | etāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu mantrapūtena vāriṇā || 5-253 ||
vijayā maṅgalā bhadrā smṛtiḥ śāntiḥ kṣamā dhṛtiḥ | siddhistu paramā puṣṭiḥ śrī ṛddhiśca ratistathā || 5-254 ||
dīptā kāntiryaśolakṣmīrīśvarī buddhireva ca | śaktirmāyāvatī brāhmī jayantī cāparājitā || 5-255 ||
ajitā mānavī śvetā ditistvaditireva ca | māyā caiva mahāmāyā mohinī kṣobhiṇī tathā || 5-256 ||

(śrīnṛsiṃha pādārcanapaddhatāvapi)
prasupte tu mahāvuṣṇau puraścaryāṃ na cācaret | muhyanti sakalā mantrāḥ supte tasmin jagadgurau || 6-41 ||
muhyantīti | sarveṣāṃ mantrāṇāṃ nārāyaṇātmakatayā tasmin yogarūpanidrāmāśrite sarve mantrāstadīyayoganidrayā vyāmohitā bhavantītyarthaḥ | tathā ca mantrāṇāṃ vyāmohakāle puraścaraṇādinā siddhirna bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | na ca tattatmantrāṇāṃ tattadevatātmakatayā tanmantrāṇāmeva tadātmakatvena tanmantrātiriktamantrāṇāmapi kathaṃ tadātmakatvamaratīti vācyam | sarvadevamayo hari rityādinā bhagavataḥ sakaladevātmakatve siddhe tattaddevatātmakatattanmantrāṇāṃ tadātmakatvasya suvacatvāt | etena hariśayanakālikapuraścaraṇaniṣedho viṣṇumantramātraviṣayo vaiśampāyanavacanasya tatprakaraṇīyatvādityapāstam | muhyanti sakalā mantrā ityatra sakalapadamahimnā mantraśabdasya vaiṣṇavāvaiṣṇavamantraparatvāvagamāt | evaṃ ca brāhmaṇebhyo dadhi dātavyaṃ na kauṇinyāye tyādau brāhmaṇādipadasya kauṇḍinyetarabrāhmaṇaparatvadarśanāt puraścaraṇaprakaraṇīyavaiśampāyanādivacanaviṣiddhakālātirikto dīkṣāprakaraṇīyasiddhāntaśekharādivacanavihitaśca yaḥ kāla sa eva yasmin kāle bhaveddīkṣā tasmin kāle bhavedidamiti sāmānyavacanena gṛhyate | tena dīkṣāyāṃ vihito'pi śrāvaṇādiḥ puraścaraṇe niṣiddha eva | hariśayanakāle puraścaraṇameva niṣiddham | tadatiriktajapapūjādestvāvaśyakatvamuktam | tatraiva |
arcayā strotrapāṭhena japena niyamana ca | tatprītikāmukairbhaktaiḥ sevyaḥ supto janārdana || 6-42 ||
yaḥ prasūpto'pi jāgartti viśvasākṣī cidātmakaḥ |
sa bhaktyā toṣito yena tasyaiva saphalaṃ januḥ (-) iti ||
śaktiviṣaye'pi (vāḍavānalīye)
ghanāgame ghanānte ca puṣpakāle ca śāmbhavi || 6-43 ||
ārādhayejjagaddhātrīṃ divā vā yadi vā niśi | ekaikadivase devyāḥ prītiḥ sāṃvatsarī bhavet || 6-44 ||
viśeṣādeṣu kāleṣu yena nārādhitā'mbikā |
sa daridro bhayagrastaḥ kṣīṇāyuḥ sādhako bhavet (-) iti | kecana śāktāstu |
śiśiraśca vasantaśca śaratkāla iti trayaḥ || 6-45 ||
uttamā ṛtavo devyāḥ puraścaraṇakarmaṇi |
ityādi (-) (yāmala-) vacanena hariśayanakālāntaḥpātini śaratkāle devīmantrapuraścaraṇavidhānād viṣṇau supte japennacetyādi(-)vaiśampāyanīyavacanaṃ devīmantrātiriktamantraparamiti saṃkocaṃ parikalpya hariśayanakāle'pi puraścaraṇamācaranti | atra śaratkālaśabdaḥśaratkālāntaḥpātidurgotsavakālaparaḥ | tantroktavacanena śaratkāle caturthyādinacamyantaṃ viśeṣata ityādivakṣyamāṇa(-kālīkalpa(-)muṇḍamālā-)divacanena ca śaktimantrapuraścaraṇavidhāne'pi tasya hariśayanādhikaraṇībhūtayāvatkālaṃ karttavyatākatve pramāṇābhāvaḥ | anyathā ūrje tapasi rādhe vā śuklapakṣastu vaiṣṇave ityādi (candrapīṭhādi) vacanena vaiśākhe kārttike tathetyādimatsya(-)puraścaraṇaprakaraṇīya (-) (merutantra -)vacanena ca vaiṣṇavasyāpi mantrasya hariśayanakālāntaḥpātini kārttikādau puraścaraṇavidhānādvaiśampāyanādivacanasya nirviṣayatvāpatteḥ | yadi ca tantropatantrāṇāmanantatvena cāturmāsye'pi śaktimantrapuraścaraṇavidhāyaikavacanānantaramupalabhyeta tadā tu saṃkocakalpanā na duṣṭā | anyathā duṣṭaiveti puraścaraṇapaddhatikṛtaḥ | prāñcastu | niṣiddhamāsapatite'pi grahaṇādau sakalamantrāṇāṃ viśeṣapuraścaraṇavidhānāt sāmānyapuraścaraṇameva hariśayanakāle niṣiddham | viśeṣapuraścaraṇe tu nāyaṃ niṣedha ityāhuḥ | vastutastu | durgotsavakālādau śāktādimantrasya kārttikādau vaiṣṇavādimantrasya bhādrapadārdau gaṇaśādimantrasya grahaṇādau mantramātrasya ca puraścaraṇavidhānādanuktakālasya viśeṣapuraścaraṇasyāpyaniṣiddhakāla evācaraṇāñca niṣiddhakālāntargataṃ yadyatkālāvacchedena yadyaddevatāmantrapuraścaraṇaṃ viśeṣavacanairvidhīyate tattatkālāvacchadena tattaddevatāmantrapuraścaraṇa kartavyameva | samānyavacanena niṣiddhoviśeṣavacanenavihitaśca yaḥ kālastatra kasyāpi mantrasya puraścaraṇamātraṃ nācarakārtike tu mantramātrasya puraścaraṇaṃ kartavyam |
sarveṣāmapi mantrāṇāṃ kuryādūrje puraskriyām (-) iti (sādhanasamuccaya-) vacanādvakṣyamāṇamahācīnādikrameṇa puraścaraṇe tu na kālādiniyamaḥ | taduktaṃ (sārasaṃgrahe)
sarva eva śubhaḥ kālo nāśubho vidyate kvacit || 6-46 ||
tathā |
digdeśaniyamo nātra sthityādiniyamo na hi | na jape kālaniyamo nārcādiṣu viliṣvapi || 6-48 ||
svecchāniyama ukto'tra mahāmantrasya sādhane |
ityādimahāmantraśabdastu mantramātropalakṣakaḥ | anyathā mahācīnakrameṇopamantrapuraścaraṇe niyamaparipālanāpatteravāpi kālapadamahārātrāntargatatattatkālaparaṃ na tu vihitaniṣiddhamāsadivasādiparam | tathā ca |
prātaḥkālaṃ samārabhya japenmadhyaṃ dināvadhi (-) iti |
pāśavakalpoktau |
gate tu prathame yāme tṛtīyapraharāvadhi || 6-49 ||
niśāyāmeva japtavyaṃ rātriśeṣe japenna ca (-) iti vīrakalpoktaśca yaḥ kālaniyamaḥ sa cāsmin mahācīnakrameṇāstīti tadarthaḥ ||
na viśeṣo divārātrau sandhyāyāṃ vā mahāniśi | sarvakāle yajeddevīmasnātaḥ kṛtabhojanaḥ || 6-50 ||
iti tatraivoktatvāt | kathamanyathā |
vīrāṇāṃ japakālastu sarvakālaḥ praśasyate |
iti (bhāvacūḍāmaṇi-) vacanaṃ saṅgamanīyam |
aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ pakṣayorubhayorapi || 6-51 ||
ārabhet puraścaryāṃ kāle dīkṣokta eva hi |
ityādivīrapuraścaraṇaprakaraṇīya (-) (yāmalādi-) vacanavirodhāduktayuktyā tu kālaśabdasyoktakālaparatayā vīraśabdasya ca kaulikaparatayā tadīyakalpe dicamasyarātreśca(?) puraścaraṇakālatayā vakṣyamāṇatvānna kaścidvirodhaḥ |
evaṃ mahānīlakrameṇa puraścaraṇe'pi noktakālaniyamaḥ | uktavacanānāṃ tatrāpyupalambhāt |
atra kecit |
na jape kālaniyamo mahāmantrasya sādhane || 6-52 ||
ityādi(-)(siddhāntasaṃgraha-) vacanānmahāmantrapuraścaraṇe kālaniyamo nāstīti vadanti | tanmate |
na deśakālaniyamo bhakṣyādiniyamo na hi | śaucādiniyamo nāsti mahāmantrasya sādhane || 6-53 ||
iti tasya vacanāt |
na śaucādikriyāḥ kāryāḥ smṛtiśāstrapracoditāḥ | ekaṃ liṅge gude pañca ityādyā yāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 6-54 ||
iti svacchandabhairavādivacanācca | mahāmantrapuraścaraṇe niyamasāmānyābhāvāpattyā(-)
niyamāstatra bhūyāṃsaḥ prakartavyāḥ prayatnataḥ | avaidhakaraṇāt siddhihāniḥ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 6-55 ||
ityādimahāvidyāpuraścaraṇaprakaraṇīyamahākālavacanavirodhaḥ spaṣṭa eveti saṃkṣepaḥ | atha deśāḥ (yoginītantre) |
ādau puraskriyāṃ kartuṃ sthānanirṇaya ucyate | puṇyakṣetraṃ nadītīraṃ guhāparvatamastakam || 6-56 ||
tīrthapradeśaḥ sindhūnāṃ saṃgamaḥ pāvanaṃ vanam | udyānāni viviktāni vilvamūlaṃ taṭaṃ gireḥ || 6-57 ||
tulasīkānanaṃ goṣṭhaṃ vṛṣaśūnyaṃ śivālayam | aśvathāmalakīmūlaṃ gośālā jalamadhyataḥ || 6-58 ||
devatāyatanaṃ kūlaṃ samudrasya nijaṃ gṛham |
tathā |
gṛhe śataguṇaṃ vidyādgoṣṭhe lakṣaguṇaṃ bhavet || 6-59 ||
koṭirdevālaye puṇyamanantaṃ śivasannidhau | mlecchaduṣṭamṛgavyādhaśaṅkātaṅkavivarjite || 6-60 ||
ekāntopavane nindārahite bhaktisaṃyute | sudeśe dhārmike deśe subhikṣe nirupadrave || 6-61 ||
ramye bhaktajanasthāne nivaset tāpasapriye | gurūṇāṃ sannidhāne ca cittaikāgrasthale tathā || 6-62 ||
eṣāmanyatamaṃ sthānamāśritya japamārabhet |
(mahākapilapañcarātre)
kṣetratīrthagṛhārāmadevālayanadīhradāḥ || 6-63 ||
kuṭī viviktamityete deśāḥ syurmantrasiddhidāḥ || 6-63ef ||
(prapañcasāre)
samudratīre'pyatha vā'driśṛṅge samudragānāṃ saritāṃ ca tīre | japedvivikte nija eva gehe viṣṇorgṛhe vā puruṣo manasvī || 6-64 ||
(māmale)
mlecchaduṣṭamṛgavyālaśaṅkātaṅkavivarjite | ekānte pāvane cintārahite bhaktisaṃyute || 6-65 ||
sudeśe dhārmike rāṣṭre subhikṣe nirupadrave | ramye bhaktagaṇasthāne nivasenna parāśraye || 6-66 ||
devatābhedena puraścaraṇasthānabhedā uktā (merutantre)
japasthānāni vakṣyāmi kṛttimākṛttimāni ca | guptāni sarvatantreṣu devatānāṃ pṛthak pṛthak || 6-67 ||
mahāgaṇapatikṣetraṃ māyūraṃ narmadātaṭam | mahāśmānaṃ māyūraṃ gaṇeśamanusiddhidam || 6-68 ||
prabhāsaṃ ca kurukṣetraṃ puṣkaraṃ bhṛguparvatam | yamunāyāstaṭaṃ kāśīdineśamanusiddhidam || 6-69 ||
ayodhyā mathurā māyā kāśī vadarikāśramaḥ | gayā ca gaṇḍakītīraṃ dvārikā viṣṇusiddhidā || 6-70 ||
kedārastryambakaṃ kāśī kāñcyavantyau vanāni ca | gaṅgātīraṃ vaidyanātho rāmeśaḥ śivasiddhikṛt || 6-71 ||
jvālāmukhī prayāgaśca kāminī mālikāpadam | sarasvatyāstathā tīraṃ śaktimantrasya siddhikṛt || 6-72 ||
tīraṃ ca kamaleśvaryā mekhalā yakṣaparvataḥ | aṅgabaṅgakaliṅgāśca kṣudradaivatasiddhidāḥ || 6-73 ||
kāmarūpaṃ ca nepālaṃ hiṅgulā vindhyavāsinī | jālandharaṃ pūrṇagirirvāmamārgeṇa siddhidāḥ || 6-74 ||
taṭaṃ padmākarāṇāṃ ca kadalīkṣvarkavāṭikā | vidrumākulito grāmo gaṇeśasyātivallabhaḥ || 6-75 ||
padmākarataṭāraṇyakaravārārkavāṭikā | godhūmadūrvākṣetrāṇi śilābhānumataḥ priyā || 6-76 ||
tulasyaśvattha dhātrīkṣuśālagrāmādisannidhau | goṣṭhe śrotriyayuggrāme harermudvaidikāntike || 6-77 ||
paścimābhimukhe liṅge nandivarje śivālaye | śivatoṣe vaṭasyārāt saṃgame vipine hrade || 6-78 ||
kadalīcūtacambelīsevantīvarbarīvane | pañcakhyātanadītīre śakteḥ prītiśca nirjane || 6-79 ||
palvalārānnimbakolaśākhoṭamadhukākule | valmīke śuṣkanadyāṃ ca modante kṣudradevatāḥ || 6-80 ||
pitṛgehe śmaśāne ca tripathe ca catuṣpathe | śūnyālaye śivākīrṇabhuvi tuṣyanti vāmagāḥ || 6-81 ||
gṛhe goṣṭhe tathodyāne vane parvatamastake | nadyāṃ tatsaṃgame devālaye syādvaidiko'dhikaḥ || 6-82 ||
yasmin deśe na gohatyā nāpi brahmavadho bhavet | na śrāvayanti śūdrāśca siddhistatra tu vaidikī || 6-83 ||
mlecchāḥ pākhaṇḍino dhūrtā rājānaḥ sacivādayaḥ | yuvatyaśca na varttante tatra siddhiradūrataḥ || 6-84 ||
atha niṣiddhasthānāni tatraiva |
jīrṇadevālayodyānagṛhavṛkṣataleṣu ca | nadīkūlādrikūṭeṣu bhūcchidrādiṣu no vaset || 6-85 ||
jīrṇatvaṃ vṛkṣaparyantamanveti | nadīkūlaniṣedhastu samudragākulabhinnaparaḥ | (yāmale)
rājānaḥ sacivā rājapuruṣāḥ prabhavo janāḥ | caranti yena mārgeṇa na vaset tatra tattvavit || 6-86 ||
(merau)
evaṃ vicārya matimān kuryādbhūmiparigraham |
atha puraścaraṇe bhakṣyādiniyamo (yāmale)
śākaṃ mūlaṃ phalaṃ bhakṣyaṃ haviṣyaṃ śaktavo'tha vā || 6-87 ||
atha vā kṣīramātraṃ syāt puraścaraṇavṛttaye |
haviṣyāṇyuktāni (smṛtau)
haimantikaṃ sitāsvinnaṃ dhānyaṃ mudgāstilā yavāḥ || 6-88 ||
kalāyakaṅgunīvārā vāstukaṃ hilamocikā | ṣaṣṭikā kālaśākaṃ ca mūlakaṃ kemuketarat || 6-89 ||
lavaṇe saindhavasāmudre gavyaṃ ca dadhi sarpiṣām | payo'nuddhṛtasāraṃ ca panasāmraharītakī || 6-90 ||
pippalī jīrakaṃ caiva nāgaraṅgakatintiḍī | kadalīlavalīdhātrīphalānyaguḍamaikṣavam || 6-91 ||
atailapakvaṃ munayo haviṣyānnaṃ pracakṣate |
(merutantre)
satkandaphalamūlāśī sadbhikṣāśī haviṣyabhuk || 6-92 ||
payovratī bhavecchreṣṭhasteṣām(-----------------------------) iti ||
tatraiva |
śreṣṭhaṃ gavāṃ dugdhamuktaṃ madhyamaṃ surabhībhavam | adhamaṃ māhiṣaṃ cānyadvratasthānāṃ niṣidhyate || 6-93 ||
(kulārṇave)
yasyānnapānapuṣṭāṅgaḥ kurute dharmasaṃcayam | annadātuḥ phalasyārdhaṃ kartuścārdhaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 6-94 ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena parānnaṃ varjayet sudhīḥ | puraścaraṇakāle tu sarvakarmasu śāmbhavi || 6-95 ||
jihvā dagdhā parānnena karau dagdhau pratigrahāt | mano dagdhaṃ parastrībhiḥ kathaṃ siddhirvarānane || 6-96 ||
parānnamiti bhikṣetarāviṣayam | bhikṣāyāṃ tu vihitatvānna doṣaḥ | taduktaṃ (merutantre)
vaidikācārayuktānāṃ śucīnāṃ śrīmatāṃ satām | satkulasthānajātānāṃ bhikṣāśī cāgrajanmanām || 6-97 ||
carumūlaphalakṣīradadhibhikṣānnaśaktavaḥ | etat saptavidhaṃ bhīkṣālabdhaṃ bhakṣyaṃ vratasthitaiḥ || 6-98 ||
(agastyasaṃhitāyām)
dadhi kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ gavyamaikṣavaṃ guḍavarjitam | tilāścaivāsitā mudgāḥ kandaḥ kemukavarjitaḥ || 6-99 ||
(paddhatau)
kandāśca puṇḍārukaserukādyā gavāṃ dadhikṣīraghṛtāni saindhavam | mudgā yavāḥ kṛṣṇatilāḥ kalāyāḥ priyaṅgavaḥ ṣaṣṭikataṇḍulāśca || 6-100 ||
kadambajambūpanasāmranimbā nāraṅgadhātrīkadalīphalāni | kapitthamiṣṭīmṛdudāḍimāni bhakṣyāṇi caitāni puraskriyāyām || 6-101 ||
miṣṭī madhurarasaviśiṣṭaphalaviśeṣaḥ | mṛdurmṛdvikā | itarāṇi prasiddhāni | etadbhinnānyapyaniṣiddhāni yāvakanārikelādīni bhakṣyāṇyeva | atha niṣiddhāni |
kṣāraṃ ca bhaumaṃ lavaṇaṃ tathā'ḍhakī māṣā masūrāścaṇakāśca kodravāḥ | tailaṃ sitaṃ mudgakamāranālakaṃ kṣaudraṃ guḍaṃ phāṇitamāmiṣādikam || 6-102 ||
kūṣmāṇḍavṛntākapalāṇḍvalābu(-) cchatrākanālaṃ laśunaṃ karīraḥ | paṭolatāmbūlavibhītakādya manyacca saṃjātarasāntaraṃ yat || 6-103 ||
andhastathā paryuṣitaṃ ca dagdhaṃ tyājyāni caitāni vadanti dhīrāḥ |
paṭolaṃ paḍavara iti prasiddham | alābustumbīphalam | karīro vaṃśāṅkuraḥ | andha ityannam | anyānyapi niṣiddhāni gṛñjarakarañjādīni tyājyānyeva | gṛñjaraṃ ca gājara iti madhyadeśīyabhāṣayā prasiddhā | athāsanāni (merutantre)
āsanaṃ tu dvidhā proktaṃ nityakāmikabhedataḥ || 6-104 ||
kuśājināmbarairyuktaṃ caturaṅgulamūrddhataḥ | caturasraṃ dvihastaṃ ca sundaraṃ mṛdunirmalam || 6-105 ||
idaṃ sukhāsanaṃ nityaṃ japasiddhividhāyakam | atha kāmyāni vakṣyante jñānasiddhyai mṛgājinam || 6-106 ||
sarvasiddhyai vyāghracarma tvāvikaṃ roganāśanam | kauśeyaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ proktaṃ vetrajaṃ śrīvivarddhanam || 6-107 ||
śvete tu kambale dharmasiddhī rakte'rthasiddhayaḥ | pīte kāmo dvijānyeṣāṃ mokṣadaḥ kṛṣṇakambalaḥ || 6-108 ||
duḥkhamuktyai rañjitaṃ tu nīlaraṅgo na śobhanaḥ |
(puraścaraṇacandrikāyām)
abhicāre kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ raktaṃ vaśyādikarmaṇi || 6-109 ||
śāntike dhavalaṃ proktaṃ citrakaṃ sarvakarmasu | stambhane gajacarma syānmāraṇe māhiṣaṃ tathā || 6-110 ||
maiṣīcarma tathoccāṭe khaḍgijaṃ vaśyakarmaṇi | vidveṣe jāmbukaṃ proktaṃ bhavedgocarma śāntike || 6-111 ||
atha niṣiddhāni (merutantre)
tyajenniṣiddhamaprāptau na niṣiddhe tu saṃviśet | niṣidhānyatha vakṣyante śokaḥ syāddārujāsane || 6-112 ||
vaṃśāsane daridraḥ syādvastre sthānavināśanam | pāṣāṇe ca tathoccāṭo jvarī syānmṛṇmayāsane || 6-113 ||
kṣityāsane bhavet pīḍā pallave cittavibhramaḥ | tṛṇāsane bhavet pīḍā niṣiddhaṃ tviṣṭikāsanam || 6-114 ||
cittakṣobho gṛhasthasya kṛṣṇasārājine bhavet | vaṭurvanasthaḥ saṃnyāsī snātakaḥ siddhimāpnuyāt || 6-115 ||
(puraścaraṇacandrikāyām)
na dīkṣito viśejjātu kṛṣṇasārājine gṛhī | viśedyatirvanasthaśca brahmacārī ca snātakaḥ || 6-116 ||
kuśājināmbareṇāḍhyaṃ caturasraṃ samantataḥ | ekahastaṃ dvihastaṃ vā caturaṅgulamucchritam || 6-117 ||
svastikādikrameṇātha viśet tatra nirākulaḥ | svastikaṃ bhadrakaṃ vīraṃ kūrmaṃ ceti catuṣṭayam || 6-118 ||
japet praśastamanyeṣāṃ prasāṅgādeva kīrtanam | uddeśānukrameṇaiva vakṣyāmyeṣāṃ tu lakṣaṇam || 6-119 ||
jānūrvorantare samyak kṛtvā pādatale ubhe | ṛjukāyaḥ samāsīnaḥ svastikaṃ tadudīritam || 6-120 ||
gulphau tu vṛṣaṇasyādhaḥ sīvanyāḥ pārśvayoḥ kṣipet | pārśve pādau tu pāṇibhyāṃ dṛḍhaṃ badhvā suniścalam || 6-121 ||
bhadrāsanaṃ bhavedetat sarvavyādhivināśanam | ekaṃ pādamathaikasmin vinyasyoruṇi saṃsthitaḥ || 6-123 ||

rudrākṣān kaṇṭhadeśe daśanaparimitān mastake viṃśatī dve ṣaṭ ṣaṭ karṇapradeśe karayugalakṛte dvādaśa dvādaśaiva | bāhvorindoḥ kalābhirnayanayugakṛte caikamekaṃ śikhāyām vakṣasyaṣṭādhikaṃ yaḥ kalayati śatakraṃ sa svayaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaḥ || 6-232 ||

ūrṇābhirvā valkalairvā śaivī kāryā sasūtrajā | prāyaśaḥ sarvadevānāṃ sūtrotpattividhiṃ śṛṇu || 6-242 ||
sūtraṃ dvijendrapuṇyastīnirmitaṃ granthivarjitam | triguṇaṃ triguṇīkṛtya grāhyaṃ prakṣālya yatnataḥ || 6-243 ||
(umāmaheśvare)
yā jīvatputrakā nārī sundarī pativatsalā | tayā kartitasūtreṇa vyūḍhā mālā subhāvahā || 6-244 ||

kanyākarttitasūtreṇa durvarṇasvarṇajairapi |
durvarṇam | mālāgrathanaprakārastatsaṃskāraśca (puraścaraṇacandrikāyām)

kṛtanityakriyāśuddhaḥ ukteṣvṛkṣeṣu mantravit | yathākāmaṃ yathālābhādakṣyāṇyānīya yatnataḥ || 6-247 ||

dugdhakāñcanavarṇāyāḥ śvetāyāścaiva gomayam || 6-249 ||
gomūtraṃ tāmravarṇāyā nīlāyāśca bhaveddadhi | ghṛtaṃ tu kṛṣṇavarṇāyā evaṃ pañcāmṛte'pi ca || 6-250 ||
gavāṃ varṇāstu sulabhāḥ santi deśeṣu kutracit | tatra varṇavibhāgena pañcagavyāni cāharet || 6-251 ||

kṣīramaṣṭaguṇaṃ proktaṃ pañcagavyaṃ tathā dadhi | gāyatryā'dāya gomūtraṃ gandhadvāreti gomayam || 6-253 ||
āppāyasvoti ca kṣīraṃ dadhi krāvṇeti vai dadhi | tejo'si śukramityājyaṃ devasya tvā kuśodakam || 6-254 ||
kṣālayet pañcagavyādyaiḥ (.......................) iti ||
(puraścaraṇacandrikāyām)
aśvatthapatrairnavakaiḥ padmākāreṇa kalpite | sūtre maṇīn sagandhābhikṣālitā(/)statra niḥkṣipet || 6-255 ||
tāraṃ śaktiṃ mātṛkāśca sūtre caiva maṇiṣvatha | vinyasya pūjayedājyairjuhuyāccaiva śaktitaḥ || 6-256 ||

gopucchasadṛśī kāryā yadvā sarpākṛtiḥ śubhā | tatsajātīyamekākṣaṃ merutvenāgrato nyaset || 6-258 ||
(merutantre)
eko merustatra deyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ sthaulyayuk ca yaḥ | ādya sthūla tatastasmānnyūnaṃ nyūnataraṃ tataḥ || 6-259 ||

(puraścaraṇacandrikāyām)

oṃ vāmadevāya namaḥ | oṃ jyeṣṭhāya namaḥ | oṃ śreṣṭāya namaḥ | oṃ rudrāya namaḥ | oṃ kālāya namaḥ | oṃ kalavikaraṇāya namaḥ | oṃ balapramathanāya namaḥ | oṃ sarvabhūtadamanāya namaḥ | oṃ manotmanāya namaḥ |
dhūpayet tāmaghoreṇa(-)
oṃ aghorebhyo'tha ghorebhyo ghoraghoratarebhyaḥ sarvataḥ sarvasarvebhyo namaste rudrarūpebhyaḥ sarvataḥ sarvasarvebhyaḥ | lepayet tatpuruṣeṇa tu | oṃ tatpuruṣāya vidmahe mahādevāya dhīmahi tanno rudraḥ pracodayāt | mantrayet pañcamenaiva pratyekaṃ tu śataṃ śatam || oṃ īśānaḥ sarvavidyānāmīśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ brahmādhipatirbrahmaṇo'dhipatirbrahmāśiṣo me'stu sadā śivom |
meruśca pañcamenaiva tato mantreṇa mantrayet | saṃskṛtyaivaṃ budho mālāṃ tatprāṇā(/) sthāpayet tataḥ || 6-266 ||
(kriyāsaṃgrahe)
mantrayenmūlamantreṇa krameṇotkramayogataḥ | tathaiva mātṛkāvarṇairmantrayenmantratattvavit || 6-267 ||
pūjayitvā yathānyāyamiṣṭadevamanukramāt | nyāsapūrvaṃ japenmantramaṣṭottarasahasrakam || 6-268 ||
juhuyācca daśāṃśena yasya devasya yat priyam |
(yoginītantre)
homakarma tataḥ kuryāddevatābhāvasiddhaye || 6-269 ||
aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā saṃpātājyaṃ viniḥkṣipet | homakarmaṇyaśaktaśceddviguṇaṃ japamācaret || 6-270 ||
tvaṃ māle sarvalokānāṃ sarvasiddhipradā matā | tena satyena me siddhiṃ dehi mātarnamo'stu te || 6-271 ||
ityuktvā paripūjyātha gopayedyatnato gṛhī |
(yāmale tu)
māle māle mahāmāle sarvatattvasvarūpiṇi || 6-272 ||
caturvargastvayi nyastastasmānme siddhidā bhava |
māyābījādikaṃ kṛtvā raktapuṣpaiḥ samarcayet (-) ityuktam |
(puraścaraṇacandrikāyām)
evaṃ kṛtvā'kṣamālāyāṃ japenmātṛkayā sudhīḥ || 6-273 ||
mātṛkāvarṇabhedebhyaḥ sarve tantrāḥ prajajñire | ataḥ sakalamantrāṇāṃ japaḥ kāryo'nayā srajā || 6-274 ||
guruṃ saṃpūjya taddhastādgṛhṇīyāt sarvasiddhaye | gāyatrīṃ tu japan kaścinmālāṃ grathnāti tāntrikaḥ || 6-275 ||
na hītthaṃ grathanaṃ kvāpi mantraśāstre nirūpitam | aśucirna spṛśedenāṃ karabhraṣṭāṃ na kārayet || 6-276 ||
(merutantre)
yena mantreṇa yā mālā kṛtā taṃ tu japet tayā | anyamantrajapācchāpo devatāyāḥ prajāyate || 6-277 ||
dṛḍhasūtraṃ niyuñjīta jape trudyati no yathā | jīrṇe sūtre punaḥ sūtraṃ granthayitvā śataṃ japet || 6-278 ||
(puraścaraṇacandrikāyām)
pramādāt patite hastācchatamaṣṭottaraṃ japet | tāvanniṣiddhaṃ saṃsparśe kṣālayitvā yathoditam || 6-279 ||
(merutantre)
tarjanyā na spṛśet sūtraṃ kampayennaiva dhūpayet | na spṛśedvāmahastena karabhraṣṭāṃ na kārayet || 6-280 ||
akṣāṇāṃ cālane'ṅguṣṭhaścānyamakṣaṃ na saṃspṛśet | japakāle sadā vidvānmeruṃ caiva na laṅghayet || 6-281 ||
parivartanakāle tu saṃghaṭṭaṃ naiva kārayet | kaliḥ khaṭakhaṭāśabde dolamāne calenmatiḥ || 6-282 ||
calite caiva vidveṣaḥ sphuṭite vyādhisambhavaḥ | hastacyute mahāvighnaḥ sūtracchede vināśakṛt || 6-283 ||
(kriyāsaṃgrahe)
cchinne sūtre tu mālāyāḥ punaḥ saṃskāramācaret | aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu japedvā'ṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 6-284 ||
(śaivāgame)
yadā saṃtrudyate mālā granthayitvā ca pūrvavat | pratiṣṭhitāyāṃ tasyāṃ tu mantraṃ japyādananyadhīḥ || 6-285 ||
anyatrāpi |
truṭitā cet svayaṃ mālā prāyaścittaṃ samācaret | gajāntakasahasraṃ tu japahomaṃ samācaret || 6-286 ||
punaḥ saṃgrathanaṃ kṛtvā prāṇasthāpanapūrvakam | tadā mālā siddhidā syānnānyathā śāṅkaraṃ vacaḥ || 6-287 ||
agnidagdhe japellakṣaṃ naṣṭe bhagne dvilakṣakam | cauranīte ṣaṭsahasraṃ patite tu śataṃ japet || 6-288 ||
(puraścaraṇacandrikāyām)
aṅguṣṭhasthāmakṣamālāṃ cālayenmadhyamāgrataḥ | tarjanyā na spṛśet so'yaṃ muktido gaṇanakramaḥ || 6-289 ||
bhuktau muktau tathā hṛṣṭau madhyamāyāṃ japet sudhīḥ | aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ tu japeduttamakarmaṇi || 6-290 ||
tarjanyaṅguṣṭhasaṃyogādvidveṣoccāṭane japaḥ | kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhasaṃyogājjapenmāraṇakarmaṇi || 6-291 ||
anyakāle imāṃ mālāṃ pūjayitvā tu gopayet | guruṃ prakāśayedvidvānna tu mantraṃ kadācana || 6-292 ||
akṣamālāṃ ca mudrāṃ ca gurorapi na darśayet | bhūtarākṣasavetālāḥ siddhagandharvacāraṇāḥ || 6-293 ||
haranti prakaṭaṃ yasmāt tasmādguptaṃ japet sudhīḥ |
atha strīśūdrāṇāṃ mālāsaṃskāraḥ (merutantre)
śūdrārthaṃ vā striyāmarthe mālāsaṃskāra ucyate || 6-294 ||
gaṇeśasūryaviṣṇvīśadurgāḥ saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ | mālāyāmatha tāṃ mālāṃ hsau(/) bījenābhimantritām || 6-295 ||
aṣṭottaraśataṃ pañcagavye tāṃ sthāpayet tryaham | caturthe tu samuddhṛtya kṣālayedastramantrataḥ || 6-296 ||
hṛnmantreṇa granthayitvā sthaṇḍile tāṃ nidhāpayet | tasmāduttolya tāṃ mālāṃ sthāpayeddhemapātrake || 6-297 ||
pañcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya śītalena jalena ca | candanena sugandhena kastūrīkuṅkumādibhiḥ || 6-298 ||

atrāpi mātṛkāvarṇairmūlamantreṇa ca mālāmabhimantrya tasyāṃ prāṇapratiṣṭhāpūrvakamiṣṭadevatārcanaṃ pūrvavat kāryamiti saṃpradāyavidaḥ | tathā |
tilena ghṛtayuktena śaktito homayet tataḥ | svarṇaṃ tu dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādgurave maṇisaṃkhyakām || 6-300 ||

mālāsaṃskāra ityukto jape syāt siddhidāyakaḥ |
atha vāmamārgiṇāṃ mālāsaṃskārastatraiva |
kīkaśādikamālānāṃ kaulikānāṃ ca vāminām || 6-302 ||

saṃhṛṣṭaḥ kalayenmālāṃ mantrapūtaṃ pibenmadhu | pañcāśanmaṇibhiḥ kāryā ṛtumatyā bhage kṣipet || 6-304 ||

prakṣālya dhūpayet paścāt protayediṣṭasūtrakaiḥ | sūtraṃ sveṣṭajape nīlaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ māraṇakarmaṇi || 6-306 ||
