vaśye pītaṃ kaṣāyaṃ tu vikṣepakaraṇe matam | cakrapūjāṃ tataḥ kuryāt sāṣṭottarasahasrakam || 6-308 ||
hunenmadyapalābhyāṃ ca mūlamantreṇa sādhakaḥ | tato valiṃ yathānyāyaṃ mahiṣādeḥ pradāpayet || 6-309 ||
śaktīśca sādhakāścā(/)pi bhojayenmaṇisaṃkhyakān | evaṃ saṃsādhitāṃ mālāṃ paśave na pradāpayet || 6-310 ||
atha karamālā (bālātantre)
tarjanī madhyamā'nāmā kaniṣṭhā ceti tāḥ kramāt | tisro'ṅgulyastriparvāṇo madhyamā caikaparvikā || 6-311 ||
parvadvayaṃ madhyamāyā merutvenopakalpayet |
tantrāntare |
anāmāmadhyamārabhya kaniṣṭhānukrameṇa ca || 6-312 ||
tarjanīmūlaparyantā karamālā prakīrtitā |
sanatkumāro'pi |
anāmāmadhyamārabhya kaniṣṭhādita eva ca || 6-313 ||
tarjanīmūlaparyantaṃ japeddaśasu parvasu | anāmāmūlamārabhya kaniṣṭhādita eva ca || 6-314 ||
tarjanīmadhyaparyantamaṣṭaparvasu saṃjapet |
ayamuttaraḥ ślokaścāṣṭottaraśatasaṃkhyajape karttavye śatajapottaramaṣṭajapaparaḥ | idaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaviṣayam | śaktiviṣaye tu |
ārabhyānāmikāmūlāt prādakṣiṇyakrameṇa tu || 6-315 ||
madhyamāmūlaparyantaṃ japedaṣṭasu parvasu | anāmāmadhyamaṃ parva meruṃ kṛtvā na laṅghayet || 6-316 ||
tarjanyagre tathā madhye yo japet tatra mānavaḥ | catvāri tasya naśyanti āyurvidyā yaśo dhanam || 6-317 ||
iti (siddhāntasāre) proktam | tatraiva |
anāmāmūlamārabhya prādakṣiṇyakrameṇa tu | tarjanīmūlaparyantaṃ japennavasu parvasu || 6-318 ||
idaṃ ca dvādaśāvṛttyā'ṣṭottaraśatasaṃkhyajapaparam | śrīvidyāyāṃ tu (yāmale)
anāmāmadhyamāyāśca mūlāgraṃ tu dvayaṃ dvayam | kaniṣṭhāyāśca tarjanyāstrayaṃ parva maheśvari || 6-319 ||
anāmāmadhyamāyāśca meruḥ syād dvitayaṃ śubham |
pradakṣiṇakramāddevi japet tripurasundarīm (-) iti viśeṣa uktaḥ || (merutantre)
aṅgulīrna viyuñjīta japakāle kadācana || 6-320 ||
aṅgulīnāṃ viyogena cchidreṣu sravate japaḥ | nollaṅghayecca gaṇanāṃ kiṃcit saṃkocayet talam || 6-321 ||
na darśayet karaṃ no cet phalaṃ gṛhṇanti rākṣasāḥ |
(puraścaraṇacandrikāyām)
aṅgulyagreṣu yajjaptaṃ yajjaptaṃ merulaṅghane || 6-322 ||
parvasandhiṣu yajjaptaṃ tatsarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet | gaṇanāvidhimullaṅghya yo japet tu pramādataḥ || 6-323 ||
gṛhṇanti rākṣasā yasmānniyataṃ gaṇayedbudhaḥ |
(rudrayāmale)
nākṣatairhastaparvairvā na dhānyairnaiva puṣpakaiḥ || 6-324 ||
na candanairmṛttikayā japasaṃkhyāṃ na kārayet | lākṣākusitasindūraṃ gomayaṃ ca karīṣakam || 6-325 ||
viloḍya guḍikāṃ kṛtvā japasaṃkhyāṃ tu kārayet |
(mantratantraprakāśe)
tatrāṅgulijapaṃ kurvan sāṅguṣṭhāṅgulibhirjapet || 6-326 ||
aṅguṣṭhena vinā karma kṛtaṃ tanniṣphalaṃ bhavet |
(muṇḍamālāyām)
nityaṃ japaṃ kare kuryānna tu kāmyaṃ kadācana || 6-327 ||
kāmyamapi kare kuryādyadi mālā na vidyate |
atha mudrāprakaraṇam |
tatra mudrāpadārtha uktaḥ (kulārṇave)
mudaṃ kurvanti devānāṃ manāṃsi drāvayanti ca || 6-328 ||
tasmānmudrā iti khyātā darśitavyāḥ kuleśvari |
(merutantre'pi)
mudaṃ svarūpalābhābhyāṃ dehadvāreṇa cātmanaḥ || 6-329 ||
yā arpayantyayatnena mudrāstāḥ śaktayo matāḥ | modayanti grahādibhyaḥ pāpaughaṃ drāvayanti ca || 6-330 ||
modanaṃ drāvaṇaṃ yasmādato mudrāḥ prakīrttitāḥ |
(yāmale)
modanāt sarvadevānāṃ drāvaṇāt pāpasantateḥ || 6-331 ||
tasmānmudreyamākhyātā sarvakarmārthasādhinī | atha mudrāḥ pravakṣyāmi sarvatantreṣu gopitāḥ || 6-332 ||
yābhirviracitābhiśca modante mantradevatāḥ | arcayejjapakāle ca dhyāne kāmye ca karmaṇi || 6-333 ||
snāne cāvāhane śaṅkhe pratiṣṭhāyāṃ ca rakṣaṇe | naivedye ca tathā'nyatra tattatkalpaprakāśite || 6-334 ||
sthāne mudrā darśitavyāḥ svasvalakṣaṇalakṣitāḥ | āvāhanādikā mudrā nava sādhāraṇā matāḥ || 6-335 ||
tathā ṣaḍaṅgamudrāśca sarvamantreṣu yojayet | ekonaviṃśatirmudrā viṣṇoruktā manīṣibhiḥ || 6-336 ||
śaṅkhacakragadāpadmaveṇuśrīvatsakaustubhāḥ | vanamālā tathā jñānamudrā vilvāhvayā tathā || 6-337 ||
garuḍākhyā tathā mudrā viṣṇoḥ santoṣavardhinī | nārasiṃhī ca vārāhī hayagrīvī dhanustathā || 6-338 ||
bāṇamudrā tataḥ parśurjaganmohanikā tathā | kāmamudrā parā khyātā śivasya daśa mudrikāḥ || 6-339 ||
liṅgayonitriśūlākhyā māleṣṭābhīmṛgātmikāḥ | khaṭvāṅgā ca kapālākhyā ḍamaruḥ śivatoṣakaḥ || 6-340 ||
sūryasya caiva padmākhyā sapta mudrā gaṇeśituḥ | dantapāśāṅkuśā vighnaparśulaḍḍukasaṃjñakāḥ || 6-341 ||
bījapūrāhvayā mudrāḥ vijñeyā vighnapārcane | pāśāṅkuśavarābhītikhaḍgacakradhanuḥśarāḥ || 6-342 ||
mauśalī mudrikā daurgī mudrāḥ śakteḥ priyaṅkarāḥ | lakṣmīmudrā'rcane lakṣmīvāgvādinyāstu pūjane || 6-343 ||
akṣamālā tathā vīṇā vyākhyā pustakamudrikā | saptajihvāhvayā mudrā vijñeyā vahnipūjane || 6-344 ||
matsyamudrā ca kūrmākhyā lelihā muṇḍasaṃjñakā | mahāyoniriti khyātā sarvasiddhisamṛddhidā || 6-345 ||
śaktyarcane mahāyoniḥ śyāmādau muṇḍamudrikā | matsyakūrmākhyalelihāḥ sarvasādhāraṇe matāḥ || 6-346 ||
daśemā mudrikā jñeyāstripurāyāḥ prapūjane | saṃkṣobhadrāvaṇākarṣavaśyonmādamahāṅkuśāḥ || 6-347 ||
khecarī bījayonyākhyā trikhaṇḍā parikīrttitā | kumbhamudrā'bhiṣeke syāt padmamudrā'sane tathā || 6-348 ||
kālakarṇī prayoktavyā vighnapraśamakarmaṇi | gālinī ca prayoktavyā jalaśodhanakarmaṇi || 6-349 ||
śrīgopālārcane veṇurnṛharernārasiṃhikā | varāhasya ca pūjāyāṃ vārāhāsyāṃ pradarśayet || 6-350 ||
rāmārcane dhanurbāṇamudre parśustathā'rcane | parśurāmasya vijñeyā jaganmohanasaṃjñakā || 6-351 ||
vāsudevāhvayā dhyāne kumbhamudrā'nurakṣaṇe | sarvatra prārthane caiva prārthanākhyāṃ prayojayet || 6-352 ||
uddeśānukramādāsāmucyante lakṣaṇāni ca || 6-252ef ||
āvāhanādikā mudrā mātṛkānyāsamudrāśca prāguktāstadanyā ihocyante | tatraiva |
aṅguṣṭhā ṛjavo hastaśākhā bhavenmudrā hṛdaye śīrṣake ca | adho'ṅguṣṭhā khalu muṣṭiḥ śikhāyāṃ karadvandvāṅgulayo varmaṇi syuḥ || 6-353 ||
nārācamuṣṭirdhṛtabāhuyugma(-) kāṅguṣṭhatarjanyudito dhvanistu | viṣvagvibhaktaḥ kathitāstu mudrā yatrākṣiṇī tarjanimadhyame staḥ || 6-354 ||
netratrayaṃ tatra bhavedanāmā ṣaḍaṅgamudrāḥ kathitā yathāvat |
vaiṣṇavīnāṃ tu mudrāṇāṃ kathyante lakṣaṇānyatha | vāmāṅguṣṭhaṃ tu saṃgṛhya dakṣiṇena tu muṣṭinā || 6-355 ||
kṛtvottānaṃ tato muṣṭimaṅguṣṭhaṃ tu prasārayet | vāmāṅgulyastathā'śliṣṭāḥ saṃyuktāḥ saṃprasāritāḥ || 6-356 ||
dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhasaṃsṛṣṭā mudraiṣā śaṅkhasaṃjñikā | hastau tu saṃmukhau kṛtvā saṃlagnau suprasāritau || 6-357 ||
kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhakau lagnau mudraiṣā cakrasaṃjñakā | anyonyābhimukhau hastau kṛtvā tu grathitāṅgalī || 6-358 ||
aṅgalyau madhyame bhūyaḥ saṃlagne suprasārite | gadā mudreyamākhyātā viṣṇoḥ santoṣavardhinī || 6-359 ||
hastau tu saṃmukhau kṛtvā saṃnatāvunnatāṅgulī | talāntanilitāṅguṣṭhau kṛtvaiṣā padmamudrikā || 6-360 ||
oṣṭhe vāmakarāṅguṣṭho lagnastasya kaniṣṭhikā | dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhasaṃyogāt kaniṣṭhā suprasāritā || 6-361 ||
tarjanīmadhyamānāmāḥ kiṃcit saṃkocya cālitāḥ | veṇumudrā bhavedeṣā suguptā preyasī hareḥ || 6-362 ||
anyonyaspṛṣṭakarayormadhyamānāmikāṅgulīḥ | aṅguṣṭena tu vadhnīyāt kaniṣṭhāmūlasaṃsthite || 6-363 ||
tarjanyau kārayedeṣā mudrā śrīvatsasaṃjñakā | anāmāpṛṣṭhasaṃlagnāṃ dakṣiṇasya kaniṣṭhikām || 6-364 ||
kaniṣṭhayā'nyayā baddhvā tarjanyā dakṣayā tathā | vāmānāmāṃ ca badhnīyāddakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhamūlake || 6-365 ||
aṅguṣṭhamadhyame vāme saṃyojya saralāḥ parāḥ | catasro'pyagrasaṃlagnā mudrā kaustubhasaṃjñakā || 6-366 ||
spṛśet kaṇṭhādipādāntaṃ tarjanyaṅguṣṭhayā tathā | karadvayena mālā cenmudreyaṃ vanamālikā || 6-367 ||
tarjanyaṅguṣṭhakau śaktāvagrato hṛdi vinyaset | vāmahastāmbujaṃ vāmajānuṃ mūrdhni pravinyaset || 6-369 ||
jñānamudrā bhavedeṣā rāmacandrasya preyasī || 6-369ef ||
aṅguṣṭhaṃ vāmamuddaṇḍitamitarakarāṅguṣṭhakenātha baddhvā tasyāgraṃ pīḍayitvā'ṅgulibhirapi ca tā vāmahastāṅgulībhiḥ | baddhvā gāḍhaṃ hṛdi sthāpayatu vimaladhīrvyāharanmārabījaṃ vilvākhyā mudrikaiṣā sphuṭamiha kathitā goyanīyā vidhijñaiḥ || 6-370 ||
hastau tu vimukhau kṛtvā granthayitvā kaniṣṭhike | mithastarjanike śliṣṭe śliṣṭāvaṅguṣṭhakau tathā || 6-371 ||
madhyame nāmike dve tu dvau pakṣāviva cālayet | eṣā garuḍamudrākhyā viṣṇoḥ santoṣavardhinī || 6-372 ||
jānumadhye karau kṛtvā cibukauṣṭhau samāvṛtau | hastau ca bhūmisaṃlagnau kampamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ || 6-373 ||
mukhaṃ vivṛtakaṃ kuryāllelihānaśca jihvikām | nārasiṃhī bhavedeṣā mudrā tatprītivardhinī || 6-374 ||
aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ ca karayorathākramya kaniṣṭhike | adhomukhībhiḥ sarvābhirmudreyaṃ nṛharermatā || 6-375 ||
devopari karaṃ vāmaṃ kṛtvottānamadhaḥ sudhīḥ | nāmayediti saṃproktā mudrā vārāhasaṃjñikā || 6-376 ||
dakṣahastaṃ cordhvamukhaṃ vāmahastamadho mukham | aṅgulyagraṃ tu saṃyuktaṃ mudrā vārāhasaṃjñikā || 6-377 ||
vāmahastatale dakṣā aṅgulīstāstvadhomukhīḥ | saṃropya madhyamāṃ tāsāmunnāmyādho vikuñcayet || 6-378 ||
hayagrīvapriyā mudrā tanmūrteranukāriṇī | vāmasya madhyamāgraṃ tu tarjanyagreṇa yojayet || 6-379 ||
anāmikāṃ kaniṣṭhāṃ ca tasyāṅguṣṭhena pīḍayet | darśayedvāmake skandhe dhanurmudreyamīritā || 6-380 ||
dakṣamuṣṭisthatarjanyā dīrghayā bāṇamudrikā |
yadvā (jñānārṇave)
yathā hastagataṃ cāpaṃ tathā hastaṃ priye kuru || 6-381 ||
cāpamudreyamākhyātā vāmahaste tvavasthitā | kalpadrumā dhanurmudrā yaśaḥkīrttivivardhinī || 6-382 ||
yathā hastagato bāṇastathā hastaṃ kuru priye | bāṇamudreyamākhyātā ripuvarganikṛntinī || 6-383 ||
tale talaṃ tu karayostiryak saṃyojya cāṅgulīḥ | saṃhatāḥ prasṛtāḥ kuryānmudrā paraśusaṃjñakā || 6-384 ||
ūrdhvasthāṅguṣṭhamuṣṭī dve mudrā trailokyamohinī | hastau tu saṃpuṭīkṛtvā prasṛtāṅgulikau tathā || 6-385 ||
tarjanyau madhyamāpṛṣṭhe aṅguṣṭhau madhyamāsthitau | kāmamudreyamuditā sarvadevapriyaṅkarī || 6-386 ||
mahādevapriyāṇāṃ ca kathyante lakṣaṇānyatha | ucchritaṃ dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhaṃ vāmāṅguṣṭhena bandhayet || 6-387 ||
vāmāṅgulībhirdakṣābhiraṅgulībhiśca bandhayet | liṅgamudreyamākhyātā śivasānnidhyakāriṇī || 6-388 ||
mithaḥ kaniṣṭhike baddhvā tarjanībhyāmanāmike | anāmikordhvasaṃśliṣṭadīrghamadhyamayoradhaḥ || 6-389 ||
aṅguṣṭhāgradvayaṃ nyasya yonimudreyamīritā | aṅguṣṭhena kaniṣṭhāṃ tu baddhvā śliṣṭāṅgulitrayam || 6-390 ||
prasārayet triśūlākhyā mudraiṣā parikīrtitā | aṅguṣṭhatarjanyagre tu granthayitvā'ṅgulitram || 6-391 ||
prasārayedakṣamālā mudreyaṃ parikīrttitā | adhaḥsthito dakṣahastaḥ prasṛtāvaramudrikā || 6-392 ||
ūrdhvīkṛto vāmahastaḥ prasṛtobhayamudrikā | militānāmikāṅguṣṭhaṃ madhyamāgre niyojayet || 6-393 ||
śliṣṭāṅgulyaśrite kuryānmṛgamudreyamīritā | pañcāṅgulyo dakṣiṇāstu militā hyūrdhvamunnatāḥ || 6-394 ||
khaṭvāṅgamudrā vikhyātā śivasyātipriyā matā | pātravadvāmahastaṃ ca kṛtvā'ṅge vāmake tathā || 6-395 ||
nidhāyocchritavat kuryānmudrā kāpālikī matā | muṣṭiṃ ca śithilāṃ baddhvā īṣaducchritamadhyamām || 6-396 ||
dakṣiṇāmūrdhvamunnamya karṇadeśe pracārayet | eṣā ḍamarumudrākhyā sarvavighnavināśinī || 6-397 ||
tato gaṇeśamudrāṇāmucyante lakṣaṇānyathā | uttānordhvamukhī madhyā saralā baddhamuṣṭikā || 6-398 ||
dantamudrā samākhyātā sarvāgamaviśāradaiḥ | vāmamuṣṭisthatarjanyā dakṣamuṣṭisthatarjanīm || 6-399 ||
saṃyojyāṅguṣṭhakāgre tu tarjanyagre svake kṣipet | eṣā pāśāhvayā mudrā vidvadbhiḥ parikīrttitā || 6-400 ||
ṛjvīṃ ca madhyamāṃ kṛtvā tarjanīṃ madhyaparvaṇi | saṃyojyākuñcayet kiṃcinmudraiṣā'ṅkuśasaṃjñikā || 6-401 ||
tarjanīmadhyamānāmākaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhamuṣṭikā | adhomukhī dīrgharūpā madhyamā vighnamudrikā || 6-402 ||
parśumudrā nigaditā prasiddhā laḍḍumudrikā | bījapūrāhvayā mudrā prasiddhatvādupekṣitā || 6-403 ||
śākteyānāṃ ca mudrāṇāṃ kathyante lakṣaṇānyatha | pāśāṅkuśavarābhītidhanurbāṇāḥ samīritāḥ || 6-404 ||
kaniṣṭhānāmike baddhvā svāṅguṣṭhenaiva dakṣataḥ | śliṣṭāṅgulī tu prasṛte saṃsṛṣṭe khaḍgamudrikā || 6-405 ||
vāmahastaṃ tathā tiryak kṛtvā caiva prasārya ca | āṅkuñcitāṅguliṃ kuryāccarmamudreyamīritā || 6-406 ||
muṣṭiṃ kṛtvā tu hastābhyā vāmasyopari dakṣiṇām | kuryānmuśalamudreyaṃ sarvavighnavināśinī || 6-407 ||
kṛtvā śirasi saṃyojya durgāmudreyamīritā | cakramudrāṃ tathā baddhvā madhyame dve prasārya ca || 6-408 ||
kaniṣṭhike tathā'nīya tadagre'ṅguṣṭhakau kṣipet | lakṣmīmudrā parā hyeṣā sarvasaṃpatpradāyinī || 6-409 ||
vīṇāvādanavaddhastau kṛtvā saṃcālayecchiraḥ | vīṇāmudreyamākhyātā sarasvatyāḥ priyaṅkarī || 6-410 ||
vāmamuṣṭiṃ svābhimukhīṃ kṛtvā pustakamudrikā | dakṣiṇāṅguṭhajarjanyoragralagne padāṅgulīḥ || 6-411 ||
prasārya saṃhitottānā eṣā vyākhyānamudrikā | śrīrāmasya sarasvatyā atyantaṃ preyasī matā || 6-412 ||
maṇibandhasthitau kṛtvā prasṛtāṅgulikau karau | kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhayugale militāṃ tu prasārayet || 6-413 ||
saptajihvākhyamudreyaṃ vaiśvānarapriyaṅkarī | kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhakau śaktau karayoritaretaram || 6-414 ||
tarjanīmadhyamānāmāḥ saṃhatā bhugnavarjitāḥ | mudraiṣā gālinī proktā śaṅkhasyopari cālitā || 6-415 ||
dakṣāṅguṭhaṃ parāṅguṣṭhe kṣiptvā hastadvayena tu | sāvakāśātmakāṃ muṣṭiṃ kuryāt sā kumbhamudrikā || 6-416 ||
muṣṭyorūrdhvakṛtāṅguṣṭhau tarjanyagre tu vinyaset | sarvarakṣākarī hyeṣā kumbhamudreyamīritā || 6-417 ||
prasṛtāṅgulikau hastau mithaḥśliṣṭau tu saṃmukhau | kuryāt svahṛdaye seyaṃ mudrā prārthanasaṃjñikā || 6-418 ||
añjalpañjalimudrā syādvāsudevābhidhā ca sā | aṅguṣṭhāvunnatau kṛtvā muṣṭyoḥ saṃlagnayordvayoḥ || 6-419 ||
tāvevābhimukhau kuryānmudrā sā kālakarṇikā | dakṣiṇā niviḍā muṣṭirnāsikārpitatarjanī || 6-420 ||
mudrā vismayasaṃjñā syādvismayāveśakāriṇī | muṣṭirūrdhvīkṛtāṅguṣṭhā dakṣiṇā nādamudrikā || 6-421 ||
tarjanyaṅguṣṭhasaṃyogādagrato vindumudrikā | adhomukhe vāmahaste ūrdhvāsyaṃ dakṣahastakam || 6-422 ||
kṣiptvā'ṅgulīraṅgulībhiḥ saṃgranthya parivartayet | eṣā saṃhāramudrā syādvisarjanavidhau smṛtā || 6-423 ||
dakṣapāṇipṛṣṭhadeśe vāmapāṇitalaṃ spṛśet | aṅguṣṭhau cālayet samyagmudreyaṃ matsyarūpiṇī || 6-424 ||
vāmahastasya tarjanyā dakṣiṇasya kaniṣṭhikām | tasya dakṣiṇatarjanyāṃ dakṣiṇasya kaniṣṭhikām || 6-425 ||
tathā dakṣiṇatarjanyāṃ vāmāṅguṣṭhaṃ niyojayet | unnataṃ dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhaṃ vāmasya mādhyamādikāḥ || 6-426 ||
aṅgulīryojayet pṛṣṭhe dakṣiṇasya karasya ca | vāmasya pitṛtīrthena madhyamānāmike tathā || 6-427 ||
adhomukhe ca te kuryāddakṣiṇasya karasya ca | kūrmapṛṣṭhasamaṃ kuryāddakṣapāṇiṃ ca sarvataḥ || 6-428 ||
kūrmamudreyamākhyātā devatādhyānakarmaṇi |
pṛṣṭhe kroḍe |
antarāṅguṣṭhamuṣṭiṃ tu kṛtvā vāmakarasya ca || 6-429 ||
madhyamāgraṃ tu dakṣasya tathā'lambya prayatnataḥ | madhyamenātha tarjanyā aṅguṣṭhāgre tu yojayet || 6-430 ||
dakṣiṇaṃ yojayet pāṇiṃ vāmamuṣṭau tu sādhakaḥ | darśayeddakṣiṇe bhāge muṇḍamudreyamucyate || 6-431 ||
tarjanīmadhyamānāmāḥ samaṃ kuryādadhomukham | anāmāyāṃ kṣipedvṛddhāmṛjvīṃ kṛtvā kaniṣṭhikām || 6-432 ||
lelihā nāma mudreyaṃ jīvanyāse prakīrttitā | tarjanyanāmikāmadhye kaniṣṭhākramayogataḥ || 6-433 ||
karayoryojayeccaiva kaniṣṭhāmūladevatām | aṅgulyagre tu niḥkṣipya mahāyoniḥ prakīrttitā || 6-434 ||
(vāmakeśvara-)tantroktāḥ prakāśyante'tra mudrikāḥ | śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi mudrāḥ sarvārthasiddhidāḥ || 6-435 ||
yābhirvirācitābhistu sānnidhyaṃ traipuraṃ bhavet | parivṛtya karau spṛṣṭāvaṅguṣṭhau kārayet samau || 6-436 ||
anāmāntargate kṛtvā tarjanyau kuṭilākṛtī | kaniṣṭhike niyuñjīta nijasthāne maheśvari || 6-437 ||
trikhaṇḍeyaṃ samākhyātā tripurādhyānakarmaṇi | madhyamāmadhyage kṛtvā kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭharodhite || 6-438 ||
tarjanyau daṇḍavat kṛtvā madhyamoparyanāmike | eṣā ca prathamā mudrā sarvasaṃkṣobhakāriṇī || 6-439 ||
etasyā eva mudrāyā madhyame sarale yathā | kriyate parameśāni sarvavidrāviṇī tathā || 6-440 ||
madhyamātarjanībhyāṃ ca kaniṣṭhānāmike same | aṅkuśākāramudrābhyāṃ madhyame parameśvari || 6-441 ||
aṅguṣṭhaṃ tu niyuñjīta kaniṣṭhānāmikopari | iyamākarṣaṇī mudrā trailokyākarṣaṇī parā || 6-442 ||
puṭākārau karau kṛtvā tarjanyāvaṅkuśākṛtī | parivarttya krameṇaiva madhyame tadadhogate || 6-443 ||
krameṇa devi tenaiva kaniṣṭhānāmikādayaḥ | saṃyojyā niviḍāḥ sarvā aṅguṣṭhāvagradeśataḥ || 6-444 ||
etadvacanatrayaṃ ca mārgabhedena vyavasthāpanīyam |
tattvaṃ tarpaṇamātraṃ tu vāmahastena dakṣiṇe | dakṣahastena vāme'pi viśeṣaḥ parikīrttitaḥ || 6-445 ||
dakṣavāmakriyāyuktaḥ kaulaścobhayamiśritaḥ |
iti prāglikhitaprāmāṇāddakṣiṇamārgiṇāṃ dakṣahastena pūjanaṃ vāmahastena tarpaṇam | vāmamārgiṇāṃ vāmahastena pūjanaṃ dakṣahastena tarpaṇam | kaulikānāṃ tu devatarpaṇe karayoraicchiko vikalpa iti vivekāt | tarpaṇe ca kāmanābhadenāṅgulibheda uktastatrāntare |
aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ tu vaśyakarmaṇi tarpayet || 6-446 ||
aṅguṣṭhamadhyamābhyāṃ tu tarpayecchāntikarmaṇi | tarjanyaṅguṣṭhayogena tarpayedabhicārike || 6-447 ||
kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhayogena stambhane tarpayet priye |
tantrāntare |
mithaḥ pṛṣṭhārpitau hastāvanyonyagrathitāṅgulī || 6-448 ||
kṛtvā baddhvā parāvṛtya natvā sā syāt kṣamāpinī |
(bhairavatantre)
yoniśca bhūtinī caiva bījākhyā daityadhūpinī || 6-449 ||
lelihāneti saṃprāptāḥ pañca mudrāḥ prakīrttitāḥ |
ādyāstisraḥ prāguktāḥ | antyayorlakṣaṇe tu tatraiva |
parivarttya karau kṛtvā kaniṣṭhākṛṣṭamadhyamām || 6-450 ||
anāmayoryugaṃ cādhastarjanīyugalaṃ pṛthak | anyonyaṃ niviḍaṃ baddhvā aṅgāṣṭhagre anāmikāḥ || 6-451 ||
daityānāṃ dhūmaketvākhyā mudraiṣā kathitā priye | vaktraṃ visphāritaṃ kṛtvā'pyadho jihvāṃ ca cālayet || 6-452 ||
pārśvasthamuṣṭiyugalaṃ lelihāneti kīrttitā |
iti mudrāprakaraṇam |
atha niyamāḥ (kulārṇave)
niyamavyatirekeṇa yadyat karma karoti yaḥ || 6-453 || 6-
kiṃ cidapyasya na phalaṃ siddhyatyakramadoṣataḥ | nyūnātiriktakarmāṇi na phalanti kadācana || 6-454 ||
yathāvidhi kṛtānīha tatkarmāṇi phalanti hi | tadvidhānakṛtaṃ karma japahomārcanādikam || 6-455 ||
devatāprītidaṃ bhūyādbhuktimuktiphalapradam |
(yāmale)
brāhme muhūrte cotthāya saṃsmṛtya gurupādukām || 6-456 ||
prātaḥkṛtyaṃ vidhāyātha kṛtvā śaucādikaṃ tataḥ | dantān pradhāvya tīrthādau gatvā snānaṃ samācaret || 6-457 ||
sandhyāmupāsya vidhivaddevarṣipitṛtarpaṇam | samāpya datvā dānāni maunī japagṛhaṃ vrajet || 6-458 ||
nityārcanaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā nityahomaṃ vidhāya ca | kṛtvā naimittikīṃ pūjāṃ vidhivajjapamācaret || 6-459 ||
tathā |
evaṃ kṛtvā sādhakendrāḥ siddhyanti devatārcanāt |
(svatantratantre)
nityanaimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ sāpekṣaṃ pūrvapūrvataḥ || 6-460 ||
anyathā tu bhavedvyarthaṃ kuryādāvaśyakaṃ tataḥ |
tantrāntare |
trisandhyamarcayeddevaṃ bhaktiṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ || 6-461 ||
(puraścaraṇacandrikāyām)
saṃpūjyaivaṃ japaṃ kuryānna mantraṃ kevalaṃ japet |
gautamaḥ |
śaktyā triṣavaṇaṃ snānamatha vā dve sakṛcca vā || 6-462 ||
trisandhyaṃ prajapenmantraṃ pūjanaṃ tatsamaṃ bhavet | ekadā vā bhavet pūjā na japet pūjanaṃ vinā || 6-463 ||
japānte ca bhavet pūjā pūjānte vā japenmanum |
anyatrāpi |
mantraṃ sādhayamānastu trisandhyaṃ devamarcayet || 6-464 ||
dvisandhyamekasandhyaṃ vā na mantraṃ kevalaṃ japet |
(muṇḍamālāyām)
yadi pūjādyaśaktaḥ syāddravyābhāvena sundari || 6-465 ||
kevalaṃ japamātreṇa puraścaryā vidhīyate |
strīṇāṃ viśeṣamāha (yāmale)
niyamaḥ puruṣe jñeyo na yoṣitsu kadācana || 6-466 ||
(vīratantre)
na nyāso yoṣitāṃ cātra na dhyānaṃ na ca pūjanam | kevalaṃ japamātreṇa mantrāḥ siddhyanti yoṣitām || 6-467 ||
(candrikāyām)

mantrārtho gurumukhādbodhyaḥ | mantracaitanyaṃ vakṣyate | yonimudrā dvitīyataraṅge uktā | sūtakādijñānaprakārastatraiva |
jātasūtakamādau syādante ca mṛtasūtakam | sūtakadvayasaṃyukto yo mantraḥ sa na siddhyati || 6-1016 ||
gurukuṇḍalinīdhyānaṃ vivāhaḥ parikīrttitaḥ | dvirāgamo bhavet snānaṃ saṃyogaḥ sandhyayā bhavet || 6-1017 ||
arghadānaṃ bhavedgarbho gāyatrī tvaṣṭamāsikam | bhūtaśuddhyādiprāṇāntaṃ tatrāvayavakalpanam || 6-1018 ||
dehī bhavenmātṛkāyāḥ prāṇāyāmastu saṃskriyā | dhyānoccāre maheśāni bālakotpattirīritā || 6-1019 ||
mantroccāraṇato devi jātasūtakamīritam | jātasūtakadoṣasya śamanārthaṃ maheśvari || 6-1020 ||
daśaviṃśati pañcāśadyadyāśaktyā japecchive | idamādau samādiṣṭaṃ mṛtiṃ saṃśṛṇu sādaram || 6-1021 ||
aṅgajñānaṃ ca tādātmyaṃ tadanantaramīrtitam | visarjanaṃ maheśāni mṛtasūtakamīritam || 6-1022 ||
mṛtasūtakaśāntyarthaṃ daśaviṃśati vā japet | tena tasya nivṛttirhi bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 6-1023 ||
yaddhā |
brahmabījaṃ manordatvā ādyante parameśvari | saptavāraṃ japenmantraṃ sūtakadvayamuktaye || 6-1024 ||
brahmabījaṃ praṇavaḥ | atha mantrāṇāṃ svāpaprabodhakālī (pañcarātre)
svāpakāle tu mantrasya japo na ca phalapradaḥ | svāpakālo vāmavaho jāgaro dakṣiṇāvahaḥ || 6-1025 ||
āgneyasya manoḥ saumyamantrasyaitadviparyayaḥ | prabodhakālaṃ jānīyādubhayorubhayorapi || 6-1026 ||
jñeyā mantrāstu āgneyā vidyāḥ saumyāḥ prakīrttitāḥ |
mantravidyayorbhedastu prathamataraṅge uktaḥ | atha mantraśikhājñānaṃ tantrāntare |
śṛṇu devi paraṃ tattvaṃ sarvajñānottamottamam || 6-1027 ||
yena vijñātamātreṇa kṣipraṃ vidyā prasīdati | mūlakuṇḍe tu yā śaktirbhujaṅgākārarūpiṇī || 6-1028 ||
tadbhramāvarttavāto'yaṃ prāṇa ityābhidhīyate | taṃ tyaktvā'vyaktamadhuraṃ kūjantī sahasotthitā || 6-1029 ||
gacchantī brahmarandheṇa praviśantī punastanum | yātāyātakrameṇaiva ca tatra kuryānmanolayam || 6-1030 ||
tena mantraśikhā jātā sarvamantrapradīpinī | tamaḥpūrṇe gṛhe yadvanna kiñcit pratibhāsate || 6-1031 ||
śikhāhīnāstathā mantrā na siddhyanti kadācana | śikhopadeśaḥ sarvatra gopitaḥ parameśvari || 6-1032 ||
vinā yena na siddhiḥ syādvarṣakoṭiśatairapi | tasmādyatnena karttavyaṃ śikhāyā bhāvanaṃ manoḥ || 6-1033 ||
atha mantracaitanyaṃ tatraiva |
mantrarūpī bhaveddevo devarūpī gururbhavet | gururūpī bhavedātmā ātmarūpī manurbhavet || 6-1034 ||
iti te kathitaṃ devi mantracaitanyamuttamam | yasya vijñānamātreṇa advaitaṃ jñānamuttamam || 6-1035 ||
atha kullukā (yāmale) |
śrīdevyuvāca |
atha vai kullukotpattiṃ kathayasva mamādhunā | kullukā kīdṛśī nātha seturvā deva kīdṛśaḥ || 6-1036 ||
kīdṛśo vā mahāsetunirvāṇaṃ tvatha kīdṛśam | anyadvā kayitaṃ yanme kīdṛśaṃ tadvada prabho || 6-1037 ||
śrīśiva uvāca |
rahasyamapi te devi kathyate śṛṇu sāmpratam | vinā yena maheśāni niṣphalaṃ tu japādikam || 6-1038 ||
kullukā ca tathā seturmahāsetustathaiva ca | nirvāṇaṃ kuṇḍalīṣaṣṭīsarvotpattiṃ śṛṇu priye || 6-1039 ||
vidyānāṃ kulapūjyatvāt kullukā tena kīrttitā | vidyāsambandhidoṣāṇāṃ bhakṣayantī yataḥ śive || 6-1040 ||
teneyaṃ kullukānāmnī sarvatantreṣu gopitā | vidyāsiddhyarṇave devi yena pāraṃ pragacchati || 6-1041 ||
tena seturmaheśāni vidyāmārgaḥ prakīrttitaḥ | mahāvidyāptisaṃdarśo mahāseturmaheśvari || 6-1042 ||
mahāvidyārṇavasyātha caitanyasya pradarśakaḥ | mahāseturmahādevi mahāvidyāsvarūpadhṛk || 6-1043 ||
devatāyāstu nirvāṇaṃ caitanyaṃ yacca kīrttitam | nirvāṇaṃ kathitaṃ bhadre vidyāvāṅmātṛkārṇakaiḥ || 6-1044 ||
nirvāṇaṃ parameśāni catuścaraṇamīritam | nirvāṇaṃ ca maheśāni prabrahmātmikā matā || 6-1045 ||
caturthaṃ kathitaṃ bhadre vidyācaraṇamīritam | pañcamī kuṇḍalī devī yathāvadavadhāraya || 6-1046 ||
mūlādhārādāvilāntaṃ visatantutanīyasīm | sarvadevasvarūpāṃ ca sarvavarṇapradīpinīm || 6-1047 ||
mahākuṇḍalinīṃ devīṃ samalīṃ kuṇḍalīṃ parām |
śrīdevyuvāca |
krameṇa daśavidyāyāḥ kullukāyā vidhiṃ vada || 6-1048 ||
śrīśiva uvāca |
pañcākṣarī kālikāyāḥ kullukā parikathyate | kālīkūrcaṃ ca dhūmāyāḥ phaḍantāḥ parameśvari || 6-1049 ||
aghorākhya ṛṣiḥ prokto virāṭchandaḥ prakīrttitam | devatā kullukā kālī bījaṃ māyābhidhaṃ matam || 6-1050 ||
kāmaśaktistathā kūrcaṃ kīlakaṃ parikīrttitam | ṣaḍdīrghāḍhyena kāmena ṣaḍaṅganyāsa īritaḥ || 6-1051 ||
dhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ kālikāvat samācaret | māyāvadhūstathā kūrcaṃ tāriṇīkullukāmatā || 6-1052 ||
tāriṇīkullukāyāśca virūpākṣa ṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ | uṣṇikchandaḥ samākhyātaṃ devatā nīlatāriṇī || 6-1053 ||
kūrcabījaṃ tathā māyā śaktirvadhūśca kīlakam | māyayā tu ṣaḍaṅgāni sarvaṃ nīlasarasvatī || 6-1054 ||
(triśaktiratne)
ajaptvā kullukāmantramasmṛtvā śrīpatiṃ harim | yo japet tāriṇīmantraṃ narake sa vilīyate || 6-1055 ||
japitvā kullukāmantramaṣṭottaraśataṃ sudhīḥ | prajapet tāriṇīṃ paścānnānyathā siddhimāpnuyāt || 6-1056 ||
kulasarvasvanāmasahasranāmastotrakathanāntaram |
harernāma na gṛhṇīyānna spṛśet tulasīdalam |
iti vacanaṃ tu vīraparamiti jñeyam | uktastotropāttaharernāmagrahaṇaṃ tu virakalpe'pi na niṣiddham |
yāni nāmāni santyatra prasaṅgānmuravairiṇaḥ || 6-1057 ||
iti tatraivoktatvāt |
(yāmale)
chinnāyāśca maheśāni kullukā'ṣṭākṣarī bhavet | vajravairocanīye ca ante varma prakīrtayet || 6-1058 ||
atikāla ṛṣiḥ prokto gāyatrīchanda īritam | ha(/)bījaṃ hu(/) tathā śaktiḥ kīlakaṃ rocanī matā || 6-1059 ||
śivaṣaḍdīrghayuktena ṣaḍaṅganyāsamācaret | dhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ chinnāvat samupācaret || 6-1060 ||
sundaryāḥ kullukā devi saṃproktā dvādaśākṣarī | vāgbhavaṃ kāmarājaṃ ca lajjā ca tripurepadam || 6-1061 ||
bhagavatīti padaṃ procya tadante ṭhadvayaṃ vadet | sundarīkullukāyāstu ṛṣirānandabhairavaḥ || 6-1062 ||
gāyatrīchanda ādiṣṭaṃ vāgbhavaṃ bījamīritam | lajjā śaktirmaheśāni kāmabījaṃ ca kīlakam || 6-1063 ||
devatā tripureśī ca ṣaḍaṅgaṃ tridvayena ca | dhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ sundarīvat samācaret || 6-1064 ||
saṃpatpradāyā prathamaṃ bījaṃ śrībhairavīmanau | vikarāla ṛṣiḥ proktaḥ paṅkticchandaḥ prakīrttitam || 6-1065 ||
devatā bhairavīnāmnā kullukā parikīrttitā | ha(/) bījaṃ sa(/) mahāśaktiramatra kīlakaṃ matam || 6-1066 ||
ṣaḍdīrghāḍhyena bījena ṣaḍaṅganyāsamācaret | mātaṅgīvagalālakṣmīdhūmocchiṣṭākrame śṛṇu || 6-1067 ||
(****************) (?) pañcānāṃ kullukā matā | ṛṣirbhairavanāmā ca yāvacchandāṃsi pārvati || 6-1068 ||
devatāsarvabījādisvasvadevakrameṇa ca | dhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ svadaivatavadācaret || 6-1069 ||
iyaṃ te kathitā devi saṃkṣepāt kullukā mayā | ajñātvā kullukāmetāṃ japate yo'dhamaḥ kudhīḥ || 6-1070 ||

tathā japādikaṃ sarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena yo japenmūrdhni kullukām || 6-1072 ||

kullukāṃ mūrdhni saṃcintya hṛdi setuṃ vicintayet | mahāsetuṃ viśuddhau ca sahasrāre samuddharet || 6-1073 ||

yadvā (rudrayāmale)
viprāṇāṃ praṇavaḥ setuḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ tathaiva ca || 6-1075 ||

sarveṣāmeva mantrāṇāmadhikāro na tasya hi | mahāsetuṃ ca deveśi sundaryā bhuvaneśvari || 6-1077 ||

ādau japtvā mahāsetuṃ japenmantramananyadhīḥ | dhanairdhaneśatulyo'sau vāṇyā vāgīśvaropamaḥ || 6-1079 ||
buddhau kṛtāntasadṛśo nārīṇāṃ madanopamaḥ | japakālo bhavet tasya sarvakālo na saṃśayaḥ || 6-1080 ||
(merutantre)
niḥsetukaṃ yathā toyaṃ kṣaṇānnimnaṃ prasarpati | mantrastathaiva niḥsetuḥ kṣaṇāt kṣarati yajvanām || 6-1081 ||
tasmāt sarvatra mantreṣu caturvarṇā dvijādayaḥ | pārśvayoḥ setumādāya japakarma samācaret || 6-1082 ||
atha nirvāṇam (rudrayāmale)
atha vakṣyāmi nirvāṇaṃ śṛṇu sāvahitā'naghe | praṇavaṃ pūrvamuccārya mātṛkādyaṃ samuccaret || 6-1083 ||
atha mūlaṃ maheśāni tato vāgbhavamuccaret | mātṛkāṃ ca samastāṃ ca punaḥ praṇavamuccaret || 6-1084 ||
evaṃ puṭitamūlaṃ tu prajapenmaṇipūrake | evaṃ nirvāṇamīśāni yo na jānāti pāmaraḥ || 6-1085 ||
varṣakoṭiśatenāpi siddhistasya na jāyate | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena yaduktaṃ tanmaheśvari || 6-1086 ||
tattadācaryavidhivajjapenmantramanuttamam | ṛṣiśchando devatā ca bījaṃ śaktiśra kīlakam || 6-1087 ||
bhāvayedyatnato devi tataḥ sveṣṭādikaṃ japet | evaṃ yadi japenmantrī mantrarājamanuttamam || 6-1088 ||
ṣaṇmāsāt siddhimāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā | sākṣāt sa eva jagatāmadhīśo nātra saṃśayaḥ || 6-1089 ||
sa dhanyaḥ sa ca vijñānī sa eva mantratattvavit | sa eva nirvṛto bhūmau viharet tu yathāsukham || 6-1090 ||
tasya darśanamātreṇa palāyante ca vairiṇaḥ || 6-1091ef ||
evaṃ kṛtvā praṇavapuṭitaṃ yo japenmantrarājaṃ tannirvāṇaṃ bhuvanamahite kullukānāṃ ca japtvā | teṣāṃ tadvannikhilabhuvanaṃ siddhayo'ṣṭau ca haste snehāduktaṃ rahasi vacanaṃ janmajanmāntareṣu || 6-1092 ||
atha jihvāśodhanamantraḥ (yāmale)
aparaikaṃ pravakṣyāmi jihvāśodhanamuttamam | yanna kṛtvā mahādevi japapūjā vṛthā bhavet || 6-1093 ||
aśuddhajihvayā devi yo japet sa tu pāpakṛt | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena jihvāśodhanamācaret || 6-1094 ||
śrīdevyuvāca |
devadeva mahādeva śūlapāṇe pinākadhṛk | pṛthakpṛthaṅmahādeva kathayasva dayānidhe || 6-1095 ||
śodhanaṃ sarvavidyānāṃ mukhasya śodhanaṃ śubham |
śrīśiva uvāca |
śrībījaṃ praṇavaṃ lakṣmītāraṃ śrīpraṇavaṃ tathā || 6-1096 ||
idaṃ ṣaḍakṣarī vidyā sundaryā daśadhā japet | bhairavyāṃ śṛṇu cārvaṅgi mukhaśodhanamuttamam || 6-1097 ||
(*****)(?) hasau(/) bījaṃ praṇavaṃ suravandite | imaṃ hi tryakṣaraṃ mantraṃ daśadhā prathamaṃ japet || 6-1098 ||
śṛṇu sundari śyāmāyā mukhaśodhanamuttamam | nijabījatrayaṃ devi praṇavatritayaṃ punaḥ || 6-1099 ||
kāmatrayaṃ vahnibinduratibījayutaṃ trikam | eṣā navākṣarī vidyā jihvāśodhanakāriṇī || 6-1100 ||
tārāyāḥ śṛṇu cārvaṅgi apūrvaṃ mukhaśodhanam | jīvanī bhuvanā lajjā bhuvaneśī tataḥ priye || 6-1101 ||
tryakṣarīyaṃ mahāvidyā vijñeyā'mṛtavarṣiṇī | durgāyāḥ śṛṇu cārvaṅgi mukhaśodhanamuttamam || 6-1102 ||
dvādaśasvaramuddhṛtya vinduyuktaṃ trikaṃ tathā | aparaikaṃ pravakṣyāmi vagalāmukhaśodhanam || 6-1103 ||
vāgbhavaṃ bhuvaneśāni vāgbījaṃ suravandite | mātaṅgryāḥ śodhanaṃ devi aṅkuśaṃ vāgbhavaṃ tathā || 6-1104 ||
bījaṃ cāṅkuśametaddhi vijñeyaṃ tryakṣarīyakam | lakṣmyāśca śodhanaṃ devi śrībījaṃ kamalānane || 6-1105 ||
praṇavaṃ dāntamuddhṛtya vāmakarṇavibhūṣitam | punaḥ praṇavamuddhṛtya vijñeyaṃ tryakṣarī matā || 6-1106 ||
vālādīnāṃ ca anyāsāṃ praṇavaṃ mukhaśodhanam | strīśūdrāṇāṃ maheśāni aukāreṇa tu śodhanam || 6-1107 ||
mukhaśodhanamātreṇa jihvā'mṛtamayī bhavet | anyathā malaviḍyuktā jihvā bhavati sarvadā || 6-1108 ||
bhakṣaṇe dūṣitā jihvā mithyāvākyena dūṣitā | kalahairdūṣitā jihvā tatkathaṃ prajapenmanum || 6-1109 ||
tacchodhanamanācārya na japet pāmaraḥ kvacit | śaivaśāktavaiṣṇavānāṃ sarveṣāmapyavaśyakam || 6-1110 ||
anyathā prajapenmantraṃ mohena yadi bhāvini | sarvaṃ tasya vṛthā devi mantrasiddhirna jāyate || 6-1111 ||
ante narakamāpnoti bhavet sā'pi na cānyathā | devo yadi japenmantramakṛtvā mukhaśodhanam || 6-1112 ||
patanaṃ tasya vai devi kiṃ punarmarttyavāsinām |

yatnācca kīlakaṃ jñātvā kuryānmantrapuraskriyām | mantrāṇāṃ praṇavaḥ śrotraṃ mukhaṃ rephaḥ prakīrttitam || 6-1118 ||

tathā |
layaśrotrāsṛgāsyā hṛcchunyāḥ senadṛśasvarāḥ | garjinīdhūmrabhairavyorabhāve tu dṛśaḥ smṛtāḥ || 6-1123 ||

tathā |
saure tathā gāṇapatye daurge śaive'tha vaiṣṇave | bhautike ca manāvāsyahṛnnetraṃ dyotate yathā || 6-1125 ||
mūlākṣare vicāro'yaṃ mūlārṇaṃ bījamucyate | viṣe vicāraḥ karttavyo bīje sati viṣānvite || 6-1126 ||
tathā |
ebhiraśeṣamantrāṇāṃ hṛnnetravadanāni ca | asavo'sya parijñeyāḥ sarvatantreṣu gopitāḥ || 6-1127 ||

cintāmaṇinṛsiṃhākhye netrāsyaprāṇahṛcchrutī | yatra bījākṣaraṃ mantrastatra sarvaṃ sa eva hi || 6-1130 ||
pradhānapūrvaparagā vikalā yatra dṛśyate | tatra netraṃ vijānīyānmukhaṃ ca kṣatajokṣitam || 6-1131 ||

tathā |

homāṅgīnarūpaṇam |

mantrasiddhilakṣaṇam |
atha puraścaraṇabhedamantrasiddhilakṣaṇādiṣu nīrūpaṇīyeṣu sūcīkaṭāhanyāyena mantrasiddhilakṣaṇamādau nirūpyate | taduktaṃ (pañcarātre)
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi mantrasiddhestu lakṣaṇam | manorathānāmakleśe siddheruttamalakṣaṇam || 7-1 ||
mṛtyūnāṃ haraṇaṃ tadvaddevatādarśanaṃ tathā | prayogānāṃ kleśasiddhiḥ siddhestu lakṣaṇaṃ tathā || 7-2 ||
tathā |
parakāyapraveśaśca purapraveśanaṃ tathā | ūrdhvotkramaṇamevaṃ hi carācarapure gatiḥ || 7-3 ||
khecarīmelanaṃ caiva tatkathāśravaṇādikam | bhūchidrāṇi prapaśyet tu tasmāduttamalakṣaṇam || 7-4 ||
smaraṇe kīrttane viṣṇorānandāśruvimocanam | romāñcodgadgadālāpaścittasyaikāgratā tathā || 7-5 ||
viṣayeṣu ca vairāgyaṃ prītiśca parameśvare | tatkathāśravaṇautsukyaṃ tatpādasevane ratiḥ || 7-6 ||
tadguṇastutikāvyānāmavilambitakarttṛtā | tatpādāmbujacihnānāṃ darśanaṃ pūjanādiṣu || 7-7 ||
anāhatasya śabdasya bhavedākasmikī śrutiḥ | vinā'pi yogābhyasanaṃ caitaduttamalakṣaṇam || 7-8 ||
khyātirvāhanabhūṣādilābhaḥ sucirajīvanam | nṛpāṇāṃ tadgatānāṃ ca vaśīkaraṇamuttamam || 7-9 ||
sarvatra sarvalokeṣu camatkārakaraḥ śuciḥ | rogāpaharaṇaṃ dṛṣṭyā viṣāpaharaṇaṃ tathā || 7-10 ||
pāṇḍityaṃ labhate mantrī caturvidhamayatnataḥ | vairāgyaṃ ca mumukṣutvaṃ tyāgitā sarvavaśyatā || 7-11 ||
aṣṭāṅgayogābhyasanaṃ bhogecchāparivarjitam | sarvabhūteṣvanukampā sārvajñādiguṇodayaḥ || 7-12 ||
ityādiguṇasaṃpattirmadhyasiddhestu lakṣaṇam | khyātirvāhanabhūṣādilābhaḥ sucirajīvanam || 7-13 ||
nṛpāṇāmaṅganānāṃ ca vātsalyaṃ lokavaśyatā | mahaiśvaryaṃ ghanitvaṃ ca putrādidhanasaṃpadaḥ || 7-14 ||
adhamāḥ siddhayaḥ proktā mantriprathamabhūmikāḥ | siddhamantrastu yaḥ sākṣāt sa śivo nātra saṃśayaḥ || 7-15 ||
(sādhanasamuccaye)
siddho yasya mahāmantraḥ sādhanena balīyasā | devānāmapi duṣprāpāḥ siddhayastatkare sthitāḥ || 7-16 ||
dikcarī khecarī siddhiḥ pādukāsiddhireva ca | antarddhisiddhirvetālasiddhiḥ kāyapraveśanam || 7-17 ||
yakṣaṇī bhairavīsiddhiḥ khaḍgasiddhistathaiva ca | ājñāsiddhirdhātuvādaguṭikāñjanasiddhayaḥ || 7-18 ||
ākarṣaṇavaśīkārau drāvaṇaṃ mohanaṃ tathā | uccāṭanaṃ stambhanaṃ ca dveṣaṇaṃ māraṇaṃ tathā || 7-19 ||
unmādanaṃ śoṣaṇaṃ ca mūrchanaṃ kṣobhaṇaṃ tathā | grahāṇāṃ ca gatistambhaṃ vegastambhaṃ nabhasvataḥ || 7-20 ||
nadīmahārṇavastambhaṃ vākstambhaṃ prativādinām | gandharvoragadaityānāṃ kīnnarāṇāṃ ca rakṣasām || 7-21 ||
siddhavidyādharādīnāṃ kanyakākarṣaṇaṃ tathā | nṛpāṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca kṣaṇādākarṣaṇaṃ bhavet || 7-22 ||
śītalīkaraṇaṃ vahneḥ sarpāṇāṃ nirviṣīkriyā | śoṣaṇaṃ sāgarasyāpi trailokyasya vaśīkṛtiḥ || 7-23 ||
amoghavacanatvaṃ ca śāpe cānugrahe tathā | kāmarūpaṃ kāmagatiḥ kāmadātṛtvameva ca || 7-24 ||
aṇimā mahimā caiva garimā laghimā tathā | īśitvaṃ ca vaśitvaṃ ca prākāmyaṃ prāptireva ca || 7-25 ||
ityādyāḥ siddhayaḥ sarvā jāyante nātra saṃśayaḥ | bahunā'tra kimuktena siddhamantrasya mantriṇaḥ || 7-26 ||
yadyadiṣṭaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ karāmalakavadbhavet |
(nāradapañcarātre)
mantrārādhanaśaktasya prathame vatsaratraye || 7-27 ||
jayānte bahavo vighnā niyamasthasya nārada | nodvegaṃ sādhako yāti karmaṇā manasā yadi || 7-28 ||
tṛtīyavatsarādūrdhvaṃ rājānaśca mahībhṛtaḥ | prārthayante'nurodhena garvitā api māninaḥ || 7-29 ||
prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ nātha mamoddhāraṇakāraṇam | prajvalantaṃ ca paśyanti tejasā vibhavena ca || 7-30 ||
ataste muniśārdūla niṣṭhuraṃ vaktumakṣamāḥ | navamādvatsarādūrdhvaṃ svayaṃ siddhyati mantrarāṭ || 7-31 ||
nānāścaryāṇi hṛdaye mantrasiddhimayāni vai | atyānandapradānyāśu pratyakṣeṇa bahistathā || 7-32 ||
jaḍadhīstu kṣaṇaṃ vipraḥ kṣaṇamasti praharṣitaḥ | kṣaṇaṃ dundubhinirghoṣaṃ śṛṇotyapyantarikṣagam || 7-33 ||
kṣaṇaṃ ca madhuraṃ vādyaṃ nānāgītasamanvitam | ājighrati kṣaṇaṃ gandhān karpūramṛganābhijān || 7-34 ||
utpatantaṃ kṣaṇaṃ vā'pi paśyatyātmānamātmanā | candrārkakiraṇākīrṇaṃ kṣaṇamālokayan nabhaḥ || 7-35 ||
gajagovṛṣanādā(/)śca śṛṇuyācca kṣaṇaṃ dvijaḥ | nirbharāmbudasaṃkṣobhaṃ kṣaṇamākarṣayatyapi || 7-36 ||
tārakāṇi vicitrāṇi yogino nabhasi sthitān | paśyatyudgrāhayantaṃ ca kṣaṇaṃ mantravatāṃ sadā || 7-37 ||
kṣaṇaṃ kilikilārāvaṃ haṃsavarhiravaṃ tathā | kṣaṇaṃ meghodayaṃ paśyet kṣaṇaṃ rātriṃ dine sati || 7-38 ||
rātrau ca divasālokaṃ sasūryaṃ kṣaṇamīkṣate | balena paripūrṇaśca tejasā bhāskaropamaḥ || 7-39 ||
pūrṇendusadṛśaḥ kāntyā gamane vihagopamaḥ | śamena yuktaḥ prauḍhena gāmbhīryeṇa sukhena ca || 7-40 ||
svalpāśanenākṛśatā bahunā'pi nikhidyate | viṇmūtrayoralpatā hi bhavennidrākṣayastathā || 7-41 ||
japadhyānagato mantrī na khedamadhigacchati | vinā bhojanapānābhyāṃ pakṣamāsādikaṃ mune || 7-42 ||

yathā svalpasukhe magno na prāpnoti mahat sukham | tathā siddhau nimagnasya muktirdūre pravarttate || 7-48 ||

bubhukṣavaḥ santyeneke kecit santi mumukṣavaḥ | bhogamokṣanirākāṅkṣī viralo bhajate harim || 7-51 ||
sa eva jīvanamuktaḥ syānnārāyaṇamanāmayam | siddhau satyāmasatyāṃ ca bhajate yoganispṛhaḥ || 7-52 ||
(merutantre)
alpaṃ tapaḥ kṣaṇānnaśyenmadhyamaṃ cāpi garvataḥ | siddhidvārā mahat tasya cihnaṃ lakṣaṇamucyate || 7-53 ||
spne vā'kṣisamakṣaṃ vā āścaryamiti harṣadam | akasmādyadi jāyeta nākhyātavyaṃ gurorvinā || 7-54 ||

nikaṭasthāśca tāstasya siddhayo yānti dūrataḥ | āvirbhavanti duḥkhāni śokāśca vividhā api || 7-56 ||
alpāśanaṃ svalpanidrā sadā cittaprasannatā | prakāśayuk śarīraṃ ca vākyaṃ satyaṃ prajāyate || 7-57 ||
tathā |

(prapañcasāre)

arkābhastejasā'sau bhavati nalinajā santataṃ kiṅkarī syād (-) rogānaśyanti dṛṣṭyā drutamatha dhanadhānyākulastatsamīpam | devā nityaṃ namo'smai vidadhati phaṇinonaiva daṃśanti putrān pautrān mitrāṇi vṛddhā(/)stanuvipadi paraṃ dhāma viṣṇoḥ prayāti || 7-59 ||
iti siddhicihnāni | (phetkāriṇītantre)
karmaṇā prabalena pratibandhāvirodhinā | yadi siddhiṃ na labhate dvistrirvā punarācaret || 7-60 ||
atha dvitrairapi puraścaraṇairmantrāṇāmasidhau tatsiddhyarthamupāyānāha | (merutantre)
asiddhatvādgurordaivāt śiṣye siddhirna jāyate | tadopāyaṃ prakuryāddhi yadgopyamadhunocyate || 7-61 ||
anulomavilomena vinduvanmātṛkākṣaraiḥ | japet saṃpuṭitaṃ mantraṃ pratyahaṃ śatasaṅkhyayā || 7-62 ||
ekamāsaṃ tato homādikāt siddho bhavenmanuḥ | puraścaryoktamakhilamāhnikaṃ ca samācaret || 7-63 ||
vaidikamantre tu viśeṣa uktastatraiva |
evaṃ vaidikamantrasya siddhaye'drirasārṇakāḥ | varṇā deyā vinduyuktāḥ kramataścotkrameṇa ca || 7-64 ||
hrasvadīrghaplutairbhedaira (-) i (-) u (-) ṛ tridhā matāḥ | hrasvaḥ pluto ḷdvividha eco'pi dvividhā matāḥ || 7-65 ||
dīrghaplutavibhedena hyanusvāro visargakaḥ | caturviṃśatirākhyātāḥ svarā evaṃ yamaiḥ saha || 7-66 ||
catvāraḥ kādikā varṇā jihvāmūlīyayuk ca kaḥ | evaṃ kavargo daśadhā cādyāḥ pañcadaśa smṛtāḥ || 7-67 ||
upadhmānīyasaṃyuktaḥ pakārastena tatra ṣaṭ | yādyaṣṭāviti saṃproktā yajurvede tu mātṛkāḥ || 7-68 ||
lakṣau dvāvadhikau ṛkṣu jño'dhiko'tharvaṇi smṛtaḥ | japaścāṣṭottaraśataṃ pratyahaṃ māsamātrakam || 7-69 ||
anadhyāyaṃ varjayitvā catvāriṃśaddinaṃ tathā | homādisakalaṃ prāgvannityamevaṃ prakalpayet || 7-70 ||
upāyantaramāha tatraiva |
kuladaivatamantraṃ tu bhūtalipyā puṭīkuru | kramotkramāchatāvṛttiṃ kuryāt siddhistu māsataḥ || 7-71 ||
tathā |
atyugradevatājapyastvaṣṭottarasahasrakam | trikālaṃ gandhapuṣpādyairniśīthe pañcamaiḥ punaḥ || 7-72 ||
ṣaṇmāsaṃ kaulikādyaiścedarcitā suprasīdati |
bhūtalipiragre vakṣyate | athopāyāntarāṇi | (gandharvatantre)
anuṣṭhito yathānyāyaṃ yadi mantro na siddhyati || 7-73 ||
punastāvat prajaptavyastataḥ siddho bhavet punaḥ | punaścānuṣṭhito mantro yadi siddho na jāyate || 7-74 ||
upāyāstatra karttavyāḥ sapta śaṅkarabhāṣitāḥ |
(merutantre)
brahmadveṣādgurordoṣāt strīdveṣāccenna jāyate || 7-75 ||
śāpato vā'kīlitatvāt tatropāyāṣṭakaṃ bhavet | saṃpātāpyāyanaṃ drāvo bodhanaṃ ca vaśīkṛtiḥ || 7-76 ||
pīḍanaṃ poṣaśoṣau ca dahanaṃ tatkriyocyate | bhūrjapatraṃ samānīya padmamaṣṭadalaṃ likhet || 7-77 ||
aṣṭagandhena devasya rocanācandanena vā | sādhakasya tu nāmārṇairmantrasaṃdarbhitaṃ likhet || 7-78 ||
yāvaddvayoḥ samāptiḥ syāt tasya cādyantayorlikhet | tārādikaṃ sādhakasya nāmāthāṣṭadaleṣu tu || 7-79 ||
dvau dvau lekhyau svarau tacca samyak dhyāyan sudhātmakam | tat saṃveṣṭya mṛdā samyagveṣṭayedbrāhmaṇādikam || 7-80 ||
śuklādivarṇayā paścāt sikthakena ca veṣṭayet | kṣipet trimadhure tat tu mṛṇmaye laghubhājane || 7-81 ||
kṣīrapūrṇe nave kumbhe tat kṣipellaghubhājane | agniṃ saṃsthāpitaṃ kṛtvā sannidhau tasya taṃ ghaṭam || 7-82 ||
saṃsthāpayet trimadhurairmūlamantreṇa homayet | aṣṭādikasahasraṃ tu saṃpātaṃ kalaśe kṣipet || 7-83 ||
homaṃ samāpya taṃ kumbhaṃ niḥkṣipecca jalāśaye | svaguruṃ brāhmaṇā(/)ścānyā(/)stoṣayeddakṣiṇādibhiḥ || 7-84 ||
saṃpātāpyāyanaṃ caitaduktaṃ siddhirna cedbhavet | drāvaṇaṃ tu tadā kuryāt tatprakāra ihocyate || 7-85 ||
va(/) bījena granthayitvā bhūrjapatre likhenmanum | uśīrarocanābhyāṃ ca śilākarpūrakuṅkumaiḥ || 7-86 ||
kṣīrājyamadhutoyānāṃ madhye taṃ likhitaṃ kṣipet | pūjanācca japāddhomādrāvitaḥ phalado bhavet || 7-87 ||
drāvito'pi na siddhaścedbodhanaṃ tasya kārayet | vāgbhavena ca bījena saṃpuṭīkṛtya taṃ japet || 7-88 ||
evaṃ buddho bhavet siddho no cet kuryāt vaśīkṛtim | kucandanamahādāruharidrāmadanīśilāḥ || 7-89 ||
etaistu likhito mantro bhūrjapatre suśobhane | kaṇṭhe dhṛto bhavedvaśyo no cet kuryāt prapīḍanam || 7-90 ||
anudāttasvareṇādyamudāttena dvitīyakam | tṛtīyamanudāttena paṭhet turyamudāttataḥ || 7-91 ||
evaṃ padāni sarvāṇi paṭhenmantrasya sādhakaḥ | anudāttapadoccāre devaṃ dhyāyedadhaḥsthitam || 7-92 ||
ūrdhvasthitamudāttasyoccāre'ṣṭādhisahasrakam | japenmantraṃ tato bhūrje bhānudugdhena lekhayet || 7-93 ||
mantraṃ tamākramedvāmapādenātha ca homayet | aṣṭottaraśataṃ mantraṃ pīḍitaḥ san prasīdati || 7-94 ||
na sidhaścet tadā poṣyaḥ procyate tatkriyā'dhunā | hrasau(/) bījapuṭitaṃ mantraṃ vilikhedbhrarjapatrake || 7-95 ||
rocanākuṅkumābhyāṃ ca dhārayeddadhidugdhayoḥ | idaṃ poṣaṇamityuktaṃ doṣaśoṣaṇamucyate || 7-96 ||
yajñasya bhasmanā lekhyaṃ vāyubījavidarbhitam | bhūrjapatre sveṣṭamantraṃ tat kaṇṭhe dhārayediti || 7-97 ||
etacchoṣaṇamityuktaṃ dahanaṃ procyate'dhunā | pṛthak pṛthak ca mantrāṇāṃ caturdikṣu samāvṛtān || 7-98 ||
ra(/) bījena palāśasya bījatailena saṃlikhet | bhūrjapatre'tha taddhāryaṃ kaṇṭhe dāhakriyā tviyam || 7-99 ||
upāyāntarāṇyuktāni (yāmaleśvaragandharvādau |)
praṇavo mātṛkā devī hṛllekhetyamṛtatrayam | amṛtatrayasaṃyogādduṣṭamantro'pi siddhyati || 7-100 ||
suvarṇamarkatailaṃ ca piṣṭaṃ mantrāmbha eva ca | etālliptāṅgasaṃjapto mantraḥ kuṇṭho'pi sidhyati || 7-101 ||

suvarṇasūryatailena piṣṭena nijavāriṇā | talliptāṅgahutaḥ kuṇṭho manuḥ sadyaḥ prasīdati || 7-102 ||

ādāvante ca mantrasya hṛllekhā kāmabījakam | śrībījaṃ ca viniḥkṣipya japenmantraṃ tu siddhaye || 7-103 ||

ityupāyāḥ | atha puraścaraṇabhedāḥ (vāḍavānalīye)

homādīni tataḥ kuryāt tadaṅgāni vidhānataḥ | evaṃ kṛte mahādevi bhavenmantraḥ phalapradaḥ || 7-109 ||

tatraiva |

ṣaṭsahasraṃ japennityaṃ bhaktibhāvaparāyaṇaḥ |
tathā |
athavā'nyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamucyate || 7-113 ||

yonipīṭhaṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ kāmarūpaṃ tathā'param | tayorekatamaṃ pūjyaṃ rudradeha ivāparaḥ || 7-116 ||
(candrapīṭhaṃ)

ūrje tapasi rādhe vā śuklapakṣastu vaiṣṇave | ekādaśyanta aiśe tu bhūtāntaḥ phālgune smṛtaḥ || 7-118 ||

caturthayāme karttavyā mālāmantre daśāṃśataḥ | viṃśāṃśādvā daśāṃśādvā anyeṣvapi hutaṃ matam || 7-121 ||
dakṣiṇā ca yathoktā ca vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kārayet | evaṃ mantraḥ prayogārho bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 7-122 ||

atra tithiniyamo nokta iti pūrvasmādviśeṣaḥ |
athavā'nyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamucyate | sūryāstaṃ ca samārabhya sūryāstaṃ yāvadeva tu || 7-142 ||
tāvajjaptvā nirātaṅkaṃ sarvasiddhiśvaro bhavet | athavā'nyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamucyate || 7-143 ||
sūryodayaṃ samārabhya yāvadastamayo bhavet | tāvadbhaktyā japeddevi sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet || 7-144 ||
athavā'nyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamucyate | sūryāstaṃ ca samārabhya yāvat sūryodayo bhavet || 7-145 ||
tāvajjapenmaheśāni sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet | athavā'nyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamucyate || 7-146 ||
śaratkāle caturthyādinavamyantaṃ maheśvari | homarūpāṃ puraścaryāṃ kuryāt siddhīśvaro bhavet || 7-147 ||
atha tarpaṇarūpāṃ ca puraścaryāṃ bravīmi te | dugdhenāśavatoyena raktairmajjābhireva ca || 7-148 ||
madhunā gandhatoyena raktadhārābhireva ca | kevalaṃ śuddhatoyasya tarpaṇena maheśvari || 7-149 ||
atrādhikāribhedena tarpaṇadravyabhedo bodhyaḥ | (sādhanasamuccaye)

tantrāntare |
athavā'nyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamucyate || 7-151 ||
divā japet ṣaṭsahasraṃ rātrāvapi tathaiva ca | evaṃ krameṇa deveśi sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet || 7-152 ||
athavā'nyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamucyate | divā japet ṣaṭsahasraṃ tāvaddhomaṃ carenniśi || 7-153 ||
sarvasiddhīśvaro bhūyādato'nyaṃ śṛṇu pārvati | athavā'nyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamucyate || 7-154 ||
nityakṛtyaṃ divā kṛtvā kevalaṃ timirālaye | rātrau japedgānaparaḥ sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet || 7-155 ||

athavā'nyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamucyate | divā japeddiksahasraṃ rātrau pūjāṃ caran japet || 7-157 ||
sahasramātraṃ prajapedāmiṣānnaparāyaṇaḥ | sarvasiddhīśvaro bhūyodvetālasiddhimāpnuyāt || 7-158 ||
athavā'nyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamucyate | pratipadvinamārabhya navamyantaṃ maheśvari || 7-159 ||
ekānte parvate śūnye kevalaṃ timirālaye | udayāstamayaṃ japtvā sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet || 7-160 ||

sindūreṇa kṛtaṃ yantraṃ sarvasidhīśvaro bhavet |

aṣṭamīsandhivelāyāmaṣṭamīnavamyoḥ sandhivelāyām | aṣṭottaralatāgṛhaṃ yathāsambhavamaṣṭaparyantānāṃ śaktīnāṃ gṛhaṃ madanamandiram | pūrvoktakalpaṃ dūtīyāgākhyam | patramūle varāṅgejaptvā bījaṃ nirasya tadeva bījaṃ mastake saṃgṛhya tilakaṃ kṛtvetyarthaḥ | idaṃ vīraparam | evamanyeṣāmapi tattanmārgaparatvaṃ sakalasādhāraṇatvaṃ ca kriyāviśeṣādboddhavyam |
tathā (-)

puraścaraṇāntaramāha |
athavā kalpayedgehe sudhādidhavalīkṛte | śubhrāsane samāviśya śuddhasphaṭikamālayā || 7-184 ||
karpūracandanālipte śubhrāmbaradharaḥ śuciḥ | śvetapuṣpaiḥ samabhyarcya dhyāyan śubhrāṃ sureśvarīm || 7-185 ||
japet sahasradaśakaṃ paśyannudyotitaṃ jagat | homayet taddaśāṃśena puṇḍarīkadalaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 7-186 ||
śarkarāmadhusaṃyuktaiḥ sarpiḥsaṃlolitaistathā | śvetāmbaraṃ sitāṃ mālāṃ śvetapuṣpādibhūṣaṇam || 7-187 ||
śvetānulepanaṃ tadvaddadyādviprāya dakṣiṇām | kumārībhyastathā dadyādbhojayet tāśca bhaktitaḥ || 7-188 ||
svayaṃ trimadhuropetaiḥ paścādbhuñjīta sādhakaḥ | nivedya purato devyai bhaktyā viśuddhabhāvataḥ || 7-189 ||

atha vā mandire śūnye sindūrāruṇamaṇḍale | nārīṃ caturdaśīrātrau kṛṣṇapakṣe niśāntare || 7-206 ||

ācchādya mṛduvastreṇa lohitaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ | tato digbandhanaṃ kṛtvā dvīpicarmāsanasthitaḥ || 7-218 ||

evaṃ kṛtvā puraścaryā mahāsiddhikarī sadā | puraścaraṇakartṝṇāṃ vaśyagā bhairavī svayam || 7-223 ||

prayatastu japenmantraṃ yoṣinniyamapūrvakam | tato homādikaṃ kāryaṃ tataḥ pūrṇaṃ bhavedidam || 7-226 ||
sotsāhaṃ tu tato devīṃ dhyātvā sustho japaṃ caret | tataḥ siddhimavāpnoti vāñchitāṃ mantrasādhakaḥ || 7-227 ||
athavā puṣpaśayyānāṃ mṛduvāsāḥ subhūṣaṇaḥ | kṛtvā'ṅgarāgaṃ sānandastrayodaśyāṃ kuje dine || 7-228 ||
vyabhicāravatīṃ nārīṃ vibhūṣyānīya sannidhim | puṣpeṇa tāṃ samālambya japedekāntamandire || 7-229 ||
pravālamālayā dhīmān mauktikasyākṣamālayā | yathāśakti japenmantraṃ tato devyai valiṃ dadet || 7-230 ||
pāyasaṃ madhusarpirbhyā sitāvalitamuttamam | sugandhakusumairmālāṃ nirmāya navapallavaiḥ || 7-231 ||
nivedya devyai tāṃ mālāṃ tasyāḥ keśe nidhāya ca | na kācit kāmaceṣṭāṃ ca vidadhyāt sādhakottamaḥ || 7-232 ||
tasyai bhūṣādikaṃ datvā puro devyai nivedayet | devyai datvā viśeṣeṇa tatastāṃ tu visarjayet || 7-233 ||
rātriśeṣaṃ tato vidvān jāgareṇa samāpayet | kṛtamevaṃvidhaṃ karma devyā harṣavivarddhakam || 7-234 ||
sādhako labhate siddhimevaṃ kṛtvā tu mantrataḥ | etat tu sukaraṃ karma dhairyādhīnaṃ sureśvari || 7-235 ||
kathitaṃ te sugopyaṃ hi na prakāśyaṃ kathaṃcana | kautukārthaṃ kiṃcidanyat kathayiṣyāmi pārvati || 7-236 ||
sādhakaḥ karaṇādyasya sarvalokapriyo bhavet | maṇḍalaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā haridrācūrṇanirmitam || 7-237 ||
caturdvāri śubhāṃ rambhāṃ sthāpayet tāṃ dalānvitām | tāsu dīpāvaliṃ datvā kauśalena viśeṣataḥ || 7-238 ||
aṣṭamyāṃ prātarārabhya tadahorātrakaṃ japet | baliṃ ca vidhivaddatvā homādyantaṃ samācaret || 7-239 ||
vidhāyopoṣaṇaṃ prātardakṣiṇāntāṃ kriyāṃ caret | mahāsiddhiṃ labhenmantrī haritālakaraḥ paraḥ || 7-240 ||
sugopyametat sarvaṃ hi kathitaṃ tava bhāmini |
(kālītantre)
athavā vijane ramye asthiśayyāsane naraḥ || 7-241 ||
ubhayāstaṃ manuṃ japtvā sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet | nije kroḍe bilvamūle śavamāropya yatnataḥ || 7-242 ||
nṛsiṃhamudrayā vīkṣya japenmātṛkayā naraḥ | sahasraṃ tatra japtvā tu sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet || 7-243 ||
(bhairavatantre)
aṣṭādhikaṃ ca sāhasraṃ kṛtvā pratidīnaṃ japet | ṣaṇmāsāt siddhisaṃyuktaḥ kavirvidyānidhirbhavat || 7-244 ||
tantrāntare |
mahāpitṛvane naktaṃ śavaśayyāsanasthitaḥ | ṣaṭsahasraṃ japenmantrī sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet || 7-245 ||
etat tritayanapi prathamavidyāviṣayam | (sādhanamuccaye)
yā tithiryasya devasya tasyāṃ vā sādhakottamaḥ | sūryodayaṃ samārabhya yāvadastamayo bhavet || 7-246 ||
sūryāstaṃ vā samārabhya yāvat sūryodayo bhavet | tavatkālaṃ japenmantraṃ puraścaryeyamīritā || 7-247 ||
homādiviprabhojyāntaṃ karttvyaṃ pūrvavadbudhaiḥ |
(agastyasaṃhitāyām)
caitre māsi navamyāṃ tu jāto rāmaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ || 7-248 ||
punarvasvṛkṣasaṃyuktā sā tithiḥ sarvakāmadā |
tathā (-)
tasmin dine mahāpuṇye rāmamuddiśya bhaktitaḥ || 7-249 ||
japedekānta āsīno yāvat syāddaśamīdinam | tenaiva syāt puraścaryā daśamyāṃ bhojayeddvijān || 7-240 ||
bhakṣyabhojyairbahuvidhairbhaktyā dadyācca dakṣiṇām | kṛtakṛtyo bhavet tena sadyo rāmaḥ prasīdati || 7-241 ||
tithinirṇayamāha |
caitre śuddhā tu navamī punarvasuyutā yadi | saiva madhyānhayogena mahāpuṇyatamā bhavet || 7-243 ||
navamī cāṣṭamī viddhā tyājyā viṣṇuparāyaṇaiḥ | upoṣaṇaṃ navamyāṃ vai daśamyāmeva pāraṇam || 7-244 ||
(vāḍavānalīye)
vakṣye tatrāpyaśaktānāṃ puraścaraṇamuttamam | pakṣādyāṃ tithimārabhya yāvat taddevatātithiḥ || 7-246 ||
tāvajjapedvarṇamayyā mālayā praharadvayam | japānte pūjanaṃ kuryāt pratyahaṃ havanādikam || 7-247 ||
yasya kasyāpi mantrasya puraścaraṇamiṣyate |
tatreti pūrvoktalakṣajaparūpapuraścaraṇa ityarthaḥ | atha grahaṇakālīnapuraścaraṇam | taduktaṃ (merutantre)
athavā'nyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamucyate || 7-248 ||
grahaṇe'rkasya cendorvā śuciḥ pūrvamupoṣitaḥ | nadyāṃ samudragāminyāṃ nābhimātre jale sthitaḥ || 7-249 ||
sparśādvimuktiparyantaṃ japenmantraṃ samāhitaḥ | tāvatkālaṃ japitvetthaṃ tato homādikaṃ caret || 7-250 ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayet paścāt puraścaryāsamaṃ tvidam | prāyaścitte prayogasya pratyavāyasya nāśane || 7-251 ||
yeṣāṃ jape ca home ca saṅkhyā tantreṣu noditā | tatra seyaṃ puraścryā sarvatantreṣu gopitā || 7-252 ||
tantrāntare'pi |
grahaṇe candrasūryasya śuciḥ pūrvamupoṣitaḥ | nadyāṃ samudragāminyāṃ nābhimātre jale sthitaḥ || 7-253 ||
yadvā śuddhodake snātvā śucau deśe samāhitaḥ | sparśādvimuktiparyantaṃ japaṃ kuryādananyadhiḥ || 7-254 ||
anantaraṃ daśāṃśena kramāddhomādikaṃ caret | tadante mahatīṃ pūjāṃ kuryādbrāhmaṇabhojanam || 7-255 ||
tato mantrasya siddhyarthaṃ guruṃ saṃpūjya toṣayet | tataḥ prayogān kurvīta mantravit kalpanoditān || 7-256 ||
(kālītantre)
athavā'nyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamucyate | candrasūryagrahe caiva grāsāvadhi vimuktitaḥ || 7-257 ||
yāvatsaṅkhyaṃ manuṃ japtvā tāvaddhomādikaṃ caret |
(sanatkumārasaṃhitāyām)
athavā'nyaprakāreṇa pauraścaraṇiko vidhiḥ || 7-258 ||
candrasūryoparāge ca snātvā prayatamānasaḥ | saṃsparśādivimokṣāntaṃ japenmantramananyadhīḥ || 7-259 ||
dṛṣṭvā snātvā ca saṃkalpya vimokṣāntaṃ japaṃ caret | tāvaddhomādikaṃ kuryādgrahaṇānte śuciḥ pumān || 7-260 ||
evaṃ japānmantrasiddhirbhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ |
tāvaditi yāvān japo jāta ityarthaḥ | taduktaṃ (siddheśvarīmate'pi)
candrasūryagrahe devi grāsāvadhi vimuktitaḥ || 7-261 ||
yāvatsaṅkhyamanurjaptastāvaddhomādikaṃ caret | pañcāṅgaṃ tāvadeva syājjapahomau samau smṛtau || 7-262 ||
siddheśvarīmataṃ proktaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam |
(candrapīṭhamantradevaprakāśikaratnāvallyādau)
upavāsatrayaṃ kṛtvā evaṃ vā śaktyapekṣayā || 7-263 ||
śrāddhādi cātisaṃkṣepādgrahaṇe sparśamātrataḥ | samudragāyāṃ sariti kaṇṭhamātre jale sthitaḥ || 7-264 ||
japaṃ kuryādudgrahāntaṃ homādyaṃ taddaśāṃśataḥ | saṃpūrṇāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ datvā mantrasiddhimavāpnuyāt || 7-265 ||
tataḥ prayogān kurvīta mantravit kalpanoditān |
(tantracintāmaṇi) dhṛtatantrāntaravacanāni |
athavā'nyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamucyate || 7-266 ||
sūryacandroparāge tu nābhimātrodake sthitaḥ | grāsādvimuktaparyantaṃ japaṃ kuryānmaheśvari || 7-267 ||
taddaśāṃśaṃ homayeddhi taddaśāṃśaistrayaṃ kramāt | anena kramayogena saṅgame saṃjapecca vā || 7-268 ||
ekāṅguṣṭhopari sthitvā grāsāvadhi vimuktitaḥ | pañcāṅgaṃ cātha vā'ṣṭāṅgaṃ daśāṅgākhyapuraskriyām || 7-269 ||
kuryādyatnena deveśi sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet | athavā'nyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamucyate || 7-270 ||
grahaṇe'rkasya cendorvā śuciḥ pūrvamupoṣitaḥ | ghaṭikārdhaṃ pūrvameva grahaṇaṃ parivarttate || 7-271 ||
tadā snānaṃ vidhātavyaṃ graste saṃkalpamācaret | jātāśaucaṃ mṛtāśaucaṃ grahaṇe nāsti pārvati || 7-272 ||
vimokṣāntaṃ japaṃ kuryāt samyagjñāte samāpanam | sūrye channe anāyātaghaṭikārdhaṃ vicārayet || 7-273 ||
tataḥ samāpanaṃ kuryāt siddhamantro bhaveddhravam | pramādādgalite yāge bahuviprān prabhojayet || 7-274 ||
yadyadaṅgaṃ vihīyeta tatsāṅge dvijabhojanam | daśāṃśaṃ havanaṃ kuryāt tarpaṇaṃ taddaśāṃśataḥ || 7-275 ||
mārjanaṃ taddaśāṃśena daśāṃśenābhiṣecanam | daśāṃśaṃ viprabhojyaṃ ca devarūpo naro bhavet || 7-276 ||
yadyadaṅgaṃ vihīyeta tatsaṅkhyādviguṇo japaḥ | dvitrivedabāṇabhedairvipradīnāṃ kramaḥ smṛtaḥ || 7-277 ||
(vāḍavānalīye)
candrasūryoparāge ca japenmantramananyadhīḥ | sparśādvimuktaparyantaṃ tāvaddhomādikaṃ caret || 7-278 ||
athavā taddaśāṃśena puraścaraṇamucyate |
atra sparśapadaṃ sparśajñānaparam |
cakṣuṣā darśanaṃ rāhoryat tadgrahaṇamucyate || 7-279 ||
tatra karmāṇi kurvīta gaṇanāmātrato na hi |
iti smārttavacanāt | tathā ca |
sūryagrahaṇakālādirnānyaḥ kālaḥ praśasyate || 7-280 ||
yastu śrāddhānurodhena grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ | na karoti puraścaryāṃ narake sa vipacyate || 7-281 ||
ityādivacanānmantriṇāṃ grahaṇapuraścaraṇamāvaśyakam |
sarvasvenāpi karttavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ vai rāhudarśane | akurvāṇastu nāstikyāt paṅke gauriva sīdati || 7-282 ||
śrāddhakaraṇe smārttanindārthavādastu dīkṣitānyapara iti sudhārṇavakṛtaḥ | taduktaṃ sanatkumāreṇāpi |
japayajñaṃ parityajya pitṛyajñaṃ karoti yaḥ | sa bhaveddevatādrohī pitṝn sapta nayatyadhaḥ || 7-283 ||
iti kecit pratinidhidvārā śrāddhamāmananti | anye tu |
annābhāve dvijābhāve pravāse putrajanmani | hemaśrāddhaṃ sagrahe ca śūdraḥ kuryāt sa eva hi || 7-284 ||
iti vacanāddhemaśrāddhaṃ vidhāya puraścaraṇamācaranti | hemaśrāddhaṃ ca pitruddeśena yathāśaktisuvarṇadānam |
kalpalatākṛtastu (-) japayajñaṃ parityajyetyādisanatkumāravacanamārabdhapuraścaraṇa(-)madhye madhyāhnapatitasūryagrahaṇaviṣayamityāhuḥ | vastutaḥ smārttānāṃ śrāddhaṃ tāntrikāṇāṃ tu puraścaraṇamāvaśyakam |
tāntrikastu japaṃ kuryāt smārttaḥ śrāddhaṃ samācaet |
iti (siddhāntasāra)vacanāt | grahaṇapuraścaraṇasaṃkalpastu(-)
oṃ adyetyādirāhugraste divākare niśākare vā'mukagotro'muka(-)śarmā'mukadevatāyā amukamantrasiddhikāmo grāsādvimuktiparyantaṃ japarūpapuraścaraṇamahaṃ kariṣye (-) iti | atra kecit |
japo homastarpaṇaṃ ca mārjanaṃ viprabhojanam || 7-285 ||
pañcāṅgopāsanaṃ loke puraścaraṇamiṣyate |
tathā (-)
siddhikāmo'sya mantrasya yāvatsaṅkhyaṃ japaṃ tataḥ || 7-286 ||
daśāṃśaṃ havanaṃ kuryāt taddaśāṃśaṃ tu tarpaṇam | daśāṃśaṃ mārjanaṃ kuryāddaśāṃśaṃ viprabhojanam || 7-287 ||
ityādivacanādekasaṃkalpāntare tu pañcāṅgopāsanameva puraścaraṇam | grahaṇapuraścaraṇādau tu puraścaraṇapadaṃ bhāktam | tasya japamātrarūpatvādekasaṃkalpāntaritapañcāṅgopāsanatvābhāvāt | tatra homādividhānaṃ tu pradhānībhūtapuraścaraṇatulyatābodhanāyetyāhustaccintyam | (merutantrādau) mukhyapuraścaraṇe'pi prathamato japamātrasaṃkalpoktatvāt | mantramārgādibhedena nyūtātiriktāṅgasya puraścaraṇasya ca tatraivoktatvādeva saṃkalpāntaritapañcāṅgopāsanasyaiva puraścaraṇapadavācyatve pramāṇābhāvāt | pañcāṅgopāsanaṃ loke puraścaraṇamiṣyata ityādivacanaṃ ca yeṣāṃ mantrāṇāṃ pañcāṅgameva puraścaraṇaṃ tanmantrapuraścaraṇaparaṃ na tu mantrasāmānyapuraścaraṇaparam | ekenaiva vākyena sāṅgajapasaṃkalpastu lāghavārthaḥ | (sādhanasamuccaye)
doṣādalpādbhayaṃ hitvā jyotiḥśāstranirūpitam | rāhuṃ dṛṣṭvā japaṃ kuryāt koṭipuṇyaphalapradam || 7-288 ||
jyotiḥśāstroktadoṣapratīkāro'pyuktastatraiva |
nimrāya rājataṃ candraṃ sauvarṇaṃ ca divākaram |
pañcopacārairabhyarcya dadyādviprāya buddhimān (-) iti ||
tathā (-)
grāsādvimuktiparyantaṃ yadā saṃkalpito japaḥ || 7-289 ||
grastāste śāstrato jñātvā vimuktiṃ japamutsṛjet | adṛṣṭvā naiva bhuñjita sūryaṃ vā rajanīkaram || 7-290 ||
tathā (-)
yāmatrayaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ candragrahaṇapūrvataḥ | sūryagrahaṇataḥ pūrvaṃ praharāṇāṃ catuṣṭayam || 7-291 ||
yat tu (matsyapurāṇe)
aparāhṇe na madhyāhne madhyāhne na tu saṃgave | bhuñjīta cet saṃgave syānna pūrvaṃ bhuktimācaret || 7-292 ||
iti vacanaṃ tadbālavṛddhāturaviṣayam | taduktaṃ vṛddhavasiṣṭhena |
sūryagrahe tu nāśnīyāt pūrvaṃ yāmacatuṣṭayam |
candragrahe tu yāmā(/)strīn bālavṛddhāturairvinā (-) iti ||
atha varṇauṣadhipuraścaraṇam |
(merutantre)
ayogyaguruto labdhvā vāryādisthānamāśritāḥ || 7-293 ||
durdeśatvāt puraścaryāṃ karttuṃ cecchakyate na hi | rājño bhāgyamato vā'pi sukumārasya vā yathā || 7-294 ||
siddhirbhavet tathā vakṣye varṇauṣadhipuraskriyām | saptadhā sā parijñeyā varṇamāsaistu siddhidā || 7-295 ||
mantravarṇauṣadhīkāṣṭhai racayedguṭikāḥ śubhāḥ | varṇakrameṇa tāḥ prohyā anulomavilomataḥ || 7-296 ||
sthūlādikāśca laghvantāḥ karttavyā maṇayo yathā | sarpadvayākṛtirmālā bhavennityaṃ tayā japet || 7-297 ||
mālayā maṇisaṅkhyākaṃ prathamo'yaṃ japaḥ smṛtaḥ | sarve samānā maṇayaḥ protavyāḥ svarṇasūtrake || 7-298 ||
kaṇṭhe dhāryā kaṇṭhamālā nityameṣa dvitīyakaḥ | tathaiva rājate sūtre prohyaitāḥ paripūjayet || 7-299 ||
taddevakalpamārgeṇa prakramo'yaṃ tṛtīyakaḥ | varṇauṣadhīnāṃ kvāthena nityasnānaṃ caturthakaḥ || 7-300 ||
varṇauṣadhīrajo lihyādgoghṛtena tu pañcamaḥ | taccūrṇodvarttanaṃ kuryādeṣa ṣaṣṭhaḥ prakīrttitaḥ || 7-301 ||
tadbhasmadhāraṇaṃ nityaṃ kuryāditi tu saptamaḥ |
varṇauṣadhyastu prāguktāḥ |
athavīrapuraścaraṇam |
atra rātrireva kālo na divasastaduktaṃ (muṇḍamālāyām)
gate tu prathame yāme tṛtīyapraharāvadhi || 7-302 ||
prajaptavyaṃ niśāyāṃ tu rātriśeṣe japenna ca | haviṣyaṃ bhakṣayennityamekabhaktaṃ susaṃyataḥ || 7-303 ||
(kulacūḍāmaṇau)
puraścaraṇakāle tu paraśaktiṃ prapūjayet | dīkṣito vastrapuṣpādyairbhojyaiḥ pāyasasambhavaiḥ || 7-304 ||
śūnyagehe samānīya cārghodakaviśodhitam | amṛtīkaraṇaṃ kṛtvā śaktīrabhimukhaṃ nayet || 7-305 ||
samānīyaśaktipūjopayuktadravyādyamṛtīkaraṇaṃ teṣāmeva |
tathā (-)
arghodakena sarvāstāḥ saṃprokṣya vidhipūrvakam | amṛtīkaraṇaṃ kuryāt sakalīkaraṇaṃ tataḥ || 7-306 ||
atrāmṛtīkaraṇādikaṃ śaktīnām | pūjyaśaktīrāha |
athāṣṭa kanyakā vakṣye devīrūpadharā yataḥ | brāhmaṇī kṣatrīyā vaiśyā śūdrā ca kulabhūṣaṇā || 7-307 ||
veśyā nāpitakanyā ca rajakī yoginī tathā | viśeṣavaidagdhyayutāḥ sarvā eva kulāṅganāḥ || 7-308 ||
aṣṭakanyārupabhedaṃ vilokyāmarṣaceṣṭitāḥ | brāhmaṇyādyaṣṭaśaktīnāṃ nāmabhiḥ kṛtasaṃjñakāḥ || 7-309 ||
gaurakṛṣṇādikaṃ rūpaṃ saumyatvaṃ ca guṇādikam |
śaktīnāṃ nāmāni vakṣyamāṇastotra eva vaktavyāni | pūjāprakāramāha |
āsanaṃ prathamaṃ datvā svāgataṃ ca vadet punaḥ || 7-310 ||
arghyaṃ pādyaṃ ca pānīyaṃ madhuparkaṃ jalaṃ tataḥ | snāpayedgandhapuṣpādbhiḥ keśasaṃskāramācaret || 7-311 ||
dhūpayitvā tataḥ keśaṃ kauśeyaṃ vinivedayet | tataḥ snānāntare pīṭhamāstīrya pādukādvayam || 7-312 ||
datvā tatra samāsīnāṃ nānālaṅkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ | bhūṣayitvā'nulepaṃ ca gandhamālyaṃ nivedayet || 7-313 ||
tāṃ tāṃ śaktiṃ samāvāhya mūrdhni tāsāṃ samānayet | bhojyamaṇḍapamadhye tu svarṇapātre suśobhane || 7-314 ||
carvyaṃ coṣyaṃ lehyapeyaṃ bhojyaṃ caiva hi bhakṣaṇam | adikṣitā yadā syustāstadā māyāṃ nivedayet || 7-315 ||
tāṃ tāmiti | yasya nāmnā yā saṃketitā tasyāḥ śirasi tāṃ śaktimāvāhya pūjayedityarthaḥ | idaṃ cāvāhanaṃ madhye'pyuktamādāvevārhati sarvatra tathā darśanāt |
tatrāsāṃ savyakarṇeṣu tataḥ stotraṃ samācaret | mātardevi namaste'stu brahmarūpadhare'naghe || 7-316 ||
kṛpayā hara vighnaṃ me mantrasiddhiṃ prayacchame | māheśī varade devi paramānandarūpiṇi || 7-317 ||

eke bahutare devi viśvarūpe namo'stu te | etat stotraṃ paṭhedyastu karmārambhe su saṃyataḥ || 7-325 ||
vidagdhāṃ vā samālokya tasya vighno na jāyate | yadi vrīḍāparāstāstu bhojane tadgṛhādbahiḥ || 7-326 ||
sthitvā stotraṃ paṭhet tāvadyāvat tṛptiḥ prajāyate | ācamya mukhavāsādi tāmbūlaṃ ca nivedayet || 7-327 ||
tathā (-)
tato dadyāt punarmālāṃ candanaṃ paṅkitaṃ śubham | visṛjya pradakṣiṇīkṛtya varaṃ pārthya sukhī bhavet || 7-328 ||
anyā yadi na gacchanti nijakanyā nijānujā | agrajā mātulānī vā jananī tatsapatnikā || 7-329 ||
vayasyā jñātijā vā'pi niḥpatirvā sabhartṛkā | pūrvābhāve parā pūjyā madaṃśā yoṣito yataḥ || 7-330 ||
ekā cedyuvatī tatra pūjitā vā vilokitā | sarvā eva tadā devyaḥ pūjitāḥ kulabhairava || 7-331 ||
idaṃ ca puraścaraṇasyādau madhye cānte ca karttavyam | tathā hi tatraiva |
ādāvante ca madhye ca lakṣapūrtau viśeṣataḥ | na pūjayati cet kāntāṃ tadā vighnairvilupyate || 7-332 ||
(vīracūḍāmaṇau)
kṣetramādau tu saṃśodhya samasūtraṃ manoharam | vedikāṃ kārayet tatra madhye muṇḍaṃ viniḥkṣipet || 7-333 ||
alinā lepanaṃ kuryānmadhye cāṣṭadalaṃ likhet | pūrvādikramato jñeyaṃ svarayugmaṃ likhet kramāt || 7-334 ||
vargāṣṭakaṃ likhet tatra madhye prāsādamālikhet | gaganaṃ bindusaṃyuktaṃ lāṅgalīśaṃ tathaiva ca || 7-335 ||
savisargaṃ varārohe keśareṣu likhet tataḥ | tatrādhārādi saṃpūjya āsanaṃ sthāpayedbudhaḥ || 7-336 ||
upaviśyāsane vīro yatra kutrāpyacūḍake | pārṣṇighātatrayaṃ kuryācchoṭikātritayaṃ tataḥ || 7-337 ||
digbandhamastramantreṇa pūrvādikramato budhaḥ | vakeśānte pinākīśaṃ nādavinduvibhūṣitam || 7-338 ||
paśupadaṃ samuccārya ramānte'stramanūttamam | pāśupatākhyavidyeyaṃ sarvavighnavināśinī || 7-339 ||
vakeśaḥ śakāraḥ | pinākīśo lakāraḥ |
bhūtaśuddhiṃ vidhāyādau nyāsapūrvaṃ vidhānataḥ |
tathā(-)
gomayena viliptāyāṃ bhūmau maṇḍalamālikhet || 7-340 ||
alinā lepanaṃ kuryādyakṣakardamakena vā | sūtreṇa sūtritaṃ padmaṃ samasūtraṃ manoharam || 7-341 ||
raktaṃ śvetaṃ haridvarṇaṃ kṛṣṇapatraṃ sukeśaram | caturasraṃ suśobhāḍhye tanmadhye yoniyugmakam || 7-342 ||
trikoṇaṃ caiva tanmadhye śūnye śūnyaṃ vicintayet | yojayeddīpitāṃ nārīṃ tatra saṃpūjayenmanum || 7-343 ||
tatraiva devīṃ saṃsthāpya īṣaddhāsāṃ sulocanām | ṣoḍaśābdena yuvatīmaprasūtāṃ tapasvinīm || 7-344 ||
svādhīnāṃ svacchavastrāṃ ca bhītihīnādṛhāsinīm | tīvraśuddhiṃ dṛḍhācārāṃ muktakeśīṃ digambarām || 7-345 ||
yogamudrādharāṃ vā'pi yogācāraparāyaṇām | īdṛśīṃ mantrasaṃyuktāṃ yāgakāle prapūjayet || 7-346 ||
mātaṅgīṃ tantukārīṃ ca bhavābdhibhītināśinīm | ṣaṭvākārīṃ carmakārīṃ śilpinīṃ nāpitāṅganām || 7-347 ||
hadṛnārīṃ viśeṣāt tu supuṣpakeṇa komalām | sāmānyārghaṃ viśeṣāgha svapātraṃ śaktipātrakam || 7-348 ||
tanmadhya niḥkṣipeddravyaṃ sāmarasyāmṛtodbhavam | tattvapañcakamantreṇa ekaikaṃ śodhayedbudhaḥ || 7-349 ||
vahnisūryakalācandrakalānte hṛdayaṃ manum | trikoṇaṃ vilikhenmadhye trikoṇamakathādikam || 7-350 ||
khāntaṃ ṣāntaṃ tathā nāntaṃ yāntaṃ dhāntaṃ saśatrukam | vāmakarṇasamāyuktaṃ vindunādairalaṅkṛtam || 7-351 ||
ratneśvarīti vidyākhyaṃ pañcaratnātmakaṃ manum | ṣaḍaṅgenaiva saṃpūjya mūlamantreṇa mantrayet || 7-352 ||
(svatantratantre)
rātrau māṃsāsavairdevīṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ | tato nagnāṃ striyaṃ nagno raman kledayuto'pi vā || 7-353 ||
japellakṣaṃ tato devīṃ homayejjvalitānale | yonikuṇḍe sthitaṃ sarpirmatsyaṃ māṃsaṃ phalaṃ tathā || 7-354 ||
daśāṃśaṃ tarpayenmadyaṃ māṃsamiśraistu sādhakaḥ | tarpaṇasya daśāṃśaṃ tu abhiṣiñcya jaganmayīm || 7-355 ||
daśāṃśaṃ bhojayet sādhu sādhakaṃ kālikāpriyam | madyaṃ māṃsaṃ ca matsyaṃ ca carvaṇaṃ ca pradāpayet || 7-356 ||
tatastu topayedbhaktyā guruṃ svarṇādibhiḥ priye |
(tantraśekhare)
evaṃ prakurvatastasya prathame vatsaratraye || 7-357 ||
bhavanti bahavo vighnāḥ śraddhābhāvādayo'śubhāḥ | asminnarthe bhavenmantrī yadi nodvignamānasaḥ || 7-358 ||
setsyatīti ca viśvastastadā'sau siddhibhāgbhavet |
(kālīkalpe)
na nāso yoṣitāṃ tatra na pūjā nāpi cintanam || 7-359 ||
rātrau japaikamātreṇa siddhidā dakṣiṇā bhavet | navamādvatsarādūrdhvaṃ svayaṃ siddhyati mantrarāṭ || 7-360 ||
iti vīrapuraścaraṇavidhiḥ | (merutantre)
vāmamārge drutaṃ siddhiḥ karmaṇā yena jāyate | tadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi sūkṣmasādhanamadbhūtam || 7-361 ||
aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇāyāṃ bhaumavāsare | gṛhītvā nṛkapālaṃ tu madyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathodanam || 7-362 ||
kulmāṣān miśritān kṛtvā gacchedaśvatthabhūmikām | ekānte nirjane tasya tale saṃlipya bhūmikām || 7-363 ||
daṇḍamātrānaṣṭadikṣu kīlānmūlena pūrayet | aṣṭottarasahasreṇa saptatantukaḍorakam || 7-364 ||
nibandhayet tatra pūjāṃ devatāyāḥ samācaret | devīṃ tu hṛdi saṃsthāpya tasmin sthāne sudīpakam || 7-365 ||
kuryācca naratailenābhāve kapilahavyakaiḥ | tadabhāve tu tailena kuḍavapramitena ca || 7-366 ||
(***********************************)(?) | tasyopari kapālaṃ tatkajjalārthaṃ niveśayet || 7-367 ||
dīpaṃ dṛṣṭvā japenmantraṃ nānyatastu vilokayet | arghe prajvalite taile bhūtapretapiśācakāḥ || 7-368 ||
nānārūpā bhinnaśabdāḥ sādhakaṃ bhīṣayanti te | na bhetavyaṃ tadantaṃ tu vāmahastena niḥkṣipet || 7-369 ||
teṣāmagre nānyadṛṣtiḥ prapaśyeddīpameva hi | kiñciccheṣe dīpataile devī sā varadā bhavet || 7-370 ||
tasyai tatra valiṃ datvā śrutvā saṃyācayedvaram | pūrvakarmavipākena yadi nāyāti devatā || 7-371 ||
dīpānte kajjalaṃ grāhyaṃ tatra devīṃ prapajya ca | ānayet tadgṛhe siddhaṃ datvā'kṣṇoḥ syājjagadvaśam || 7-372 ||
datvā'kṣṇoḥ kajjjalaṃ tacca prayogānācaret tataḥ | sarva evaṃ prasiddhyanti lolupe na gurau sati || 7-373 ||
rakṣayedañjanaṃ samyaṅgo cedbhakṣati bhairavaḥ |
tatraiva |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi sarvatantreṣu gopitam || 7-374 ||
sarvasiddhikaraṃ dīpaṃ na vācyaṃ yasya kasyacit | śaktyādyarhagaṇārkeṣu bhakto varṇaḥ prajāyate || 7-375 ||
mantravarṇasya divase kramāddīpaṃ prakalpayet | sāyaṃ tu kuḍavājyasya varttirbhūpañcatantubhiḥ || 7-376 ||
yāvajjvalati dīpo'sau tāvat paśyanmanuṃ japet | mantrārṇasaṅkhyadīpeṣu jvaliteṣvatha taddine || 7-377 ||
punardīpe kṛte sā tu dīpe saṃdṛśyate sphuṭā | iṣṭaṃ svakīyaṃ kathayedyācayenmanasepsitam || 7-378 ||
dadāti devatā tuṣṭā guhyametat prakāśitam |
atha dūtīyāgavidhiḥ |
(rudrayāmale)
dūtīyāgasya vidhinā ramamāṇo varastriyā || 7-379 ||
japtvā mantraṃ sādhakendraḥ sadyaḥ siddhimavāpnuyāt |
tantrāntrare |
puruṣeṇa vinā kiñcit prakṛtyā kriyate na hi || 7-380 ||
tathā śaktiṃ vinā devaḥ phalaṃ dātuṃ kṣamo na hi | tasmāt puṃśaktisaṃyogaṃ kṛtvā mantraṃ prasādhayet || 7-381 ||
(kumārītantre)
naṭī kapālinī veśyā rajakī nāpitāṅganā | brāhmaṇī śūdrakanyā ca tathā gopālakanyakā || 7-382 ||
mālākārasya kanyā ca nava kanyāḥ prakīrttitāḥ | etāsu kāṃ cidānīya tatastadyonimaṇḍale || 7-383 ||
pūjayitvā mahādevīṃ tato maithunamācaret |
(devīyāmale)
atha pūjāphalaṃ vakṣye uttarottaragocaram || 7-384 ||
svaśaktyā ayutaṃ puṇyaṃ paraśaktiprapūjane | tato veśyā'dhikā jñeyā rajakī ca tato'dhikā || 7-385 ||
rajakyāḥ kṣurakī śreṣṭhā kṣurakyāścarmakāriṇī | tato'dhikatarā proktā hetunārī varānane || 7-386 ||
tato'pyantajasambhūtā cāṇḍālī ca tato'dhikā | tato mātaṅginī śreṣṭhā mātaṅgyāḥ puṣkaśī tathā || 7-387 ||
puṣkaśyā antyajā śreṣṭhā tato'tisundarī smṛtā | sundarī parataḥ proktā prītimatyanurāgiṇī || 7-388 ||
tatparā parameśāni unmattā śubhalakṣaṇā | samayācārasaṃpannā mantrajñā bhayavarjitā || 7-389 ||
vidagdhā tvaprasūtā ca dhairyasvātantryasaṃyutā | evaṃguṇasamāyuktāḥ pūjayet sarvayoṣitaḥ || 7-390 ||
(mahākālasaṃhitāyām)
ṛṣikanyāṃ na cākarṣenmadyapānāṃ ca kanyakām | dvijātīnāṃ striyaṃ cāpi vratasthānāṃ striyaṃ tathā || 7-391 ||
gurvaṅganāṃ guroḥ patnīṃ sagotrāṃ śaraṇāgatām | śiṣyayoṣāṃ na cākarṣet pāpināṃ vanitāṃ tathā || 7-392 ||
nāpuṣpitāṃ gurviṇīṃ vā bālāṃpatyāṃ tathā punaḥ |
(devīyāmale)
ātmīyā ca parā caiva śaktimātraṃ maheśvari || 7-393 ||
mantrādhidevatābuddhyā pūjyāḥ sarvopacārakaiḥ | vividhaiḥ phalatāmbūlairvastrālaṅkārahemabhiḥ || 7-394 ||
saṃpūjya vidhivadbhaktyā bahuhetuṃ pradāpayet | saṃbhogavāsanāṃ kṛtvā yaḥ kuryācchaktipūjanam || 7-395 ||
sa dāridryamavāpnoti nārakī ca bhaveddhruvam |
(vīracūḍāmaṇāvapi)
ānīya yuvatīṃ ramyāṃ kulakarmavilāsinīm || 7-396 ||
ṣoḍaśābdena yuvatīṃ pītonnatapayodharām | unmattāṃ mattamātaṅgīṃ sadā ghūrṇitalocanām || 7-397 ||
mṛgaśāvakanetrāṃ ca sāraṅgīṃ mṛduhāsinīm | krodhalobhadayādambhamohamāyāvivarjitām || 7-398 ||
svāmidharmaratāṃ satyavādinīṃ ca sadā śucim | gaṇikāṃ naṭīṃ cāṇḍālīṃ jīvinīṃ jārajāmatha || 7-399 ||
yogamudrādharāṃ gopīṃ carmakārīṃ ca citriṇīm | caturvarṇasamāyuktāmuttamāṃ parvatodbhavām || 7-400 ||
mahākālaḥ |
snātāṃ divyāmbaradharāṃ nānālaṅkārabhūṣitām | yuvatīṃ pīnavakṣojāṃ tathā cākṛtibhojanām || 7-401 ||
haste gṛhītvā vāmorau sthāpayecchaktimuttamām | aśaknuvāno voḍhuṃ tāṃ devīṃ vāme'tha vā'sane || 7-402 ||
(vīracūḍāmaṇau)
vāmabhāge samālikhya trikoṇaṃ padmavarttulam | śvetaraktasamāyuktaṃ nīlaṃ sundūracarcitam || 7-403 ||
sādhakaḥ prāṅmukho bhūtvā devīṃ pratyaṅmukhāṃ japet | pīṭhaśaktiṃ vidhānena navaśaktīḥ prapūjayet || 7-404 ||
ratiḥ prītiḥ priyā kāntiḥ kāminī kāmamālinī | kandarpadalinī durgā bhāvinī nava śaktayaḥ || 7-405 ||
viyadbhṛguṃ samuccārya manuvindukalānvitam | mahāpretapadaṃ paścāddhṛdayāntamimaṃ manum || 7-405 ||
mūlaṃ mantraṃ samuccārya saṃbuddhyā tāriṇīpadam | ehyehi ca padaṃ paścāt pādukābhyāṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 7-406 ||
gṛhitvā vāmahastena āsane copaveśayet |
tāriṇīpadamityupalakṣaṇaṃ sveṣṭadevatānāmetyarthaḥ | tathā (-)
raktacandanaliptāṅgī raktapuṣpavibhūṣitām || 7-407 ||
sarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktāṃ vivastrāṃ pūjayet priye | vāruṇīmadamattāṃ ca hāvabhāvasamāvṛtām || 7-408 ||
yāvadākaṇṭhaparyantaṃ tāvat pānaṃ pradāpayet | dhyānaṃ kuryānmaheśāni gahvare makarānane || 7-409 ||
tāmracūḍasamākāraṃ gajavaktrasamaprabham | tatrasthāṃ cintayeddevīṃ vidyāṃ bhuvanamohanīm || 7-410 ||
tāraṃ vai hṛdayānte ca paścānmadanamandiram | caturthyantaṃ japeddevi bhge puṣpaṃ viniḥkṣipet || 7-411 ||
prakṣālya kuladravyeṇa gandhapuṣpaiḥ samarcayet | dhūpadīpādikaṃ kṛtvā paścādāvaraṇaṃ yajet || 7-412 ||
icchā jñānā kriyā paścādvāmā jyeṣṭhā ca raudrikā | ratiḥ prītistathā kāmaṃ puṣpabāṇadhanurdharam || 7-413 ||
vasantaṃ pūjayet paścāt patrāṅkurasamanvitam | cikuraṃ pūjayed devi alisyandasamanvitam || 7-414 ||
viriñciṃ pūjayennābhau hṛdaye ca haraṃ harim | stane vaktre maheśāni trimūrtiṃ pūjayet tataḥ || 7-415 ||
kāmeśīṃ caiva viśveśīṃ parāṃ tu bhagamālinīm | bhruvormūle maheśāni pañcavāṇān prapūjayet || 7-416 ||
drāmādyāṃ drāviṇīṃ mūrdhni drīmādyāṃ kṣobhiṇīpadam | klī(/) vaśīkaraṇīṃ vaktre guhye blū(/) bījapūrvikām || 7-417 ||
ākarṣiṇīṃ hṛdi punaḥ sargāntabhṛgusaṃyutām | saṃmauhinīṃ kramādevaṃ bāṇapūjanamīritam || 7-418 ||
karṇayoḥ pūjayeccakre bhānuṃ candraṃ krameṇa ca | rasanāyāṃ vahniḥ pūjyo netre nakṣatramālinī || 7-419 ||
prāṇaṃ saṃpūjayedghrāṇe ājñāyāṃ tripathagāminīm | akṣobhyaṃ pūjayenmūrdhni gandhapuṣpopahārakaiḥ || 7-420 ||
puṣpamālāṃ gale dadyādatha śaktyā japedbudhaḥ |
akṣobhyaṃ pūjayediti tārāviṣaye | (jñānārṇave)
pañcamaṃ gajadantasya hemarūpyādinirmitam || 7-421 ||
viśuddhakṣaumaracitāṃ tūlikāṃ tatra yojayet | puṣpāṇyākīrya madhye tu karpūrasya rajastathā || 7-422 ||
maṇḍūkādī(/)statra devi uparpupari śailaje | maṇḍūkaṃ pūjayedādau rudraṃ kālāgnisannibham || 7-423 ||
ādhāraśaktiṃ kūrmaṃ ca tathā'nantaṃ varāhakam | pṛthivīṃ ca tathā kandaṃ nālaṃ padmaṃ dalaṃ tathā || 7-424 ||
keśarālīśca saṃpūjya karṇikāṃ pūjayet tataḥ | mañcakaṃ ca samabhyarcya tatra pādacatuṣṭaye || 7-425 ||
dharmaṃ jñānaṃ ca vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ ca kramādyajet | apūrvān pūjayedetā(/)statpādānāṃ samīpake || 7-426 ||
ātmāntarātmaparamajñānātmanaḥ prapūjayet | mañcakāgreṣu saṃpūjya guṇatrayamathārcayet || 7-427 ||
dūtīṃ sulakṣaṇāṃ ramyāṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitām | nānālaṅkārasubhagāṃ svavaśāṃ śāradāmiva || 7-428 ||
pūjayet parameśāni pañcakāmaśaraistathā | vaṭukādī(/)ścaturdikṣu pūjayet siddhihetave || 7-429 ||
mātṛkāṃ vinyaset tasmāddehe kāmaśarānvitām | trikoṇaṃ vinyasenmūrdhni tatra pūjāṃ yajet kramāt | | 430 ||
trikoṇamadhye bālākhyāṃ kāmeśīṃ paripūjayet | gaṇeśaṃ ca kulādhyakṣaṃ tathā lakṣmīṃ sarasvatīm || 7-431 ||
trikoṇeṣu ca saṃpūjya vasantaṃ madanaṃ priye | stanayoḥ pūjayet paścānmukhe tasyāḥ kalādharam || 7-432 ||
vāgbhavaṃ kāmarājaṃ ca strībījaṃ kāmarājakam | hasaklemātmakaṃ datvā ādhāraśaktimuccaret || 7-433 ||
śrīpādukāṃ tato datvā pūjayāmi vadet tataḥ | anena manunā tasya lalāṭe sumunoharam | | 434 ||
trikoṇaṃ tatraṃ saṃlikhya sindūrādyairviśeṣataḥ | vaṭukaṃ yoginīṃ caiva kṣetrapālaṃ gaṇeśvaram || 7-435 ||
lakṣmīṃ sarasvatīṃ caiva pūjayet tatra sundari | kāmabījaṃ samuccārya kāmarājaṃ tataḥ param || 7-436 ||
śrīpādukāṃ tato datvā pūjayāmi vadet tataḥ | dakṣapādatale devi pūjayenmanunā'munā || 7-437 ||
va(/) vasantaṃ samuccārya nādahīnāramātataḥ | pādukāṃ pūjayāmīti tasyā vāmakare nyaset || 7-438 ||
śaktibījaṃ samuccārya somapādapadaṃ tataḥ | śrīpādukāṃ tato datvā pūjayāmi stanadvaye || 7-439 ||
ārohakramataḥ kāmakalānyāsaṃ caret sudhīḥ |
(smaradīpikāyām)
pāde gulphe tathorau ca bhage nābhau kuce hṛdi || 7-440 ||
kaṇṭhe kakṣe tathauṣṭhe ca gaṇḍe netre śrutāvapi | śīrṣe sarvaśarīra ca vaset kāmaḥ sthitikramāt || 7-441 ||
iti sthānānyuktāni | kalānāṃ nāmāni tu tantre |
śraddhā prītī ratiścaiva dhṛtiḥ śāntirmanoharā | manoramā manorāmā madanonmādinīti ca || 7-442 ||
mohinī dīpanī caiva śiṣiṇī ca vaśaṅkarī | rañjinī subhagā devī ṣoḍaśī priyadarśanā || 7-443 ||
akārādisvarairarcyāḥ kalāḥ kusumadhanvanaḥ | pūṣā'ryamā sumanasā ratiḥ prītistathā dhṛtiḥ || 7-444 ||
ṛddhiḥ saumyā marīciśca daśamī cāṃśumālinī | aṅgirā śaśinī caiva cchāyā saṃpūrṇamaṇḍalā || 7-445 ||
puṣṭiścaivāmṛtā ceti kalā somasya ṣoḍaśa | akārādisvarayutāḥ pūjanīyā manīṣibhiḥ || 7-446 ||
dakṣapādādi mūrdhāntaṃ vāme mūdhādi sundari | pādāntaṃ pūjayet sarvāḥ kalā vai kāmasomayoḥ || 7-447 ||
