na doṣaṃ tatra vijñeyaṃ sarvate śrutinoditam | devī muddiśya mokṣārthaṃ kṛtaṃ yaddoṣavarjitam || 7-573 ||
etacchāstrasmidaṃ divyaṃ na vācyaṃ śruticoditam | antaryāgamidaṃ jñeyaṃ bahiryāgaṃ ca vaidikam || 7-574 ||
mantratantrasamāyuktaṃ taddvayaṃ brahmabodhakam | cakrasaṃketasamayaṃ sarvaṃ tubhyaṃ prakāśitam || 7-575 ||
gopanīyaṃ prayatnena na vācyaṃ paśusannidhau | tyajaṃ śaṅkāṃ mahābhāga satyametanmayoditam || 7-576 ||
mātaṅgīpūjanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dūtīyāge manoharam |
dūtīyāge ca viprāṇāṃ nādhikāraḥ | taduktaṃ (bṛhacchrīkramasaṃhitāyām)
vāmāgamo'pi viprastu madyamāṃsaṃ na bhakṣayet || 7-577 ||
svakīyāṃ parakīyāṃ vā nākṛṣya brāhmaṇo yajet (-) iti ||
(mahākālasaṃhitāyāmapi)
svayoṣāṃ parayoṣāṃ vā naivākṛṣya dvijo japet | lobhādyadi careddevamadho yāti dvijastadā || 7-578 ||
ihāmutra phalaṃ nāsti hīnāyurapi jāyate |
brāhmaṇetarāṇāmapi yogināmevātrādhikāraḥ | taduktaṃ (siddhināthasaṃhitāyām)
advaitajñānaniṣṭho yo yo'sau saṃsārapāragaḥ || 7-579 ||
sa eva jagade dūtyā nādhikārī bhavediti |
iti dūtīgāgavidhiḥ |
atha śāvaramantrapuraścaraṇam |
(merutantre)
atha śāvaramantrāṇāṃ puraścaraṇamucyate || 7-580 ||
kāmarūpākhyadeśe tu kāmākhyā yatra devatā | kāmaśailo'sti yatrāsau kāmapīṭhaṃ taducyate || 7-581 ||
tatra saṃlekhya mantraṃ hi vaṃśopari yathākramam | gurūṇāṃ vācanīyaḥ sa svayaṃ paścāt paṭhenmanum || 7-582 ||
gurorabhāve tasyaiva mūle śailasya parvaṇi | likhitvā prapaṭhenmantraṃ kāmapīṭhaṃ gururmataḥ || 7-583 ||
athavā yoginīśaile dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi dhruvam | yogāmbā yatra devī sā likhitvā prapaṭhenmanum || 7-584 ||
jvālāmukhī samīpe vā hiṅgulāyāḥ samīpataḥ | likhitvā prapaṭhenmantraṃ nānyathaiva prasiddhyati || 7-585 ||
mukhyataḥ strīsamīpe hi kāmapīṭhe manugrahaḥ | athavā sarvadeśeṣu mantragrahaṇamucyate || 7-586 ||
tālapatre manuṃ vakṣye pūrṇakumbhe nidhāpayet | bhāskaraṃ ca guruṃ dhyātvā vācayet trigurū raviḥ || 7-587 ||
etāvatā śāvaramantrāṇāṃ vidhivadgrahaṇameva puraścaraṇamityuktam |
atha vīrasādhanam |
tatrādau citāsādhanamuktaṃ (yoginīhṛdaye)
devyuvāca |
bhagavan sarvamantrajña sarvaśāstra viśārada | śmaśāne ca puraścaryā tvayā saṃpūjitā purā || 7-588 ||
kathayasva tadedānīṃ yadi sneho'sti māṃ prati |
īśvara uvāca |
yasmin pariśrameṇāpi nṝṇāṃ siddhiḥ samīhitā || 7-589 ||
na jātā tatra karttavyā sādhakairvīrasādhanā | purā siddhyai nṛpāṇāṃ ca karttavyo samupasthite || 7-590 ||
nānyasiddhikaraṃ śīghraṃ vīrasādhanavarjitam | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena vidheyā vīrasādhanā || 7-591 ||
bhayamuktena śucinā sarvasiddhimabhīpsitā | nānayā durlabhaṃ kiṃcit sādhakasya samīhitam || 7-592 ||
girije tat prayatnena yācaneyaṃ prakāśyate | aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ pakṣayorubhayorapi || 7-593 ||
kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣeṇa sādhayedanayā hitam |
(vīratantre)
mahāvīrakramaṃ deva sūcitaṃ na prakāśitam || 7-594 ||
kathayasva mahādeva sarvasiddhipradaṃ mahat |
bhairava uvāca |
sarvasiddhipradaṃ sākṣāt sarvadevanamaskṛtam || 7-595 ||
sarvapāpaharaṃ devi sarvarogavināśanam | brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ dikpālānāṃ ca bhāvini || 7-596 ||
bharavānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ gandharvāṇāṃ ca yoginām | śāśvat siddhipradaṃ devi sarveṣāmālayaṃ mahat || 7-597 ||
nānyat siddhipradaṃ devi vīrasādhanavarjitam | mahābalo mahāvīro mahāsāhasikaḥ śuciḥ || 7-598 ||
mahāsvaccho dayāvā(/)śca sarvabhūtahite rataḥ | teṣāṃ kṛte mahādevi kathitaṃ vīrasādhanam || 7-599 ||
tathā (-)
ghaṭībandhanavastraṃ vai mūlena paridhāya ca | tadbāhye ca punarvastraṃ mūlenāṅgavilepanam || 7-600 ||
kṛtoṣṇīṣaśca mūlena sindūreṇordhvapuṇḍrakam | iṣṭadevaṃ guruṃ natvā yātrā praharamadhyataḥ || 7-601 ||
kāryā ca sādhakaiḥ sārdhaṃ hṛdi mantraṃ parāmṛśan | akṣubdho bhuktabhojyaśca yadi syādvīrasādhakaḥ || 7-602 ||
divyo vā na paśustatra bhuktvā sādhanamācaret | aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ pakṣayorubhayorapi || 7-603 ||
bhaumavāre tamisrāyāṃ sādhayet siddhimuttamām | upacāraṃ samādāya kulāmṛtarasaṃ tathā || 7-603 ||
sāmipānnaṃ guḍaṃ chāgaṃ surā piṣṭakameva ca | nānāphalaṃ ca naivedyaṃ svasvakalpoktasādhanam || 7-604 ||
citāsthāne samānīya suhṛdbhiḥ śastrapāṇibhiḥ | samānaguṇasaṃpannaiḥ sādhako gatabhīḥ svayam || 7-605 ||
na nirīkṣeccaturdikṣu devatādhyānatatparaḥ | bhītaścet sādhakastatra caturdikṣu ca sādhakaḥ || 7-606 ||
svaguruṃ bhrātṛvargaṃ vā brāhmaṇān vā'pi suvratān | suhṛdānapi rakṣārthaṃ kiyaddūre niveśayet || 7-607 ||
no cet kevalamevāsau bhairavaḥ parikīrttitaḥ | akṣālitāṃ citābhūmiṃ gatvā sādhakasattamaḥ || 7-608 ||
prakṣātilāṃ yadi prāyaḥ kārayedasthisaṃcayam |
(yāmale)
asaṃskṛtā citā grāhyā na tu saṃskārasaṃskṛtā || 7-609 ||
tathā (-)
saṃkalpaṃ prathamaṃ kuryāt svastivācanapūrvakam | sāmānyārghaṃ vidhāyaitat tataḥ pūjāṃ samārabhet || 7-610 ||
vastrālaṅkārabhūṣādyairbhūṣitaḥ pūrvadiṅmukhaḥ |
saṃkalpastu (-)
oṃ adyetyādi amukagotraḥ śrīmadamukaśarmā'mukamantrasiddhikāmaḥ śmaśānasādhamanahaṃ kariṣye (-) ityevaṃrūpaḥ |
(vīratantre)
astrāntamūlamantreṇa prokṣaṇaṃ yāgabhūmiṣu || 7-611 ||
gurupādayugaṃ dhyātvā gaṇeśaṃ vaṭukaṃ tathā | yoginīṃ mātṛkāṃ caiva vāmapādapuraḥsaram || 7-612 ||
ye cātra saṃsthitā devā rākṣasāśca bhayānakāḥ | piśācāḥ siddhayakṣāśca gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ || 7-613 ||
yoginyo mātaro bhūtāḥ sarvāśca khecarastriyaḥ | siddhidāstā bhavantvatra tathā ca mama rakṣakāḥ || 7-614 ||
praṇamya manunā'nena puṣpāñjalītrayaṃ kṣipet | śmaśānādhipatiṃ paścādbhairavaṃ kālabhairavam || 7-615 ||
mahākālaṃ yajedyatnāt pūrvādidikcatuṣṭaye | pādyādibhiśca mantrajño valiṃ paścānnivedayet || 7-616 ||
śabdabījaṃ tataḥ paścāt śmaśānādhipatatparam | imamante sāmiṣānnaṃ baliṃ gṛhṇapadaṃ tataḥ || 7-617 ||
gṛhṇa gṛhṇāpaya yugaṃ vighnanivāraṇaṃ tataḥ | kuru siddhiṃ me samuktvā prayacha svāhayā'nvitam || 7-618 ||
tārādyamanunā devi prathamo valirīritaḥ | māyānte bhairavāt paścādbhayānakapadaṃ tataḥ || 7-619 ||
pūrve baliṃ samuddhṛtya dakṣiṇe balimāharet | hūmante tu mahākālāt paścāt pūrvavaduddharet || 7-620 ||
paścime kāladevāya praṇavādyena kalpayet | śabdānte kālaśabdānte bhairaveti padaṃ tataḥ || 7-621 ||
śmaśānādhipa ityevaṃ pūrvavaccāntare haret | citāmadhye tato dayādvalitrayamanuttamam || 7-622 ||
kālarātrimahākāli kālike ghoraniḥsvane | gṛhāṇemaṃ baliṃ mātardehi me siddhimuttamām || 7-623 ||
hū(/) kālikāyai svāheti baliṃ datvā bhūtanāthāya dāpayet | śabdānte bhūtanāthānte śmaśānādhipa ityapi || 7-624 ||
praṇavādyena mantreṇa dāpayedvalimuttamam | hū(/) sarvagaṇanāthānte adhipatipadaṃ tathā || 7-625 ||
śmaśāne mastake datvā pūrvavacca samuddharet | tārādyena baliṃ datvā pañcagavyena sundari || 7-626 ||
asthisaṃprokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā pīṭhamantraṃ nyaset punaḥ | bhūrje vā vaṭapatre vā tatra pīṭhamanuṃ nyaset || 7-627 ||
tantrāntare |
tataścitāpaścimata ekīkṛtyāsthisaṃcayam | oṃ hrī(/) ādharaśaktaye nama ityaṇunā punaḥ || 7-628 ||
pañcagavyena saṃprokṣya bhūrje vā vaṭapatrake | hasauriti likhenmantraṃ sthāpayet tatra tat punaḥ || 7-629 ||
kambalādyāsanaṃ tatra vinyasyādhāraśaktaye | nama ityaṇunā tatra hrīmādyāṃ ca prapūjayet || 7-630 ||
(vīratantre)
pīṭhamāstīrya tasmin vai baddhavīrāsanastataḥ | vīrārdane deveśi loṣṭān dikṣu viniḥkṣipet || 7-631 ||
kūrcabījadvayaṃ devi māyāyugmaṃ tataḥ param | kālike ghoradaṃṣṭre ca pracaṇḍe caṇḍanāyike || 7-632 ||
dānavān dārayetyuktvā haneti dvitayaṃ tataḥ | para vīraṃ mahāvighnaṃ chedayeti dvayaṃ tataḥ || 7-633 ||
sarvāstrānto dviṭhānto'yaṃ vīrādanumanuḥ smṛtaḥ | anena mantritaṃ loṣṭaṃ daśadikṣu viniḥkṣipet || 7-634 ||
tanmadhye bhairavo devo vighnairna paribhūyate | yadi pramādāddeveśi sādhako bhayavihvalaḥ || 7-635 ||
taistaiḥ sarvaiḥ suhṛdbhiśca rakṣito nābhibhūyate | arkendusitavādyālatūlairnirmitavarttikām || 7-636 ||
pradīpaṃ yatra saṃsthāpya astraṃ tatra prapūjayet | gate tasmin mahādīpe vighnaiśca paribhūyate || 7-637 ||
tadadhaścāstramantreṇa nikhanet kuladīpikām | tattatkalpavidhānena bhūtaśuddhyādikaṃ caret || 7-638 ||
ṣodhāṃ vā tārakāṃ vā'pi vinyasya pūjayet tataḥ |
devatāmiti śeṣaḥ | ata eva (yāmalādau)
tataḥ pañcopacāreṇa purato devatāṃ yajet || 7-639 ||
nimīlya cakṣuṣī paścāddevaṃ dhyātvā manuṃ japet | ekākṣarī yadi bhaveddiksahasraṃ tato japet || 7-640 ||
dvyakṣare cāṣṭasāhasraṃ tryakṣare hyayutārdhakam | tataḥ paraṃ tu mantrajño gajāntakasahasrakam || 7-641 ||
niśārdhāt tu samārabhya udayāntaṃ samācaret | yadyasahyaṃ bhayaṃ karṇanetre vastreṇa bandhayet || 7-642 ||
tato'rdharātraparyantaṃ yadi kiñcinna dṛśyate | jayadurgāmanunā'rghaṃ tenaiva sarṣapān kṣipet || 7-643 ||
oṃ tilo'si somadevatyo gosavastṛptikārakaḥ | pitṝṇāṃ svargadātā tvaṃ marttyānāṃ mama rakṣakaḥ || 7-644 ||
bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ vighneṣu śāntikārakaḥ | iti kṣiptvā tilā(/)statra caturbhāgaiḥ śivāditaḥ || 7-645 ||
tataḥ saptapadaṃ gatvā punastatraiva saṃviśet | evaṃ tatrāpi saṃpūjya prajapenmanumuttamam || 7-646 ||
nirbhayaḥ san japet tāvadyāvat siddhiḥ prajāyate | bhayaṃ tu svapnavajjñeyaṃ pare'hni śeṣamācaret || 7-647 ||
(vāmakeśvaratantre)
japānte ca valiṃ dadyāddevatāyai yathāvidhi | mahiṣaṃ chāgalaṃ cāpi gṛhītvā varameva ca || 7-648 ||
gṛhaṃ gacchet suhṛdvargaiḥ sārdhaṃ suhṛṣṭamānasaḥ |
iti citāsādhanāvidhiḥ |
atha śavasādhanavidhiḥ |
(bhūtaḍāmare)
yaduktaṃ bhāvasarvasve sarvatantreṣu gopitam || 7-649 ||
vīrasiddhividhānaṃ hi devadevena śambhunā | yasya vijñānamātreṇa mandabhāgyo'pi siddhyati || 7-650 ||
tathā (-)
puraścaraṇasaṃpanno vīrasiddhiṃ samācaret | putradārādhanasnehalobhamohāvivarjitaḥ || 7-651 ||
mantraṃ vā sādhayiṣyāmi dehaṃ vā pātayāmyaham | pratijñāmīdṛśīṃ kṛtvā validravyāṇi cintayet || 7-652 ||
(vīratantre)
pūrvoktamupahārādi samādāya tu sādhakaḥ | sādhayet svahitāṃ siddhiṃ sādhanasthānamāśrayet || 7-653 ||
gurudhyānādikaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvoktamāśrayet sudhīḥ | vīrārdanāntike bhūmau māyāmoho na vidyate || 7-654 ||
ye cātretyādimantreṇa bhūmau puṣpāñjalitrayam | śmaśānādhipatīnām tu pūrvavadvalimāharet || 7-655 ||
aghorākhyeṇa mantreṇa valisādhanamācaret | sudarśanena vā rakṣāmubhābhyāṃ vā prakalpayet || 7-656 ||
māyāsphuradvayaṃ bhūyaḥ prasphuradvitayaṃ punaḥ | ghoraghorataretyante tanno rūpapadaṃ tataḥ || 7-657 ||
vaṭayugmāntarānte ca pracaṭa dvitayaṃ punaḥ | heyugmaṃ ramayugmaṃ ca tato bandhayugaṃ tataḥ || 7-558 ||
pātaya dvitayaṃ varma phaḍantaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ | ekapañcāśadarṇo'yamaghorāstramayo manuḥ || 7-659 ||
hālāhalaṃ samuddhṛtya sahasrārasvarūpakam | varmāstrāntaṃ mahāmantraṃ sudarśanasya kīrttitam || 7-660 ||
bhūtaśūddhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā nyāsajālaṃ pravinyaset | jayadurgākhyamantreṇa sarṣapān dikṣu niḥkṣipet || 7-661 ||
oṃ durge durge rakṣāṇi svāhā (-) iti jayadurgākhyamantraḥ |
tilo'sīti ca mantreṇa tilānapi viniḥkṣipet | yaṣṭividdhaṃ śūlaviddhaṃ khaḍgaviddhaṃ payomṛtam || 7-662 ||
rajjuviddhaṃ sarpadaṣṭaṃ cāṇḍālairvā'bhibhūtakam | taruṇaṃ sundaraṃ śūraṃ raṇe naṣṭaṃ samujjvalam || 7-663 ||
palāyanaviśūnyaṃ ca saṃmukhe raṇavittamam | svecchāmṛtaṃ dvivarṣaṃ ca vṛddhāṃ strīṃ ca dvijaṃ tathā || 7-664 ||
annābhāvamṛtaṃ kuṣṭaṃ saptarātrordhvagaṃ tathā | evaṃ cāṣṭavidhaṃ tyaktvā pūrvoktānyatamaṃ śavam || 7-665 ||
gṛhītvā mūlamantreṇa pūjāsthāne samānayet | cāṇḍālādyabhibhūtaṃ vā śīghraṃ siddhiphalapradam || 7-666 ||
praṇavādyastramantreṇa śavasya prokṣaṇaṃ caret | praṇavaṃ kūrcabījaṃ ca mṛtakāya namo'stu phaṭ || 7-667 ||
puṣpāñjalitrayaṃ datvā praṇamet sparśapūrvakam | re vīraparamānanda śivānanda kuleśvara || 7-668 ||
ānandabhairavākāra devīparyaṅkaśaṅkara | vīro'haṃ tvāṃ prayacchāmi uttiṣṭha candrikārcane || 7-669 ||
praṇamyānena mantreṇa svāpayet tadanantaram | tāraṃ śabdaṃ mṛtakāya namo'ntaṃ mantramucyate || 7-670 ||
śavasvāpanamantro'yaṃ sarvatantreṣu deśitaḥ | dūpena dhūpitaṃ kṛtvā gandhādi vā pralipya ca || 7-671 ||
raktākto yadi deveśa bhakṣayet kulasādhakam | gatvā śavasya sānnidhyaṃ dhārayet kaṭideśataḥ || 7-672 ||
yadyupadrāvayet tasya dadyānniṣṭhīvanaṃ mukhe | punaḥ prakṣālitaṃ kṛtvā japasthānaṃ samānayet || 7-673 ||
kuśaśayyāṃ paristīrya tatra saṃsthāyecchavam | elālavaṅgakarpūrajātīkhadirasārdrakaiḥ || 7-674 ||
tāmbūlaṃ tanmukhe datvā śavaṃ kuryādadhomukham | sthāpayitvā tasya pṛṣṭhaṃ candanena vilepayet || 7-675 ||
bāhumūlādikaṭyantaṃ caturasraṃ vibhāvayet | madhye padmaṃ caturdvāraṃ dalāṣṭakasamanvitam || 7-676 ||
tataścaiṇeyamajinaṃ kambalāntaritaṃ nyaset | dvādaśāṅgulamānena yajñakāṣṭhāni dikṣu ca || 7-677 ||
imaṃ valiṃ gṛhṇa yugaṃ gṛhṇāpaya yugaṃ tataḥ | vighnanivāraṇaṃ kṛtvā siddhiṃ prayaccheti dvayam || 7-678 ||
anena manunā pūrvaṃ valiṃ dadyācca sāmiṣam | svasvanāmādikaṃ datvā pūrvadvalimāharet || 7-679 ||
sarveṣāṃ lokapālānāṃ tataḥ sādhakasattamaḥ | śavādhisthānadevebhyo valiṃ dadyāt surayā saha || 7-680 ||
catuḥṣaṣṭiyoginībhyo ḍākinībhyo valiṃ diśet | pūjādravyaṃ sannidhau ca dūre cottarasādhakam || 7-681 ||
saṃsthāpyāsanamabhyarcya svamantrānte trapāṃ tataḥ | phaḍityanena mantreṇa tatrāśvārohaṇaṃ viśet || 7-682 ||
kuśān pādatale datvā śavakeśān pramārjya ca | dṛḍhaṃ nibandhya juṭikāṃ kṛtasaṃkalpasādhakaḥ || 7-683 ||
śavopari samārūhya prāṇāyāmaṃ vidhāya ca | vīrārdanena mantreṇa dikṣu loṣṭān samākṣipet || 7-684 ||
tato devaṃ samabhyarcya upacāraistu vistaraiḥ | śavāsye vidhivaddevi devatāpyāyanaṃ caret || 7-685 ||
uthāya saṃmukhe sthitvā paṭhedbhaktiparāyaṇaḥ | yaśo me bhava deveśa mamāmukapadaṃ tataḥ || 7-686 ||
siddhiṃ dehi mahābhāga bhūtāśrayapadāmbaraḥ | mūlaṃ samuccaranmantrī śavapādadvayaṃ tataḥ || 7-687 ||
paṭṭasūtreṇa bandhīyāt tadotthātuṃ na śakyate | oṃ bhīrubhīma bhayābhāva bhavyalocanabhāvuka || 7-688 ||
trāhi māṃ devadeveśa śavānāmadhipādhipa | iti pādatale tasya trikoṇaṃ cakramālikhet || 7-689 ||
tadotthātuṃ na śaknoti śavo'pi niścalo bhavet | upaviśya punastasya bāhū niḥsārya pārśvayoḥ || 7-690 ||
hastayoḥ kuśamāstrīrya pādau tatra nidhāpayet | oṣṭhau tu saṃpuṭau kṛtvā sthiracittaḥ sthirendriyaḥ || 7-691 ||
sadā devīṃ hṛdi dhyātvā maunī tu japamācaret | śmaśāne proktasaṅkhyabhirjapaṃ kuryāt kuleśvari || 7-692 ||
athavā'rambhakālāt tu yāvaccodayate raviḥ | yadyardharātriparyantaṃ japte kicinna lakṣyate || 7-693 ||
tadā pūrvavadarghādisamayādāgatāni ca | kṛtvopaviśya tatraiva japaṃ kuryādananyadhīḥ || 7-694 ||
calāsanādbhayaṃ nāsti bhaye jāte vadet tataḥ | yat prārthayasi deveśi dātavyaṃ kuñjarādikam || 7-695 ||
dināntare pradāsyāmi svanāma kathasva me | ityuktvā saṃskṛtenaiva nirbhayastu punarjapet || 7-696 ||
tataścenmadhuraṃ vakti vaktavyaṃ madhuraṃ tataḥ | tadā satyaṃ ca saṃskāryaṃ naraṃ ca prārthayet tataḥ || 7-697 ||
yadi satyaṃ na kuryācca varaṃ vā na prayacchati | tadā punarjapeddhīmānekāgraṃ mānasaṃ bhajan || 7-698 ||
(yakṣaḍāmare)
na paśyedadbhute jāte na bhāṣeta ca na spṛśet | ekacitto japaṃ kuryādyāvat pratyakṣatāṃ vrajet || 7-699 ||
(vīratantre)
nararūpo nātra devo yo naro vopasarpati | yatnatastena boddhavyaṃ naro vā devayonayaḥ || 7-700 ||
mātā vā tatsutā vā'pi mātulānī tathā'pi vā | āgatya vighnaṃ carate māyayā'cchādya vigraham || 7-701 ||
uttiṣṭha vatsa te kāryaṃ sarvaṃ jātaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | prabhātasamayo jātastvatpitā krośate gṛhe || 7-702 ||
prāyeṇa sakalā lokā rājāno daṇḍadhāriṇaḥ | kadācit kenāpyādiṣṭastadā kiṃ te kariṣyati || 7-703 ||
ityādivividhairvākyairna japaṃ parisaṃtyajet | mṛtāḥ pitṛgaṇāstatra dūradeśanivāsinaḥ || 7-704 ||
bāndhavāstatra āyānti devarūpadharāstataḥ | strīputrasevakādī(/)śca gṛhītvā nīyate paraiḥ || 7-705 ||
rudanti putrakāḥ sarve bhrātaro'nujaśiṣyakāḥ | nijakāntāṅgasaṃsparśaṃ vastrādyābharaṇādikam || 7-706 ||
gṛhītvā nīyate patnī pālakaistadbhayaṃ tyajet | yadi na kṣubhyate tatra tadā kiṃ vā na labhyate || 7-707 ||
strīrūpadhāriṇī devī dvijarūpadharaḥ pumān | varaṃ gṛhṇeti śabdaṃ vai trivārānte varaṃ labhet || 7-708 ||
sādhunā'sādhunā vā'pi yoṣiccedvaradāyinī | tadā vīrapatestasya kiṃ na siddhyati bhūtale || 7-709 ||
niṣpāpaḥ puruṣaścaiva kule caiva susaṃskṛtaḥ | asaṃskṛtavarā devī pāpayuktā na saṃśayaḥ || 7-710 ||
saṃmukhe'saṃmukhe vā'pi saṃskṛtaṃ vakti cāparam | saiva devī na saṃdehaḥ sa devo bhairavaḥ svayam || 7-711 ||
na cedevaṃ bhaveccaiva māyāpuṭitavigrahāt | varayenna varaṃ tatra na varaṃ pravadet kvacit || 7-712 ||
sa cet saṃskṛtamākhyātaṃ vakti vaktavyamīdṛśam | na cet svayaṃ kaulikoktyā varaṃ grāhyaṃ nirākulam || 7-713 ||
athavā utkaṭaṃ kiñcillabhetāpyātmano hitam | śabdo vā jāyate samyagamṛtaṃ vā'pi labhyate || 7-714 ||
sarvaṃ vicārya gṛhītavyamevaṃ dik parikīrttitā | devyākṛtayo bahudhā narādyākṛtayaḥ kvacit || 7-715 ||
avaśyaṃ tatra bhetavyaṃ na tatra pratyayaḥ kvacit | bhairvā vaṭukāścaiva kulaśāstraparāyaṇāḥ || 7-716 ||
etacchāstraprasaṅgena kṛtyā kuṭilavigrahāḥ | putro bhūtvā varayet taṃ nārī bhūtvā vimohayet || 7-717 ||
tasmāt tattvaparo vīra ācāre yatnamācaet |
(būtaḍāmare)
vadatyāgatya ceṣṭaṃ vā dehasphūrartiṃ karoti hi || 7-718 ||
etena jāyate vīrasiddhirdadyāt tato valim | devatāṃ ca guruṃ natvā visṛjya hṛdayaṃ punaḥ || 7-719 ||
sthāpayet toṣayedvidvān śavaṃ toye viniḥkṣipet |
(vīratantre)
satye kṛte varaṃ labdhvā saṃtyajecca ca japādikam || 7-720 ||
jātaṃ phalamiti jñātvā jūṭikāṃ mocayet tataḥ | saṃprakṣālya ca saṃsthāpya jūṭikāṃ mocayet pade || 7-721 ||
padacakraṃ mārjayitvā pūjādravyaṃ jale kṣīpet | śavaṃ jale'tha garte vā niḥkṣipya snānamācaret || 7-722 ||
tatastu svagṛhaṃ gatvā valiṃ datvā dināntare | agnimarātrau tu yeṣāṃ devānāṃ yajamāno'ham || 7-723 ||
te gṛhṇantu mayā dattaṃ valimimaṃ ca sāmiṣam | atha yairyācitaścāśvanarakuñjaraśūkarān || 7-724 ||
datvā piṣṭamayāneva karttavyaṃ samupoṣaṇam |
tatrāntare |
yavakṣodamayaṃ vā'pi śālikṣodamayaṃ ca vā || 7-725 ||
candrahāsena vidhivat tattanmantreṇa pātayet | pare'hni nityamācarya pañcagavyaṃ pivet tataḥ || 7-726 ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayet tatra pañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyakān | pañca pañca gṛhītān vā kramāccaiva daśāvadhi || 7-727 ||
tataḥ snātvā ca bhuktvā ca nivaseduttamasthale | yadi na syādviprabhojyaṃ tadā nirdhanatāṃ vrajet || 7-728 ||
tena cennirdhanatvaṃ syāt tadā devaḥ prakupyati | trirātaṃ vā'tha ṣaḍrātraṃ gopayet kulasādhanam || 7-729 ||
śayyāyāṃ yadi gacchedvā tadā vyādhī prajāyate | gītaṃ śrutvā ca vadhiro niścakṣurnṛtyadarśanāt || 7-730 ||
yadi vakti dine vākyaṃ tadā sa mūkatāṃ vrajet | pañcadaśadināntā hi dehe devasya saṃsthitiḥ || 7-731 ||
gobrāhmaṇānāṃ devānāṃ nindāṃ kuryānna kutracit | devagobrāhmaṇādī(/)śca pratyahaṃ tu spṛśecchuciḥ || 7-732 ||
prātarnityakriyānte tu villvapatrodakaṃ pivet | tataḥ snāyāt tu tīrthādau prāpte ṣoḍaśavāsare || 7-733 ||
svāhāntaṃ mūlamuccārya tarpayāmi namaḥpadam | evaṃ padatrayādūrdhvaṃ devānāṃ tarpaṇaṃ jalaiḥ || 7-734 ||
munitarpaṇaśūnyasya na syāddevasya tarpaṇam | ityanena vidhānena siddhimāpnoti niścitam || 7-735 ||
iha bhuktvā varān divyānante yāti hareḥ padam | anaṅgaṃ sāṅgamapi vā niṣphalaṃ saphalaṃ ca vā || 7-736 ||
kṛtvā sādhanamevaitacchakteḥ priyatamo bhavet | śavābhāve śmaśāne vā karttavyā vīrasādhanā || 7-737 ||
ye bhāvā yasya vai proktāstairbhāvairyadi nārcayet | īdṛśakramayogena bhraṣṭo bhavati sādhakaḥ || 7-738 ||
nopadiśet tatra bhāvaṃ na pūjāṃ tatra saṃdiśet | śmaśānāntaṃ gṛhītvā tu tāvacchuddhiḥ prajāyate || 7-739 ||
(vīracūḍāmaṇau)
athavā'nyaprakāreṇa sādhanaṃ kathayāmi te | japasthānaṃ tu saṃśodhya khananādi prayatnataḥ || 7-740 ||
tanmadhye ca valiṃ dadyāllikhedyantraṃ trikoṇakam | tanmadhye ca mahāśaṃṅkhaṃ niveśya muṇḍapañcakam || 7-741 ||
tasyopari mahāpretamakhaṇḍāṅgaṃ suśobhanam | udvarttanādikaṃ kuryāt snāpayedvidhipūrvakam || 7-742 ||
paridhāpyaṃ raktavastraṃ netrāñjanasamīritam | tāmbūlādi mukhe dadyāllalāṭe raktacandanam || 7-743 ||
hṛdaye ca likhedyantraṃ padmamadhye trikoṇakam | pūjāyantraṃ lalāṭe ca śastreṇa vilikhet tataḥ || 7-744 ||
mūrdhni bāhau tathā haste pāde caiva tathā kaṭau | khadirādīni kāṣṭhāni kīlānyāropayet sudhīḥ || 7-745 ||
bandhakaṃ varddhayet tatra dṛḍhabandhena bandhayet | ṣaṭpātreṣu valiṃ dadyāt kīle kīle pṛthak pṛthak || 7-746 ||
māṣaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā matsyaṃ pāyasaṃ trividhāḥ surāḥ | modakaṃ ca mahāpūpaṃ dugdhānnotsargamācaret || 7-747 ||
krodhīśavahnimārūḍhaṃ tūryasvarasamanvitam | varmabījaṃ samuccārya śmaśānakāliketi ca || 7-748 ||
pūrvabījaṃ samālikhya astrānto mantra ucyate | māyābījaṃ samuccārya śmaśānabhairavāya ca || 7-749 ||
mahākālāya devāya sarvavighnaharo bhava | valiṃ gṛhṇa dvidhā kuryāt trayodaśaṃ savindukam || 7-750 ||
śmaśānavāsino rudrā astimāṃsavalipriyāḥ | vighnaṃ nivāraya samyagvaliṃ gṛhṇa dvidhā punaḥ || 7-751 ||
vighnaṃ nivāraya yugaṃ varaṃ caiva prayaccha me | dviṭhānto mantra ityukto valiruktavidhānataḥ || 7-752 ||
māyā lajjā tayā lakṣmīrnandinīśatrayaṃ likhet | nārāyaṇastathā sūkṣmaparaṃ tu madhusūdanaḥ || 7-753 ||
yoginībhyaḥ paraṃ paścāt śmaśānavāsinīti ca | pracaṇḍā caṇḍarūpāyai karttṛkharparadhāriṇī || 7-754 ||
valiṃ gṛhṇāpaya yugaṃ sarvavighnaṃ nivāraya | varaṃ dehi padaṃ brūyāddviṭhānto yoginīvaliḥ || 7-755 ||
raudraṃ vahnisamārūḍhaṃ caturdaśasvarānvitam | vindunādakalākrāntaṃ kṣetrapālaṃ ca ṅe'ntam || 7-756 ||
śmaśānavāsine brūyācchoṇitāsthipriyāya ca | dviṭhāntaṃ mantramuccārya kṣetrapālavaliṃ haret || 7-757 ||
vārāhībījamuddhṛtya bījaṃ pañcāntakaṃ punaḥ | vakratuṇḍāyeti padaṃ varma caiva samuddharet || 7-758 ||
valiṃ gṛhṇapadaṃ brūyādvighnaṃ nivārayeti ca | siddhiṃ prayaccha me caiva astrānto manuruttamaḥ || 7-759 ||
pādasyāpādanaṃ kuryānmadirānandavigrahaḥ | hṛdayopari mahāvīraḥ śaktiṃ caiva śavopari || 7-760 ||
vivastrā muktakeśī ca karttṛkharparadhāriṇī | prakṣālya kuladravyeṇa kulacakraṃ prapūjayet || 7-761 ||
dhūpadīpādinaivedyaiḥ pañcabhūtabaliṃ haret | yathāśakti japaṃ kuryāt mūlamantraṃ samarpayet || 7-762 ||
viparītaparā nīvī mathunaṃ ca śavopari | ayutaṃ ca japet tatra sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet || 7-763 ||
yadā vai bhayabhīto'sau bhakṣayanti ca tatkṣaṇāt | dehi dehi yadā brūyāt tadā chāgavaliṃ haret || 7-764 ||
balidānaṃ vinā hiṃsā na karttavyā kadācana | puraścaraṇato mantrasiddhirbhavati niścitam || 7-765 ||
(muṇḍamālāyām)
athavā'nyaprakāreṇa kuryādvai vīrasādhanam | saṃgrāme pativān pretānānīya vidhipūrvakam || 7-766 ||
aṣṭadikṣu vidhāyāṣṭau navamaṃ madhyasaṃsthakam | rajjvā rajjvā rajjunātha ropite dṛḍhakīlake || 7-767 ||
candanādibhirabhyukṣya sugandhikusumādibhiḥ | alaṅkṛtya prayatnena madhyasyātha mastakam || 7-768 ||
lalāṭe pūjayeddevīmupacāraiḥ samujjavalaiḥ | valiṃ dadyādaṣṭadikṣu māṣamāṃsaiḥ surāśavaiḥ || 7-769 ||
pāyasairmadhusaṃyuktaiḥ kusumairakṣataistathā | tato japaṃ prakūrvīta śavasya hṛdi nirbhayaḥ || 7-770 ||
upaviśyāsane śoṇe vyāghracarmavinirmite | pañcāyutaṃ ca japtvā'tha pūrvavat kalpayedvalim || 7-771 ||
vyāghravānarabhallūkaśṛgālolkāmukhānatha | dṛṣṭvā'tha na bhayaṃ kuryānmāyāmeva vicinyayet || 7-772 ||
tato'nubhāvaṃ labdhvā'tha dadyācchāgādikaṃ valim | tathā'kliṣṭamanā bhūtvā śavaṃ niḥkṣipya vāriṇi || 7-773 ||
dvijebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt sādhakebhyo viśeṣataḥ | suveśābhyastathā strībhyaḥ kumārībhyaḥ prayatnataḥ || 7-774 ||
vasanaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ tadvanmadhuradravyabhojanam | svayaṃ tathaiva bhuñjīta narāṇāṃ tu vivarjayet || 7-775 ||
etena tu mahāsiddhirjāyate bhuvi durlabhā | rājyaṃ śriyaṃ parānando vairirāṣṭrajayaṃ tathā || 7-776 ||
jaganmohanavaśyādi kavitākauśalaṃ punaḥ | saṃgrāme ca tamuddiśya sādhakaṃ vairivāhinī || 7-777 ||
palāyate pragalbhā'pi ki punaḥ kṣudravairiṇaḥ | nānāvidhāṣṭasiddhīnāṃ sādhako bhājanaṃ bhavet || 7-778 ||
idaṃ mayoktaṃ deveśi na prakāśyaṃ kadācana | etat te paramaṃ gopyaṃ viśeṣāt paśusaṃsadi || 7-779 ||
rahasyametat paramamāgamasyaikajīvitam || 7-779ef ||
iti vīrasādhanavidhiḥ |
vibhratyadbhutabhūtibhūtapavaco vaicitracitrāmṛta(-) srotaḥśālini sannibandhanasaritsaṃbhedamabhyarhitam | navye'smin naradevanirmitapuraścaryārṇave saptamaḥ sadyuktisphuṭamauktikotkararucottuṅgastaraṅgo gataḥ || 7-780 ||
[iti śrīmanmahārājādhirājapratāpasiṃhasāhaviracite puraścaryārṇave mantrasiddhilakṣaṇopāyapuraścaraṇabhedanirūpaṇaṃ nāma saptamastaraṅgaḥ]|| 7 || atha gaṇeśādimantrāstatpuraścaraṇaviśeṣāśca
pradarśyate |
tatrādau vighnarājamantra ukto (merutantre)
asiddhaguruṇā datto mantraḥ syādbahuvighnadaḥ | tatrādau sādhayedvighnarājamantraṃ tataḥ punaḥ || 8-1 ||
niṣpāpasya puraścaryābalāt siddhyenmanūttamaḥ | tatrāmnāyavibhedena sarvatantreṣu gopitām || 8-2 ||
ekabījātmakaṃ vakṣye vighnamantraṃ susiddhidam | tatrādau vaidikānā tu gakāraḥ kevalo mataḥ || 8-3 ||
dakṣiṇānāṃ binduyukto dvibinduḥ pūrvamārgiṇām | etaddvayayutaḥ paścādūrdhvāmnāye ca gaumiti || 8-4 ||
glaumuttare gomati ca pātālāmnāyamīritam | gaṇapo'sya muniśchando nivṛdvighno'sya devatā || 8-5 ||
gaṇaṃ japāya svāhā hṛtmekadaṃṣṭrāya hu(/)phaṭ | acalakarṇine namaḥ śikhā proktā'tha varma tu || 8-6 ||
gajavaktrāya ca namo netramastramudīryate | mahādaśamacaṇḍāya hu(/) phaḍetacca vaidikaiḥ || 8-7 ||
ṣaḍdīrghayuktabījena tāntriko nyāsamācaret |
atha dhyānam |
raktāmbaraṃ raktavarṇaṃ raktagandhānulepanam || 8-8 ||
raktapuṣpaiḥ pūjyamānaṃ tundilaṃ candramaulinam | trinetraṃ vāmanaṃ bibhradbījapūraṃ ca śuṇḍayā || 8-9 ||
vāmadakṣordhvayoḥ pāśāṅkuśo cakraṃ varastvadhaḥ | padmāsanaṃ sarpabhūṣaṃ dhyāyedvighnavināyakam || 8-10 ||
(śāradāyām)
sindūrābhaṃ trinetraṃ pṛthutarajaṭharaṃ hastapadmairdadhānaṃ dantaṃ pāśāṅkuśeṣṭānyurukaravilasadbījapūrābhirāmam | bālendudyotimauliṃ karipativadanaṃ dānapūrārdhagaṇḍaṃ bhogīndrābaddhamauliṃ bhajat gaṇapatiṃ raktavastrāṅgarāgam || 8-11 ||
asya mantrasya puraścaraṇamuktaṃ (merutantre)
lakṣamekaṃ manuṃ japtvā juhuyāt taddaśāṃśataḥ |
(śāradāyāṃ tu)
vedalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ daśāśaṃ juhuyāt tataḥ (-) ityuktam |
tathā (-)
modakaiḥ pṛthukairlājaiḥ saktubhiścekṣuparvabhiḥ || 8-12 ||
nārikelaistilairmocairhomaṃ kuryāt pṛthak pṛthak | sahasramekaṃ dviśataṃ pañcāśatpramitaṃ tathā || 8-13 ||
dalaistrimadhurāktaiḥ syāddhomaḥ kāmyo'tha kathyate | daugdhānnena ghṛtāktena homo'bhīṣṭaphalapradaḥ || 8-14 ||
lakṣmīkāmo nārikelaiścaturthyāṃ juhuyāt tathā |
mocaṃ kadalīphalam | atha lakṣmīgaṇeśamantrastathaiva |
vakṣye'tha dakṣiṇāmnāye lakṣmīgaṇapatiṃ surāḥ || 8-15 ||
gajalakṣmīsamāyuktamayaṃ yogo'tidurlabhaḥ | śrīga(/) saumyāya voccārya mahāgaṇapatiṃ tathā || 8-16 ||
ṅe'ntamuktvā varavaradoktvā sarvajanaṃ vadet | me vaśamānaya svāhetyekonatriṃśadakṣaraḥ || 8-17 ||
antaryāmī muniśchando gāyatrī nivṛdanvitā | devo lakṣmīgaṇeśo'trāyādyabījadvayena tu || 8-18 ||
ṣaḍdīrghayuktenāṅgāni jātiyuktāni kārayet |
atha dhyānam |
hemābhaṃ pītavasanaṃ cakraśaṅkharadābhayān || 8-19 ||
dakṣordhvakaramārabhya dakṣiṇādhaḥkarāvadhi | dadhataṃ śuṇḍayā svarṇaghaṭaṃ padmopari sthitam || 8-20 ||
vāmāṅkāviṣṭalakṣmyā cāśliṣṭaṃ dakṣabhujena ca |
asya puraścaraṇaṃ tatraivoktam |
lakṣaṃ japo hunedvilvasamidho madhuraplutāḥ || 8-21 ||
tarpaṇādi tataḥ kṛtvā kāmyakarmādi sādhayet | huneccatussahasrāṇi śrīphalirmadhurāplutaiḥ || 8-22 ||
mahālakṣmīkaro homaḥ putramitrakalatradaḥ |
atha śaktigaṇeśamantrastantrāntare |
pañcāntako vahnisaṃstho vāmanetrārdhacandravān || 8-23 ||
māyāsaṃpuṭitastryarṇo mantraḥ śaktigaṇeśituḥ |
(merutantre)
akṣaro'yaṃ virāṭ chando munirbhārgava īritaḥ || 8-24 ||
devatā śaktigaṇapaḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret | ṣaḍdīrghayuggakāreṇa tato dhyāyedgajānanam || 8-25 ||
dhyānaṃ yathā (-)
dakṣordhve cāṅkuśaṃ vāme pāśaṃ vāme tvadhaḥkare | bījapūraṃ svadantaṃ tu dakṣiṇe svarṇavarṇakam || 8-26 ||
puṣkare modakaṃ bibhrat karṇayordīrghacāmare |
asya mantrasya puraścaraṇaṃ tatraivoktam |
lakṣamekaṃ japenmantraṃ haviṣyāśī jitendriyaḥ || 8-27 ||
taddaśāṃśaṃ prajuhuyādapūpairghṛtasaṃplutaiḥ | evaṃ siddhamanurmantrī kāmyakarmāṇi sādhayet || 8-28 ||
atha kṣipraprasādanagaṇeśamantro (nibandhe)
saṃvarttako netrayutaḥ pārśvo vahnyāsane sthitaḥ | prasādanāya hṛnmantraḥ svabījāḍhyo daśākṣaraḥ || 8-29 ||
(merutantre)
ṛṣirgaṇaka ākhyātaśchandaḥ proktaṃ virāḍiti | devatā kathitaḥ kṣipraprasādanavināyakaḥ || 8-30 ||
ṣaḍdīrghabhājā bījena kuryādaṅgakriyāṃ manoḥ || 8-30ef ||
atha dhyānaṃ (śāradāyām)
pāśāṅkuśau kalpalatāṃ viṣāṇaṃ dadhat sutuṇḍāhitabījapūraḥ | raktastrinetrastaruṇendumauli (-) rhārojjvalo hastimukho'vatādvaḥ || 8-31 ||
asya puraścaraṇaṃ (merutantre)
lakṣamekaṃ japenmantraṃ trisvādvaktaistilairhunet | pūrvoditāṣṭadravyairvā tarpaṇādi tataścaret || 8-32 ||
atha vakratuṇḍamantrastatraiva |
vakratuṇḍāya hu(/) ceti prokto mantraḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ | hrasvaṃ tu kavacaṃ strībhirjaptavyaṃ sarvasiddhidam || 8-33 ||
bhārgavo munirākhyāto'nuṣṭupchanda udāhṛtam | devatā vakratuṇḍo'sya surāsuranamaskṛtaḥ || 8-34 ||
ṣaḍbhirmantragatairvarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni prakalpayet |
atha dhyānam |
udyaddineśvararuciṃ pāśāṅkuśavarābhayān || 8-35 ||
hastairdadhānaṃ smerāsyamaruṇaṃ cintayeddhṛdi |
puraścaraṇamāha
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ juyāt taddaśāṃśataḥ || 8-36 ||
aṣṭadravyaiḥ purā proktairmadhurāktairyathāvidhi |
atha herambamantraḥ (śāradāyām)
pañcāntako vinduyuto vāmakarṇavibhūṣitaḥ || 8-37 ||
tārādihṛdayānto'yaṃ herambamanurīritaḥ | caturvarṇātmako nṝṇāṃ caturvargaphalapradaḥ || 8-38 ||
(merutantre)
munirgaṇāka ākhyāto gāyatrī chanda īritam | pañcavaktro'sya herambo devatā siṃhavāhanaḥ || 8-39 ||
ṣaḍdīrghabījayuktena ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ || 8-39ef ||
dhyāna tu (śāradāyām)
muktākāñcananīlakundaghusṛṇacchāyaistrinetrānvitai(-) rnāgāsyairharivāhanaṃ śaśadharaṃ herambamarkaprabham | dṛptaṃ dānamabhītimodakaradān ṭaṅkaṃ śiro'kṣātmikāṃ mālāṃ mudgaramaṅkuśaṃ triśikhakaṃ dorbhirdhānaṃ bhaje || 8-40 ||
asya puraścaraṇamuktaṃ (merutantre)
lakṣatrayaṃ japitvā taṃ tilairhutvā daśāṃśataḥ | madhuratrayasaṃyuktaistarpaṇādi samācaret || 8-41 ||
evaṃ siddhamanurmantrī prayogānācaret tataḥ |
atha haridrāgaṇeśamantrastantrāntare |
pañcāntako dharāsaṃstho vindubhūṣitamastakaḥ || 8-42 ||
ekākṣaro mahāmantraḥ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ |
yadvā mantrāntaram |
mantroddhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalānane || 8-43 ||
indrabījaṃ samuddhṛtya nijabījaṃ samuddharet | caturdaśasvareṇāṭyaṃ bindubhūṣitamastakam || 8-44 ||
ekākṣarī mahāvidyā kathitā padmayoninā | bījena dīrghayuktena karāṅganyāsakalpanā || 8-45 ||
mantrāntarāṇi vistarabhayādupekṣitāni | atha dhyānam |
haridrābhaṃ caturbāhuṃ hārītavasanaṃ vibhum || 8-46 ||
pāśāṅkuśadharaṃ devaṃ modakaṃ dantameva ca |
asya puraścaraṇamuktaṃ (merutantre)
vedalakṣaṃ japitvā'nte haridrācūrṇamiśritaiḥ || 8-47 ||
daśāṃśaṃ taṇḍulairhutvā brāhmaṇānapi bhojayet |
athamahāgaṇapatimantro (merutantre) |
ūrdhvāmnāye pravakṣyāmi gaṇeśān siddhidāyakān || 8-48 ||
bhuktimuktipradaṃ tatra mahāgaṇapatiṃ śṛṇu | tāraḥ śrībījahṛllekhā kāmo bhūbījameva ca || 8-49 ||
gaṇeśabījaṃ gaṇapataye varavareti ca | dasarvajanaṃ me vaśamānayāgnivadhūriti || 8-50 ||
aṣṭāviṃśativarṇo'yaṃ gaṇako'sya munirmataḥ | nivṛdgāyatrikā chando mahāgaṇapatiḥ suraḥ || 8-51 ||
ga(/) bījaṃ hrī(/) ca śaktiḥ syāddīrghaṣaṭkayutastu gaḥ | tārādibījaṣaṭkena pṛthagyuktena kārayet || 8-52 ||
ṣaḍaṅgāni manorasya jātiyuktānyathācaret | athavā tārapūrveṇa dīrghaṣaṭkayutena ca || 8-53 ||
svabījenāṅgulinyāsaṃ ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret |
atha dhyānam |
aikṣave jaladhau dvīpe navaratnamye śubhe || 8-54 ||
tattaraṅgalasartoyairdhaute śītamahītale | tattoyagaṇasaṃpṛktagandhāvāhaniṣevite || 8-55 ||
kalpapādapasaṃśobhibhūbhāge samalaṅkṛte | nānākusumasaṅkīrṇe nānāpakṣivirājite || 8-56 ||
anekaphalasaṃkīrṇe sevite cā'psarogaṇaiḥ | udyadbālātapajyotiścandrajyotsnāsamākule || 8-57 ||
vilasatpadmarāgaughakuṭṭimāruṇabhūtale | kalpapādapapuṣpasyaṣaṭpadasvanamañjule || 8-58 ||
pārijātaṃ kalpataruṃ tasya madhye vicintayet | yugapaṭṭatuṣaṭkena khacitaṃ puṣpaśobhitam || 8-59 ||
navaratnamayaṃ tasyādhastāt sihāsanaṃ smaret | tanmadhye lipipadmaṃ ca ṣaḍāraṃ tasya madhyataḥ || 8-60 ||
karṇikāyāṃ gaṇeśaṃ ca tatsaṃsthaṃ ca mahāgaṇam |
(śāradāyām)
ṣaṭkoṇāntastrikoṇasthaṃ mahāgaṇapatiṃ smaret || 8-61 ||
hastīndrānanaminducūḍamaruṇacchāyaṃ trinetraṃ rasā (-) śliṣṭaṃ svapriyayā supadmakarayā svāṅkasthayā santatam | bījāpūragadādhanustriśikhayukcakrājñapāśotpala (-) vrīhyagrasvaviṣāṇaratnakalaśān hastairvahantaṃ bhaje || 8-62 ||
gaṇḍapālīgaladdānapānalālasamānasān | dvirephān karṇatālābhyāṃ vārayantaṃ muhurmuhuḥ || 8-63 ||
karāgradhṛtamāṇikyakumbhavaktraviniḥsṛtaiḥ | ratnavarṣaiḥ prīṇayantaṃ sādhakān madavihvalam || 8-64 ||
māṇikyamukuṭopetaṃ ratnābharaṇabhūṣitam |
asya mantrasya puraścaraṇamuktaṃ (merutantre)
ekādaśāyutaṃ japtvā sahasrottaramādarāt || 8-65 ||
daśāṃśaṃ juhuyādaṣṭadravyairekākṣaroditaiḥ | tarpayitvā daśāṃśena cābhiṣikto'ṇunā tataḥ || 8-66 ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayet samyak ṣaḍrasairbhūridakṣiṇām | datvā praṇamya visṛjedevaṃ siddho bhavenmanuḥ || 8-67 ||
(śāradāyāṃ tu)
dhyāyenmantraṃ japen mantrī caturlakṣaṃ samāhitaḥ |
catussahasrasaṃyuktaṃ catvāriṃśatsahasrakam (-) ityuktam ||
atha viriñcigaṇanāyakamantro (merutantre)
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi pūrvāmnāyagaṇeśvarān || 8-68 ||
virañcivighneśamuktā (-)
athānyat saṃpravakṣyāmi brahmaṇā samupāsitam | kāśyāṃ brahmeśasaumyasthaṃ viriñcigaṇanāyakam || 8-69 ||
hrī(/) viriñcipadaṃ proktvā ṅe'ntaṃ gaṇapatiṃ tataḥ | prāgvadvaravaretyādi ṣaḍviṃśatyakṣaro manuḥ || 8-70 ||
vedapañceṣupañceṣudvyarṇairuktaṃ ṣaḍaṅgakam |
tathā (-)
asya dhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi hyurdhvamūrdhvakareṣu ca || 8-71 ||
bījapūraṃ gadāṃ cāpaṃ cakraṃ mālāṃ ca dakṣiṇe | vāme padmaṃ pāśabāṇān dantaṃ ratnāḍhyakumbhakam || 8-72 ||
padmadvayakarāṃ puṣṭimaṅkasthāmaruṇaprabhām | āliṅgayantamaruṇaṃ sravanmadakapolakam || 8-73 ||
trinetraṃ pītavasanaṃ dṛḍhamutthāpitadhvajam | kirīṭinaṃ kuṇḍalinaṃ dhyāyeddevaṃ gajānanam || 8-74 ||
asya puraścaraṇam |
vedalakṣamitā proktā sarveṣāṃ tu puraskriyā | madhuratrayasaṃyuktaiḥ pūrvoktairaṣṭabhirhunet || 8-76 ||
sarveṣāmiti | atra vistarabhayādupekṣitānāṃ viriñcivighneśādimantrāṇām | atha vighnagaṇeśamantrastatraiva |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi paścimāmnāyasiddhidān | nānāścaryakarān kāśīsaṃsthitān gaṇanāyakān || 8-77 ||
mahāgaṇapateraṃśāścatuḥṣaṣṭivināyakāḥ | ekaikānte gṛhītvā tu yoginīṃ ceṭikāmapi || 8-78 ||
svarṇabhūmiṃ samāsādya yāvadantargṛhaṃ mama | aṣṭāvaraṇakairaṣṭau saṃsthitāḥ siddhidāyakāḥ || 8-79 ||
tatrāṣṭau kāśikābāhye svargabhūmau samāsthitāḥ | yojanaikaṃ bahiḥ kāśyāṃ kīrttitaḥ paridhistu saḥ || 8-80 ||
ga(/) vighnāya namaḥ prokto mantra eva ṣaḍakṣaraḥ | kṣipraprasādanasamamaṣṭānāṃ sādhanaṃ smṛtam || 8-81 ||
puraścaraṇe viśeṣamāha tatraiva |
vedāyutaṃ japenmantraṃ homaśca ghṛtapāyasai | prayogāḥ kṣipramevātra kṣiprameva ca siddhayaḥ || 8-82 ||
athocchiṣṭagaṇeśamantrastatraiva |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi uttarāmnāyasiddhidān | vadeddhastipiśācīti likhet svāhā navākṣaraḥ || 8-83 ||
kaṅkālo'sya muniścchando virāḍucchiṣṭanāmakaḥ | gaṇeśo devatā proktaḥ sarvasaṃpatpradāyakaḥ || 8-84 ||
dvitridvidvidvibhiścāsya pañcāṅgavidhirīritaḥ |
asya dhyānaṃ tantrāntare |
raktamūrtiṃ gaṇeśānaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam || 8-85 ||
raktavastraṃ trinetraṃ ca raktapadmāsanasthitam | caturbhujaṃ mahākāyaṃ dvidantaṃ sasmitānanam || 8-86 ||
iṣṭaṃ ca dakṣiṇe vāme dadhantamabhayaṃ kare | pāśāṅkuśau ca hastābhyāṃ jaṭāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitam || 8-87 ||
lalāṭaṃ candrerekhāḍhyaṃ sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitam | sarvābhīṣṭapradaṃ dhyāyeducchiṣṭagaṇanāyakam || 8-88 ||
asya puraścaraṇaṃ (merau)
navalakṣaṃ japaḥ proktaḥ kāmyakarmāṇyatha bruve |
mantrāntaramāha tatraiva |
athānyamasya vakṣyāmi dvādaśārṇaṃ mahāmanum || 8-89 ||
oṃ hrī(/) ga(/) hastipiśāci likhet svāheti mantrakaḥ | navārṇamantravat sarvaṃ dhyānapūjājapādikam || 8-90 ||
puraścaraṇāmāha |
puraścaryā'rkalakṣaṃ syāt prayogādi ca pūrvavat |
iti gaṇeśaprakaraṇam |
atha sūryamantraḥ |
(śāradāyām)
tāro ghṛṇirbhṛguḥ paścādvāmakarṇavibhūṣitaḥ || 8-91 ||
vahnyāsano maruccheṣaḥ sanetro'dristya paścimaḥ | aṣṭākṣaro manuḥ prokto bhānorabhimatapradaḥ || 8-92 ||
devabhāgo muniḥ prokto gāyatrī chanda īritam | ādityo devatā prokto dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalapradaḥ || 8-93 ||
satyāya hṛdayaṃ proktaṃ brahmaṇe śira īritam | viṣṇave syācchikhā varma rudrāya parikīrtitam || 8-94 ||
agnaye netramākhyātaṃ sarvāyāstramudāhṛtam | tejo jvālā maṇiṃ hu(/) phaṭ dviṭhāntāḥ pṛthagīritāḥ || 8-95 ||
nyāsāntarāṇi tatraiva draṣṭavyāni | atha dhyānaṃ |
raktābjayugmābhayadānahastaṃ keyurahārāṅgadakuṇḍalāḍhyam | maṇikyamauliṃ dinanāthamīḍe bandhūkakāntiṃ vilasattritrenatram || 8-96 ||
asya puraścaraṇaṃ tatraivoktam |
vasulakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ samidbhiḥ kṣīraśākhinām | tatsahasraṃ prajuhuyāt kṣīrāktābhirjitendriyaḥ || 8-97 ||
atha mantrātaraṃ tatraiva |
ākāśamagnidīrghandusaṃyutaṃ bhuvaneśvarī | sargānvito ghṛgurbhānostryakṣaro manurīritaḥ || 8-98 ||
ādhārādipadāgrāntaṃ kaṇṭhādādhārakāvadhi | mūrdhādikaṇṭhaparyantaṃ kramādbījatrayaṃ nyaset || 8-99 ||
ṣaḍdīrghasvarayuktena madhyenāṅgāni kalpayet || 8-99ef ||
atha dhyānam |
raktāmbujāsanamaśeṣaguṇaikasindhuṃ bhānuṃ samastajagatāmadhipaṃ bhajāmi | padmadvayābhayavarān dadhataṃ karābjai (-) rmākyamaulimaruṇāṅgaruciṃ trinetram || 8-100 ||
athāsya puraścaraṇam |
bhānulakṣaṃ japenmantramannājyena daśāṃśataḥ | tilairvā madhurāsiktairjuhuyādvijitendriyaḥ || 8-101 ||
(merutantre)
atha mantrāntaraṃ vakṣye dinaśasya ṣaḍakṣaram | ha(/) kha(/) khakholkāya vā'tha khakholkāyāgnigehinī || 8-102 ||
munirbrahmā ca gāyatrī chandaḥ savitṛdaivatam | sūkṣmarūpāyāgnivadhūmantreṇa hṛdayaṃ matam || 8-103 ||
sūkṣmākārāyāgnivadhūriti mantreṇa śīrṣakam | sūkṣmabālāya svāheti kavacaṃ ca sanetrakam || 8-104 ||
sūkṣmakāya hu(/) phaḍiti śastaṃ pañcāṅgamīritam | mantravarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ syāddhyānamasyocyate'dhunā || 8-105 ||
raktapadmadvayaṃ hastairvibhrāṇaṃ varadābhaye | bandhūkābhaṃ trinetraṃ ca raviṃ dhyāyet subhūṣitam || 8-106 ||
athāsya puraścaraṇaṃ tatraiva |
lakṣamekaṃ japenmantraṃ niyatātmā jitendriyaḥ | juhuyāt taddaśāṃśena vilvāśvatthapalāśajaiḥ || 8-107 ||
udumbarasamudbhūtaistrimadhvaktaiḥ samidvaraiḥ | tarpaṇādi tataḥ kuryāt prākproktavidhinā sudhīḥ || 8-108 ||
atha mantrāntaraṃ (śāradāyām)
viyadardhendulasitaṃ tadādiḥ sargasaṃyutaḥ | ajapākhyo manuḥ prokto dvyakṣaraḥ surapādapaḥ || 8-109 ||
ṛṣirbrahmā smṛto devī gāyatrī chanda iritam | devatā jagatāmādiḥ saṃprokto girijāpatiḥ || 8-110 ||
hasā ṣaḍdīrghayuktena kuryādaṅgakriyāṃ manoḥ || 8-110ef ||
dhyānam |
udyadbhānusphuritataḍidākāramūrdhāmbikeśaṃ pāśābhītī varadaparaśū sandadhānaṃ karābjaiḥ | divyākalpairnavamaṇimayaiḥ śobhitaṃ viśvamūlaṃ saumyāgneyaṃ vapuravatu vaścandracūḍaṃ trinetram || 8-111 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
bhānulakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ pāyasena sasarpiṣā | daśāṃsaṃ juhuyāt samyak tataḥ siddho bhavenmunuḥ || 8-112 ||
atha mārttaṇḍabhairavamantrastatraiva |
ākāśamagnipavanasādyāntārghīśavindumat | mārttaṇḍabhairavaṃ nāma bījametadudāhṛtam || 8-113 ||
puṭitaṃ bimbabījena sarvakāmaphalapradam | ṭhāntaṃ dahananetrendusahitaṃ tadudāhṛtam || 8-114 ||
pañcahrasvādyabījena pañcamūrtīḥ pravinyaset | madhyamādikaniṣṭhāntamaṅgulīṣu kramādimāḥ || 8-115 ||
sūryākhyo bhāskaro bhānustato ravidivākarau | śirovadanahṛdguhyapādadeśeṣu tāḥ punaḥ || 8-116 ||
dīrghayuktena bījena netrāṅgāni pravinyaset | vyāpakaṃ mūlabījena kurvīta tadanantaram || 8-116 ||
dhyānam |
hemāmbhojapravālapratimanijaruciṃ cārukhaṭvāṅgapadmau cakraṃ śaktiṃsapāśaṃ śṛṇimatirucirāmakṣamālāṃ kapālam | hastāmbhojairdadhānaṃ trinayanavilasadvedavaktrābhirāmaṃ mārttaṇḍaṃ vallabhārghaṃ maṇimayamukuṭaṃ hāradīptaṃ bhajāmaḥ || 8-117 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
lakṣatrayaṃ japenmantrī bījaṃ vimbapuṭīkṛtam | daśāṃśaṃ kamalaiḥ phullairjuhuyānmadhurokṣitaiḥ || 8-118 ||
iti sūryaprakaraṇam |
atha viṣṇumantrāḥ |
(śāradāyām)
atha vakṣye mahāmantrān viṣṇoḥ sarvārthasādhakān | yeṣāṃ saṃsmaraṇāt santo bhavābdheḥ pāramāśritāḥ || 8-119 ||
tāraṃ namaḥpadaṃ paścānnarau dīrghasamanvitau | pavano ṇāyamantro'yaṃ prokto vasvakṣarātmakaḥ || 8-120 ||
sādhyo nārāyaṇaḥ prokto muniśchanda udāhṛtam | mantrasya devī gāyatrī devatā viṣṇuravyayaḥ || 8-121 ||
kruddholkāya hṛdākhyātaṃ maholkāya śiraḥ smṛtam | vīrolkāya śikhā proktā vyulkāya kavacaṃ matam || 8-122 ||
sahasroklāyāstramuktamaṅgakḷptiriyaṃ matā | bhūyovarṇairmanoḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret || 8-123 ||
avaśiṣṭu punarvarṇau vinyaset kukṣipṛṣṭhayoḥ || 8-123ef ||
atha dhyānam |
udyatkoṭidivākarābhamaniśaṃ śaṅkhaṃ gadāṃ paṅkajaṃ cakraṃ bibhratamindirāvasumatīsaṃśobhi pārśvadvayam | koṭīrāṅgadahārakuṇḍaladharaṃ pītāmbaraṃ kaustubho (-) ddīptaṃ viśvadharaṃ svavakṣasi lasacchrīvatsacihnaṃ bhaje || 8-124 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
vikāralakṣaṃ prajapenmanumenaṃ samāhitaḥ | taddaśāṃśaṃ sarasijairjuhuyānmadhurāplutaiḥ || 8-125 ||
vikāralakṣaṃ ṣoḍaśalakṣam | atha mantrāntaraṃ tatraiva |
praṇavo hṛdbhagavate vāsudevāya kīrttitaḥ | pradhānaṃ vaiṣṇave tantre mantro'yaṃ dvādaśākṣaraḥ || 8-126 ||
ṛṣiḥ prajāpatiśchando gāyatrī parikīrtitā | devatā'sya manoḥ prokto vāsudevo manīṣibhiḥ || 8-127 ||
tāreṇa hṛdayaṃ proktaṃ namasā śira īritam | caturvarṇaiḥ śikhā proktā pañcārṇaiḥ kavacaṃ matam || 8-128 ||
samastena bhavedastramaṅgakalpanamīritam || 8-128ef ||
atha dhyānam |
viṣṇuṃ śāradacandrakoṭisadṛśaṃ śaṅkhaṃ rathāṅgaṃ gadā (-) mambhojaṃ dadhataṃ sitābjanilayaṃ kāntyā jaganmohanam | ābaddhāṅgadahārakuṇḍalamahāmauliṃ sphuratkaṅkaṇaṃ śrīvatsāṅkamudārakaustubhadharaṃ vande munīndraiḥ stutam || 8-129 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ dīkṣito vijitendriyaḥ | tatsahasraṃ prajuhuyāt tilairājyapariplutaiḥ || 8-130 ||
atha lakṣmīvāsudevamantrastatraiva |
hṛllekhābījayugalaṃ ramābījayugaṃ tataḥ | lakṣmyante vāsudevāya hṛdantaḥ praṇavādikaḥ || 8-131 ||
caturdaśākṣaraiḥ prokto mantro'yaṃ surapadayaḥ | hṛdayaṃ śaktibījābhyāṃ ramābhyāṃ śira īritam || 8-132 ||
lakṣmyā proktā śikhā varma vāsudevāya īritam | namaḥ sāstraṃ samādiṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ tārādi kalpayet || 8-133 ||
dhyānam |
vidyuccandranibhaṃ vapuḥ kamalajāvaikuṇṭhayorekatāṃ prāptaṃ snehavaśena ratnavilasadbhūṣābharālaṅkṛtam | vidyāpaṅkajadarpaṇān maṇimayaṃ kumbhaṃ sarojaṃ gadāṃ śaṅkhaṃ cakramamūni vibhradamitāṃ diśyācchriyaṃ vaḥ sadā || 8-134 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ tatsahasraṃ saroruhaiḥ | homaṃ kuryādvikasitairmadhuratrayasaṃyutaiḥ || 8-135 ||
pūjā syādvaiṣṇave pīṭhe dvādaśākṣaravartmanā | pāyasena kṛto homo lakṣmīvaśyapradāyakaḥ || 8-136 ||
madhurāktaistilairhutvā sarvakāryāṇi sādhayet |
(viṣvaksenyām)
atha mantrāntaraṃ vakṣye viṣṇoḥ sarvārthasādhakam || 8-137 ||
ṅe'ntaṃ viṣṇuṃ samuddhṛtya hṛdayaṃ bāṇavarṇakaḥ | bhavābdheḥ setubhūto'yamavyaktādyaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ || 8-138 ||
avyaktaḥ praṇavaḥ |
nārado'sya muniśchando gāyatrī viṣṇuravyayaḥ | devatā mantravarṇaistu ṣaḍaṅgāni prakalpayet || 8-139 ||
dhyānam |
śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ lakṣmīsamāvṛtam | pītāmbaraṃ ghanaśyāmaṃ dhyāyedviṣṇuṃ sanātanam || 8-140 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ trimadhvaktaistilairhunet | tarpaṇādi tataḥ kuryādevaṃ siddho bhavenmanuḥ || 8-141 ||
atha matsyamantro (merutantre)
eka evābhavanmatsyāvatāraḥ kalpa ādime | tasya mantraṃ pravakṣyāmi bhuktimuktipradāyakam || 8-142 ||
tāro namo bhagavate ma(/) matsyāya ramāṃ vadet | dvādaśākṣaramantro'yaṃ munirbrahmā samīritaḥ || 8-143 ||
gāyatrī chanda uddiṣṭaṃ devatā mīnavigrahaḥ | bhagavān sa ramānātho bījaṃ śrīma(/) ca kīlakam || 8-144 ||
mantrapadaiḥ karāṅganyāsau kāryau | atha dhyānam |
nābhyādho rohitasama ākaṇṭhaṃ ca narākṛtiḥ | ghanaśyāmaścaturbāhuḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ || 8-145 ||
śṛṅgīmatsyanibho mūrdhā lakṣmīvakṣovirājitaḥ | padmacihnitasarvāṅgaḥ sundaraścārulocanaḥ || 8-146 ||
puraścaraṇamāha |
japeddvādaśasāhasraṃ trimadhvaktaistilairhunet | pratyahaṃ taddaśāṃśena vaiśākhe kārtike tathā || 8-147 ||
māghe ca mārgaśīrṣe ca haviṣyāśī jitendriyaḥ | ārabhya bhādrābahulamaṣṭamīṣoḍaśāhakam || 8-148 ||
lakṣmīmanuṃ japennityamidaṃ cāpi kalāśatam | tathaiva homaḥ karttavyastathā'nyadivaseṣu tu || 8-149 ||
tarpayeddvādaśaśataṃ tilataṇḍulacandanaiḥ | ādyantayoḥ śataṃ cāṣṭau tarpayecca tathā śriyam || 8-150 ||
raktotpalairvā padmairvā mālatyādyaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ | evaṃ kṛte varṣamekaṃ mantrasiddhiḥ prajāyate || 8-151 ||
nityaṃ dvādaśaviprā(/)śca śrīrūpāṃ ca suvāsinīm | bhojayet pūjanaṃ cāsya caret toyāśaye sadā || 8-152 ||
tathā (-)
evaṃ siddha manurmantrī jāyate siddhibhājanam | etadyuktaṃ śataṃ mantraṃ japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 8-153 ||
taddevatādine siddhaḥ pustakādeva jāyate | akuṇṭhitaprayogeṣu na punastasya saṃskṛtiḥ || 8-154 ||
etatpallavitā mantrā mama sidhyanti pārvati | etatsaṃpuṭitāḥ sarve vaidikāḥ siddhidāḥ kalau || 8-155 ||
anena grathitā japtāḥ kaule syurdrutasiddhidāḥ | gāṇeśā vaiṣṇavāḥ saurāḥ siddhiṃ dadyurvidarbhitāḥ || 8-156 ||
yadbalāt sarvamantrāṇāṃ svayaṃ siddhiḥ prajāyate | tasmānnokto nānyatantre merutantre prakāśitaḥ || 8-157 ||
atha kūrmamantrastatraiva |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi kūrmamantraṃ mahādbhutam | ekaḥ kūrmāvatāro'bhūnmadhyamāne mahodadhau || 8-158 ||
tāro namo bhagavate ku(/) kūrmāya dharādhara | dhurandharāya ṇasyānte siddhavarṇo mato manuḥ || 8-159 ||
prakṛtiśchanda uditaṃ kaśyarpo'sya munirmataḥ | devatā bhagavān viṣṇurmataḥ kacchaparūpadhṛk || 8-160 ||
dharādharetyādiśaktiḥ ku(/) bījaṃ sveṣṭasiddhaye | niyogo devatā dhyānaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam || 8-161 ||
pītāmbaraṃ kūrmapṛṣṭhaṃ nyastalāṅgūlaśobhitam | dīrghagrīvaṃ mahāgrāhaṃ gilantaṃ raktalocanam || 8-162 ||
mantravarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni japo lakṣacatuṣṭayam | ājyahomastarpaṇaṃ tu candanotpalavāribhiḥ || 8-163 ||
atha varāhamantrastraiva |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi varāhasya manūn śubhān | kalpe jātāścaturvarṇā avatārā ramāpateḥ || 8-164 ||
tāro namo bhagavate varāheti ca saṃvadet | rūpāya bhūrbhuvaḥ suvaḥ pataye bhūpatīti ca || 8-165 ||
tvaṃ me dehi dāpayeti svāhāntaḥ suravarṇakaḥ |
(śāradāyām)
bhārgavo munirākhyātaśchando'nuṣṭubudāhṛtam || 8-166 ||
devatā'divarāho'sya mantrasya kathito budhaiḥ | ekadaṃṣṭrāya hṛdayaṃ vyomolkāya śiraḥ smṛtam || 8-167 ||
śikhā tejo'dhipataye viśvarūpāya varma ca | mahādaṃṣṭrāya astraṃ syāt pañcāṅgamiti kalpayet || 8-168 ||
atha dhyānam |
āpādaṃ jānudeśādvarakanakanibhaṃ nābhideśādadhastān(-) muktābhaṃ kaṇṭhadeśāt taruṇaravinibhaṃ mastakānnīlabhāsam | īḍe hastairdadhānaṃ rathacaraṇadarau khaḍgakheṭau gadākhyāṃ śaktiṃ dānābhaye ca kṣitidharaṇalasaddaṃṣṭramādyaṃ varāham || 8-169 ||
asya puraścaraṇaṃ tatraiva |
lakṣamekaṃ japenmantraṃ madhurāktaiḥ saroruhaiḥ | juhuyāt taddaśāṃśena pīṭhe viṣṇoḥ prapūjayet || 8-170 ||
atha mantrāntarāṇi (merutantre)
athānyaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi varāhāṣṭākṣaraṃ param | oṃ bhūrvarāhāya namo munirbrahmā samīritaḥ || 8-171 ||
jagatī chanda uddiṣṭaṃ varāho devatā smṛtaḥ | padaiḥ samastamantreṇa pañcāṅgāni prakalpayet || 8-172 ||
dhyānam |
kṛṣṇāṅgaṃ nīlavaktraṃ ca malinaṃ padmasaṃsthitam | pṛthvīśaktiyutaṃ dhyāyecchaṅkhaṃ cakrāmbujaṃ gadām || 8-173 ||
bhūlakṣmīkāntiratibhiḥ samantāt parivāritam | varmāsivadbhiśca kalau drutasiddhipradāyakam || 8-174 ||
japapūjādikaṃ sarvamasya pūrvavadācaret | etaṃ manuṃ yaḥ prabhajet sa bhavecca dharāpatiḥ || 8-175 ||
imityekākṣaro mantro varāhasya prakīrttitaḥ | hayagrīvo muniḥ proktaśchando'nuṣṭup ca devatā || 8-176 ||
varāho dīrghayuktena bījenaivāṅgakalpanam | prāgvaddhyāyedraktavarṇaṃ pūjādyaṃ pūrvavadbhavet || 8-177 ||
bhūrityekākṣaraṃ bījaṃ sarvaṃ prāgvat samīritam | pītavarṇaṃ sadā dhyāyeddvāpare drutasiddhidam || 8-178 ||
atha dharaṇīmantraḥ (śāradāyām)
hṛdayaṃ bhagavatyai syādharaṇyai tadanantaram | dharaṇyante dharedvandvaṃ dviṭhānto'yaṃ dhruvādikaḥ || 8-179 ||
ekonaviṃśatyarṇāḍhyaṃ dharāhṛdayamīritam | varāho'sya muniḥ proktaścchando nivṛdudāhṛtam || 8-180 ||
devatā sarvabhūtānāṃ prakṛtirvasudhā matā | hṛdayaṃ tribhirākhyātaṃ caturbhiḥ śira īritam || 8-181 ||
tribhiḥ śikhā samuddiṣṭāpañcabhiḥ kavacaṃ matam | dvābhyāṃ netraṃ samākhyātaṃ dvābhyāmastraṃ punarbhavet || 8-182 ||
mantravarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni kuryādevaṃ vidhānavit || 8-182ef ||
dhyānam |
śyāmāṃ vicitrāṃśukaratnabhūṣaṇāṃ padmāsanāṃ tuṅgapayodharānanām | indīvaraṃ dve navaśālimañjarīṃ śukaṃ dhānāṃ vasudhāṃ bhajāmaḥ || 8-183 ||
puraścaraṇamāha |
lakṣamenaṃ japenmantrī dharāhṛdayamādarāt | sasarpiṣā pāyasena juhuyāt taddaśāṃśataḥ || 8-184 ||
tāṃ viṣṇoḥ pūjayet pīṭhe vakṣyamāṇavidhānataḥ | sa japati jagatāṃ nāthaḥ karuṇāvaruṇālayo nṛhariḥ || 8-185 ||
śaraṇīkṛtayaccaraṇā bhavajaladhiṃ tulayanti goppadena | atha dustarasaṃsārasāgarottārasetavaḥ || 8-186 ||
caturṇāṃ puruṣārthānāmasādhāraṇahetavaḥ | ucyante candracūḍena tantreṣu prakaṭīkṛtāḥ || 8-187 ||
mantrāḥ śrīdivyasiṃhasya brahmādyaiḥ samupāsitāḥ |
(merutantre)
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi nṛsiṃhasya manūn śubhām || 8-188 ||
pratimanvantaraṃ cā'yamavatāro harerbhavet | dvīpāntare nṛsiṃhastu caturdaśasu mūrttiṣu || 8-189 ||
ākalpaṃ vasate tatra bhaktānugrahakārakaḥ | ādimanvantare jāto nṛsiṃho vakṣyate'dhunā || 8-190 ||
dvātriṃśadvarṇako gopyo bhuktimuktiprado yataḥ |
(vaiṣvaksenyāṃ) brahmanāradasaṃvāde |
mantrarājaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvābahito mune || 8-191 ||
yatprasādādavikalaṃ sṛjāmi sakalaṃ jagat | ādau viṣṇuṃ samuddhṛtya śārṅgiṇaṃ balisaṃsthitam || 8-192 ||
pradyumnasahitaṃ paścāduddharedbhūmibālakam | sagovindaṃ tataḥ prītiyuktaṃ balinamuddharet || 8-193 ||
vaikuṇṭhānte varāhaṃ ca nārāyaṇasamanvitam | samādhavavṛṣaghnākhyaṃ vṛṣaṃ narakajidgatam || 8-194 ||
śaṅkarṣaṇāntamadhusūdanādibhyāṃ samanvitam | bālasthaṃ ca muśalyantamuddharecca balānujam || 8-195 ||
vīrabhāganiruddhādyasaṃyutaṃ harimuddharet | haṃsānte balinā'krāntaṃ bhūdharaṃ ca tato harim || 8-196 ||
vāsudevānvitaṃ viśvamūrttyantaṃ viṣṇusaṃyutam | sāniruddhaṃ ca gadinaṃ śūlāḍhyaṃ satrivikramam || 8-197 ||
bindumādhavasaṃyuktaṃ haṃsahaṃsāntamindukam | govindayugviśvamūrtiṃ vṛṣaharyādyamindukam || 8-198 ||
bhūdharāntaṃ tataḥ satyaṃ baliṃ pradyamnasaṃyutam | sadhāmenādyaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ hariṃ sapuruṣottamam || 8-199 ||
saviṣṇumetadubhayaṃ dviruddhṛtyāntime śiraḥ | dadyāt tataḥ sāttvatāntaṃ puruṣottamapūrvajam || 8-200 ||
sakeśavāntyamuddhṛtya vaikuṇṭhapuruṣottamau | yoginau viśvamūrteśca daśamaṃ sendumuddharet || 8-201 ||
dvātriṃśadakṣarātmā'yaṃ mantrarājaḥ suradrumaḥ | dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ bījabhūto'yamadbhutaḥ || 8-202 ||
adyastūlaughadahano bhavatīti vināśanaḥ | yanmahāvaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma parabrahmeti gīyate || 8-203 ||
svaprakāśaṃ jagadvyāpi saccidānandalakṣaṇam | tadeva tvaṃ vijānīhi mantrarūpamidaṃ mune || 8-204 ||
na nṛsiṃhāt paro devo naitanmatrāt paro manuḥ | na taddhyānāt paraṃ dhyānaṃ saṃsārabhayanāśanam || 8-205 ||
bhagavadbhaktitattvajñairupāsyo'yaṃ mahāmanuḥ | na prakāśyastvayā vatsa devānāmapi durlabhaḥ || 8-206 ||
anekamantrakoṭīnāṃ cūḍāmaṇirayaṃ manuḥ | yathā nṛsiṃho bhagavān devatānāṃ śiromaṇiḥ || 8-207 ||
yannāmasmaraṇādeva na punarjāyate bhavaḥ | kiṃ punaḥ śraddhayā bhaktyā bhajatāṃ tatpadāmbujam || 8-208 ||
sakṛduccaritaṃ yena nṛsiṃhetyakṣaratrayam | dharmarājabhaṭaistasya kimartha dṛśyate mukham ||| 8-209 ||
caturṇāmapi vedānāṃ sārāṃśastveka eva hi | nṛsiṃheti nṛsiṃheti nṛsiṃheti ca kīrttanam || 8-210 ||
(merutantre)
lobhādhikyāt kaliyuge na gururna ca devatā | ekaṃ śreyaskaraṃ proktaṃ nṛharernāmagarjanam || 8-211 ||
(saṃhitāyām)
athoktamantrarājasya ṛṣyādīn śṛṇu nārada | ṛṣirbrahmā'hamuddiṣṭaśchando'nuṣṭubudāhṛtam || 8-212 ||
devatā śrīnṛsiṃho'sya devadevo jagadguruḥ | dhruvamāye bījaśaktī nārasiṃhastu kīlakam || 8-213 ||
udāttastu svaraḥ prokto varṇaḥ śukla udāhṛtaḥ | dharmāthakāmamokṣārthe viniyogaḥ prakīrttitaḥ || 8-214 ||
(merutantre)
vedavedāṣṭaṣaṭṣaṭkaṃ vedārṇaiḥ syāt ṣaḍaṅgakam |
atha dhyānam (saṃhitāyām)
kṣīrārṇave sitadvīpe kalpavṛkṣavanaṃ smaret || 8-215 ||
nānāpuṣpaphalākīrṇaṃ muktāratnaughavarṣaṇam | vikasadbālamandārapuṣpāmodamanoharam || 8-216 ||
kusumāntarmadhusvādamanālikulasaṃkulam | kokilālāpamukharaṃ nānāpakṣigaṇānvitam || 8-217 ||
ṛtuṣaṭkena yugapat sevyamānaṃ sukhāspadam | utphullāmbujakahlārakumudotpalaśālibhiḥ || 8-218 ||
haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇaiḥ sarobhirupaśibhitam | tasya madhye sphuraddīpti cintadyenmaṇimaṇḍapam || 8-219 ||
tadantaḥpadmarāgaughakuṭṭimāraktabhūtale | nānāratnaprabhodbhāsisvarṇasiṃhāsanopari || 8-220 ||
bhogīndrabhogatalpe ca padmamaṣṭadalaṃ smaret | tatkarṇikāsamāsīnaṃ śrīnṛsiṃhaṃ vicintayet || 8-221 ||
candrakoṭipratīkāśaṃ bhāsvatpītāmbarāvṛtam | jvalatkālānalaprakhyajvālāmālidurāsadam || 8-222 ||
cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ cāpaṃ sabāṇaṃ varamudrikām | abhayākhyāṃ tathā mudrāṃ nijabhakteṣu sārthikām || 8-223 ||
dhārayantaṃ mahābāhuṃ caturbhiḥ karapallavaiḥ | somasūryāgninayanamīṣaddhyānānanāmbujam || 8-224 ||
sphuratsaudāminījihvaṃ daṃsṭrādbhutamukhāmbujam | taptacāmīkaraprakhyajaṭāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitam || 8-225 ||
haimaṃ kirīṭaṃ bibhrāṇaṃ bhāsvanmaṇigaṇojjvalam | śrīvatsakaustubhoraskaṃ sphuranmakarakuṇḍalam || 8-226 ||
yogapaṭṭapinaddhāṅgaṃ vanamālāvirājitam | hārakeyūramañjīrasphuratkāñcīguṇādibhiḥ || 8-227 ||
bhūṣitaṃ bhūṣaṇairdivyairnānāratnopakalpitaiḥ | jvalanmaṇiśikhādīptaphaṇīndraphaṇapaṅktibhiḥ || 8-228 ||
kṛtacchatraṃ svatejobhirbhāsayantaṃ diśo daśa | kalpāntakāladahanajvālajālaviḍambibhiḥ || 8-229 ||
lalāṭanayanajvālairdurnirīkṣye surairapi | svavāmāṅkagatāṃ lakṣmīṃ taptajāmbunadaprabhām || 8-230 ||
śuddhakṣaumaparīdhānāṃ nānālaṅkārabhūṣitām | varābhayaṃ padmayugmaṃ bibhrāṇāṃ karapaṅkajaiḥ || 8-231 ||
śaratpūrṇenduvadanāṃ mandasmitamukhāmbujām | āślipyantaṃ kṛtāśleṣāmānandotphullalocanām || 8-232 ||
bhāratyā dakṣiṇe deśe stūyamānaṃ hi sarvadā | śaṅkhacakragadāpadmavāribhirvanamālibhiḥ || 8-233 ||
indranīlanibhairvīraiḥ pārṣadaiḥ parito vṛtam | brahmādibhiḥ suragaṇaiḥ sanakādyairmaharṣibhiḥ || 8-234 ||
yogibhiḥ siddhagandharvairapsarobhiśca sevitam | atiprasannavadanaṃ bhaktābhīṣṭavarapradam || 8-235 ||
evaṃvidhamanirdeśyamavāṅmanasagocaram | divyasiṃhaṃ hṛdiṃ dhyāyet paramātmānamacyutam || 8-236 ||
evaṃ dhyātvā mahāviṣṇuṃ divyakeśariṇaṃ vibhum | karmabandhādvinirmuktaḥ prāpnuyādvaiṣṇavīṃ tanum || 8-237 ||
sāndrānandamayaṃ śāntaṃ nityavijñānavigraham | hṛtpadme nṛhariṃ dhyātvā sākṣānnārāyaṇo bhavet || 8-238 ||
