ādiṣoḍaśacakrasthamathavā binduvarjitam | anādimaparicchinnaṃ yogigamyamatīndriyam || 8-239 ||
parātparataraṃ nityaṃ nirupādhimanāvilam | svataḥprakāśaṃ jagataḥ sākṣībhūtaṃ nirañjanam || 8-240 ||
jyotirmayaṃ narahariṃ dhyātvā brahmamayo bhavet | athavā viśvamakhilaṃ bhāvayennṛharestanum || 8-241 ||
jīvanmukto bhavet sadyo nirādhirakutobhayaḥ || 8-241ef ||
dhyānāntaramuktaṃ (śāradāyām)
māṇikyādrisamaprabhaṃ nijarucā saṃtrastarakṣogaṇaṃ jānunyastakarāmbujaṃ trinayanaṃ ratnollasadbhūṣaṇam | bāhubhyāṃ dhṛtaśaṅkhacakramaniśaṃ daṃṣṭrogravaktrollasa (-) jjvālājihvamudagrakeśanicayaṃ vande nṛsiṃhaṃ vibhum || 8-242 ||
(merutantre)
vāme śaṅkhamariṃ dakṣe jānuvinyastabāhukam | grasantaṃ daityarājānaṃ kṛśānūpamatejasā || 8-243 ||
draṃṣṭāpradīptavadanaṃ lalajjihvaṃ trilocananam | suraiśca munibhirlakṣmyā kṛtāñjalikayā stutam || 8-244 ||
kāmanābhedena dhyānabhedā uktāstatraiva |
kāmyaprayogasiddhyarthaṃ dhyānabhedān vadāmyaham | udyatsahasrārkabhāsaṃ trinetraṃ bhīṣaṇākṛtim || 8-245 ||
vajratulyekṣaṇaṃ vahnikāntiṃ nānābhujairvṛtam | nakhairdāritadaityaiśaṃ raktadhārāktakāyakam || 8-246 ||
krūrakarmādiviṣaye smareddevaṃ bhayānakam | viśvarūpamayaṃ dhyānaṃ nahareḥ procyate'dhunā || 8-247 ||
nṛsiṃhaṃ taṃ mahābhīmaṃ kālānalasamaprabham | akṣamālādharaṃ raudraṃ kaṇṭhaṃ hāreṇa śobhitam || 8-248 ||
nāgayajñopavītaṃ ca pañcānanasuśobhitam | candramoliṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ prativaktraṃ trilocanam || 8-249 ||
bhujaiḥ parighasaṃkāśairdaśabhiścopaśobhitam | akṣasūtraṃ gadāṃ padmaṃ śaṅkhaṃ gokṣīrasannibham || 8-250 ||
dhanuśca muśalaṃ caiva vibhrāṇaṃ cakramuttamam | khaḍgaṃ śūlaṃ ca bāṇaṃ ca nṛhariṃ rudragopanam || 8-251 ||
indranīlakanīlābhaṃ candrābhaṃ svarṇasannibham | pūrvodayottarajvāladūrdhvāsyaṃ sarvavarṇakam || 8-252 ||
evamugrahariṃ dhyāyet sarvavyādhinivṛttaye | dhyeyo yadā mahat karma tadā ṣoḍaśahastavān || 8-253 ||
nṛsiṃhaḥ sarvalokeśaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ | dvau vidāraṇakarmārhau dvau cātroddharaṇakṣamau || 8-254 ||
cakraśaṅkhadharāvanyāvanyau vāṇadhanurdharau | khaḍgakheṭadharāvanyau dvau gadāpadmadhāriṇau || 8-255 ||
pāśāṅkuśadharāvanyau dvau ripormukuṭārpitau | iti ṣoḍaśadordaṇḍamaṇḍitaṃ nṛhariṃ vibhum || 8-256 ||
dhyāyedambujanīlābhamugrakarmaṇyananyadhīḥ | dhyeyo mahattame kārye tadā ṣaḍviṃśahastavān || 8-257 ||
nṛsiṃhaḥ sarvabhūṣāḍhyaḥ sarvasiddhikaraḥ prabhuḥ | dakṣiṇe khaḍgacakre ca paraśuṃ pāśameva ca || 8-258 ||
halaṃ ca muśalaṃ samyagabhayaṃ cāṅkuśaṃ tathā | paṭṭiśaṃ bhindipālaṃ ca kheṭatomaramudgarān || 8-259 ||
vāmabhāgakaraiḥ śaṅkhaṃ khaḍgaṃ pāśaṃ ca śūlakam | hutāśanaṃ varaṃ śaktiṃ samyagmṛṇmayakuṇḍikām || 8-260 ||
kārmukaṃ jarjanīmudrāṃ gadāṃ ḍamarusarpakān | karadvandvaiḥ kramācchatrorjānumastakapattalam || 8-261 ||
ūrdhvīkṛtābhyāṃ hastābhyāṃ mantramālādharaṃ | adhaḥsthitābhyāṃ hastābhyāṃ hiraṇyakavidāraṇam || 8-262 ||
priyaṅkaraṃ ca bhaktānāṃ detyānāṃ ca bhayaṅkaram | nṛsiṃhaṃ saṃsmareddivyaṃ mahāmṛtyubhayāpaham || 8-263 ||
athocyate dhyānamanyanmukharogaharaṃ param | viṣarogaharaṃ mṛtyuharaṃ śatrubhayāvaham || 8-264 ||
svarṇaughatulye garuḍe sthitaṃ pūrṇenduvarṇakam | sumukhaṃ vidyudābhāsanetratrayavirājitam || 8-265 ||
subhūṣaṃ pītavasanaṃ saṅkhacakravarābhayān | dhārayantaṃ caturbhiśca karaiḥ kṣveḍādināśakam || 8-266 ||
apamṛtyumahākṛtyānāśakaṃ nṛhariṃ smaret || 8-266ef ||
(śāradāyām)
udyatkoṭiraviprabhaṃ narahariṃ koṭīrahārojjvalaṃ daṃṣṭrābhīmamukhaṃ lasannakhamukhairdīrghairanekairbhujaiḥ | nirbhinnāsuranāthamagniśaśabhṛtsūryātmanetratrayaṃ vidyutpuñjajaṭākalāpabhayadaṃ vahniṃ vamantaṃ bhaje || 8-267 ||
saumye saumyaṃ smaret kāryakrūre krūramimaṃ bhajet |
puraścaraṇamāha (merau)
aṣṭalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ dīkṣito vijitendriyaḥ || 8-268 ||
tatsahasraṃ prajuhuyādghṛtāktahaviṣā'nale | tarpaṇaṃ mārjanaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇārādhanaṃ tathā || 8-269 ||
kuryāt saṃsiddhamantrastu prayogānācaret tataḥ |
(śāradāyāṃ tu)
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ tatsahasraṃ ghṛtaplutaiḥ || 8-270 ||
pāyasānnaiḥ prajuhuyādvidhivatpūjite'nale |
evaṃ kṛte bhavenmantrī siddhamantraḥ pratāpavān (-) ityuktam |
atha mantrabhedā (merutantre)
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi dvitīyaṃ nṛhariṃ vibhum || 8-271 ||
(saṃhitāyām)
atha vakṣye nṛsiṃhasya bījarūpaṃ manūttamam | saṃvarto vahnimārūḍho manusvaravibhūṣitaḥ || 8-272 ||
bindunādakalākrānto bhuktimuktiprado manuḥ | atrirasya muniḥ prokto gāyatrī chanda īritam || 8-273 ||
devatā nṛhariḥ proktaḥ surāsuranamaskṛtaḥ | ṣaḍdīrghabhājā bījena ṣaḍaṅgāni prakalpayet || 8- 274 ||
dhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ mantrarājoditaṃ caret |
asaya puraścaraṇamuktaṃ (merutantre)
ekalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ haviṣyāśī jitendriyaḥ || 8-275 ||
taddaśāṃśaṃ hunet samyagghṛtāktaiḥ pāyasaiḥ śubhaiḥ | tarpayecchuddhasalilaiḥ kṛtvā cātmābhiṣecanam || 8-276 ||
brāhmaṇān samyagārādhya siddhamantraḥ samācaret | mantrarājoditān sarvān prayogānantra sādhakaḥ || 8-277 ||
tatraiva |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi tṛtīyaṃ nṛharermanum |
(śāradāyām)
pāśaḥ śaktirnarahariraṅkuśo varma phaḍmanuḥ || 8-278 ||
ṣaḍakṣaro narahareḥ kathitaḥ sarvakāmadaḥ | ṛṣirbrahmā samuddiṣṭaḥ paṅktiśchanda udāhṛtam || 8-279 ||
devatā narasiṃho'sya ṣaḍbījairaṅgakalpanā || 8-279ef ||
atha dhyānam |
kopādālolajihvaṃ vivṛtanijamukhaṃ somasūryāgninetraṃ pādādānābhiraktaprabhamuparisitaṃ bhinnadaityendragātram | śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ sapāśāṅkuśakuliśagadādāraṇānyudvahantaṃ bhīmaṃ tīkṣṇāgradaṃṣṭraṃ maṇimayavividhākalpamīḍe nṛsiṃham || 8-280 ||
puraścaraṇamāha |
ṛtulakṣaṃ japedenaṃ ghṛtena juhuyāt tataḥ | tatsahasraṃ samiddhe'gnau toṣayeddraviṇairgurum || 8-281 ||
(merutantre)
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi turyamanvantarodbhavam | jvālāmālinṛsiṃhasya manuṃ bhūtādināśakam || 8-282 ||
(śāradāyām)
bījaṃ namo bhagavate narasiṃhāya tatparam | syājjvālāmāline paścāddīptadaṃṣtrāya tatparam || 8-283 ||
agninetrāya sarvādirakṣoghnāya padaṃ vadet | sarvabhūtavināśānte nakāro dīrghavānmarut || 8-284 ||
evaṃ jvaravināśānte nāyārṇo dahayugmakam | pacadvayaṃ rakṣayugmaṃ hu(/) phaṭsvāhā dhruvādikaḥ || 8-285 ||
saptaṣaṣṭyakṣaraiḥ prokto jvālāmālimahāmanuḥ | hṛt trayodaśabhiḥ proktaṃ śiro daśabhirīritam || 8-286 ||
śikhaikādaśabhiḥ proktā varmāṣṭādaśabhirmatam | varṇairdvādaśabhirnetramastraṃ syāt karaṇākṣaraiḥ || 8-287 ||
evamaṅgāni vinyasya cintayenmantradevatām |
dhyānam |
prajvalan pralayānalābhamayugmanetramanāratam || 8-288 ||
bhāsuraṃ śikhinaḥ śikhābhirupadaṃṣṭramukhāmbujam | rakṣasāṃ bhayadaṃ vikīrṇa saṭākalāpavibhīṣaṇam || 8-289 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
lakṣamekaṃ japenmantraṃ taddaśāśaṃ samāhitaḥ | kapilājyena juhuyāt samiddhe havyavāhane || 8-290 ||
(merutantre)
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi yo jātaḥ pañcame vibhuḥ | manvantare sa lakṣmīkaḥ sevyate yo gṛhasthitaiḥ || 8-291 ||
(saṃhitāyām)
atha lakṣmīnṛsiṃhasya mantraṃ vakṣye sudurlabham | tārendirāśaktiramāḥ śūlinaṃ puruṣottamam || 8-292 ||
lakṣmīpriyapadaṃ ṅe'ntaṃ nityamāmuditottaram | cetasaṃ tādṛśaṃ proktvā lakṣmīśritapadottaram || 8-293 ||
ardhadehapadaṃ ṅe'ntaṃ ramā māyā ca hṛt | suravarṇo manuḥ proktaścaturvargaphalapradaḥ || 8-293 ||
muniḥ prajāpatiḥ proktaśchando'nuṣṭubudāhṛtam | lakṣmīnṛsiṃho bhagavān devatā'sya prakīrttitaḥ || 8-294 ||
svabīnena ṣaḍaṅgāni kṛtvā nyāsāntaraṃ caret |
taduktaṃ (merutantre)
purastāt keśavaḥ pātu cakrī jāmbūnadaprabhaḥ || 8-295 ||
paścānnārāyaṇaḥ śaṅkhī nīlajīmutasannibhaḥ | indīvaradalaśyāmo mādhavordhvagadādharaḥ || 8-296 ||
govindo dakṣiṇe pārśve dhanvī candraprabho mahān | uttare haladhṛgviṣṇuḥ padmakiñjalkasannibhaḥ || 8-297 ||
āgneyyāmaravindākṣo muśalī madhusūdanaḥ | trivikramaḥ khaḍgapāṇirnair(-)ṛtyāṃ jvalanaprabhaḥ || 8-298 ||
vāyavyāṃ vāmano vajrī taruṇādityadīptimān | aiśānyāṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ śrīdharaḥ paṭṭiśāyudhaḥ || 8-299 ||
vidyutprabho hṛṣīkeśo vāyavyāṃ diśi mudgarī | hṛtpadmaṃ padmanābho me sahasrārkasamaprabhaḥ || 8-300 ||
sarvāyudhaḥ sarvaśaktiḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvato mukhaḥ | indragopakasaṃkāśaḥ pāśahasto'parājitaḥ || 8-301 ||
savāhyābhyantaraṃ dehaṃ vyāpya dāmodaraḥ sthitaḥ | evaṃ sarvatra niśchidraṃ nāmadvādaśapañjaram || 8-302 ||
praviṣṭo'haṃ na me kiñcidbhayamasti kadācana | iti nyāsaṃ vidhāyādau lakṣmīnarahariṃ smaret || 8-303 ||
dhyānaṃ yathā |
sarpendrabhogaśayanaḥ sarpendraphaṇacchatravān | āliṅgitaśca ramayā dīptayā candrasannibhaḥ || 8-304 ||
padmacakravarābhītidharastryakṣenduśekharaḥ |
(saṃhitāyāṃ) tu mantrarājoktameva dhyānamuktam | puraścaraṇamāha |
ṣaṣṭyuttaraṃ trilakṣaṃ tu prajapet tatsahasrakam || 8-305 ||
madhvaktamallikāpuṣpairjuhuyānmantravittamaḥ | abhyarcya salile devaṃ tarpayenmanunā tataḥ || 8-306 ||
abhiṣiñcet svamūrdhānaṃ brāhmaṇān bhojayet tataḥ | tataḥ prayogān kurvīt sādhako nijavāñchitān || 8-307 ||
tatraiva |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi ṣaṣṭhamanvantare'bhavat | lakṣmyā saha nṛsiṃho'yastanmantraḥ sarvakāmadaḥ || 8-308 ||
oṃ śrī(/) lakṣmīnṛsiṃhāya manuraṣṭākṣaro mataḥ | muniḥ prajāpatiśchando'nuṣṭublakṣmīhariḥ suraḥ || 8-309 ||
ṣaḍdīrghayuktaṃ kṣrau(/) bījaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ | dhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ ṣaḍakṣaravadīritam || 8-310 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ ghṛtaplutaiḥ | pāyasairjuhuyānmantrī tarpaṇādi tataścaret || 8-311 ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi yo jātaḥ saptame hariḥ | jaya jaya śrīnṛsiṃha manuraṣṭākṣaro mataḥ || 8-312 ||
ṛṣyādyaṣṭārṇavat proktaṃ pūjā cāsya ṣaḍarṇavat | ekārṇavat prayogā(/)śca gṛhasthaḥ sādhayecchuciḥ || 8-313 ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi tvaṣṭame yastu jāyate | daśāvatāranṛharirdakṣasāvarṇikāntare || 8-314 ||
oṃ kṣrau(/) namo bhagavate nṛsiṃhāya saṃvadet | oṃ kṣrau(/) ca matsyarūpāya kūrmarūpāya taddvayāt || 8-315 ||
oṃ kṣrau(/) varāharūpāya tato bījadvayaṃ vadet | nṛsiṃharūpāya tato vedādi kṣrau(/) vadet tataḥ || 8-316 ||
proktvā vāmanarūpāya tridhā bījadvayaṃ vadet | rāmāya tacca kṛṣṇāya tadvayaṃ kalkine vadet || 8-317 ||
jayaśabdadvayānte tu śālagrāmanivāsine | divyasiṃhāyeti coktvā vadet paścāt svayambhuve || 8-318 ||
puruṣāya namastāraḥ kṣraumekonaśatārṇakaḥ | advijena tu buddhāya vaktavyaṃ bījapūrvakam || 8-319 ||
tadā mantraḥ samākhyātaścaturūrdhvaśatākṣaraḥ | chando'tijagatī proktamṛṣiratriḥ prakīrttitaḥ || 8-320 ||
daśāvatāranṛharirdevatā sarvakāmadaḥ | ṣaḍdīrghayuktabījena saḍaṅgāni prakalpayet || 8-321 ||
mantrarājavadevāsya dhyānapūjādikaṃ bhavet | yajet ṣaḍaṅgapūjānte matsyādīnavatārakān || 8-322 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
ayutaṃ prajapenmantraṃ sājyena haviṣā tataḥ | juhuyāt taddaśāṃśena tarpaṇādi tataścaret || 8-323 ||
kāmyakarmāṇi sarvāṇi mantrarājavadeva hi | asya saṃsevanādviprā brahmacaryādivicyutāḥ || 8-324 ||
nṛsiṃharūpatāṃ prāpya jātāḥ sthānanṛsiṃhakāḥ | āviṃśati ca te dehe samyak kurvanti pūjitāḥ || 8-325 ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi jāyate navame tu yaḥ | narasiṃho vīranāmā śṛṇu tatsādhanaṃ priye || 8-326 ||
bāle ca taruṇe vṛddhe prayogārthaṃ manutrayam | proktaṃ saṃsādhike vaktraśuddhe siddhāstrayo'pi ca || 8-327 ||
tāro namo bhagavate bījānte narapadaṃ vadet | siṃhāyeti tataḥ proktvā jvālāmālāpadaṃ vadet || 8-328 ||
pinaddhāṅgāya ityuktvā agninetrāya saṃvadet | sarvabhūtavināśeti nāyetyuktvā dvidhā daha || 8-329 ||
paca yugmaṃ rakṣayugmaṃ hrī(/) śrī(/) rakṣāgnigehinī | catuṣpañcāśadarṇo'yaṃ mantraḥ prathama īritaḥ || 8-330 ||
varṇāḥ ṣoḍaśapūrvasya line dīptapadaṃ vadet | daṃṣṭrāya cāgninetrāya sarvarakṣo(-)padaṃ tataḥ || 8-331 ||
ghnāyoktvā sarvabhūteti ṅe'ntaṃ vināśanaṃ vadet | sarvajvaravināśāya hanadvandvaṃ dahadvayam || 8-332 ||
pacayugmaṃ bandhayugmaṃ hu(/) phaṭ svāhā kvagārṇakaḥ | tṛtīyamatha vakṣyāmi pūrvārṇā gajabāhavaḥ || 8-333 ||
vināśanāya cānte syāt pūrvasarvapadaṃ tridhā | madhye bhūtajvaradoṣapadāni trīṇi yojayet || 8-334 ||
hanādicaturante tu rakṣayugmaṃ ca māṃ ca mām | hu(/) phaṭsvāhā navakṛtivarṇatulyo mato manuḥ || 8-335 ||
mantrarājoktavaccāsya pūjādhyānajapādikam | mālāmantrā ime khyātā drutasiddhividhāyakāḥ || 8-336 ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi daśame jāyate tu yaḥ | oṃ kṣrau(/) mahānṛsiṃhāya namo'nto daśavarṇakaḥ || 8-337 ||
vāmadevo muniśchando virāḍdevo nṛsiṃhakaḥ | ṣaḍdīrghayuksvabījena ṣaḍaṅganyāsamācaret || 8-337 ||
dhyānapūjāpuraścaryā homo lakṣmīnṛsiṃhavat | varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ prayogo'ṣṭākṣaroditaḥ || 8-338 ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi mantramekādaśasya tu | oṃ kṣrau(/) namo bhagavate narasiṃhāya mantrakaḥ || 8-339 ||
trayodaśārṇa uddiṣṭo bhuktimuktipradāyakaḥ | vāmadevo muniḥ prokto jagatī chanda īritam || 8-340 ||
devatānarasiṃho'tra svabījenāṅgakalpanam | dhyānapūjāprayogādi ṣaḍakṣaravadīritam || 8-341 ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi dvādaśe jāyate tu yaḥ | kāśyāṃ sa vasate nityaṃ duṣṭabuddhipracālakaḥ || 8-342 ||
tāraṃ sahasrārajvālāvarttine kṣrau(/) hanadvayam | hu(/) phaṭsvāhā conaviṃśavarṇo mantra udāhṛtaḥ || 8-343 ||
munirjayanta ākhyataśchando gāyatramucyate | sudarśananṛsiṃho'sya devatā parikīrttitaḥ || 8-344 ||
cakrarājāya hṛt proktaṃ jvālācakrāya vai śiraḥ | gajacakrāya ca śikhā kavacaṃ tvasya saṃmatam || 8-345 ||
asurāntakacakrāya hyastrāya phaḍitīritam | sudarśanāyeti manuḥ pañcāṅgametadīritam || 8-346 ||
atha dhyānam |
cakrāṇāṃ tu sabhāmadhye kālāgnisadṛśaprabham | caturbhujaṃ vivṛttāsyaṃ catuścakradharaṃ harim || 8-347 ||
taptakāñcanasaṃkāśaṃ trinetraṃ cādyavigraham | dhyāyet samastaduḥkhaghnaṃ tādṛglakṣmyā samanvitam || 8-348 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
ravilakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ tilaiḥ śubhaiḥ | hunet puṣpaistataścāpi catvāriṃśatsahasrakam || 8-349 ||
punarājyena juhuyāt sahasraṃ ca namaskriyāḥ | tarpaṇādi tataḥ kṛtvā prayogānācaret tataḥ || 8-350 ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi bhuktimuktipradāyakam | jātaṃ trayodaśe devaṃ nṛhariṃ kṣau(/) tu saṃpuṭaḥ || 8-351 ||
māyayā bhogadātā syāt praṇavena ca mokṣadaḥ | asya pūjāprayogādyamekākṣarasamaṃ bhavet || 8-352 ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi jātaṃ manvantare vibhum | abhayākhyo nṛsiṃho'yaṃ samastabhayanāśanaḥ || 8-353 ||
tāro namo bhagavate narasiṃhāya hṛdvadet | tejastejasa ityuktvā āvirāvirbhaveti ca || 8-354 ||
vajranakha vajradaṃṣṭra karmāśayān dvī randhaya | tamordvigrasa vahnistrī vadedabhayamātmani || 8-355 ||
bhūyiṣṭhā oṃ kṣraumiti ca dviṣaṣṭyarṇo manurmataḥ | muniḥ śuko'tijagatī chandaḥ prāgvadivākhilam || 8-356 ||
caturdaśanṛsiṃhānāṃ sādhanaṃ vedabodhitam | tadatra kathitaṃ devā bhuktimuktipradāyakam || 8-357 ||
atha vāmanamantro (merutantre)
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi vāmanasya śubhān manūn | manvantaraṃ tapatyekaṃ sareśaṃ bādhate param || 8-358 ||
punardadāti haraye trailokyaṃ sa valirnṛpaḥ | ekaṃ manvantaraṃ śakraḥ svayamevābhavadvaliḥ || 8-359 ||
evaṃ ṣaḍvāmanāḥ kalpe teṣāṃ mantrān vadāmyaham |
ṣaḍvāmanāśca tantrāntare |
dadhivāmanayajñeśavāmanu bhogavāmanaḥ || 8-360 ||
bālako vāmano viśvarūpo'nyo valivāmanaḥ |
tatra dadhivāmanamantraḥ (śāradāyām)
tāro hṛdviṣṇave paścādṅentaḥ surapatirbhavet || 8-361 ||
mahābalāya ṭhadvandvaṃ manuraṣṭādaśākṣaraḥ | ṛṣirindurvirāṭchando devatā dadhivāmanaḥ || 8-362 ||
hṛdekena śiro dvābhyāṃ śikhā tribhirudāhṛtam | kavacaṃ pañcabhiḥ proktaṃ netraṃ tāvadbhirakṣaraiḥ || 8-363 ||
dvābhyāmastramiti proktaḥ prakāro'ṅgasya sūribhiḥ || 8-363ef ||
atha dhyānam |
muktāgauraṃ navamaṇilasadbhūṣaṇaṃ candrasaṃsthaṃ bhṛṅgākārairalakanikaraiḥ śobhivaktrāravindam | hastāgrābhyāṃ kanakakalaśaṃ śuddhatoyābhipūrṇaṃ dadhyannāḍhyaṃ kanakacaṣakaṃ dhārayantaṃ bhajāmaḥ || 8-364 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
guṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ ghṛtaplutaiḥ | pāyasānnaiḥ prajuhuyāddadhyannairvā yathāvidhi || 8-365 ||
vāmanamantrabhedāstu (merau) draṣṭavyāḥ | atha trivikramamantrā (merau)
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi mantraṃ traivikramaṃ param | tāro namo bhagavate vyāhṛtitritayaṃ vadet || 8-366 ||
vyāpakāya paraṃ paścādṅe'ntaṃ cāpi trivikramam | viṃśatyarṇo mahāmantro gatarājyapradāyakaḥ || 8-367 ||
padapañcakasarveṇa ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ | munayo vālikhilyāḥ syuśchando gāyatramīritam || 8-368 ||
devatā viśvarūpo'yaṃ trivikrama udāhṛtaḥ |
dhyānam |
dakṣāṅghrivyāptapātālaṃ vāmāṅghrivyāptabhūtalam || 8-369 ||
dakṣiṇaṃ punarutthāpya svargavyāptikaraṃ harim | validattaiḥ kuśatilatoyaiḥ saṃprasravatkaram || 8-370 ||
abhayaṃ vāmahastena kurvantaṃ ca sureśvaram | gaṅgaughadhautapādābjaṃ dhyāyedbrahmādikastutam || 8-371 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
viṃśallakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ tilataṇḍulasarṣapaiḥ | trimadhvaktairhunet paścāt tarpaṇādyaṃ ca kārayet || 8-372 ||
evaṃ siddhamanurmantrī labhate vāñchitaṃ phalam |
atha paraśurāmantrastatraiva |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi rāmantraṃ mahādbhutam || 8-373 ||
ākalpamekaṃ evāyaṃ jāmadagnyo mahābalaḥ | brahmakṣetrāya virmahe kṣatriyāntāya dhīmahi || 8-374 ||
tanno rāmaḥ pracodayāt (-----------------------------) |
tathā |
śrīmatparaśurāmasya gāyatryeṣā mahādbhutā || 8-375 ||
rājyakṛt kalibhūṣānāṃ sarvatantreṣu gopitā | bharadvājo muniḥ prokto gāyatrī chanda īritam || 8-376 ||
śrīmān paraśurāmo'sya devatā bhaktavatsalaḥ | aṣṭeṣutridvibāhvabdhivarṇaiḥ proktaṃ ṣaḍaṅgakam || 8-377 ||
atha dhyānam |
sāttvikaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ ca bhaśmoddhūlitavigraham | agnihotrasthalāsīnaṃ nānāmunigaṇāvṛtam || 8-378 ||
kambalāsanamārūḍhaṃ svarṇatārakuśāṅgulim | śvetavastradvayopetaṃ juhvantaṃ śāntamānasam || 8-379 ||
dhyāyecca rājasaṃ rāmaṃ kuṅkumāruṇavigraham | kirīṭinaṃ kuṇḍalinaṃ paraśvabjavarābhayān || 8-380 ||
karairdadhantaṃ taruṇaṃ viprakṣatraughasaṃvṛtam | pītāmbaradharaṃ kāmarūpaṃ bālanirīkṣitam || 8-381 ||
dhyāyecca tāmasaṃ kṣatrarudhirākteparaśvagham | āraktanetraṃ karṇasthabrahmasūtraṃ yamaprabham || 8-382 ||
dhanuṣṭaṅkārasaṃghoṣasaṃtrastabhuvanatrayam | caturbāhuṃ muśalinaṃ saṃkruddhabhrātṛsaṃyutam || 8-383 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ sitājyaghṛtapāyasaiḥ | hunedbrāhmaṇabhojyāntaṃ kṛtvā siddho bhavenmanuḥ || 8-384 ||
brahmakarmarato nityaṃ gāyatrījapatatparaḥ | sa eva jāyate siddho nānyo vipraḥ kadācana || 8-385 ||
tathā (-)
phiraṅgā yavanāścīnāḥ khurāsānāścalendhujāḥ | rāmabhaktaṃ gradṛṣṭvaite trasanti praṇamanti ca || 8-386 ||
atha śrīraghunāthamantrā (vaśiṣṭhasaṃhitāyām)
kṛṣṇaṃ dvaipāyanaṃ vyāsaṃ guruṃ satyavratīsutam | samādhisthaṃ muniṃ śāntaṃ prasannādityatejasam || 8-387 ||
gaṅgātīre mahāpuṇye samāsīnaṃ taponidhim | śaunakaḥ paripapraccha sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇipatya ca || 8-388 ||
śrīśaunaka uvāca |
ayi prasādasumukha kuruṣva mayi mānasam | tatprāsādānmahāmantrā vihitā bahavo mayā || 8-389 ||
karuṇārasapūrṇābhyāṃ netrābhyāṃ māṃ vilokaya | saccidānandamātmānaṃ jñātavān brahmaśāsvatam || 8-390 ||
idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi mantraṃ sāṅgaṃ sahārcanam | rāmātmanā'vatīrṇasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ || 8-391 ||
brūhi me bhagavan sarvaṃ śrotuṃ yogyo'smyahaṃ yadi | asau bhāgyena loko'yaṃ dāridryeṇa ca pīḍitaḥ || 8-392 ||
yena saubhāgyamatulaṃ mahadaiśvaryasambhavam | śāstrajñānaṃ kavitvaṃ ca sarvajñatvaṃ labhennaraḥ || 8-393 ||
śrīvyāsa uvāca |
sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā brahman kathaye sakalaṃ tava | brahmaṇā kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ vaśiṣṭhāya mahātmane || 8-394 ||
vaśiṣṭho'pi svaputrāya matpitre dattavānmanum | prasannahṛdayaḥ śuddhaḥ pitā me karuṇānidhiḥ || 8-395 ||
kurukṣetre mahāpuṇye sūryaparvaṇi dattavān | mayā ca sādhito mantro japahomārcanādibhiḥ || 8-396 ||
itaḥ pūrvaṃ mayā nokto mantrarājastu kasyacit | evaṃ paramparāproktaṃ bhaktyā mantraṃ śṛṇuṣvame || 8-397 ||
ayogyāya na dātavyo mantrarājastvayā mune | yatnena gopaya tvaṃ ca rahasyaṃ śrīprasiddhidam || 8-398 ||
śiṣyalakṣaṇamuktvā (-)
īdṛgvidhāya śiṣyāya mantraṃ dadyāt tu nānyathā | yadanyathā vadet tasmin devatā śāpadā bhavet || 8-399 ||
mantroddhāramāha |
māntāntaṃ vindusaṃyuktaṃ nārāyaṇavibhūṣitam | bījametat samuddhṛtya vinduhīnaṃ punaśca tat || 8-400 ||
bhāntaṃ cākārasaṃyuktaṃ māntāntāṃ natimuddharet | etat ṣaḍakṣaraṃ mantraṃ sarvaiśvaryapradāyakam || 8-401 ||
sarvasubhāgyajananaṃ sarvalokavaśaṅkaram | vidyāsiddhikaraṃ nṝṇāṃ mahadāṃjñākaraṃ mune || 8-402 ||
ṛṣirbrahmā'sya mantrasya gāyatraṃ chanda ucyate | rāmākhyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma devatā parikīrttitā || 8-403 ||
jānīyāt prathamaṃ varṇaṃ bījaṃ śaktiṃ natiṃ tathā |
mantrārthamāha (rāmārcanacandrikāyām)
śrīrāmamantrarājasya samyagartho'bhidhīyate || 8-404 ||
rakāro vahnivacanaḥ prakāśe paryavasyati | saccidānandarūpo'sya paramātmārtha ucyate || 8-405 ||
vyañjanaṃ niṣkalaṃ brahma prāṇo māyeti ca svaraḥ | vyañjanaiḥ svarasaṃyogo viddhi tatprāṇayojanam || 8-406 ||
rephe jyotirmaye tasmāt kṛtamākārayojanam | makāro'bhyudayārthatvānmāyātmeti ca kathyate || 8-407 ||
tasmādanena bījena samāyaṃ brahma ucyate |
(rāmopaniṣadi)
svaprakāśaḥ svayaṃ jyotiḥ svānubhūtyekacinmayaḥ || 8-408 ||
tadeva mantrarājasya manurāḍdvyakṣaraḥ smṛtaḥ | akhaṇḍaikarasānandastārako brahmavācakaḥ || 8-409 ||
rāmāyeti suvijñeyaḥ satyānandacidātmakaḥ | namaḥpadaṃ suvijñeyaṃ pūrṇānandaikavigraham || 8-410 ||
sadā namanti hṛdaye sarve devā mumukṣavaḥ |
ādyabījabhedāt ṣaḍvidho'yaṃ mantrastaduktaṃ (merutantre)
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi bhuktimuktipradāyakān || 8-411 ||
rāmamantrān sa bhagavān pratimanvantare hyabhūt | yugānāṃ parivartena kalpe śakrāvatārakaḥ || 8-412 ||
tatrādyasya pravakṣyāmi mantrarājaṃ ṣaḍakṣaram | rāmāya nama ityeṣa rā(/) klī(/) hrī(/) ai(/) tu pūrvakaḥ || 8-413 ||
śrītārādyaśca ṣaḍvarṇaḥ ṣaḍvidhaḥ parikīrttitaḥ | brahmā saṃmohanaḥ śaktirdakṣiṇāmūrttireva ca || 8-414 ||
agastyaḥ śrīśivaḥ prokto munayo'nukramādime | chando gāyatrasaṃjñaṃ ca śrīrāmo devatā mataḥ || 8-415 ||
ṣaḍakṣarasyaiva bhūyāṃsaḥ prabhedāstatraivoktāḥ |
pañcāśanmātṛkāmantravarṇaḥ pratyekapūrvakaḥ | lakṣmyādirvāgbhavādiśca manmathādirdhruvādikaḥ || 8-416 ||
rāmacandrastathā bhedāḥ śatadvayamitā amī | rāmabhadreti śabdena caivaṃ bhedāḥ śatadvayam || 8-417 ||
ramābījādikānāṃ tu viśvāmitro munirmataḥ | vāgbījapūrvakāṇāṃ tu dakṣiṇāmūrttirucyate || 8-418 ||
kāmabījādipūrveṣāṃ muniḥ saṃmohano mataḥ | tārādipūrvakāṇāṃ tu śrīśivaḥ procyate muniḥ || 8-419 ||
śrīmāyāmanmathaikaikabījādyantagato yadā | rāmabhadro rāmacandraḥ ṣoḍhā ṣaḍvarṇa ucyate || 8-420 ||
ṣoḍhā namo'ntaḥ prāk proktaḥ phaṭkārāntaḥ sa eva hi | ṣoḍhā syādvahnijāyāntaḥ sa evaṃ ṣaḍvidho mataḥ || 8-421 ||
catuḥśataṃ caturviṃśabhedāstena nirūpitāḥ |
tathā |
tārādirmuktaye hyeṣa ramādirbhuktaye bhavet || 8-422 ||
vāksiddhaye ca vāgādiḥ sarvavaśyāya mānmathaḥ | tārādyaiḥ puṭitān mantrān sarvārthaṃ viniyojapet || 8-423 ||
tathā |
brahmarandhe bhruvormadhye hṛnnābhyandhuṣu pādayoḥ | bījaiḥ ṣaḍdīrghasaṃyuktaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ || 8-424 ||
(vaśiṣṭhasaṃhitāyām)
ādhāre bhāvayecchaktiṃ cidānandasvarūpiṇīm | udyadādityasaṃkāśamādhāraṃ tatprabhāmayam || 8-425 ||
ādhārabhāvanāmevaṃ saṃbhāvya munisattama | tataḥ samutthitaṃ tejaḥ śikhārūpaṃ ca cintayet || 8-426 ||
vidyutkoṭipratīkāśaṃ candrakoṭisuśītalam | suṣumnāmukhamunmīlya prāpayedupadeśataḥ || 8-427 ||
brahmādhvanā'nayedūrdhvaṃ dvādaśāntendumaṇḍalam | prāpayya vidhinā buddhyā srāvayet tat sudhāmṛtam || 8-428 ||
tataḥ parigalacchuddhasudhādhārābhirāvṛtam | nijadehaṃ jagat sarvamekībhūtaṃ vicintayet || 8-429 ||
niṣprapañcaṃ nirākāraṃ niravadyaṃ nirañjanam | aśūnyaśūnyoparamaṃ sadasadbhāvavarjitam || 8-430 ||
akhaṇḍānandamātmānaṃ bhāvayenmunisattama | devatāgurumantrāṇāṃ bhāvayedaikyamātmanaḥ || 8-431 ||
evaṃ saṃcintayenmantrī mantraṃ pratidinaṃ japet | aihikānakhilān bhogān bhuktvā cānte padaṃ vrajet || 8-432 ||
upasaṃhṛtya tat tejo yadvā hṛdayapaṅkaje | rāmaṃ jyotirmayaṃ dhyāyet sarvalokaikasākṣiṇam || 8-433 ||
jagadudbhūtisambhūtiparihūtikaraṃ harim | devāsuramanuṣyaiśca yogivṛndaiśca sevitam || 8-434 ||
atha dhyānam |
caturbhujaṃ śaṅkhacakragadāpaṅkajadhāriṇam | kirīṭahārakeyūraratnakuṇḍalamaṇḍitam || 8-435 ||
evaṃ dhyātvā japenmantraṃ ṣaṭsahasraṃ dine dine | vācaḥ śriyaḥ patirbhūtvā kavirbhavati vatsarāt || 8-436 ||
dhyānāntaramāha |
dhyāyet kalpatarormūle sauvarṇamaṇḍapaṃ mune | tanmadhye puṣpakākhyaṃ ca vimānaṃ divyamuttamam || 8-437 ||
madhye siṃhāsanaṃ tasya nānāratnavibhūṣitam | tanmadhye'ṣṭadalaṃpadmamudyadādityasannibham || 8-438 ||
śrīrāmamenaṃ tanmadhye samāsīnaṃ mahāmune | samyagjñānamayīṃ mudrāṃ dadhānaṃ dakṣiṇe kare || 8-439 ||
tejaḥprakāśanaṃ vāmaṃ jānumūrdhani cāparam | jānakīvallabhaṃ devamindranīlasamaprabham || 8-440 ||
udyānanirataṃ deva dvibhujaṃ raghunandanam | vaśiṣṭhavāmadevādimunibhiḥ parivāritam || 8-441 ||
vāmabhāge samāsīnāṃ sītāṃ kāñcanasannibhām | bhajatāṃ kāmadāṃ nityaṃ raktotpalakarāmbujām || 8-442 ||
lakṣmaṇaṃ paścime bhāge dhṛtacchatrasucāmaram | pārśve bharataśatrughnau tālavṛntakarāvubhau || 8-443 ||
evaṃ dhyātvā japenmantraṃ jñānalakṣmyośca bhājanam || 8-443ef ||
(śāradāyāmapi)
kālāmbhodharakāntikāntamaniśaṃ vīrāsanādhyāsinaṃ mudrāṃ jñānamayīṃ dadhānamaparaṃ hastāmbujaṃ jānuni | sītāṃ pārśvagatāṃ saroruhakarāṃ vidyunnibhāṃ rāghavaṃ paśyantaṃ mukuṭāṅgadādivividhākalpojjvalāṅgaṃ bhaje || 8-444 ||
(merutantre)
vīrāsanasamārūḍhaṃ vyākhyāmudropaśobhitam | vāmorunyastataddhastaṃ sītālakṣmaṇasaṃyutam || 8-445 ||
tantrāntare pūrvoktadhyānamuktvā (-)
evaṃ taddyānamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate | rāmamindīvaraśyāmaṃ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇam || 8-446 ||
dhyātvā tu hṛdayāmbhoje ye japanti ṣaḍakṣaram | karāmalakavajjñeyā muktisteṣāṃ mahātmanām || 8-447 ||
(vaśiṣṭhasaṃhitāyām)
śāstrajñānaṃ kavitvaṃ ca ṣaṇmāsājjāyate mune | japatāṃ mantriṇāmevaṃ japayogena dhīmatām || 8-448 ||
puraścaraṇakṛtyena vinā'pi phalado manuḥ |
asya puraścaraṇamuktaṃ (merutantre)
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ daśāṃśaṃ madhuraplutaiḥ || 8-449 ||
vilvapatraiḥ phalaiḥ puṣpaistilairvā paṅkajairhunet |
atha mālāmantrastatraiva |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi lakṣmaṇopāsitaṃ manum || 8-450 ||
tāro namo bhagavete ṅe'ntaḥ syādraghunandanaḥ | rakṣoghnaviśadāyeti madhureti padaṃ tataḥ || 8-451 ||
prasannavadanāyeti tataścāmitatejase | balāyeti ca rāmāya viṣṇave nama ityayam || 8-452 ||
saptacatvāriṃśadarṇo mālāmantra udāhṛtaḥ | muniḥ pitāmahaśchandaḥ syādanuṣṭup ca devatā || 8-453 ||
rājyābhiṣikto rāmaśco(/) bījaṃ śaktirnamo'stviti | saptarttusaptadaśaṣaḍrasasaṅkhyaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakam || 8-454 ||
tathā |
dhyānaṃ daśākṣaraṃ proktaṃ lakṣamekaṃ japenmanum | vilvaiḥ prasūnaiḥ patrairvā tilaistrimadhunā yutaiḥ || 8-455 ||
madhuratrayayuktena pāyasenātha vā'mbujaiḥ | homaṃ daśāṃśataḥ kuryāt tathā sarvatra tarpaṇam || 8-456 ||
mārjanaṃ bhojayedviprān prayogādi ca pūrvavat |
daśākṣaramantro vakṣyate | manvantarabhedena śrīrāmamantrabheda uktastatraiva |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi svārociṣasamudbhavam || 8-457 ||
rāmasyaikākṣaraṃ mantraṃ kīrttyate sa tu rāmiti | brahmā muniḥ syādgāyatraṃ chando rāmo'sya devatā || 8-458 ||
mūrttipañjaranāmānaṃ tattvanyāsaṃ ca kārayet | ṣaḍdīrghārdhenduyuktena bījenaiva ṣaḍaṅgakam || 8-459 ||
dhyānapūjādikaṃ prāgvadbhānulakṣaṃ japenmanum | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi tṛtīyāntarmanorvidhim || 8-460 ||
rāma etyeṣa kathito dvyakṣaro bhuktimuktidaḥ | ekākṣaroktamṛṣyādi syādādyena ṣaḍaṅgakam || 8-461 ||
dhyānapūjāprayogādi sarvaṃ jñeyaṃ ṣaḍarṇavat |
evaṃ puraścaraṇamapi jñeyam |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi caturthāntarmanorvidhim || 8-462 ||
tāramāyāramānaṅgavāksvabījaiśca ṣaḍvidhaḥ | dvyakṣaro mantrarājastu tryakṣaraḥ parijāyate || 8-463 ||
nyāsapūjāprayogādi sarvaṃ pūrvavadācaret | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi pañcamāntarmanorvidhim || 8-464 ||
dvyakṣaraścandrabhadrānto dvividhaścaturakṣaraḥ | ṛṣinyāsārcanādyaṃ tu sarvaṃ pūrvavadācaret || 8-465 ||
viśeṣataścaturvargaphalado'yaṃ mato manuḥ | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi ṣaṣṭhamanvantarodbhavam || 8-466 ||
rāmāya nama ityeṣa manuḥ pañcākṣaro mataḥ | viśvāmitro muniḥ proktaḥ paṅktiśchando'sya devatā || 8-467 ||
rāmabhadro bījaśaktī prathamārṇanatī kramāt | bhrūmadhye hṛdi nābhyadho pādayorvinyasenmanum || 8-468 ||
ṣaḍaṅgaṃ pūrvavadyadvā mantrārṇairmanunā'strakam |
dhyānamāha |
madhye vanaṃ kalpatarormūle puṣpalatāsane || 8-469 ||
lakṣmaṇena praguṇitamakṣṇaḥ koṇena sāyakam | bhavekṣamāṇaṃ jānakyā kṛtavyajanamīśvaram || 8-470 ||
jaṭābhāralasacchīrṣaṃ śyāmaṃ munigaṇāvṛtam | lakṣmaṇena dhṛtacchatramathavā puṣpakopari || 8-471 ||
daśāsyamathanaṃ śāntaṃ sasugrīvavibhīṣaṇam | vijayārthī viśeṣeṇa varṇalakṣaṃ japenmanum || 8-472 ||
prāgvaddhomastarpaṇādi prayogādyaṃ ca sādhayet | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi mantraṃ sāvarṇikodbhavam || 8-473 ||
tārādiṣaḍbhiḥ saṃyukto dvedhā saptākṣaro manuḥ | aṣṭākṣaro dvādaśadhā kīrttirto rājyadāyakaḥ || 8-474 ||
sarvaṃ ṣaḍarṇavajjñeyaṃ dhyānapūjājapādikam | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi mantrān navamasaṃbhavān || 8-475 ||
tāro rāmaścaturthyantaḥ krodho'straṃ vahnivallabhā | aṣṭārṇo'yaṃ paro mantro munyādiḥ syāt ṣaḍarṇavat || 8-476 ||
nāśakaḥ sarvadoṣāṇāṃ saṅgrāmavijayapradaḥ | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi mantrān daśamasambhavān || 8-477 ||
oṃ hrī(/) namaśca rāmāya hrīmityaṣṭākṣaraḥ paraḥ | ṛṣiḥ sadāśivaḥ prokto gāyatraṃ chanda ucyate || 8-478 ||
śivomārāmacandro'sya devatā parikīrttitaḥ | dīrghayā māyayā'ṅgāni tārapañcārṇayuktayā || 8-479 ||
oṃ namo rāmāya hrī(/) hṛdayāya namaḥ (-) ityādi | dhyānapuraścaraṇe prāha |
rāmaṃ trinetraṃ somārdhadhāriṇaṃ śūlinaṃ varam | bhasmoddhūlitasarvāṅgaṃ kapardinamupāsmahe || 8-480 ||
rāmābhirāmāṃ saundaryasīmāṃ somāvataṃsinīm | pāśāṅkuśadhanurbāṇadharāṃ dhyāyet trilocanām || 8-481 ||
rāmaśaktiṃ tu sītākhyāṃ varṇalakṣaṃ japenmanum | homapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ ṣaḍakṣaravadīritam || 8-482 ||
viśeṣato bhogadātā saṅgrāmavijayapradaḥ | athaikādaśasambhūtān rāmamantrān vadāmyaham || 8-483 ||
saptārṇairyau manū proktau ṣaḍbhistārādikaiḥ pṛthak | saṃpuṭau te dvādaśadhā navārṇā manavaḥ surāḥ || 8-484 ||
dhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ teṣāṃ saptārṇavadbhavet | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi dvādaśāntarasambhavam || 8-485 ||
jānakīvallabho ṅe'ntaḥ svāhāntaśca humādikaḥ | daśākṣaro'yaṃ mantraḥ syādvaśiṣtho'sya muniścarāṭ || 8-486 ||
chandaśca devatā rāmaḥ sītāpāṇiparigrahaḥ | ādyaṃ bījaṃ dviṭhaḥ śaktiraṅgaṃ ṣaḍdīrghako mataḥ || 8-487 ||
śirolalāṭabhrūmadhyatālukaṇṭheṣu hṛdyapi | nābhyandhujānupādeṣu daśārṇān vinyasenmanoḥ || 8-488 ||
dhyānamāha |
ayodhyānagare ratnacite sauvarṇamaṇḍape | mandārapuṣpairābaddhavitāne toraṇānvite || 8-489 ||
siṃhāsanasamārūḍhaṃ puṣpakopari rāghavam | rakṣobhirharibhirdevairdivyayānagataiḥ śubhaiḥ || 8-490 ||
saṃstuyamānaṃ munibhiḥ prahṛṣṭairupasevitam | sītālaṅkṛtavāmāṅgaṃ lakṣmaṇenopaśobhitam || 8-491 ||
śyāmaṃ prasannavadanaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam | dhyāyannevaṃ japenmantraṃ varṇalakṣamananyadhīḥ || 8-492 ||
japapūjāprayogādi sarvamasya ṣaḍarṇavat | atha trayodaśe jātaṃ rāmamantraṃ vadāmyaham || 8-493 ||
rāmo ṅe'nto dhanuṣpāṇistathā syādvahnisundarī | daśākṣaro munirbrahmā virāṭ chando'sya devatā || 8-494 ||
rākṣasāntakaro rāmo rā(/) bījaṃ parikīrttitam | svāhā śaktiśca bījena ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret || 8-495 ||
varṇanyāsaṃ tathā dhyānaṃ pauraścaraṇikaṃ vidhim | daśākṣaroktavat kuryāccāpabāṇadharaṃ smaret || 8-496 ||
viśeṣājjayadaścāyaṃ bhraṣṭarājyapradāyakaḥ |
evaṃ hanumadādyupāsitā mantrā (merau) draṣṭavyāḥ | atha rāmagayatrī tatraiva |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi śatrughnopāsitāṃ parām || 8-497 ||
jayadāṃ rāmagāyatrīmupāsyāṃ sūryavaṃśajaiḥ |
dāśarathayo vidmahe sītāvallabhāya dhīmahitannorāmaḥ pracodayāt |
eṣā syādrāmagāyatrī bhaktānāṃ bhuktimuktidā || 8-498 ||
janmaprabhṛti yat pāpaṃ daśabhiryātimakṣayam | purā kṛtaṃ śatenaiva sahasreṇa japena vā || 8-499 ||
puraścaraṇamasyāśca caturlakṣajapo vidhiḥ | yacca yāvacca pūjādi sarvaṃ pūrvavadācaret || 8-500 ||
tārādireṣā gāyatrī muktimeva prayacchati | māyādirapi vaiśvaryaṃ ramādiśca śriyaṃ parām || 8-501 ||
madanenāpi saṃyukto saṃmohayati medinīm |
atha sītāmantro (vaśiṣṭhasaṃhitāyām)
śrībījaṃ pūrvamuccārya sītāyai padamuddharet || 8-502 ||
vahnijāyānvito mantro bhajatāṃ kalpabhūruhaḥ | janako'sya ṛṣiḥ prokto gāyatrī chanda ucyate || 8-503 ||
sītākhyā yā jagadhātrī devatā sā jaganmayī |
(merutantre)
sītā bhagavatī proktā śrībījaṃ śaktirantyakau || 8-504 ||
dīrghasvarayujā'dyena ṣaḍaṅgāni prakalpayet | pūjayedvaiṣṇave pīṭhe dhyāyedrāghavasaṃyutām || 8-505 ||
svarṇābhāmambujakarāṃ rāmālokanatatparām |
atha balarāmantrastantrāntare |
tārānte balabhadrāya hṛdayaṃ vasuvarṇavān || 8-506 ||
manistu jaiminiśchando gāyatraṃ devatā'sya ca | balarāmo mantravarṇairdvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅgakam || 8-507 ||
atha dhyānam |
śubhrābhragauraṃ nīlābhaṃ vasanaṃ revatīprīyam | dadhānaṃ sīramuśale balarāmaṃ samāśraye || 8-508 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ juhuyāt taddaśāṃśataḥ (-) iti |
atha śrīkṛṣṇamantrāḥ (merutantre)
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi kṛṣṇamantrān mahādbhutān | kṛṣṇaḥ sa eva bhagavān kalidvāparasandhigaḥ || 8-509 ||
vardhayet kalidharmāṇāṃ bhaktānāṃ tāraṇāya saḥ | ekasaptatirūpo'sau pratimanvantare bhavet || 8-510 ||
taduktācaraṇānmokṣastatkṛtācaraṇāccyutiḥ | iti tattvaṃ samākhyātaṃ vibhavasya bhavasya ca | | 511 ||
jātaścādye kaliyuge nānāgopīrate rataḥ | tatkarma kurvatāṃ pātastatsāmarthyaṃ vibhāvinā || 8-512 ||
svadharmaniratānāṃ tu kalau janma prajāyate | tasya mantraṃ pravakṣyāmi bhuktimuktiprasādhanam || 8-513 ||
gopījanavallabhāya svāhāmantro daśākṣaraḥ |
(gītamīye )
gopījanapadasyānte vallabhāya dviṭhāvadhiḥ || 8-513 ||
ayaṃ daśākṣaro mantro dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalapradaḥ | bījapūrvo japaścāsya rahasyaṃ kathitaṃ mune || 8-514 ||
luptabījasvabhāvatvāddaśākṣaramihocyate |
(bṛhadgautamīye)
bhogamokṣaikanilayo luptabījo daśākṣaraḥ || 8-515 ||
uddhāre tu pṛthak tena kāmabījaṃ mahāmune | madyogāt phalado mantro nānyathā kalpakoṭibhiḥ || 8-516 ||
(merutantre)
nārado'sya muniḥ prokto virāṭ chanda udāhṛtam | devatā nandaputraḥ klī(/) bījaṃ śaktiḥ śikhipriyā || 8-517 ||
āviśuḥ pūrvapadakaistrailokyarakṣaṇādikaiḥ | asurāntādikaiścakraśabdaiḥ svāhāntakaiścaret || 8-518 ||
jātiyuktaiśca pañcāṅgaṃ tathā pañcāṅgulīṣvapi | hṛdaye śīrṣake caiva śikhāyāṃ kavace tathā || 8-519 ||
astre pārśvadvaye kaṭyāṃ pṛṣṭhe mūrdhani ca kramāt |
nyāsāntarāṇyuktā dhyānamāha |
evaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena mantrī mantrakalevaram || 8-520 ||
trayyantabodhitaṃ nityaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dhyāyejjagatpatim | pūrvaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ ramyaṃ smaret pūrvaṃ virājitam || 8-521 ||
navīnapallavodrekaphalasampattisaṃyutam | madhupaiḥ kṛtajhaṅkāraiḥ kīrādyaiśca nināditam || 8-522 ||
ādityatanayāpārśvalaharīkaṇaśītalam | tasmin vane kalpataruṃ navapallavaśobhitam || 8-523 ||
svarṇaśākhāgrasaṃyuktaṃ navaratnaphalānvitam | divyāmṛtaughavarṣeṇa sravantaṃ viśvamucchritam || 8-524 ||
jvaladratnasamābaddhāṃ puṣpareṇuvibhūṣitām | ṣaḍūrmirahitāṃ mantrī tasyādhastādbhuvaṃ smaret || 8-525 ||
māṇikyakuṭṭimaṃ tatra yogapīṭhaṃ vicintayet | padmamaṣṭadalaṃ tatra yathoktaṃ raktavarṇakam || 8-526 ||
tasya madhye sukhāsīnaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dhyāyedananyadhīḥ | udyadādityasaṃkāśaṃ prasannavadanaṃ vibhum || 8-527 ||
indranīlamaṇiprakhyaṃ snigdhadīrghaśiroruham | māyūreṇa supicchena rājamānottamāṅgakam || 8-528 ||
bhramarākrāntakalpadrupuṣpasaṃśobhimastakam | kuṭilālakavibhrājadbhālaṃ karṇakṛtotpalam || 8-529 ||
gorocanāktatilakaṃ pūrṇacandranibhaṃ smaret | padmanetraṃ dīptamaṇimakarākṛtikuṇḍalam || 8-530 ||
kapolasthalalāvaṇyavijitasvacchadarpaṇam | atyadbhutonnāsikaṃ ca pakvavimbaphalādharam || 8-531 ||
dāḍimībījaradanaṃ kambusundarakandharam | āraṇyapallavaiḥ puṣpaiḥ kṛtagraiveyasaṃpadam || 8-532 ||
kaustubhaprabhayā dīptaviśālonnatavakṣasam | śrīvatsakāṅkitoraskaṃ vṛṣaskandhaṃ ca hāriṇam || 8-533 ||
ājānulambidordaṇḍaṃ balitrayayutodaram | kṣudraghaṇḍikayā baddhakaṭiṃ graiveyarājitam || 8-534 ||
cakraśaṅkhalasatpadmapītāṃśukapaṭādibhiḥ | kuliśapramukhaiścihnairaṅkitasvacchapattalam || 8-535 ||
mukhāmbujasamāsaktavaṃśacchidrārpitāṅgulim | tadutthadivyasadrāgaśravaṇāhṛtamānasam || 8-536 ||
apāṅgaiḥ prāṇijātaṃ tu mohayantamanāratam | paramānandasandohasaṃpūrṇīkṛtamānasam || 8-537 ||
mukhapadmasamāsaktasvāntanetrābhirāvṛtam | gobhirūdhnabharākrāntamandayānābhireva ca || 8-538 ||
kavalīkṛtasaṃtyaktaghāsaleśābhirapyalam | prastutastanapānena saṃbhṛtānananirgataiḥ || 8-539 ||
ḍiṇḍīrapiṇḍasaṃyuktairdugdhairdṛṣṭimanoharaiḥ | vaṃśavādanasodbhītagītākarṇanalālasaiḥ || 8-540 ||
uttambhinīkṛtaśrotrapuṭayugmaiśca tarṇakaiḥ | kiṃviṣāṇāntarodbhūtijātakaṇḍūtimastakaiḥ || 8-541 ||
parasparavimadārthaṃ khurasparśamahītalaiḥ | snigdhairgurubhirutpucchaiḥ suśobhigalakambalaiḥ || 8-542 ||
vatsavatsāsamūhaiśca saṃvṛtaṃ tadanantaram | kṛtahuṃbhāṣa vajjālairgurudīrghakakudvaraiḥ || 8-543 ||
uccakarṇapuṭāpītaveṇuśabdasudhārasaiḥ | savayaskaiśca gāyadbhirnṛtyadbhistulyabhūṣaṇaiḥ || 8-544 ||
nānāveṣadharairgopaiḥ saṃstuvadbhiḥ samāvṛtam | madhurākṛtibhirbālairaspaṣṭādbhutabhāṣaṇaiḥ || 8-545 ||
śārdūlanakhasaṃkḷptagalākalpaistathā'vṛtam | tato gopapurandhrīṇāṃ smaredvṛndaṃ samāhitaḥ || 8-546 ||
tadbhāvabhāvakallolasaṃjīvitamanobhavam | vallavīvallavagavāṃ devavṇdaṃ bahiḥ smaret || 8-547 ||
saṃmukhe devadevasya kāṅkṣantaṃ dhanasaṃcayam | ṛṣisaṅghaṃ tathā dakṣe vedādhyayanatatparam || 8-548 ||
dharmārthibhiḥ smaret paścāt sanakapramukhā(/)stathā | vāme sastrīkayogīndrān yakṣagandharvakinnarān || 8-549 ||
siddhividyādharā(/)ścāpi cāraṇānapsarogaṇān | anekaśrutisaṃpūrṇavīṇāvādanatatparam || 8-550 ||
ākāśe nāradaṃ dhyāyenmunivaryaṃ gatasmayam |
atha puraścaraṇam |
tataḥ pūrvoktavidhinā dīkṣitaḥ prajapenmanum || 8-551 ||
mantrārthaṃ cintayenmantrī niyamastho jitendriyaḥ | catvāriṃśat sahasrāṇi śvetapadmākṣamālayā || 8-552 ||
paścānmantrasya siddhyarthaṃ daśalakṣaṃ japet sudhīḥ | lakṣaṃ hunedraktapadmaiḥ sitāsarpirmadhuplutaiḥ || 8-553 ||
śarkarāghṛtayuktena havirdravyeṇa vā hunet | tarpayet salilaiḥ śuddhaiścandracandanavāsitaiḥ || 8-554 ||
ātmābhiṣekaṃ kṛtvā'tha bhūdevān pūjayet tataḥ | nānāvidhairbhakṣyabhojyaistāmbūlaiśca sadakṣiṇaiḥ || 8-555 ||
tato nijaguruṃ samyak praṇipratya yathāvidhi | dhanadhānyāmbarādyaiśca vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ || 8-556 ||
toṣayet parayā bhaktyā nijakāryasya siddhaye | tataḥ siddhamanurmantrī prayogān nijavāñchitān || 8-557 ||
kuryādbhaktiyutaḥ samyaṅnityanaimittike rataḥ | tatkāle devakījātaṃ śaṅkhacakragadābujān || 8-558 ||
dadhataṃ pītavasanaṃ sundaraṃ gaganaprabham | niśāyāme caturthyāṃ tu dhyātvā lakṣaṃ japenmanum || 8-559 ||
trimadhvaktaistaddaśāṃśaṃ kiṃśukaprasavairhunet | vīryaṃ prajñāṃ smṛtiṃ prāpya kavīnāmagraṇīrbhavet || 8-560 ||
atha mantrāntaraṃ (śāradāyām)
kṛṣṇāya padamābhāṣya govindāya tataḥ param | gopījanapadasyānte vallabhāya dviṭhāvadhiḥ || 8-561 ||
kāmabījādirākhyāto manuraṣṭādaśākṣaraḥ | nārado'sya muniḥ prokto gāyatraṃ chanda ucyate || 8-562 ||
devatā kathitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ | catuṣkaraṇavedābdhinetrasaṅkhyākṣarakramāt || 8-563 ||
pañcāṅgāni manoḥ kuryānmantravijjñātisaṃyutaiḥ |
dhyānam |
smaredvṛndāvane ramye mohayantamanāratam || 8-564 ||
govindaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ gopakanyāḥ sahasraśaḥ | ātmano vadanāmbhojapreṣitākṣimadhuvratāḥ || 8-565 ||
pīḍitāḥ kāmabāṇena ciramālikhanotsukāḥ | muktāhāralasatpīnatuṅgastanabharānanāḥ || 8-566 ||
srastadhammillavasnā mandaskhalitabhāṣaṇāḥ | dantapaṅktiprabhodbhāsisyandamānādharāñcitāḥ || 8-567 ||
vilobhayantīrvividhairvibhramairbhāvagarvitaiḥ || 8-568ef ||
phullendīvarakāntiminduvadanaṃ varhāvataṃsapriyaṃ śrīvatsāṅkamudārakaustubhadharaṃ pītāmbaraṃ sundaram | gopīnāṃ nayanotpalārcitatanuṃ gogopasaṅghāvṛtaṃ govindaṃ karaveṇuvādanaparaṃ divyāṅgabūṣaṃ bhaje || 8-569 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
mantramenaṃ yathānyāyamayutadvitayaṃ japet | juhuyādaruṇāmbhojairdaśāṃśaṃ susamāhitaḥ || 8-570 ||
atha mantrāntarāṇyuktāni (merutantre)
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi kramājjātā yugatraye | ye mantrā daśavarṇasya bhedāḥ siddhividhāyakāḥ || 8-571 ||
kāmamāyendirāpūrvo māyāśrīkāmapūrvakaḥ | lakṣmīmāyāsmarādyaśca mantrarājo daśākṣaraḥ || 8-572 ||
trayodaśākṣaro mantrastraya ete yugatraye | munyādyantavidhisteṣāṃ paṅktyāmuktavidhānataḥ || 8-573 ||
paṅktyāmiti daśākṣara ityarthaḥ |
dhyānaṃ tṛtīyamantre tu daśārṇavadudāhṛtam | viṃśārṇoktaṃ dvitīye tu prathame'tha nigadyate || 8-574 ||
darāricāpasadbāṇamudgarābjakarāmbujam | veṇumādāya hastābhyāṃ vādayantaṃ mudā'nvitam || 8-575 ||
ravimaṇḍalagaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dhyāyediṣṭaphalāptaye |
atha puraścaraṇam |
bāṇalakṣaṃ japitvā'gnau daśāṃśaṃ haviṣā hunet || 8-576 ||
tarpaṇādi tataḥ kṛtvā siddhamantraḥ samācaret |
atha mantrāntaraṃ tatraiva |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi saptaviṃśatike kalau || 8-577 ||
tāro namo bhagavate vāsudevāya vai vadet | dvādaśārṇo manuḥ prokto nārado'sya munirmataḥ || 8-578 ||
gāyatrī chanda ityuktaṃ śrīkṛṣṇo devatā mataḥ | candranetrābdhibāṇārṇaiḥ saṃpūrṇenāṅgakalpanā || 8-579 ||
dhyānamāha |
kalpadrumatale ramye ratnasiṃhāsane śubhe | sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇaṃ niviṣṭaṃ nandanandanam || 8-580 ||
prastutastanabhāreṇa govṛndena yutaṃ smaret | meghaśyāmaṃ kare daṇḍau hastābhyāṃ bibhrataṃ tathā || 8-581 ||
padmāyatākṣaṃ śaknasya hastikumbhāmṛtasya tu | dhārayā sicyamānaṃ tu dhyātavyo viṣṇuravyayaḥ || 8-582 ||
puraścaraṇamāha |
evaṃ saṃcintya deveśaṃ varṇalakṣaṃ japenmanum | tatsahasrāṇi gokṣīrairjuhuyāt tarpayet tataḥ || 8-583 ||
atha mantrāntaraṃ tantrāntare |
tāraṃhṛdbhagavate rukmiṇīvallabhāya ṭhadvayam | nārado'sya muniḥ proktaśchando'nuṣṭup prakīrttitam || 8-584 ||
rukmiṇīvallabho devaḥ pañcāṅgaṃ māntrikaiḥ padaiḥ || 8-584ef ||
dhyānam |
tāpicchacchaviraṅkagāṃ priyatamāṃ svarṇaprabhāmambuja (-) prodyadvāmabhujāṃsvabāhulatayā'śliṣyatsacittāsmayām | śliṣyantīṃ svayamanyahastavilasatsauvarṇavetraściraṃ pāyādvo'śanasūnapītavasano nānāvibhūṣo hariḥ || 8-585 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
dhyātvaivaṃ rukmiṇīnāthaṃ japellakṣamamuṃ manu | ayutaṃ juhuyāt padmairaruṇairmadhurāplutaiḥ || 8-586 ||
atha mantrāntaraṃ (merau)
athāto nagavedākhye klī(/) kṛṣṇāyāgnigehinī | ṣaḍakṣaro mantrarājo japadhyānādi pūrvavat || 8-587 ||
daśārṇavadityarthaḥ | evaṃ bhūyāṃśo mantrabhedā vistarabhayādupekṣitāḥ | atha buddhamantrastatraiva |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi bauddhamantraṃ mahāphalam | satyatvānna dvijādīnāmadhikāro hi karhicit || 8-588 ||
vāmamārgaratā viprāḥ kuṇḍakā jātivicyutāḥ | hīnā vaidikasaṃskāraiḥ pramādāt svecchatāṃ gatāḥ || 8-589 ||
golakāśca tathā jātyā kāyasthādaya eva ca | bauddhaṃ viṣṇuṃ samārādhya bhuktiṃ muktiṃ prayānti te || 8-590 ||
namo bagavate buddha saṃsārārṇavatāraka | kalikālādahaṃ bhītaḥ śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 8-591 ||
ādyaiḥ padaiścaturbhiśca caraṇadvitayena ca | ṣaḍaṅgavidhirākhyātaḥ pūrṇena vyāpakaṃ triśaḥ || 8-592 ||
atha dhyānam |
padme padmāsanasthaṃ tamūrvornyastakaradvayam | gauraṃ muṇḍitasarvāṅgaṃ dhyānastimitalocanam || 8-592 ||
pustakāsanahastaiśca nānāśiṣyaiśca śobhitam | indrādilokapālaiśca nutaṃ śvetāmbarāvṛtam || 8-593 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ homayecca ghṛtodanam | tulasīmiśrītoyaiśca bhagavantaṃ pratarpayet || 8-594 ||
atha kalkimantrastatraiva |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi kalkimantraṃ mahāphalam | ka(/) kalkine hṛdanto'yaṃ prokto mantraḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ || 8-595 ||
mantrārṇaiśca ṣaḍaṅgāni pūrṇena vyāpakaṃ caret |
atha dhyānam |
dhyāyennīlasamārūḍhaṃ śvetoṣṇīṣavirājitam || 8-596 ||
mahāpratodahastaṃ ca kaustubhoddāmakañcukam | mardayantaṃ mlecchagaṇaṃ krodhaghūrṇitalocanam || 8-597 ||
antarhitairdevamunigandharvaiḥ saṃstutaṃ harim |
atha puraścaraṇam |
ṣaḍlakṣaṃ tu japenmantraṃ sasitaiḥ pāyasairhunet || 8-598 ||
tarpayet salilai śuddhaiḥ prīṇayedbhūsurānapi | evamārādhito mantraḥ saṃgrāme vijayapradaḥ || 8-599 ||
etatsādhanamālokya dūrato duḥkṣitīśvarāḥ | praṇamanti tathā svecchācchatravo yānti saṃśayam || 8-600 ||
dine dine varddhate śrīrmṛto vaikuṇṭhamāpnuyāt |
atha hayagrivamantro (merutantre)
athocyate hayagrīvamantraḥ sarvasamṛddhidaḥ || 8-601 ||
hasāvukārasaṃyuktau vindunā pariśobhito | viprasevyo bījamantro hayagrīvasya cādimaḥ || 8-600 ||
hasāvaukārasaṃyuktau savindū kṣatriyasya tu | hasāvekārasaṃyuktau savindurvaiśyajanmanaḥ || 8-601 ||
triṣṭup chando munirbrahmā hayagrīvo'sva devatā | ṣaḍdīrghayuktabījena ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ || 8-602 ||
atha dhyānam |
kamalaṃ japamālāṃ ca bhayaṃ pustakameva ca | śvetapadmasthitaṃ gauraṃ śvetavastrānulepanam || 8-603 ||
bhaktapriyaṃ hayagrīvaṃ vande'haṃ dānavāntakam |
atha puraścaraṇam |
vedalakṣaṃ japedante daśāṃśaṃ juhuyādghṛtaiḥ || 8-604 ||
sugandhādyaistarpaṇaṃ syānmārjanādviprabhojanāt | siddho mantraḥ prayogārho jāyate bhuktimuktidaḥ || 8-605 ||
atha mantrāntaraṃ (śāradāyām)
udgiratpadamābhāṣya praṇavodgīthaśabdataḥ | sarvavāgīśvaretyantaṃ pravadedīśvaretyatha || 8-606 ||
sarvavedamayācintyapadānte sarvamuccaret | bodhaya dvitayānto'yaṃ mantrastārādirīritaḥ || 8-607 ||
ṛṣirbrahmā'sya saṃdiṣṭaśchando'nuṣṭubudāhṛtam | devatā syāddhayagrīvo vāgaiśvaryaprado vibhuḥ || 8-608 ||
tāreṇa pādairmantrasya pañcāṅgāni prakalpayet || 8-608ef ||
atha dhyānam |
śaracchaśāṅkaprabhamaśvavaktraṃ muktāmayairābharaṇairupetam | rathāṅgaśaṅkhārcitabāhuyugmaṃ jānudvayanyastakaraṃ bhajāmaḥ || 8-609 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ kundapu.ṣpairmadhuplutaiḥ | daśāṃśaṃ vaiṣṇave vahnau juhuyānmantrasiddhaye || 8-610 ||
atha mantrāntaraṃ (merutantre)
atha mantrāntaraṃ vakṣye tīkṣṇabuddhikaraṃ varam | viśvottīrṇasvātmarūpacinmayānandarūpiṇe || 8-611 ||
tubhyaṃ namo hayagrīva vidyārājāya viṣṇave | svāhā so'haṃ ca haṃsādiraṣṭatriṃśākṣaro manuḥ || 8-612 ||
tāramantrapadaiścātra pacāṅgavidhirīritaḥ |
dhyānaṃ pūrvavat | atha puraścaraṇam |
puraścaryā tu ṣaṭtriṃśallakṣo'nyat pūrvavanmatam || 8-613 ||
atha cakramantraḥ (śāradāyām)
tāro bhṛgurviyadbhūyastadādyaṃ vahnidīrghayuk | pāvakaḥ kavacāstrānto manuḥ saptākṣaraḥ smṛtaḥ || 8-614 ||
ahirbudhnyo muniḥ proktaśchando'nuṣṭubudāhṛtam | devatā munibhiḥ proktā cakrarūpī hariḥ svayam || 8-615 ||
ācakrāya hṛdākhyātaṃ vicakrāya śiraḥ smṛtam | sucakrāya śikhā proktā dhīcakrāya tanucchadam || 8-616 ||
saṃcakrāya smṛtaṃ netraṃ jvālācakrāya tatparam | ṣaḍaṅgamantrāḥ pratyekaṃ dviṭhāntā yānti saṃyutāḥ || 8-617 ||
atha dhyānam |
kalpāntārkaprakāśaṃ tribhuvanamakhilaṃ tejasā purayantaṃ raktākṣaṃ piṅgakeśaṃ ripukulabhayadaṃ bhīmadaṃṣṭrāṭṭa(-)hāsam | cakraṃ śaṅkhaṃ gadābje pṛthutaramuśalaṃ cāpapāśāṅkuśān vai vibhrāṇaṃ dorbhirādyaṃ manasi suraripuṃ bhāvayeccakra(-)saṃjñam || 8-618 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
arkalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ juhuyāt tatsahasrakam | tilaiḥ sasarṣapaiḥ padmairvilvairdugdhodanaiḥ kramāt || 8-619 ||
athānantamantrastatraiva |
athānyaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi viṣṇoḥ prītikaraṃ manum | anantāya namaśceti ṣaḍarṇo'yamudāhṛtaḥ || 8-620 ||
vyāso muniśca gāyatrī chando'nantaśca devatā | niyogo roganāśārthamanyadgovindavadbhavet || 8-621 ||
atha gopālasundarīmantrastatraiva |
atha mārgadvayopāsyāṃ vakṣye gopālasundarīm | māyāśrīkāmabījāni kṛṣṇāyeti tato vadet || 8-622 ||
ekonatriṃśakaṃ varṇaṃ rudradevasvarau tathā | pañcamaṃ ca trapābījamebhiḥ saptamakūṭakam || 8-623 ||
govindāya padaṃ paścāccitraiśvaryādyakūṭakam | gopījanavallabhāya tataśca sakalatrapām || 8-624 ||
kūṭarūpāṃ samuccārya vadedvahneśca gehinī | trayoviṃśākṣaro mantro bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ || 8-625 ||
munirvidhātā dakṣe syādvāme tvānandabharavaḥ | chandastu devī gāyatrī devo gopālasundarī || 8-626 ||
tritrivedābdhivedābdhivarṇaiḥ kūṭavihīnitaiḥ | ṣaḍaṅgavidhiruddiṣṭo mantravarṇān nyaset tanau || 8-627 ||
nyāsāntarāṇyuktvā dhyānamāha |
kamalāvasudhāyuktaṃ dhyāyecchrīcakragaṃ harim | kṣīrāmbhodhau sitadvīpe vane kalpadrumādibhiḥ || 8-629 ||
vyāpte tasmin svarṇamayaṃ cintayedratnamaṇḍapam | tatra śrīpīṭhamadhye tu sthitaṃ vidhimukhaiḥ stutam || 8-630 ||
padmamaṣṭadalaṃ śaṅkhaṃ varṇān vaṃśīśca dakṣiṇaiḥ | bhujairdadhantaṃ vāmaistu cāpaṃ pāśaṃ tathā'ṅkuśam || 8-631 ||
vipañcīṃ cāraktavarṇaṃ nānābharaṇabhūṣitam | pītāmbaradharaṃ gopīsamūhaiḥ parito vṛtam || 8-632 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
lakṣamekaṃ japenmantraṃ juhuyāt pāyasā'ndhasā | tarpaṇādi tataḥ kuryānmantrasiddhiḥ prajāyate || 8-633 ||
atha śrīdharamantrastatraiva |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi śrīdharasya manuṃ param | ramāruḍhaṃ kāmabījaṃ śrīdharāya tato vadet || 8-634 ||
trailokyamohanāyeti namo'ntaḥ ṣoḍaśākṣaraḥ | ṛṣirbrahmā bhavecchando gāyatraṃ śrīdharaḥ suraḥ || 8-635 ||
śrībījena ṣaḍaṅgāni kuryāt ṣaḍdīrghasaṃyujā |
atha dhyānam |
udghāṭye ca site dvīpe sarvarttuphalitadrume || 8-636 ||
tatra kalpadrumādhastāt pakṣīndraracitāsane | śaṅkhacakragadāpadmapāṇiṃ cāmīkaradyutim || 8-637 ||
kirīṭinaṃ kuṇḍalinaṃ śrīvatsāṅkitavakṣasam | hṛdi lakṣmīdharaṃ dhyāyecchrīdharaṃ puruṣārthadam || 8-638 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
lakṣamekaṃ japenmantraṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ rghṛtairhunet | tarpaṇādi tataḥ kuryāt pūrvavat sādhakottamaḥ || 8-639 ||
tarpaṇādi tataḥ kuryāt pūrvavat sādhakottamaḥ |
iti viṣṇuprakaraṇam |
atha śaivamantrāḥ |
(śāradāyām)
atha vakṣye maheśasya mantrān sarvārthasiddhidān || 8-640 ||
yaiḥ pūrvamṛṣayaḥ proktāḥ śivasāyujyamañjasā | hṛdayaṃ vaparaṃ sākṣi lānto'nantānvito maruta || 8-642 ||
pañcākṣaro manuḥ proktastārādyo'yaṃ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ |
etanmantrārtha ukto (vāmadevasaṃhitāyām)
oṃkāraḥ paripūrṇasya brahmaṇo vācakaḥ smṛtaḥ || 8-643 ||
namaḥśabdo namaskāravācakaḥ parikīrttitaḥ | prahvatvalakṣaṇaḥ prokto namaskāraḥ purātanaiḥ || 8-644 ||
prahvatā nāma jīvasya śivāt satyādilakṣaṇāt | bhedena bhāsamānasya māyayā sarvarūpataḥ || 8-645 ||
sambandhaṃ nama ityāha śivatādātmyalakṣaṇam | satyajñānaparānandasvarūpā cit kalā'parā || 8-646 ||
ativyaktatayā jñeyā śivaśabdena śāmbhavi | vācako'yaṃ tataḥ śabdo brahmaṇaścitkalātmanaḥ || 8-647 ||
ṛṣyādinyāsamāha |
vāmadevo muniśchandaḥ paṅktirīśo'sya devatā | ṣaḍbhirvarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni kuryānmantrasya deśikaḥ || 8-648 ||
atha dhyānam |
dhyāyennityaṃ maheśaṃ rajatagirinibhaṃ cārucandrāvataṃsaṃ ratnākalpojjvalāṅgaṃ paraśumṛgavarābhītihastaṃ prasannam | pramāsīnaṃ samantāt stutamamaragaṇairvyāghrakṛttiṃ vasānaṃ viśvādyaṃ viśvavandyaṃ nikhilabhayaharaṃ pañcavaktraṃ trinetram || 8-649 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
tattvalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ dīkṣitaḥ śaivavartmanā | tāvatsaṅkhyāsahasrāṇi juhuyāt pāyasaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 8-650 ||
tataḥ siddho bhavenmantraḥ sādhakābhīṣṭasiddhidaḥ |
atha mantrāntaraṃ tatraiva |
ṣaḍakṣaraḥ śaktiruddhaḥ kathito'ṣṭākṣaro manuḥ || 8-651 ||
ṛṣiśchandaḥ purā prokto devatā syādumāpatiḥ | aṅgāni pūrvamuktāni somamīśaṃ vicintayet || 8-652 ||
atha dhyānam |
bandhūkābhaṃ trinetraṃ śaśiśakaladharaṃ smeravaktraṃ vahantaṃ hastaiḥ śūlaṃ kapālaṃ varadamabhayadaṃ cāruhāraṃ bhajāmi | vāmorustambhagāyāḥ karatalavilasaccāruraktotpalāyā hastenāśliṣṭadehaṃ maṇimayavilasadbhūṣaṇāyāḥ priyāyāḥ || 8-653 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
manulakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ tatsahasraṃ yathāvidhi | juhuyānmadhurāsiktairāragbadhasamidvaraiḥ || 8-654 ||
mantrāntaramāha |
sāntaḥ sadyāntasaṃyukto vindubhūṣitamastakaḥ | prāsādākhyo manuḥ prokto bhajatāṃ sarvasiddhidaḥ || 8-655 ||
ṣaḍadīrghayuktabījena ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ | vāmadevo muniśchandaḥ paṅktirdevaḥ sadāśivaḥ || 8-656 ||
iśānādīrnyasenmūrtīraṅguṭhādiṣu deśikaḥ | īśānākhyaṃ tatpuruṣamaghoraṃ tadanantaram || 8-657 ||
vāmadevāhvayaṃ sadyamādyaṃ bījaṃ kramādviduḥ |
atha dhyānam |
tataḥ samāhito bhūtvā dhyāyeddevaṃ sadāśivam || 8-658 ||
muktāpītapayodamauktikajapāvarṇairmukhaiḥ pañcabhi(-) stryakṣairañcitamīśamindumukuṭaṃ pūrṇendukoṭiprabham | śūlaṃ ṭaṅkakṛpāṇavajradahanān nāgendraghaṇṭāṅkuśān pāśaṃ bhītiharaṃ dadhānamamitākalpojjvalaṃ cintayet || 8-659 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
evaṃ dhyātvā japenmantraṃ pañcalakṣaṃ madhuplutaiḥ | prasūnaiḥ karavīrotthairjuhuyāt taddaśāṃśakam || 8-660 ||
mantrāntaramāha |
tāro māyā viyadvindumanusvarasamanvitam | pañcākṣarasamāyukto vasuvarṇomanurmataḥ || 8-661 ||
pañcākṣaroktavat kuryādaṅganyāsādikaṃ budhaḥ || 8-661ef ||
dhyānam |
vande sindūravarṇaṃ maṇimukuṭalasaccārucandrāvataṃsaṃ bhālodyannetramīśaṃ smitamukhakamalaṃ divyabhūṣāṅgarāgam | vāmorunyastapāṇestaruṇakuvalayaṃ saṃdadhatyā priyāyā vṛttottuṅgastanāgre nihitakaratalaṃ vedaṭaṅkeṣṭahastam || 8-662 ||
atha puraścaraṇm |
aṣṭalakṣaṃ japedevaṃ manuṃ vedavidāṃ varaḥ | tatsahasraṃ prajuhuyāt pāyasānnairghṛtaplutaiḥ || 8-663 ||
atha mṛtyuñjayamantrastatraiva |
tāraṃ sthirā sakarṇendurbhṛguḥ sargavibhūṣitaḥ akṣarātmā nigadito manurmṛtyuñjayātmakaḥ || 8-664 ||
ṛṣiḥ kaholo devyādirgāyatrī chanda īritam | mṛtyuñjayo mahādevo devatā'sya samīritaḥ || 8-665 ||
bhṛguṇā dīrghayuktena ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret || 8-665ef ||
atha dhyānam |
candrārkāgnivilocanaṃ smitamukhaṃ padmadvayāntaḥsthitaṃ mudrāpāśamṛgākṣasūtravilasatpāṇiṃ himāṃśuprabham | koṭirendugalatsudhāplutatanuṃ hārādibhūṣojjvalaṃ kāntyā viśvamanoharaṃ paśupatiṃ mṛtyuñjayaṃ bhāvayet || 8-666 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
guṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ viśāladhīḥ | juhuyādamṛtākhaṇḍaiḥ śuddhadugdhājyalolitaiḥ || 8-667 ||
atha dakṣiṇāmūrtimantrastatraiva |
atha vakṣye mantraratnaṃ samstapuruṣārthadam | avāpūryena japtena divyaṃ jñānaṃ munīśvarāḥ || 8-668 ||
dakṣiṇāmūrttaye pūrvaṃ tubhyaṃ padamanantaram | vaṭamūlapadasyānte padaṃ paścānnivāsine || 8-669 ||
dhyānaikaniratāṅgāya paścādbrūyānnamaḥpadam | rudrāya śambhave tāraśaktiruddho'yamīritaḥ || 8-670 ||
ṣaṭtriṃśadakṣaro mantraḥ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ | muniḥ śukaḥ samuddiṣṭaśchando'nuṣṭup samīritam || 8-671 ||
dakṣiṇāmūrtināmā'sya devatā śambhurīritaḥ | ṣaḍbhirvarṇairhṛdākhyātaṃ dvābhyāṃ śira udīritam || 8-672 ||
śikhā'ṣṭabhiḥ samādiṣṭā vasvarṇaiḥ kavacaṃ matam | pañcabhirnetramākhyātaṃ tribhirastramudāhṛtam || 8-673 ||
ṣaḍete tāraśaktyādyāstārādyantāḥ sajātayaḥ | aṅgamantrāḥ samuddiṣṭā yathāvaddeśikottamaiḥ || 8-674 ||
atha dhyānam |
hemācalataṭe ramye siddhakinnarasevite | vividhadrumaśākhābhiḥ sarvato vāritātape || 8-675 ||
supuṣpitairlatājālairāśliṣṭakusumadrume | śilāvivaranirgacchannirjharānilaśītale || 8-676 ||
gāyadbhṛṅgāṅganāsaṅghe nṛtyadvarhikadambake | kūjatkokilasaṅghena mukharīkṛtadiṅmukhe || 8-677 ||
parasparavinirmuktamātsaryamṛgasevite | ādyaiḥ śukādyairmunibhirajasraṃ samupasthite || 8-678 ||
purandaramukhairdevaiḥ sevāyātairvilokitam | vaṭavṛkṣaṃ mahocchrāyaṃ padmarāgaphalojjvalam || 8-679 ||
gārutmatamayaiḥ patrairniviḍairupaśobhitam | navaratnamayākalpairlambamānairalaṅkṛtam || 8-680 ||
jalajaiḥ sthalajaiḥ puṣpairāmodibhiralaṅkṛtam | śṛṇvadbhirvedaśāstrāṇi śukavṛndairniṣevitam || 8-681 ||
saṃsāratāpavicchedakuśalasthalamadbhutam | vicintya tasya mūlasthe satnasiṃhāsane śubhe || 8-682 ||
āsīnamamitākalpaṃ śaraccandranibhānanam | stūyamānaṃ munigaṇairdivyajñānābhilāṣibhiḥ || 8-683 ||
saṃsmarejjagatāmādyaṃ dakṣiṇāmūrttimavyayam || 8-683ef ||
kailāśādrinibhaṃ śaśāṅkaśakalasphūrjajjaṭāmaṇḍitaṃ nāsālokanatatparaṃ trinayanaṃ vīrāsanādhyāsinam | mudrāṭaṅkakuraṅgajānuvilasatpāṇiprasannānanaṃ kakṣābaddhabhujaṅgamaṃ munivṛtaṃ vande maheśaṃ param || 8-684 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
ayutadvayasaṃyuktaṃ guṇalakṣaṃ japenmanum | taddaśāṃśaṃ tilaiḥ śuddhairjuhuyāt kṣīrasaṃyutaiḥ || 8-685 ||
atha mantrāntaraṃ tatraiva |
praṇavo hṛdayaṃ paścāt tato bhagavate padam | ṅeyutaṃ dakṣiṇāmūrttiṃ mahyaṃ medhāmudīrayet || 8-686 ||
prayaccha ṭhadvayānto'yaṃ dvāviṃśatyakṣaro manuḥ | muniścaturmukhaśchando gāyatrī devatā manoḥ || 8-687 ||
dakṣiṇāmūrttirākhyāto vedavyākhyānatatparaḥ | tāraruddhaiḥ svarairdīrghaiḥ ṣaḍbhiraṅgāni kalpayet || 8-688 ||
athavā manusambhūtaiḥ padairvā kalpayet kramāt | pūrvoktavaṭamūlasthaṃ cintayenmantranāyakam || 8-689 ||
atha dhyānam |
sphaṭikarajatavarṇaṃ mauktikīmakṣamālā (-) mamṛtakalaśavidyājñānamudrākarāgraiḥ | dadhatamuragakakṣaṃ candracūḍaṃ trinetraṃ vidhṛtavividhabhūṣaṃ dakṣiṇāmūrttimīḍe || 8-690 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
lakṣamekaṃ japenmantraṃ brahmacārivrate sthitaḥ | juhuyāt saghṛtaiḥ padmairdaśāṃśaṃ saṃskṛte'nale || 8-691 ||
atha nīlakaṇṭhamantrastatraiva |
lohito'gnyāsanaḥ sadyavindumān prathamaṃ tataḥ | dvitīyaṃ vahnibījasthā dīrghāśāntīndubhūṣitā || 8-692 ||
tṛtīyaṃ lāṅgalī sargī mantro bījatrayānvitaḥ || nīlakaṇṭhātmakaḥ prokto viṣadvayaharaḥ paraḥ || 8-693 ||
haradvayaṃ vahnijāyā hṛdayaṃ parikīrttitam | kapardine ṭhayugalaṃ śiromantra udāhṛtaḥ || 8-694 ||
nīlakaṇṭhāya ṭhadvayaṃ śikhāmantra udāhṛtaḥ | kālakūṭapadasyānte viṣabhakṣaṇaṃ ṅeyutam || 8-695 ||
hu(/) phaṭ kavacamādiṣṭaṃ vidvadbhirnīlakaṇṭhine | svāhāntamastrametāni pañcāṅgāni manorviduḥ || 8-696 ||
atha dhyānam |
bālārkāyutatejasaṃ dhṛtajaṭājūṭendukhaṇḍojjvalaṃ nāgendraiḥ kṛtabhūṣaṇaṃ japavaṭīṃ śūlaṃ kapālaṃ karaiḥ | khaṭvāṅgaṃ dadhataṃ trinetravilasatpañcānanaṃ sundaraṃ vyāghratvakparidhānamajñanilayaṃ śrīnīlakaṇṭhaṃ bhaje || 8-697 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
lakṣatrayaṃ japenmantraṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ sasarpiṣā | haviṣā juhuyāt samyak saṃskṛte havyavāhane || 8-698 ||
athārdhanārīśvaramantrastatraiva |
agniḥ saṃvarttakādityarānilāḥ ṣaṣṭhavindumat | cintāmaṇiriti khyātaṃ bījaṃ sarvasamṛddhidam || 8-699 ||
kaśyapo munirākhyātaśchando'nuṣṭubudāhṛtam | ardhanārīśvaraḥ prokto devatā jagatāṃ patiḥ || 8-700 ||
rephādirvyañjanaḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ kuryādaṅgāni ṣaṭkramāt || 8-700ef ||
atha dhyānam |
nīlaprabhātaruciraṃ vilasattrinetraṃ pāśāruṇotpalakapālatriśūlahastam | ardhāmbikeśamaniśaṃ pravibhaktabhūṣaṃ bālendubaddhamukuṭaṃ praṇamāmi rūpam || 8-701 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
ekalakṣaṃ japedbījamitthaṃ mantrī vicintayet | ayutaṃ madhunā siktairjuhuyāt tilataṇḍulaiḥ || 8-702 ||
atha śarabhamantro (merutantre)
oṃ kha(/) khā(/) kha(/) phaḍuccārya dviḥ prāṇān grasatīti ca | hu(/) phaṭ sarvaśastrasaṃharaṇāya śarabheti ca || 8-702 ||
śālvāya pakṣirājāya hu(/) phaṭ svāhāntako manuḥ | ekacatvāriṃśadarṇo vāsudevo muniḥ smṛtaḥ || 8-703 ||
kālāgnirudraḥ śarabho devatā parikīrttitaḥ | chandastu jagatī svāhā śaktīrbījaṃ khamucyate || 8-704 ||
vedaṣaṭsaptanavaṣaṇṇavārṇairaṅgakalpanam |
atha dhyānam |
candrārkāgnitrinayanaṃ kālīdurgādvipakṣakam || 8-705 ||
vidyujjihvaṃ vajranakhaṃ vaḍavāgnyudaraṃ tathā | vyādhimṛtyuripughnaṃ ca caṇḍavātātiveginam || 8-706 ||
hṛdbhairavasvarūpaṃ ca vairivṛndaniṣūdanam | mṛgastvardhaśarīreṇa pakṣābhyāṃ cañcunā dvijaḥ || 8-707 ||
adhovaktraścatuṣpādastūrdhvavaktraścaturbhujaḥ | kālāntadahanaprakhyo nīlajīmūtaniḥśvanaḥ || 8-708 ||
ariryaddarśanādeva vinaṣṭabalavikramaḥ | saṭācchaṭograrūpāya pakṣavikṣiptabhūbhṛte || 8-709 ||
aṣṭapādāya rudrāya namaḥ śarabhamūrttaye |
puraścaraṇamāha |
evaṃ dhyāyan sahasraṃ tu prajapet pāyasaṃ hunet || 8-710 ||
pratyahaṃ māsaṣaṭkeṇa mantrasiddhiḥ prajāyate |
atha kṣetrapālamantraḥ (śāradāyām)
varṇāntyamauvinduyuktaṃ kṣetrapālāya hṛnmanuḥ || 8-711 ||
tārādyo vasuvarṇo'yaṃ kṣetrapālasya kīrttitaḥ | ṣaḍdīrghabhājā bījena ṣaḍaṅgānyasya yojayet || 8-712 ||
atha dhyānam |
nīlāñjanādrinibhamūrdhvapiśaṅgakeśaṃ vṛttogralocanamupāttagadākapālam | āśāmbaraṃ bhujagabhūṣaṇamugradaṃṣṭram kṣetreśamadbhutatanuṃ praṇamāmi devam || 8-713 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
lakṣamekaṃ japenmantraṃ juhuyāt taddaśāṃśataḥ | caruṇā ghṛtasiktena tataḥ kṣetreśamarcayet || 8-714 ||
athāpaduddhāravaṭukamantrastatraiva |
uddharedvaṭukaṃ ṅe'ntamāpaduddhāraṇaṃ tathā | kurudvayaṃ punarṅentaṃ vaṭukaṃ taṃ samuddharet || 8-715 ||
ekaviṃśatyakṣarātmā śaktiruddho mahāmanuḥ | abhīṣṭaphalasaṃsiddhyai kīrttitaḥ surapādapaḥ || 8-716 ||
bṛhadāraṇyaka ṛṣiśchando'nuṣṭubudāhṛtam | āpāduddhāraṇo devo bhairavo devatā budhaiḥ || 8-717 ||
aṅgulīdehavaktreṣu mūrttīrnyasyedyathā purā | sadyādipañcahrasvāḍhyaṃ śaktibījapuraḥsaram || 8-718 ||
vakāraṃ pañcahrasvāḍhyamīśānādiṣu yojayet | ṣaḍdīrghayuktayā śaktyā vakāreṇa ca tadvatā || 8-719 ||
aṅgāni jātiyuktāni praṇavādyādi kalpayet |
atha dhyānam |
tasya dhyānaṃ tridhā proktaṃ sāttvikādivibhedataḥ || 8-720 ||
vande bālaṃ sphaṭikasadṛśaṃ kuṇḍalollāsi vaktraṃ divyākalpairnavamaṇimayaiḥ kiṅkiṇīnūpurāḍhyaiḥ | dīptākāraṃ visadavasanaṃ suprasannaṃ trinetraṃ hastājñābhyāṃ vaṭukamaniśaṃ śūladaṇḍau dadhānam || 8-721 ||
udyadbhāskarasannibhaṃ trinayanaṃ raktāṅgarāgasrajaṃ smerāsyaṃ varadaṃ kapālamabhayaṃ śūlaṃ dadhānaṃ karaiḥ | nīlagrīvamudārabhūṣaṇadharaṃ śītāṃśucūḍojjvalaṃ bandhūkāruṇavāsasaṃ bhayaharaṃ devaṃ sadā bhāvayet || 8-722 ||
dhyāyennīlādrikāntaṃ śaśiśakaladharaṃ muṇḍamālaṃ maheśaṃ digvastraṃ piṅgakeśaṃ ḍamarumatha śṛṇiṃ khaḍgapāśābhayāni | nāgaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ kapālaṃ karasarasiruhairbibhrataṃ bhīmadaṃṣṭraṃ sarpākalpaṃ trinetraṃ maṇimayavilasatkiṅkiṇīnūpurāḍhyam || 8-723 ||
sāttvikaṃ dhyānamākhyātamapamṛtyunivāraṇam | āyurārogyajananamapavargaphalapradam || 8-724 ||
rājasaṃ dhyānamākhyātaṃ dharmakāmārthasiddhidam | tāmasaṃ śatruśamanaṃ kṛtyābhūtagrahāpaham || 8-725 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ haviṣyāśī jitendriyaḥ | taddaśāṃśaṃ prajuhuyāt tilairmadhurasaṃyutaiḥ || 8-726 ||
atha pāśupatāstramantraḥ (śāradāyām)
tāro vānto dharāsaṃstho vāmanetrendubhūṣitaḥ | pārśvo vakaḥ karṇayuto varmāstrāntaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ || 8-727 ||
manuḥ pāśupatāstrākhyo grahakṣudranivāraṇaḥ | ṣaḍbhirvarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni hu(/) phaḍantaiḥ sajātibhiḥ || 8-728 ||
atha dhyānam |
madhyāhnārkasamaprabhaṃ śaśidharaṃ bhīmādṛhāsojjvalaṃ tryakṣaṃ pannagabhūṣaṇaṃ śikhiśikhāśmaśrusphuranmūrdhajam | hastājñaistriśikhaṃ samudgaramasiṃ śaktiṃ dadhānaṃ vibhuṃ daṃṣṭrābhīmacaturmukhaṃ paśupatiṃ divyāstrarūpaṃ smaret || 8-729 ||
puraścaraṇam |
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ juhuyāt taddaśāṃśataḥ | gavyena sarpiṣā mantrī saṃskṛte havyavāhane || 8-730 ||
atha hariharamantrastantrāntare |
māyāṃ pūrvaṃ samuddhṛtya prāsādaṃ tata uddharet | tataḥ śaṅkaranārāyaṇāya hṛtpraṇavādikaḥ || 8-731 ||
trayodaśākṣaro mantraścaturvargaphalapradaḥ | nārado'sya ṛṣiḥ proktaśchando'nuṣṭup prakīrttitam || 8-732 ||
trailokyavandyapādājño devatā hariśaṅkaraḥ | ṣaḍaṅgāni prakūrvīta dīrghaṣaṭkāḍhyamāyayā || 8-733 ||
atha dhyānam |
śūlaṃ cakraṃ pāñcajanyamabhītiṃ dadhataṃ karaiḥ | svasvabhūṣācchanīlārdhadehaṃ hariharaṃ bhaje || 8-734 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
lakṣamekaṃ japenmantraṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ ghṛtaplutaiḥ | pāyasairhavanaṃ kuryāt saṃskṛte havyavāhane || 8-735 ||
iti śivaprakaraṇam |
atha gaurīmantraḥ (siddhantasaṃgrahe)
hrī(/) gauri rudradayite yogeśvari padaṃ vadet | hu(/) phaṭ svāhā ṣoḍaśārṇo gaurīmantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 8-736 ||
ajo munistathā'nuṣṭup chando gauryasya devatā | māyayā tu ṣaḍaṅgāni kuryāt ṣaḍdīrghayuktayā || 8-737 ||
dhyānam |
hemābhāṃ bibhratīṃ dorbhirdarpaṇāñjanasādhane | pāśāṅkuśau divyabhūṣāṃ gaurīṃ devīmupāsmahe || 8-738 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
lakṣamekaṃ japenmantraṃ daśāṃśaṃ juhuyādghṛtaiḥ | tarpaṇādyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā kāmyakarmāṇi sādhayet || 8-739 ||
atha mantrāntaraṃ vakṣye māyābījaṃ samuddharet | ṅe'ntāṃ bhavānīmuccārya namaḥ śeṣe prakīrttayet || 8-740 ||
nyāsajālaṃ purā proktaṃ devīṃ dhyāyet samāhitaḥ |
dhyānaṃ yathā |
bālārkābhāṃ trinayanāṃ khaḍgakheṭavarābhayān || 8-741 ||
dorbhirdadhānāṃ siṃhasthāṃ bhavānīṃ bhāvayet sadā |
asya puraścaraṇaṃ pūrvavadekalakṣajapaḥ |
iti bhavānīprakaraṇam |
atha garuḍamantro (merutantre)
vakṣye'tha gāruḍaṃ mantraṃ kṣipatāro'gnigehinī || 8-742 ||
pañcākṣaro manuḥ paṅktiśchando'nanto mato muniḥ | devatā garuḍastāro bījaṃ śaktirdahāṅganā || 8-743 ||
svāhānto hṛdaye nyasyo jvalajvala mahāmate | rudracūḍānana svāhā'ṅgasyānte mastake nyaset || 8-744 ||
garuḍānte śikhe svāhā śikhāyā manurīritaḥ | varmamantrastu garuḍa prabhañjayayugaṃ vadet || 8-745 ||
dviḥ prabhedaya vitrāsaya duṣṭapaṅktiṃ vimardaya | svāhā saptatriṃśadarṇo netramantro'tha kathyate || 8-746 ||
ugrarūpadharetyuktvā sarvaṃviṣahareti ca | bhīṣaya dvitayaṃ sarvaṃ dahayugmaṃ tato vadet || 8-747 ||
bhasmīkuru kuru svāhā dantavarṇo mato manuḥ | astramantro'pratihatabalāpratihateti ca || 8-748 ||
śāsanānte vadeddhu(/) phaṭ svāhānto'ṣṭādaśākṣaraḥ |
atha dhyānam |
cañcvagrapracaladbhogī bhogaṃ mukuṭamaṇḍitam || 8-749 ||
pakṣoccāritasatsāmagānaṃ viṣaharaṃ bhaje |
asya puraścaraṇaṃ pañcalakṣajapaḥ |
pañcalakṣaṃ japenmanum (----) iti tatraivoktatvāt |
tathā |
tilairhunet tarpaṇādi kṛtvā siddho manurbhavet || 8-750 ||
darśanāduragāstasya naṣṭā naśyedviṣadvayam | viṣṇubhaktiparo bhūyāt svayamevārināśanaḥ || 8-751 ||
iha loke sukhī dīrghajīvī bhūpatipūjitaḥ |
paratra yāti vaikuṇṭham (-----------------------------) ityādi |
atha kārttavīryamantrastatraiva |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi viṃśanmantrā(/)stu dakṣiṇe || 8-752 ||
āmnāye yatsādhakānāmakleśādaṣṭasiddhayaḥ | dvāviṃśatturyau tārādyau dakṣe vāme saturyakau || 8-753 ||
caturdaśasvaropetau śeṣāmnāyeṣu tadbhavet | vinduyuktaṃ tvādyabījaṃ caturthasvarasaṃyutam || 8-754 ||
ṣaṭtriṃśatturyau vindvāḍhyau dvitīyaṃ bījamucyate | kāmabījaṃ tṛtīyaṃ syāddvādaśārṇaṃ caturthakau || 8-755 ||
ṣaṣṭhasvarendusaṃyuktau caturthaṃ bījamucyate | pāśo lajjā'ṅkuśo lakṣmīkavacāstramidaṃ bhavet || 8-756 ||
bījānāṃ daśakaṃ ṅe'ntaḥ kārttavīryārjuno namaḥ | ekonaviṃśatyarṇo'yaṃ dattātreyo muniḥ smṛtaḥ || 8-757 ||
chando'nuṣṭup kārttavīryārjuno devaḥ prakīrttitaḥ | phrā(/) brāmiti syāddhṛdayaṃ klī(/) bhrīmiti śiraḥ smṛtam || 8-758 ||
oṃ hū(/) śikhā samākhyātā kre(/) śre(/) kavacamīritam | hu(/) phaḍastraṃ samākhyātaṃ śeṣeṇa vyāpakaṃ caret || 8-759 ||
nyāsāntarāṇyuktvā dhyānamāha |
prabhākararuciḥsvarṇakaṇṭhamālāvirājitaḥ | dhyeyo raktāṃśukiṣṇīṣī nānākalpavibhūṣitaḥ || 8-760 ||
sahasrārdhabhujairbāṇān sahasrārdhairdhanūṃṣi ca | dadhaṭṭaṅkāraśabdaiśca trāsitākhiladurjanaḥ || 8-761 ||
samyagbāṇāsanārūḍhaḥ saptadvīpadharāpatiḥ | bhūpālamukuṭāghṛṣtapādapadmojñalocanaḥ || 8-762 ||
sthūlakāyo'tibhīmaśca rathastho bhaktavatsalaḥ |
atha puraścaraṇam |
caturlakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ homaḥ kāryaḥ payondhasā || 8-763 ||
tilājyataṇḍulairvā'pi puraścaryā sarittaṭe | tarpaṇādi tataḥ kuryānmantrasiddhiḥ prajāyate || 8-764 ||
atha mantrabhedāḥ |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi kārttavīryamanorbhidaḥ | ekānaviṃśatyarṇo'yaṃ tārādirnakhavarṇakaḥ || 8-765 ||
chandarṣinyāsapūjādi sarvaṃ pūrvavadīritam | dvitīyo'yaṃ bheda ukto bhajatāmiṣṭadāyakaḥ || 8-766 ||
kārttavīryārjunāyeti namo mūlaṃ navākṣaram | phro(/) pūrvako daśārṇo'yaṃ virāṭ chanda udīritam || 8-767 ||
sarvārthasiddhaye cāsya niyogo'nyat tu pūrvavat | nyāsapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ bhedo'yaṃ tu tṛtīyakaḥ || 8-768 ||
phro(/) śrī(/) pūrvo navārṇastu bhavedekādaśākṣaraḥ | prāgvanmunyādikaṃ sarvaṃ chandastraiṣṭubhamucyate || 8-769 ||
niyogastambhanāyāsya caurāṇāṃ vasuhāriṇām | prāgvat pūjāprayogādi turyo bhedo nirūpitaḥ || 8-770 ||
phro(/) klī(/) pūrvo navārṇastu bhavedekādaśākṣaraḥ | naranārīnṛpāṇāṃ ca mohanāya niyojanam || 8-771 ||
muniśchandomukhaṃ prāgvat prayogā(/)ścāpi sādhayet | evaṃ tu pañcamo bhedo mantrasya parikīrttitaḥ || 8-772 ||
phro(/) bhrū(/) pūrvo navārṇastu ṣaṣṭho bhedaśca pūrvavat | munyādi bhramaṇoccāṭadveṣamāraṇakarmakṛt || 8-773 ||
phro(/) hrīmante navārṇastu bhedaḥ saptamako bhavet | vaśyaṃ pāpakṣayaṃ mohaṃ śubhaṃ ca tanute sadā || 8-774 ||
phro(/) mā(/) navākṣaraśceti hyaṣṭamo'rcādi pūrvavat | ākarṣaṇāya caurāṇāṃ niyogaḥ parikīrttitaḥ || 8-775 ||
phro(/) kro(/) navārṇo navamo bhedaḥ pūjādi pūrvavat | vākstambhe vā gatistambhe niyogaḥ parikīrttitaḥ || 8-776 ||
phro(/) śrī(/) navākṣaraśceti daśamo bheda ucyate | triṣṭup chando'nyadakhilamūnaviṃśativadbhavet || 8-777 ||
phro(/) vāgbījaṃ navārṇaśca bheda ekādaśaḥ smṛtaḥ | hu(/) phaḍnavārṇa iti ca dvādaśārcādi pūrvavat || 8-778 ||
tṛtīyabhedastārādyo mantra ekādaśākṣaraḥ | trayodaśastu bhedo'yaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvavadīritam || 8-779 ||
evaṃ bhedāścaturthādyāḥ sapta praṇavapūrvakāḥ | dvādaśādyāḥ sapta mantrā jagatīcchandaso matāḥ || 8-780 ||
prāgvanmunyādikaṃ sarvaṃ prayogaḥ pūrvavanmataḥ | dakṣiṇāmnāyagāścaite viṃśanmantrāḥ prakīrttitāḥ || 8-781 ||
athordhvāmnāye |
oṃ namaḥ kārttavīryārjunāya varmāstraṭhadvayam | caturdaśārṇamantro'yamaṣṭamaḥ parikīrttitaḥ || 8-782 ||
bhūnetrasaptanetrākṣivarṇairasyāṅgapañcakam | ekonaviṃsadarṇasya munyādyamakhilaṃ matam || 8-783 ||
atha mālāmantraḥ |
tāro namo bhagavate tataḥ śrīpadamuccaret | kārttavīryārjunāyeti haihayeti padaṃ tataḥ || 8-784 ||
nāthāya śrīkārttavīryārjuneti ca sahasraśaḥ | karasadṛśasarveti duṣṭāntakapadāt paṭhet || 8-785 ||
sarvaśiṣṭeṣṭadapadaṃ sarvata udadheḥ padam | āgantukāmān pravadedasmadvasuvilumpakān || 8-786 ||
caurasamuhhān svakarasahasraiśca nivāraya | rundhasva pāśasahasrairbandhayeti tato'ṅkuśaḥ || 8-787 ||
sahasrairākarṣaya svacāpodbhūtapadāt tataḥ | vadedbāṇasahasraiśca bhindi bhindīti saṃvadet || 8-788 ||
svahastodgatakhaḍgeti sahasraiśchindhiyugmakam | svahastodbhūtamuśalasahasrairmardayadvayam || 8-789 ||
svaśaṅkhodbhūtanādeti sahasrairbhīṣayadvayam | svahastodbhūtacakreti sahasraidvirnikṛntaya || 8-790 ||
parakṛtyāṃ trāsaya dvistataścākarṣayadvayam | bhrāmaya dvirmohaya dvirudvāsayayugaṃ vadet || 8-791 ||
unmādayadvayaṃ dvedhā tāpaya dvirvināśaya | dvedhā vidāraya stambhayadvayaṃ jṛmbhaya dvayam || 8-792 ||
mārayadvitayaṃ procya vaśaṃ kuru vaśaṃ kuru | uccāṭayoccāṭayeti vināśaya vināśaya || 8-793 ||
dattātreyaśrīpadānte pādapriyatameti ca | śrīkārttavīryārjuneti sarvagaścodadhervadet || 8-794 ||
āgantukāmān pravadedasmadvasuvilumpakān | caurasamūhān samyak ca vadedunmūlayadvayam || 8-795 ||
hu(/) phaṭ svāheti mantro'yaṃ bāṇābdhyanalavarṇavān | proktaḥ pañcadaśaśchando gāyatryanyacca pūrvavat || 8-796 ||
dattātreyapriyatam ṅe'ntaṃ hṛdi tu vinyaset | māhiṣmatīti nāthāya śiromantro nagākṣaraḥ || 8-797 ||
revatī ca jalakrīḍāsaktāyeti śikhā matā | haihayādhipatirṅe'ntaḥ kavacaḥ parikīrttitaḥ || 8-798 ||
sahasrabāhave'straṃ syādevaṃ pañcāṅgamīritam |
atha dhyānam |
udagrabāṇā(/)ścāpāni dadhataṃ sūryasannibham || 8-799 ||
prapūrayantaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ dhanurjyāniḥsvanaistathā | kārttavīryaṃ nṛpaṃ dhyāyedgaṇḍaśobhitakuṇḍalam || 8-800 ||
evaṃ dhyātvā samabhyarcya sarvakarmāṇi sādhayet |
atha puraścaraṇam |
trisahasraṃ japaḥ proktaḥ śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaret || 8-801 ||
atha prayogaḥ |
dakṣottaraiḥ pratiśatairetānyastrāṇi saṃdadhat | cakreṣukhaḍgamuśalakuṭhārān pāśameva ca || 8-802 ||
prāsacarmadhanuḥśaṅkhān madhyabhāskarasannibham | balāḍhyamaruṇaṃ ghoraṃ tālamātaṅgasaṃsthitam || 8-803 ||
raktāmbaraṃ raktanetraṃ dhyātvaivaṃ prajapenmanum | niśīthe'ṣṭottaraśataṃ naṣṭadravyāptisiddhaye || 8-804 ||
japenniśyekapādena ṣaṇmāsānaṣṭayuk chatam | saṃprārthya mantriṇaṃ caurāḥ prayacchantyakhilaṃ dhanam || 8-805 ||
caurairhṛtapaśūn mantrī yadā netuṃ samicchati | japedaṣṭottaraśataṃ dhyāyeddevaṃ nṛpāśitān || 8-806 ||
kaṇṭhe samyak sarvapaśūn gṛhābhimukhamāgatān | dhyātvaivaṃ dvādaśāhena te cāyānti vimocitāḥ || 8-807 ||
cairairhṛtaṃ ca vīhyādi taccheṣaṃ homayenniśi | hṛtaṃ prakāśyate bhītaiścaurairjhaṭiti nānyathā || 8-808 ||
bāṇān praveśayedrātau dhanuṣā dhyānatatparaḥ | daśadikṣu japenmantraṃ rāṣṭrāde rakṣaṇaṃ bhavet || 8-809 ||
mantreṇa parijaptāni pārthivāni rajāṃsi ca | kṣiptāni mantriṇā yatra tatra rakṣā bhavenniśi || 8-810 ||
mantrāntaramāha |
phromityekākṣaro mantraḥ kārttavīryasya ṣoḍaśaḥ | munipūjādikaṃ prāgvallakṣamekaṃ puraskriyā || 8-811 ||
ṣaḍdīrghayuktenānena ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ | prāgvat prayogā ityevamūrdhvāmnāyaḥ prakīrttitaḥ || 8-812 ||
paścimāmyamantrāstu proktāścārabbabhāṣayā | aṣṭau śatānyaśītiśca yeṣāṃ saṃsādhanāt kalau || 8-813 ||
pañca khānāḥ sapta mīrāḥ nava śāhā mahābalāḥ | hindudharmapraloptāro jāyante cakravarttinaḥ || 8-814 ||
pūrvāmnāye navaśataṃ ṣaḍaśītiḥ prakīrttitāḥ | phiraṅgabhāṣayā mantrāsteṣāṃ saṃsādhanādbhuvi || 8-815 ||
adhipā mandarāṇāṃ ca saṃgrāmeṣvaparājitāḥ | iṅgrejā navaṣaṭpañca landrajāścāpi bhāvitāḥ || 8-816 ||
vidyā bauddhanidārśinyāṃ pañca proktāstu yā mayā | tadbījapūrvāḥ sarve'pi manavo vāmasiddhidāḥ || 8-817 ||
dakṣiṇācāraphaladaḥ kārttavīryārjuno nṛpaḥ | vāmācāreṇa śūdrāṇāmiha loke phalapradaḥ || 8-818 ||
na vāmināṃ hitārthaṃ tu kārttavīryaṃ prayojayet | saptajanmasu dāridryaṃ paiśācyaṃ prāpnuyādbijaḥ || 8-819 ||
iti kārttavīryaprakaraṇam |
atha hanumanmantrastatraiva |
athānyaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi mantramaṣṭādaśākṣaram | namo bhagavate procya āñjaneyāya saṃvadet || 8-820 ||
mahābalāya svāheti munirasyeśvaraḥ smṛtaḥ | chando'nuṣṭubdevatā tu hanumān ha(/) ca bījakam || 8-821 ||
svāhā śaktiścāñjaneyo rudramūrttirmarutsutaḥ | agnigarbho rāmadūto brahmāstravinivārakaḥ || 8-822 ||
etairṅe'ntaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni tathā'ṅguṣṭhādiṣu nyaset |
atha dhyānam |
taptakāñcanasaṃkāśaṃ hṛdaye nihitāñjalim || 8-823 ||
kirīṭinaṃ kuṇḍalinaṃ dhyāyedvānaranāyakam |
atha puraścaraṇam |
ayutaṃ prajapenmantraṃ daśāṃśaṃ juhuyāt tilaiḥ || 8-824 ||
viprasantarpaṇādyaṃ tu prāgvat siddho bhavenmanuḥ |
atha kānyāni |
jitendriyo naktabhojī pratyekaṃ sāṣṭakaṃ śatam || 8-825 ||
japitvā kṣudrarogebhyo mucyate divasatrayāt | bhūtapretapiśācādināśāyaivaṃ samācaret || 8-826 ||
mahāroganivṛttyai tu sahasraṃ tridinaṃ japet | yatāśano'yutaṃ nityaṃ japeddhyāyan kapīśvaram || 8-827 ||
rākṣasaughaṃ vinighnantamacirājjayati dviṣaḥ | sugrīveṇa samaṃ rāmaṃ saṃdadhānaṃ smaran kapim || 8-828 ||
prajapyāyutamātraṃ tu sandhiṃ kuryādviruddhayoḥ | laṅkādahantaṃ taṃ dhyāyannayutaṃ prajapenmanum || 8-829 ||
śatrūṇāṃ pradahedgrāmānacirādeva sādhakaḥ | prayāṇasamaye dhyāyan hanumantaṃ manuṃ japet || 8-830 ||
yo yāti so'cirāt sveṣṭaṃ sādhayitvā gṛhaṃ vrajet | yaḥ kapīśaṃ sadā gehe pūjayejjapatatparaḥ || 8-831 ||
āyurlakṣmyau pravartete tasya naśyantyupadravāḥ | śārdūlataskarādibhyo rakṣenmanurayaṃ smṛtaḥ || 8-832 ||
prasthānakāle caurebhyo duṣṭasarpādapi dhruvam | pucchākāre suvasane lekhanyā kokilotthayā || 8-833 ||
aṣṭagandhairlikhedrūpaṃ kapirājasya sundaram | tanmadhye'ṣṭādaśārṇaṃ tu śatrūṇāmayutaṃ likhet || 8-834 ||
tena mantrābhijaptena śirobandhena bhūmipaḥ | jayatyarigaṇaṃ sarvaṃ darśanādeva niścitam || 8-835 ||
yadvā jigīṣurnṛpatiḥ pūrvoktaṃ lekhayeddhvaje | dhvajamādāyoparāge saṃsparśānmokṣaṇāvadhi || 8-836 ||
māntrikājjāpayet paścāddaśāṃśena hutaṃ caret | sarṣapaistilasaṃmiśraiḥ saṃskṛte havyavāhane || 8-837 ||
gajasthaṃ taṃ dhvajaṃ dṛṣṭvā palāyante'rayo'cirāt |
atha mantrāntaraṃ tatraivoktam |
athānyaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi mantramaṣṭākṣaraṃ param || 8-838 ||
ṣaḍdīrghayuktā hṛllekhā praṇavena ca saṃpuṭā | aṣṭārṇo'yaṃ hanumato mantrarājaḥ prakīrttitaḥ || 8-839 ||
ṣaḍdīrghayuktabījena ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ |
asya ṛṣiḥ śrīrāmaḥ jagato chando hanumān devatā | atha dhyānam |
bālārkābhaṃ tribhuvanaṃ kṣobhakān sarvarākṣasān || 8-840 ||
tādenaiva trāsayantaṃ sugrīvādikasevitam | sundaraṃ rāmacaraṇadhyānaṃ dhyāyet samīrajam || 8-841 ||
asya puraścaraṇaṃ dvādaśasahasrajapaḥ sarvamasya dvādaśārṇavadityuktatvāt | dvādaśārṇamantro'pi tatraiva |
athāsyānyaṃ pravakṣyāmi dvādaśārṇaṃ mahāmanum | hau(/) bījaṃ samyaguccārya pūrvoktaṃ kūṭapañcakam || 8-842 ||
hanumate namo mantro rāmacandro munirmataḥ | jagatī chanda uddiṣṭaṃ hanumān devatā mataḥ || 8-843 ||
bījaṃ tu pañcamaṃ kūṭaṃ śaktirādyaṃ tu kūṭakam | ṣaḍbījaiḥ prathamairnyāsaḥ ṣaḍaṅgo'sya prakīrttitaḥ || 8-844 ||
kūṭapañcakaṃ tu |
ādyantākṛtivedārṇā vindurudrasvarānvitāḥ | hanūmatastvādyakūṭametat sādhaka uccaret || 8-845 ||
prakṛtyākṛtivedārṇā vindurudrasvarānvitāḥ | dvitīyakūṭametat syādādyantākṛtivarṇakāḥ || 8-846 ||
visargendusvaropetāstṛtīyaṃ kūṭamucyate | ādyantasiddhākṛtyabdhivarṇairīśasvarānvitaiḥ || 8-847 ||
sānusvāraisturyakūṭaṃ sādyaḥ sauḥ pañcamaṃ matam |
atha dhyānapuraścaraṇe |
dhyānaṃ pūrvoktamevāsya japedarkasahasrakam || 8-848 ||
daśāṃśaṃ juhuyādbrīhīn payodadhyājyasaṃyutān |
atha mālāmantrastatraiva |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi mālāmantraṃ vadeddhruvam || 8-849 ||
vajrakāya vajratuṇḍa vadet kapilapiṅgala | ūrdhvakeśa mahāveti la raktamukha kīrttayet || 8-850 ||
taḍijjihva mahāraudra daṃṣṭrotkaṭaka hadvayam | karāline mahā procya dṛḍhaprati ca hā vadet || 8-851 ||
hi laṅkeśvara vetyuktvā dhāya mahāvadet param | śetubandhamahāśailapravāha gaganecara || 8-852 ||
ehyehi bhagavan procya mahābalaparākrama | bhairavājñāpaya procya ehyehīti padaṃ vadet || 8-853 ||
mahāraudrapadaṃ procya dīrghapucchena veṣṭaya | vairiṇaṃ bhañjaya dvandvaṃ hu(/) phaḍbāṇārkavarṇavān || 8-854 ||
munyādyarcāprayogādi sarvaṃ sūryārṇavanmatam |
atha mantrāntaram | (sādhanasamuccaye)
namaḥ savindumuddhṛtya hanumantaṃ ca ṅe'ntakam || 8-855 ||
rudrātmakāya kavacamastraṃ cetyekavarṇakaḥ | mantro'yaṃ hariṇā pūrvaṃ datto gāṇḍīvadhanvine || 8-856 ||
etasya sādhanaṃ kṛtvā raṇe vijayamāptavān |
mantrāntaram |
svabījaṃ pūrvamuccārya ṅe'ntaṃ pavananandanam || 8-857 ||
vahnijāyāvadhiḥ prokto mantro'yaṃ surapādapaḥ | ṣaḍdīrghabhājā bījena mantrārṇairaṅgakalpanā || 8-858 ||
svaraiḥ kādyaiśca pādyaiśca prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ caret | dhyāyedraṇe hanūmantaṃ kapikoṭisamanvitam || 8-859 ||
dhāvantaṃ rāvaṇaṃ jetuṃ haṣṭvā satvaramutthitam | lakṣmaṇaṃ ca mahāvīraṃ patitaṃ raṇabhūtale || 8-860 ||
gurukrodhaṃ samutpādya gṛhītvā guruparvatam | hāhākāraiḥ sadarpaiśca kampayantaṃ jagattrayam || 8-861 ||
ābrahma ca samāvyāpya kṛtvā bhīmakalevaram | pūjā tu vaiṣṇave pīṭhe lakṣamekaṃ japaṃ caret || 8-862 ||
tataḥ siddhamanurmantrī sādhayet siddhimuttamām |
tathā |
brāhme muhūrte cotthāya kṛtanityakriyo dvijaḥ || 8-863 ||
gatvā nadīṃ tataḥ snātvā tīrthamāvāhya cāṣṭadhā | mūlamantraṃ tato japtvā siñcedādityasaṅkhyayā || 8-864 ||
saṃpūjya hanumantaṃ ṣaṭsahasraṃ japamācaret | evaṃ saptadinānte ca samāyāti kapīśvaraḥ || 8-865 ||
rātrau tribhāgaśeṣāyāṃ dadāti varamīpsitam | vidyāṃ vā'pi dhanaṃ rājyaṃ vā śatrunigraham || 8-866 ||
dadāti sādhakendrāya satyaṃ satyaṃ suniścitam |
iti hanumatprakaraṇam |
atha kāmantraḥ (śāradāyām)
brahmā bhūmyā samāsīnaḥ śāntivinduvibhūṣitaḥ || 8-867 ||
bījaṃ manobhuvaḥ proktaṃ jagattritayamohanam | ṛṣiḥ saṃmohanaḥ prokto gāyatraṃ chanda īritam || 8-868 ||
sarvasaṃmohanaḥ sākṣāddevatā makaradhvajaḥ | bījena dīrghayuktena ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ || 8-869 ||
atha dhyānam |
japāruṇaṃ ratnavibhūṣaṇāḍhyaṃ mīnadhvajaṃ cārukṛtāṅgarāgam | karāmbujairaṅkuśamikṣucāpaṃ puṣpāstrapāśau dadhataṃ bhajāmi || 8-870 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
lakṣatrayaṃ japenmantraṃ madhuratrayasaṃyutaiḥ | puṣpaiḥ kiṃśukajaiḥ phullairjuhuyāt taddaśāṃśataḥ || 8-871 ||
atha mantrāntaraṃ tatrāntare |
mānmathaṃ bījamuddhṛtya ṅe'ntaṃ kāmaṃ samuccaret | hṛdayāntaḥ ṣaḍarṇo'yaṃ jagatsaṃmohanakṣamaḥ || 8-872 ||
asya mantrasya hṛṣyādidhyānaparyantaṃ pūrvavat kāryam | puraścaraṇe viśeṣo yathā |
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ daśāṃśaṃ madhurāplutaiḥ | palāśakusumairhomaṃ kuryādvā cūtapallavaiḥ || 8-873 ||
iti kāmamantrapuraścaraṇam |
bibhratyadbhutabhūtibhūtapavacovaicitracitrāmṛta (-) srotaḥśālinisannibandhanasaritsaṃbhedamabhyarhitam | nepālendranarendranirmitapuraścaryārṇave'sminnagāt sadyuktisphuṭamauktikotkararucottuṅgastaraṅgo'ṣṭamaḥ || 8-874 ||
[iti śrīmanmahārājādhirājaśrīpratāpasiṃhasāhaviracite puraścaryārṇave gaṇeśādimantrapuraścaraṇavivecanaṃ nāmāṣṭamastaraṅgaḥ] || 8 ||
